pa'o| /de la bla ma'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten0 pa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phun sum tshogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa mthong ba rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /de la bdag gi yang dag pa'i nan tan rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bstenamamipa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyishegan du 'gro zhing chos mnyad pa'i phyir bsnyen bkur byed la/ ji ltar rjes su bstan pa bzhin du skrub cing bdag gis yang dag pa'i nan tan rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /de la byas pa gzo ba rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten shepa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de nyid de las man ngag dang yon tan rjes su thob nas byas pa gzo ba de rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /de la bla ma'i 'dod pa bsgrubar — pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten ⑦ pa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de nyid man ngag des skye bo mang po la phan par bya bamakyirjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /gzhan yang dad pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ldan pa'i bsam pa bsgrub ⑫pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa dang / 'bral ba'i bsam pa bsgrub pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa dang / mi 'bral ba'i bsam pa bsgrub nyapa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i bsam pa baspub 8 pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa'o/ /de la ldan pa'i bsam pa bsgrub ⑫pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang byams pa bsgom 8pa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la bde ba dang ldan pa'i bsam pas 57—69

——nga bde ba dang ldan par baspub0)pa rjes su dran pasatsho0theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /de la 'bral ba'i bsam pa bsgrub nyapa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa mini gang snying rje bsgom rgapa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can dmas la sdug bsngal dang 'bral ba'i bsam pa baspub pa 3 rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o—/ /de la mi 'bral ba'i bsam pa bsgrubarwakupa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni sang dga' ba bsgomashā— pa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la bde ba dang mi 'bral ba'i bsam pa bsgrub tsopa rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /de la kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i bsam pa bsgrub mi pa rjes su dran pa'i dad pa ni gang btang snyoms bsgom 1rtepa la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la tshe kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i bsam pa bsgrubawaṃ pa rjes su dran pas theg pa chen po la dad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub sems dpas theg pa chen po la dad pa'i rnam dzipa rab tu dbye ba tshad med pa 'di lta bu dag gis theg pa chen po la dad pa'i rnam pa rab tu dbye ba tshad med pa shes par bya'o/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag 'ikhrig brgyar yang de'i tsamatha' bde bar shes par mi 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po'i phyir theka pa chen po la rab tu dbye bar rib par bya'o/ /rab tu dbye ba'i le'u ste bsum pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa' dad pa thabs chen kyis rgasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa chen po'i phyir theg pa chen po la dad pa'i phan yon du 'tshal bar bgyi ba gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang 57—70

chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po'i phyir theg pa chen po la dad pa'i phan yon ni tshad med de/ de'i phyob/sa tsam zhig bstan par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam par 'phel bar byed pas rnam par 'phel ba dang ldan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / skal ba (mnyam pa dang 1 skal ba mi mnyam par sems skyed 1 pa dag las byang chub kyi sems skyed ṭa pa srung 4ba'i phyir kun srung ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni bdag gi don dang gzhan kyi ba don phun sum tshogs pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir don che ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnamasam —kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni chos kyi dbyings zab mo bstan pa'i rnam pa thams cad la mos pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir zab pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theb pa chen po la dad pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa chen po mngon par baspub zupa dang 'thun pa'i phyir mthu ka che ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thes pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can tshad med pa yongs su smin par byed pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir gzi brjid che ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dka/ par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad spub pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir ring du 'gro ba'o/ /risas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni bdud kyi —las dang mu stegs tsocan thams cad kyisashā theg pa chen po la mos pa mi sgul pa'i phyir mi sayo ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub 57—71

sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni mang du thos pa la brten tshe nas sems can thams cad kyi the tshom tsasacod pa dang / 'thun pa'i phyir nus pa'o| /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag pa'i nan tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang 'thun pa'i phyir sgrub par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni bdag dang gzhan dag mirnal 'byor chen po 'thobam —)pa dang lus dang ngag dang yid kyi zhe las 'dul ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su skong ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can thams cad phan tshun lus dang ngag gi gnod pa med pa yang dag par 'dzin du gzhug pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rikas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa0 ni sems can log par zhugs pa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang dka' ba spyod pa thams cad dang du blang peb dang 'thun pa'i phyir bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po laladad pa ni bskal pa mtha' ⑫yas par chos dkar po rnam par spel bar rtsol ba la yongs su mi skyo ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang tshob dang 'thun pa'o//rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems 57—72

can thams cad kyi don sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon par bsgrubashāpa dang 'thun pa'i phyir bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi jig pa chen po la dad pa ②ni 'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i ye shes bla na med pa la gnas nas sangs rgyas kyi chos bsgrub (pepa dang 'thun pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bskang ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa theg pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba'i yang dag par bstan pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir tshogs yongs su sdud pa dang 'thun pa'o/ /rikas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni bsod nams tshad med pa skyedarazicing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams yongs su gzung ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la ④mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba chen po dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge ba'i bshes kanyen yongs su gzung ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir shin tu yongs su gzung ba dang 'thun pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can dpag tu med pa labaldan pa dang 'bral༅ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i bsam pa bsgrubar pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir snying brtse bas non pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrul pa'i nyes byas kun tu spyod pa thams cad la 'dzematsho pa nye bar gnas pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir shin tu sbed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub 57—73

nga ——sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can log par zhugs pa dang | 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa thams cad la sgyid lug pa med pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir brtan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni nyin mtshan du dge ba'i phyogs chen po la mngon par brtson par byas pas yongs su mi skyo ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir sbyor ba legs par boms par byas pa'o/ /ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thes pa chen po la dad pa ni rigashā7 pa'i gnas lnga byang batshu1dang 'thun pa'i phyir legs par byang ba'o ka/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni dus thams cad du bzhin 'dzum zhing gsong por smra ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir 'thun pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni banod pa dang / ma dad pa dang / dngangs pamazidang / the tshom shādang —/ rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir rin po che lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni rgya che ba dang kha na ma tho ba med pa dang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' bas lus dang sems blom par byed pa'i phyir zla ba lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa na po la dad pa ni rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la r+ṣakhyab pa'i phyir nam mkha' lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni bsod nams dang ye shes tshad med pa yongs su bzungapa4ba'i phyir rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i gru lta dur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thes pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can thams cad kyipa— bde ba'i gnas yin pas rtsi chen po lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 57—74

theg pa chen po la dad pa ni ngan song dang ngan 'gro thams cad las 'da' bar byed pa'i phyir zam ba pa lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lo tog ṭ+wāskye ba'i rtsa ba byed pa'i phyir sa bon lta bur blta'o1 | /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i mtshon cha thams cad kyis gnod par mi 'gyur bar bsrung ba'i phyir ko cha lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rin po che phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sogs shing rngo sdud de rnamar —)par gnas par byed pa'i phyir gter chen po lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni de las gzhan du dad pa thams cad zil gyis kanon pa'i dbang rnyed pa'i phyir rgyal po lta bur blta'o r+ṣa| /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theka pa chen po la dad pa ni yun ring po nas rjes su 'brang ba'i ngan song dang gnod sems dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i las dang / nyon mongs pa'i dug gi gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir sman nad med byed lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba gcod pa la dad pa'i mtshon cha'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir rdo rje lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ṭ+wākyi theg pa shechen po la dad pa ni smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdub bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrub pa dang / bdung bar byed pa dang / mya ngan gyi me'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir chu lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa 57—75

chen po la dad pa ni mi 'dod pa thams cad dang phrad par byed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir ༅lag cha bzang po lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni rtag par rgyun du dkar po'i phyogs kyi chos rnam par 'phel ba'i phyir zla ba lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theka pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can tshad med pa la ye shes tshad med pas snang bar bya ba dang 'thun pa'i phyir nyi ma lta bur balha'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni dam pa'i chos kyi char 1tshad med pa 'bebs pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir sprin chen po lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjetheka pa chen po la dad pa ni gzhan nu stekas can dang / phas kyi cho rgol ba thams cad gzhom pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir lce 'bab pa lta bur blta'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po la dad pa ni sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'joms (5par byed pa dang 'thun pa'i phyir lo legs pa lta bur blta'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas mngon par shes te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi tshe rgyal po'i ba 'di nyid du bud med grong pa'i tha chad phyag dar byed pa ngan 'gro ba zhig byung ste/ des khyim bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig gipa kukhyim du sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan 'dren ces thos nas de ④bkres pa dang —/ skom pas nyen pas khyim bdag de'i khyim ga la ba der song ba dang /der 'khor gyi khyams shen sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rab tu zhi ba'i spyod lam du gnas pa dang bshos 'drimayo pa mthong ngo / /bud med des spyod lam phun sum tshogs pa de dang tshogs kyis bskor ba bamadzes pa de yang 57—76

mthong nas/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung rab tu zhi ba'i spyod lam dang / zhabs 'bringasheb mdzes pas mdzes so zhes dad pa'ishesems gcig bskyed nas de 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /de rgyu de nyid kyis sum cu kyirtsa gsum gyi 4lha'i nang du skyes pa nas rgyu de nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tusgyushenges par gyur pa'i bar du'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas mngon par shes te 'das pa'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi tshe rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid du zas 'dod ces bya ba'i bram ze zhig byung ngo / /zas 'dod de sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog la rang bzhin gyis ma dad na bsnyen 6bkur lta ga la zhig byed—/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms kyi phyir gshegs pa dang / bram ze de yang don zhig gnyer zhing rgyal po'i khab nas byung ngo / /de byung ba dang bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs de bzhin gshegs pa de khas bonam1 du mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang des gzugs mdzes pa la dmigs te/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po rnams kyisaphasku legs par brgyan to zhes dad pa'isnyesems gcig rnyed nas/ de 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /de rgyu des rab mtshe ma'i lha'i nang du skyes pa nas rgyu de nyid kyis rim gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur pa'i bar du'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas mngon par shes te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi tshe rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid du gzhan mu stegs can lnga brgya zhig 57—77

nga nga byung ste/ de dka skabs btsal ba'i bsam pas yang dab par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ga la ba der dong ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'khor brgya phrag duyo)mas bskor te mdun gyis byas nas chos ston cing bzhubs so/ /de na nu stegs can lnga brgya tsam po de dab gis kye ma'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ni snyan 1 pa gsung ba'o zhes dad pa'i sems kacig rnyed nas de dag 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /de dag rgyu des dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skyes pa nas rgyu de nyid kyis rim gyis kya nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ zas pa zad pa rjes su thob pa'i bar du'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas mngon par shes te/ gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pas 'od zer gang gis sems can dazul bar skyes pa'i misems can rnams sems can dmyal ba nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i 'od zer bkye bas des sems can dazul bar skyes pa'i sems can rnams la reg nas sems can dmyal ba'i gnod pa'i sdub bsngal thams cad rgyun chad de bde ba dang ldan par gyur nas/ de dag 'di snyam du sang gis/ bdag cab na3sems can dazul ba'i gnod pa'i sdurga bsngal thams cad rgyun bcad nas bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa 'di su'i mthu snyam pa dang 1 de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs nas de dag gis de bzhin gshesas pa'i sku mthong ngo / /mthong nas kye ma'o gang gis bdag cag thi sems can dmyal ba'i gnod pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun bcad nas bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa de'i mthu 'di ni mthu che ba'o snyam ste/ dad pa'i sems bcig rnyed nas/ de das 'chi ba'i dus byas te shi 'phos nas rgyu de nyid kyis mtshungs par de dag lhar skyes pa nas rim gyis rgyu de nyid kyis nga'i bstan pa la 57—78

gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa tshad ma mchis pa dag kyang brjod par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong byang chub sems dpa'i chos mngon par rtogs pa'i rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa chen po skyes so/ /'khor der 'dus pa las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lhag tsa ma rnams kyang mos pa las mi g.yo ba'i tshul gyis mos pa klung du byed pa'i bzod pa skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' dad pa thabs chen gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kang la la dag chos kyi nam grangs 'di la mos pa sngon du btang ste/ sbyor bar bgyid pa ni ring po mi thogs par de dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal zas dang / btung ba dang / bzhon pa dang /na bza' dang / rgyan dang / snod spyad dang / 'tshog chas dang / yo byad dang —/ sbos dang / phreng ba dang / byuka pa dang / glu dang / gar da nga /rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dang / mar me dang / bud med dang / skyes pa dang /kun spyod pa'i yo byad 'thobar1)par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dad pa'i snod yongs su tshol zubs byang chub sems dpa' dad pa thabs chen la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal zas dang | btung ba dang / bzhon zu pa dang / na bza' dang rgyan dang / snod spyad dang / 'tshog chas dang / yo byad gang yin/ sbos dang / preng ba dang /byug pa dang / glu dang / gar dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dang / mar me dang —/ bud med dang / skyes pa dang / kun spyad —pa'i yo byad0 gang yin/byang chub sems dpa' dad pa thabs chen gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sgrib pa 57—80

thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bsam gtan gyi dga' ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal zas so/ /sgrib4pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi khu⑧ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi btung ba'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ni nyade bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bzhon ④pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo tsha shes pa dang /khrel yod pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi na bza'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyan no/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i mang du thos pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi snod spyad dang / 'tshog chas dang yo byad do/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi rdzogs par longs spyod pa 'bel kuba'i gtam rnam par gdon mi za ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gru dang / gar dang —/ rol mo'i dbyangs sgra'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyipa mar me'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bud med dang / skyes pa dang / kun spyod pa'i yo byad do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa sngon du btang ste sbyor bar byed pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yo byad bcu po 'di dag ring po mi thogs par kun rdzob dang / don dam par yang thob 57—81

par gyuraban gang dag 'di latshu1de bzhin nyid du sbyor bar byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yo byad bcu po 'di dag thob par 'gyur ba'i steng du de das gis gzhal med khang gang la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs pa'i gzhal med khang de'ang thob par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs pa'i gzhal med khang ci 'dra/ byang chub sems dpa' dad pa thabs chen gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po shin tu 'byung ba/ gnas gzhan dag shin tu rnam par bye ba tshad med pa/ rnam par gzhab byupa 'khor kyi khyams yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum pa las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul gyi mtshan nyid 'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa gnas pa/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dpag tu med pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtanatshu4pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad mdzad pas nye bar gnas pa nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa thams cad kyi bkodalapa las lhag pa —de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 3bkod pa dran pa dang —/ blo gros dang / rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'gro ba/ zhi gnas dang 57—82

lhag mthong chen po'i theg pa/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa chen po nas 'jug pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs tshad med pas brgyan pa/pad ཿma chen po'i rgyal pos brtan pa'i gzhal med khang chen po na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs te/ rigs kyi bu gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa sngon du btang ste/ sbyor bar kubyed pa de dag gis de bzhin gshesas pa'i gzhal med khang de lta bu yang thob par gyur 1na/ gang dag de bzhin nyid du sbyor bar byed pa lta sbos kyang ci dgos bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/risas kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar khyod kyis bshad pa bzhin te | gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa sngon du btang nas sbyor bar byed pa de dag ring por —mi thogs par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yo byad 'di dag dang / de bzhin kashegs pa'i gzhal med khang de yang thob par 'gyur na—/ kang dag 'di la de bzhin nyid du sbyor bar byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dba' bos 'di skad ces gsol to—/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa dang / klog pa dang / yi ber 'drimamib dang / 'don pa dang / nyan pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / gzhan dab/ la'ang rgya cher rab tu ston pa dang / tshul bzhin sems pa dang / bsgom —pa'i rnam pas sbyor ba de dag bsod nams ji tsam skyed par 'grur / bcom ldan 'das kyis〈 cho bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang la la dag chos kyi rnam 1 grangs 'di la mos pa dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'dri bab dang / 'don pa dang / nyan pa dang —/ kha ton byed pa dang / gzhan dag la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 57—83

sngag /'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ tshob /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rardo lkam— tshonā ma 1ṅgā ra tī ma hā yā ④na sru tra—/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs zhesaragebya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/④ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig ba na—/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi —phung po'i ri la dge slong stong du tshang ba thams cad kyang dkar po'i chos yongs su rdzogs pa/ seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrog pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs dpab tu med pa tshol ba la mkhas pa sha stag gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig 1 tu bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na phyag rgya rin po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 57—94

rtag tu brtson dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyis brgyan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 3sems dpa' chen po bsod nams mngon 4bsgrags dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan bkod pa dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i ༅ blo gros dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'ir4 mtshon cha dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sra ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sazungs kyi blo gros dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don kun mthong dang /byang chub sems ༄dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros brtan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lab na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ngan song spong —dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mya ngan dang nun pa thams cad 'joms pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' kachen po mi len mi nya'ador ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tsan dan snying po dang / byang chub sems 57nga 96

dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'byung dka'abadang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dga' 'byung dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spobs pa brtseb/sa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mgyogs pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nges par byungadzamib/dbyangs sgra thogs pa med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa zil gyis gnon pa la mkhas pa/ mi 'jigs pa la gnas pa/ rjes su chags pa dang khong gu khro ba dang bral ba/ yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ khams gsum la ma chags pa/ g.yog 'khor mi byed pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las nges par skyes pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ re ba thams cad yongs su skong ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par khong du chud pa/ lus dang ngab dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' don yod pa la mos pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par brtson pa—/ ting nge 'dzin dang spyod pa tshad med parar—byin gyis brlabs pa/ mi 'jigs pa thob pa/ stong pa nyid 1 spyod yul ba/ mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa sha stag dang yang thabs cig —)go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das 57nga 96

la 'di skad ces sasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ji ltar rtogs par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rikas kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni dngos po med par rtogs par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / spros pa med pa dang ma spros pa dang blang bakhyamed pa dang dor ba med pa dang dngos po med pa dang / gnas pa med pa ste de ltar rtogasakupar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos kyi dbyings 'byung ba lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni 'byung ba med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni dngos po med par ཿ rtobs pa ste/ dngos po gang du yang brjod par bya ba ma yin zhing bstan par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos kasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub la rnam pa du mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi rnam pa ni tshad med de de ni tshad dang ldan par bstan zi par mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/chos kyi dbyings rnam par rtog 3 par bgyid dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi dbyings ni rnam par mi rtog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa lags na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ci'i slad du rtog par bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad ni ④ rtog/ pa dang / rnarna par rtog pa dang /57—97
di wa snye ༷/ ne rdo ༷ tho rdo rdeX /ji/ khro twe wa nga tsar+shabye snge bye tshe traṃ ༷ |/bye sdom 'a 4 ca ༷ dro rte/ rwa lnga / ༷saX )bye hūṃ wa

yongs su rtog pa las byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin bshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub 'dirwa33ni zab lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ cim1skad smras pas1bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang chos thams cad spros pa med pa ni byang chub ces bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal sa/zhon nur gyur pa 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis —dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad du gsol 1 bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po — chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa la gnas pa 'di la dris shig dang / 'disararje nga la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gruramuchupas bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs te 'dug nas sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzirgas pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis ci'i slad du mi bshad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu gang na byang chub sems dpa' yon tan 'di lta bu dang ldan pa dag 'khod pa ( de na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhugs so/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nir+sha btang snyoms su bzhubs pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/rigs kyi bu nga ni sems can gyi khams yal bar 'dor ba ma yin te/ rigs kyi du 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bstan pa ni bstan pa tshad med cing 57—98

da 1 / rnaX su / mi traṃ / ngh+ru traṃ dī zlo traṃ sdi rna zhi tsha nge rdo ga ༷ da r+ṣa tre/ladu ༷ 3 gre na snye da / je / nga rngo / |slo ba ka hūṃ rdo / daX nga ri/ bye dz+wa cha gli yang sa/ kyi/ gā su a rgarna di twe nā de / miX ༷sa da da / ༷ ṭī chu ṭ+wāṃ / ṭā shā sdu45 t+ta

bstan pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi kyeba'i gzungs bshad du kasol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'di la dris shig dang / 'dis tsakhyod la ston par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na—/ rigs kyi bu skyes bu dam pa 'di ni ye shes kyi tshogs la gnas pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pas bdag la dgongs na bdag gis skyes bu dam pa 'di la drikubar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / 'jam dpal nga kyis ting nge 'dzin rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thob pa yin namamide bzhin kashegs pa la gsol ba sadab ci dbos/ rikas kyi bu khyod ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la skal ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das — bdag bis sangs rgyas kyi chos gang dag kun tu bsten pa dang / bsgomasashepa dang mang du bgyis pa de thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthur rib 1par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu tsalegs so legs so/ /nga kyisatso tshig 'di legs par smras te/ 'od kyang 'jam dpal nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs kyis ⑪khyod byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la dris shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to| /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'di ni shin tu zab mo ston pa ste/ theg pa chen po rtogs par khong du chud pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyang chos thams cad kyi 57—99

dbang phyug gi rgyal po yin gyis༅bdag la ma gsungakushig /yang rigs kyi bu khyod ni stong pa nyid la gnas pa'i ④ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'o| /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces sprus so/ /kye4rgyal ba'i sras khyod kyis bdag la skabs bye na khyod la bdag yi ge 'bru gnyis shig 'dri'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus la dbab parakushes྾)na dris shig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad nyaces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i gzhi'i don gang yin/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos sprus pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni gzhi med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni dngos po med pa'i don to—/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni sprosam 3pa med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni ma spros pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni blang ba med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni dor ba med pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i don to/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'i don ni bsnyad du med pa'i don tshe⑨/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ni de lta bu yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras kal te chos thams cad spros pa med pa yin na/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams shes ji skad 57—100

bstan—/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 1 bstan pa 'di ni bstan du med pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bstan du med na ci zhika bstan/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal bstan du med pa ni btakas te bstan to/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras btags pas ci zhig 'dogs par byed/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal btags pas ni dngos po yang mi 'dogs/ dngos po med pa yang mi 'dogs so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras gal te btags pas dngos po yang mi 'dogs dngos po med pa yang mi 'dogs na theg pa gsum po das ji ltar bstan/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ 'jam dpal nga chos kyi dbyings chags pa med pa la chags par ma byed/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o zhes bstan pa'i phyir te/ gang dngos po med pa'i phyir zhe na/ phung po lngatshu3dmigs pa med༅pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ byang chub spros pa dang bcas pa yin nam/ 'on te spros pa med pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyibu byang chub ni spros pa dang bcas pa yang ma yin/spros pa med pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar byang chub dang / spros pa dang bcas pa dang / spros pa med pa de bani gnyis su med de gnyis su dbyer med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la rigs kyi bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa 'di legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /btam 'di brjod pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di 57—101

la rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos bstan pa 'di lta bu ni rnam pam༅'tshal bar mi rung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rikas kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad btags pa 'dis btags pamukyelags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te| ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag pa'i sgo 'di ni mos par bgyi dka' ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de nas brtsom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos rnam par dag pa'i sgo bstan pa 'di legs par smras lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang 'di ni chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'thunarwashepa yin no/ /'di ni chos kyi char chen po yin no/ /de nas shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bram ze mnyam pa nyid du gnas pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub ni mnyam 1 pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa lags te/de la yi ge mi dmigs/ tshig 'bru mi dmigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ chos kyi dbyings la tshig 'bru misgyu pa snang —/ don kyang mi snang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal 57—102

gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces kasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid kyi rgyu 'thunashā)pa gang lags/ rnam pa gang lags/ rtags gang lags/mtshan ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal stong pa nyid ni brjod du med pa/ bsnyad du med pa ste/ brjod du med pa'i chos nyid 'di la mos pa gang yin pa de stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid de ni yi ge med pa ste/ de'i phyir stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid de ni bsnyad du med pa ste/ de'i phyir stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /ribs kyi bu chos thams cad ni chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyis 4stong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sham —ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces sasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos la gnas pa rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa ni mchoka yin gyi dgra bcom pa'i shes pa ni de lta shem yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na—/ dgra bcom pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las ring du banas la/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po྾chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos 'di skad ces kasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis 4gsungs pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na nyan thos kyis ni shenyan thos kyi chos rnams ma thob pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu nyan thos kyis nyan thos kyi chos rnams ma thob pa ni ma yin te/ 'on kyang nyan thos la byang chub sems 57—103

hāsdu shī na nā ge r+ṣa da shā ṭā ༷/ga sgru gupas ༷su ༷ pre dro dza/ ༷ ca rna da / ༷ / mi rna: rngo ༷ ༷ dbyi /khro dri ༷ she// tre/ /ṭā ཿ ༷ ste/ da daX pa bsdi swā da saX tre dajirte//zi / / / / sdu rnam rdo // ji da rdo su ji

dpa' dang lhan cig tu dris pa la lan gdab pa'am/ spyod pa'i ⑫byin gyis brlabarakhyapar bya ba'i nus pa dang mthu ga la yod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags na bstan pa 'di gang la bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal ngas gang bstan pa 'di ni bstan pa med pa'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan gyis nyan thos kyi chos rnams thob bam/ smras pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis sprus pa②/ 'o na ci khyod so so'i skye bo'am/ smras pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/'o na ci bakhyod 1slob pa'am/ smras pa de ni ma yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa—/ 'o na nga ci shes rab dang ldan pa'i mchog yin nam/ smras pa de ni ma yin no1 /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ gal te btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i du so so'i skye bo yang ma yin/ slob pa yang ma yin/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i mchog kyang ma yin na de nyid nga dmigs pa can du 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/rigs kyi bu kho bo ni skyes bu dam pa rgya mtsho lhar gting dpag dka' ba khyod dang 'gyed par mi byed do/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod ni rgan rabs thu bo mchog yin gyis btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de skad ma zer cig /gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu rgas pa'i dngos posad ni ci yang 'thob 3 par mi 'gyur/ mngon par rtobs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu don de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir nga la dpe bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste 57—104

dper na rdo rje ngan ngon gyis kyang ri brag chen po rnam par 'jig go/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du khyod kyi spu'i khung bu bcig na shes rab 'dug pa gang yin pa de ni kho bo lta bu'i sems can rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed rnams la med do/ /rigs kyi bu don de nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir yang nga la dpe bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ ba lang4glang shepo che shin tu mi bzad pa chen po de yang mi stobs dang ldan pas lcags kyu chung rkengus dul bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du khyod ni stobs dang ldan pa/ kho bo ni nyam chung ba ste/ glang po che chen po 'di lta bu dang kho bo 'gyed ga la nus/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/dper na mi danus long gis shul du mchi ba'am/ grong khyer mthong bar yang rngo mi thogasapa④na khyim nas khyim du mchi ba'i rngo lta ga la thogs te④/ dewaṃni gnas ma mchis soku / /de bzhin du glang po che chen pokulta bu 'di dag gi mdudatshon bdag ni dmus long dang mtshungs par mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag ni de tsam du rgya che ba lags so/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi sdod du ma gyur te/ da ci bgyir yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de skad ma zer cig /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/dper na de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis sems can ji snyed cig la reka pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob pa yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du khyod ni ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa yin no| /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lha dang mi'i skye dgutsalas sems can dgu khri nyis stong gis chos mngon par rtogs par 57—106

gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dkon mchog ta la la sbyor ba mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba de la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jis rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab 3kyi rdul snyed kyi pha rol nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrab bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyis zhal mngon par bstan te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang mtshan rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar 'thunadz+wa pa sha stag go/ /phyogs gcig ji lta bar phyogs bcu rnams nas kyang de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos kyi blo gros khyod de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyor ba mtha' yas pa la snyoms par zhusas pa lekas so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin sashegs pa rnam par snang mdzad 'di nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang / sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs shudang / khyod nyid kyi dge ba'i rtsa bsar nye bar brtan snyepas 'di lta ste chos thams cad bstan par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par sbyang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings su 'jug par bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams rnam par dgrol ba dang / chags pa med pa'i ye shes la 'jub cing —dachud par bya ba dang / kun du sbyor bar bya ba dang / skad thams cad brjod par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'jug par bya ba dang / chos thams cad la sgrib pa med par bya ba dang / dus gsum thams cad yongs su shes pa'i chos bstan pa la 57—106

da rtsa tsha cas // misde / ༷tso // rngo trī ma wa rtse rnge sdu bye sdo / /lnga rte wa rtsi sdo ༷ ༷ sno rde byed twe saX / twe nga gaXl nga / tsho /wa/ 2bye / / rde — bye zlo da/da/ ༷ 'u cad ciX / rngo rtordo ༷ kri

'jug par bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcu nas de bzhin gshegs pa yosangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrab bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thams cad kyang mtshan 'thun par ②'di dag thams cad khyod la byin gyis rlob kyis tsarigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhaka pa bcu las brtsams te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs ④kyis chos bstan pa 'di la spobs pa skyed cig /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang zub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la thokas pa med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang / sgrib pa med pa dang /chod pa med pa dang / brjed kapa med pa'i chos nyid dang / tha dad pa med pa'i ④ ye shes dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / zil gyisam0mi non pa dang /zhum pa med pa dang / 'phrogasas dpa med pa'i chos nyid dang / brjod pa bzang po nye bar skrub pa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis phyag g.yas pa brkyang steyi/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo grosayikyi mgo la nyug pa mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo grogro la reka ma thag tu/ de nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dab byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rikas 'di ni 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas katugs tshopas rgya che ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dab 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin/ da ltar byungawaṃ 57—107

ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gang dag 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang | da lhar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni gang yin/ gang las bsams te ཿde skad smra/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa bcu po de dab gang yin pa de shod cig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces spras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ de dag ni 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ga/sungs so/ /gsung ngo / /sasung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam paratshurdogazhag pa dang / las dang po pa dang /rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / skye bar skyes pa —dang / sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang —/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang gzhon nur gyur pa dang rgyal tshab dang / dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhaka pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa ni bcu po de dag ste/ de dag ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so④/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye 57—108

rgyal ba'i sras dag de la sems dang po bskyed⑪pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong ma thag tu gzugs 1bzang ba'am/ mdzes pa'am/ kha dob bzang po rgyas pa'am/rgya che ba'am/ gzi bajid che ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'am/kun rjod ②pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'am/ rjes su bstan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngam/ sems can sdug bsngal ba dag mthong ngam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa rgya cher thos na 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dod cing thog ma nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzobs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /sems bskyed ma thag pa de nyid kyis bsnyen par dka' baba'i gnas bcu yongs su bzung bar 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da lhar byung ba'i las dang ④chos yang dag par blangs —3pa shes pa dang /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam shes pa dang / khams du ma sna tshogs shes pa dang /mos pa dang rnam par grol ba du ma shes pa dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang ldang ba 33thams cad shes pa dang / sngon gyi rganas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa dang / lha'i mig gi shes pa dang / zag pa zad pa zeshes pa ste/bsnyen par dka' ba'i gnas bcu po de dag yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 57—109

rnam par gzhab pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 8chen po de sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'ipa —bde ba'i yo byad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la 'jig rten gyi bdab por 'gyur ba dang / mchog tu bya ba dang zil gyis mi gnon pa dang /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa dang phrad pa dang / rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rnal 'byor du bya ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par bzlog pa dang /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / sems can sdug bsngal ba yongs su bskyab pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems bskyed tsa ma thag pa de nyid kyis rngo shas cher sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la sbyor zhing gong du banas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi/ gzhan gyi dring nal mi 'job pa thob —)pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dab 'di ni sems dang po bskyed nyapa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bzhagamasnyapa'o— /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la las dang po 3pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhas mipa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can rnams la thog ma nyid du sems rnam pa bcu bskyed de/ rnam pa bcu gang rtsenyazhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phan par bya ba'i sems dang bde bar bya ba'i sems dang / snying brtse ba'i sems dang / mnyen pa'i sems dang / sdub pa'i sems dang / phan gdags tsopa'i sems dang / kun du bsrung pa ba'i sems dang / snyoms pa'i sems dang / slob dpon gyi sems dang —/ ston pa'i sems te/ sems rnam pa bcu po 'di dag bskyedar+shado/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal 57—110

da wa / bye bya ༷ // — snro 2 pa/ gli ca — zlo /ji nge da ༵ ri /tred shā / ༷ bye ༷ / ched na wa da / t+t+waṃ rngoX stu 2 pa nga sna ༷༷ rgyaX da she / /bye phyi hā rna rngobye wa /kye su / hūṃ wa 'i nga sdi nga ༷ rde ༷ ji

ba'i sras dag las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de lung mnod pa dang /kha ton la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mang du thos nas rab tu dben pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rab tu dben par gyur nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mngon par dga' ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbe ba'i bshes gnyen la mngon par dka' nas bka' blo bde ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bka' blo bde bar gyur nas dus shes pa la sbyar bar bya'o1 /dus shes par gyur nas mi 'jigs pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mi 'jigs par gyur nas don shes pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /don shes nga ra gyur nas chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba nyal sbyar bar bya'o/ /chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar gyur nas brjed pa med pa'i chos nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rmongs pa med par gyur nas chos rnam par dgod pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lhar sems bskyed ma thag pa de nyid kyis shas 2cher sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mngon par brtson par byed cing gong du gnas gang dag thob pa'i sanas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi sazhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhas pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la mirnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dmigs pa rnam pa bcus chos rnams rtobs par byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad la mi rtag pa nyid du rtokas par byed pa dang / chos thams cad la sdug bsngal ba nyid dang /bdag med pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / g.yo ba med pa nyid dang /dbugs 'byin pa med pa nyid dang / gnas med pa nyid dang / rnam par 57—111

rtog pa med pa nyid dang / rtsol ba med pa nyid dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa nyid du rtogs (3par byed de/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar gyur pa'i phyir sbyor bar mi byed/ mi sbyor bar yang mi byed de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni sems can gyi khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o—/ /chos kyi dbyings brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sa'i khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /chu'i khams dang me'i khams dang rlung gi khams dang nam mkha'i khams dang /gzugs kyi khams dang bzugs med pa'i khams brtag pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar demusheni shas 1cher chos rnams la snang ba 'jug ci nga gong du gnas gang dab thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhagadza—pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dab skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhab pa gang zhe na/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yongs su sbyong bkadabyed pa bcus gsung rab 'phags par skyes pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na—/ 'di lta ste/ chos nyid las phyir mi zlogs rngo pa dang / sangs rgyas la mi byed pa'i dad pa mthar thuka par 'gyur ba 3yongs su grub pa dang / chos nges par sems pa dang / sems can la rnam par dacad pa dang / zhing la rnam par dpyodapa bapa dang / 'jig rten la rnam par dpyod pa dang / las la rnam par dpyod pa dang / rnam par smin pa la rnam par dpyod pa dngashe/ 'khor 57—112

ba la rnam par dpyod pa dang4/ mya ngan las 'das pa la rnam par dpyod pa ste/yongs su sbyong ba ②byed pa bcu po de dag gis gsung rab 'phags par skyes pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa 1 la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid ④rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyadarkupa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad 4pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos yongs su 'grub pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par dpyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shas cher dudu gsum mnyam pa nyid dumadzirtogs par byed cing / gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdaka nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog 57—113

pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni skye bar skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de 4la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam 3par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i las gang ci rtsom yang de dag thams cad sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan 1par 'dod par bya ba dang /sems can thams cad la bde bar sbyar ba dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad rab tu thar bar bya ba dang /sems can thams cad la gnod paXmed par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad drang bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad dad par mabya ba dang /sems can thams cad gdul bar bya snyeb dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir rtsom ste6/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la gnas bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu bang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can mtha' yas pa dang rje sems can dpag tu med pa dang / sems can grangs med pa dang /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sems cad mtshungs pa med pa dang /sems can gzhal du med pa dang / sems can stong pa nyid dang / sems can g.yo ba med pa nyid dang / sems can med pa nyid dang / sems can rang bzhin med pa nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shas cher mngon par zhen pa med pa la sems 'jog cing gong du gnas 3 gang dab thos pa'i 57—114

gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te⑫/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum 1tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par sazhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni chos bcu thos na 4sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad shākyang rungs —sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ chos kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung — / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung ste—/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i bsngags pa'am/ bsngags pa ma yin pa 'chad kyang rung ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa yin/ sems can gyi khams rgya chung zhes 'chad pa'am/ sems can gyi khams rgya che zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams gdul sla zhe'am/ sems can gyi khams gdul dka' zhe'am/ chos kyi dbyings rgya chung zhe'am/ chos kyi dbyings rgya che zhe'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams dka 'jig ce'am mi 'jig ce'am chos kyi dbyings yod ce'am chos kyi dbyings med ces 'chad kyang rung ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bsam pa nges pa ḍayin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 57—116

sras dag bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya ba dang /chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa nyid dang /med pa nyid dang / brdzun yopa nyid dang / dben pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / sgyu ma lta bukunyid dang / mi lam lta bu nyid dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar de mi 'phrogasakupa'i phyir shas cher lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par 'phel ba'i chos can du gyur cing / gong du gnas bang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dmigs pa bcu thos ka —/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyasakuyod do zhe'am —med do zhes sa kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog pa dang —/ chos yod do zhe'am med do zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yod do zhe'am med lngado zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yod do zhe'am med do zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kubyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la nges par 'byung ngo zhe'am nges par mi 'byung ngo zhes bya ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dag 'das so zhe'amapha ma 'das so zhes bya ba dang / de 57—116

tre / ཿ / skre ༷daX/ / traṃ / // da skre / dasaḥ /da/ traṃ rwa sdu tre / ra ci nga ga tre ༷sa da nga dī pe 2 de da rte 2 sdu 0 gi tso / / traṃ da sa tho /glu rdo mi // rnaḥstu/ ༷༷ bye // / dze+e ཿ swā / wa zhi ཿ rgya ngaX tre rngo ne — wa / ༷ zi —da sdu pa ra da /nga zhiX/byi du da nga ngargya rjongag

bzhin gshegs pa dgab byon to zhe'amamanyabyon pa ma yin no zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dag mid ltar byung ba'o zhe'am/ da ltar byung ba ma yin no zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zad do zhe'am/ mi zad do zhes bya ba dang | dus gsum po dag mtshan nyid gcig ce'am/ mtshan nyid gcig pa mayin no zhes thos kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldob pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos kyi rgyun bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad gcig pa nyid dang / tha dad pa nyid du yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /mang ba dang gcig pa nyid dang / yi ke la don sgro btags pa dang 1 don la yi ge sgro btags pa dang / — dngos pos dngos po med pa sgro btags pa dang / dngos po med pas dngos po sgro btags pa dang / mtshan mas mtshan ma med pa sgro btags pa dang / mtshan ma med pas mtshan ma sgro btags pa dang / mtshan nyid kyis mtshan nyid med pa sgro btags pa dang / mtshan nyid med pas mtshan nyid sgro btags pa yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de shas cher chos thams cad la mkhas pa yongs su smin — pa'i tshul la nges par 'byung tshezhing gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dab la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi bzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thob pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhaka pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras darga 'di la gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang 57—117
rgyu/ wa sge / rnaXri lnge / wa khye/bye rna zlo 'ad/ skre kwa sdu hūṃ rde ṅge / /sdo twe bye ri ñca wa ngaX/ / nga ra // rde / ri / ༷da// traṃ sduX bye / | bye da mi da/

chub sems dpa' ni chos rtogs pa bcu dang ldan pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ lus kyi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin/ ngag gi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin/ yid kyi las 'bras bu yod pa dang ldan pa yin—/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis skye ba mngon par spubashāpa yin/ sems can gzhan dag midang / gang zag gzhan rnams kyi bsam pa shes par byed cing mos pa la rtog tsapa yin/ sems can gyi khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/'dod pa'i khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/ gzugs kyi khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams tha dad pa rab tu shes pa yin/dus ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i phyir zumangon par shes pa myur ba yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dab 'di ni gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhon nur ——gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'aXde la chos mngon par sgrub —— pa bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab tu g.yo bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dpyad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par 'gro ba dang / dri ba grangs med pa ledri ba dang —/ yid kyi lus mngon par sgrub —dpa dang / sgra skad la sbyor ba tshad med pa dang / sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa yongs su 'grub pa yang dab par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de (dashas cher mngon par sgrub tshipa mkhas pa la sbyor zhing / gong du gnas gang dag thos pa'i gnas de dag la yang bdag nyid sbyor gyi gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa thobawaṃpa'i 57—118

phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag༅pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par kazhag pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la 1rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' ni chos rtogs par bya ba bcu la mkhas pa yin te—/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi 1 skye ba rtosas par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ nyon mongs pa rgyu ba rtogs par bya ba la malas pa yin/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba rtobs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ spyod yulaXl sbyor ba rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ chos nyid rtokasapar bya ba la mkhas pa yin—/ nye bar spyad 4pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dbye ba rtokas par bya ba la mkhas pa yin/ sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba shes pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa choyin/kun rdzob kyi bden pa la4 nges par rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa yinam( te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dka rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' de la gnas bcu yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor la malas pa yang dag par brngod par bya'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor kun du spyad r+shapa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du 'jug pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du rnam par dpyad tu pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang bskur ba dang —/ chos kyi rgyal po'i byin gyi rlabs la dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i pha rol kanon pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung yang dag par brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i sems 57nga 119

ji kyi sde zhiX /rto ze rto wa ༷ / / rto rte ṣe kā tho bye rdo sdu ཿ rdo miX rna nga / wa wa ratso sa ༷/ char ṭ+wāṃ du rā rdoXrdo 2 ༷༷ tre ༷/sto ༷ / rtsi hā tshaX tre twe 2 bye da ༷ rdo r+sāsna nga // dkyis / tre ṅge rde

nus—/ rdzu 'phrul4rnam par lta ba shes par mi nus/ 'das pa'i dus la rnam par lta ba shes par mi nus shing byumangon par 'du byed pa shes par mi nus/blos rnam par lha ba shes par mi nus/ sems kyi yul shes par mi nus/ ye shes kyi spyod yul shes par mi nus te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de 3la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gnas bcu yang dag par brjod pa mdzad de/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/dus gsum shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbungadz+wa5med pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par dgang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad pyin gyis brlab pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su shes pa dang / chos thams cad mngon par shes pa dang / sangs rgyasaXkyi ye shes mtha' yas pa brjod pa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shas cher thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sems 'jug pa'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gzhag pa bcu bshad ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu'ipa6phyosas re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos/rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun 57—121

du rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg go/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /'khrugs sgyu/ rab tu 'khrubs 3 /kun du rab tu 'khrukas so / /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / chos nyid thob pas lha'i me tog mi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i bdug pa'i sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i sbos kyi sprin gyi char yangatshu1mngon par bab bo / /lha'i bye ma'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i phreng ba'i sprin 1 gyi char dang /lha'i gos kyi sprin kyi char dang / lha'i rin po che'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i pad ma'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i rgyan phreng gi sprin gyi char dang / lha'i rgyan gyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyang ma dkrol ba bar sgra byung ngo / /lha'i snang ba yang rab tu byung ngo / /lha'i nga ro yang grag go/ /gling bzhi pa 'dir ri rab kyi rtse mor lha'i dbang po'i khang par ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi lams thams cad du yang chos bstan pa 'di khyab par gyur nas byung ste lhag chad med do/ /tshig 'bru 'di dag nyid kyis don 'di nyid ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams kyi pha rol nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed lhags te/ phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid 'di ston pa legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang ming chos kyi blo gros zhes bya ba sha stag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi sprin ces bya ba dag nas de bzhin bshegs pa'i mtshan chos kyi blo gros bzang po zhes bya 57—122

ba sha stag gi thad nas 'dir phyin to/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisamatsho de dag thams cad dumapechos bstan pa 'di byung ste/ 'khor 'di lta bu das gi nang du tshig 'bru 'di dag gis don 'di nyid ston te/ lhag chad med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdab cag ni khyod kyi dbang du gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi lams 'dir phyin to/ /bdag cag/ ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin pa de bzhin du phyokas bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa thams cad du ri rab kyi rtse mor lha'i dbang po'i khang pa rnams su yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i 1 rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed phyin zipar gyur toka/ // bam po gnyis pa/ she de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor dang / chos kyi dbyings la yang rnam par bltas nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rang byung shin tu rnam das blo mnga' ba/ /mjos shing bzugs kyi stobs dang ldan gyur pa/ /bsnyen ba dka' mtshan gyis brgyan pa mthong gyur nas/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /do zla med pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun brjod 3bzang dang rjes su bstan pa dang —/ /sdug bsngal bzod rlarla 1 'jig rten 'gro mthong nas/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung sanas de bzhin gshebs—/ /kun du bzang po'i yon tan thos grur nas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /gnas rnams ji snyed gang dag yod gyur dang / /rang bzhin gnas pa'i ⑨gnas 57—123
