rnams gzhan dag kyang / /gzhan min dngos por rnam par rtogs bya'i⑪phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan she pa sems 'jog byed/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dus dag na/ /dge dang mi dge'i ༅las rnams gang yod pa/ /de dag rgyu rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /ting 'dzin bsam gtan rnam thar spyod pa dang / /de bzhin snyoms 'jug rnam dag mthar thug pa/ /de dag gnas skabs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jika rten brtson 'grus stobs dang dbang po rnams/ /ci 'dra ci 'dra de yi de dang mder/ /rim pa de dag rtokas par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'jig rten kun gyi mos pa ci 'dra dang / /lhag pa'i bsam pa tha dad rnam gsum nas/ /bstan bcos du ma rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan lapa sems 'jog byed/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma'i khams/ /gang dag 'jig rten gsum 'dir yod kun gyi/ /khams kyi rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir—/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems de ༄ — 'jog /chos 'dir kun du 'gro bar rgang gyur cing 4/ /dge ba'i 'jug pa gang yang rab 'jug pa/ /yang dag rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang ba don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams thams cad ji ltar 'byung ba dang / /sems can ji ltar sa las tsu'abyung 'grur zhes/ /chags med mig ni rab tu dbye ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'das pa'i dus dang da ltar byung dus nashe/ /sems can ris dngos mtshan nyid gang yod dang / /sngon gyi gnas rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /57—124

ji ltar 'gro bar sems can 'ching byed pa/ /kun du sbyor ba 'jig rten gang yod pa'i/ /nyon mongs zad pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jig rten gsum na tha snyad gang btags dang / /ngag lam sngags tshul spyod pa kang yod pa/ /brda yi bden pa rtobs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /chos rnams thams cad brjod du med pa ste/ /stong pa mi g.yom33rang bzhin ngo bo nyid/ /dod dam bden pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed—/ /zhing rnams dag tu sa g.yo bstan pa dang / /rgya mtsho dag kyang rnam par 'khrukasakupa dang / /de bzhin gshegs kyi4rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtanam9pa sems 'jog byed༄/ /'od zer rtse mo re las 'od zer rnams| /de bzhin phyogs bcu kun du rab tu 'gyed/ /de dag 'od gcig rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing mang bsam gyis mi khyab gang yod pa/ /de dag rang gi lag tu mngon sprul te—/ /sgyu ma'i tshul deyo3rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams ji ltar de bzhin sems can kun/ /rganod pa med par lag pa'i mthil bzhag nas/ /chos rnams srog med rtogs par bya ba'i phyir—/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /rgya mtsho rnams na ji snyed chu yod pa/ /skra rtse'i thigs 7pa'i nang du 'jug par byed/ /ma lus mthar thug rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /zhing rnams kun na phra rab rdul gyi bag1 /gang yod de dag ma lus bgrang byed cing / /phra rab rdul grangs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub 57nga 125
da 2 shā ༷ wa miX hūṃ cu ༷ /༷rware rdo sdi ngh+ru /rdo ཿ/ ༷ ༷༷ ngh+ru ṭ+wāṃ dhe ngh+ru r+shaX / sdu snyo wa wa bye ༷rna da — sdu ga ma rngoX / / ༷

don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'jig rten 'di na 'das dang de 1bzhin durje /ma 'ongs sres kapa'i bskal pas 'jigasarwagepa rnams/ /bskal pa zad pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /dus gsum dag gi de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /ston pa rang rgyal thos las byung rnams kyi/ /chos kyi rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten khams kyirapernams/ /skra yis bcings nas ma lus srang la 'debs/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'joka /khor payug ri bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skra yis bcings nas ma lus srang la 'debs/ /rags dang phra ba rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'job /lus pa med pa'i 'jika rten khams rnams su/ /skad cig gcig la dbyangs kyisamaji go bar byed/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag dag pa bstan kyipa'i phyir//byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jirga rten kun gyi sgra rnams ci 'dra ba/ /skad cig gcigatshunyal skad cig rjod byed cing / /zhi ba'i rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /'jirga rten gsum po ma lus rtogs par byed/ /sems can kun gyisamarab tu rnam par shes/ /lce yangs rgya kachen rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /zhing rnams kun du brjod dang 'dra bar yang //skad cib gcig lta gyur sel bar byed/ /rnam rtog chos rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'dir ni zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang zhing rang byung gi/ /57—126

chos rnams skad cig gcig la rtogs bya'i⑪phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog /rdul phran tha dad lta bur 'jig rten khams/ /rnam pa kun du mngon par sprul byed cing / /yid lasaḍūbyung ba de dag rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /'das dang de bzhin ma byon sangs rgyas rnams/ /ji snyed gang dag 'jig rten bzhugs 1so cog /sems kyi skad cig gcig la rtoyos bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'jog byed/ /tshig gcig brjod kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bskal pa zad kyi de la nyams pa med/ /tshig rab dbye ba rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jogami /phyogs bcu rnams kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba ci 'dra ldog pa ci 'dra ba/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig la rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub dod du brtan pa sems 'job byed/ /phyogs rnams kun du 'gro yang lus kyisasgyu ༄sam/ /ngag gam yid kyis gang du'ang chabs pa med/ /dus gsum stong pa nyid du rtogs bya'i phyir/ /byang chub don du brtan pa sems 'di 'jog( 3 /byang chub sems ni ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ /bzhal yas bskal par phyogs su rgyu byed cing / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchod par 1bya'o zhes/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi bstan pa yin/ /phyogs bcu dag gi 'jig rten tha dad par/ /'jig rten bdag por rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur tsa ba/ /gang yang rung ba kadam pa sgrog ⑪par byed/ /'di ni mi ldob rnams kyikabastan pa yin1 /byang chub don du srid par spyad spyod tshe/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bde sbyor gang yin pa/ / de yi tshabasngakas pa rtag tu rjod zapar byed/ /'di ni mi ldoka rnams kyi bstan tshepa yin/ /chos mchog chos rab phul du phyin pa dang / /57—127

khyad par 'phags chos bla med gang yod pa/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ston/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi 3)bstan pa yin/ /yon tan kun ldan de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /tsher1nyid 'di na yod kyi gzhan med pa/ / de la 1byang chub sems dpa' sbyor bar byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyirubastan pa yin1 /tshad med gzhal yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad gyurar1 ci 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' de la ston par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi྾bstan pa yin/ /ting 'dzin gang dag ji snyed yod pa dang / /de bzhin ting 'dzin rgyud kyi rnam pa dag④ /de dag bde gshegs sras la rjod par byed/ /'di ni mi ldog rnams kyi )bstan pa yin/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par zlog pa dang / /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /'jig rten kun gyis rtag tu ma bskor ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de bstan bya| / shin tu sdug bsngal 'jig rten thams cad dang / /⑨ngan song sa rnams dag tu gnod gyur pa'i/ /gnas dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyur pa nyade/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan par bya/ /gang zhig byang chub don du sems 'jog pa/ /de ni dang po'i byang chub sems dparad+kubastan/ /bslab pa'i gdams ngag ji bzhin nges byas pa/ /ji bzhin rnam par gzhag ⑫'di de yi kuyin/ /nad bral rnams kyiḥbastan pa ji bzhin du/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa bya ba'i phyir/ /de ltar thog ma su zhig sems bskyed pa/ /'di ni gnyis te dang po'i las can no/ /phan pa thob byed sems dang rab dang bde/ /gnyen dang sdug dang de bzhin sdud sems dang / /kun du bsrungasnyeba'i sems dang snyoms pa'i sems/ /slobawaṃdapon sems dang snyoms par ston pa'i sems /57—128

de 'dra dag la sems gnas gyur pa de/ /lung nod kha ton byed par sbyarab bar bya/ /mang du thos nas dgon par gnas su gzhug /dben4par gyur nas dge bshes stenayodadu gzhug /dge bshes rnams la bka'arabablo bde bar bya/ /dus tshod shes la shes bzhin ldan par bya/ /dus shes gyur shenas shin tu 'jigs med bya/ /'jibs pa med nas don la brtson par bya/ /don shes gyur nas de bzhin chos brjod bya/ /chos rnams kun la rbongs gyur med par bya//rmongs pa med par gyur nas rgyal ba'i sras/ /legs par kasungs pa'i chos la gnasarkupar bya/ /'di ni dang po'i las can brjod pa ste/ /byang chub zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'di ni bdams pa 'di ni bstan pa ste/ /'di la su slob de ni sangs rgyas sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum pa gang yin pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bstan la perab tu sbyor/ /mi rtag nyid dang sdug bsngal stong nyid dang / /bdag med pa dang g.yo ba med pa dang / /de bzhin chos 'di thams cad bdag min dang / /mngon par 'du byed med dang dben pa dang / /'di dag thams cad rtog pa med yin par1/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ltar rtog par byed/ /sems can khams dang chos kyi dbyings la yang /brtag0par bya phyir de ni gzengs yangababastod/ /'jika rten khams ni mtha' yas mu med ces/ /de ltar de ni dpyod du gzhurga par bya/ /'di na sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' ji snyed yod pa dang / /phyogs na 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa/ /de dag rnams la de ni dpyod du gzhug /rgya chen chos rnams kun dang khams rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin ma lus mthar thug brtag bya ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas sras po sbyor byed la/ /phan par bya 57—129

phyir rjes su bstan pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye bar gang skyes pa/ /bstan la skyes shing rab tu 'byung bar byed/ /blo ldan de ni dngos med dngos po rtogs| /dam chos gnas su skyes te lekas par skyesalha / /de ni rang gi sa las yongs mi ldob /sangs rgyas mthar thug yin par 'dzin pa skye/ /rtag tu chos la nges par sems dang ldan/ /sems can rang bzhin ci 'drar rnam par dpyod| /las dang 'jig rten dag dang zhing rnams dang / /rnam par smin dang 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /rnam par dbye ba rgyal ba'i sras kyis shes/ /de thugs skyes pa'i byang chub sems dparatshu1brjod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'das dang byung rnams dang / /ma byon dka kyang chos rnams rnam dpyad nas/ /grub dang gang yang lekas skyes mthar thug dang / /rang byung rnams kyi grub pa ci 'dra ba/ /sangs rgyas dam pa de dag thams cad ni/ /dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes su zhugs pa cheshes/ /nam yang mnyam nyid bye brag 'byed mi byed/ /de ni dus bsum tha dad med par 'jug /gang gi phan yon rnam papa—'di 'dra ba/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' bzhi pa ste/ /'di dag rab baspubs byang chub sems dpa' de/ /byang chub don du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltarar1 byang chub sems dpa' lnga pa ste/ /sbyor ba phun sum tshogs par brngod pa yin/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rjes su zhugs pa ste/ /bsod nams las dag brtsams pas mthar phyin byed/ /de ltar bsod nams rab tu ci byed kyang / /'jig rten kun gyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / /phan par 'dod dang bde ba thob byed dang / /snying brtse ba dang skye dgu —dgrol 'gyur byed/ /'jig rten gnod gyur gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /'dren par byed cing rab tu dang bar byed/ /sems can 57—130

tre da — dzo da sa rdzu 2 bhā la rna gyi ye ci sdu skyi me+e|dad ༷ dri stu rdo ༷ na ༷༷ /mi rdo/ shā /nge/ di — ༷ ༷ t+t+waṃ nga bye / ༷༷ 3 2 bye hūṃ ( rdo sde sde da ṭ+wāṃ ༷ /khro tre / rna wa dī ༷༷ ༷/ shā ཿ ngh+ru bye

mang po thams cad gdul 'dod dang nyu / /mya ngan 'das pa'i sems kyis pemathu yang che/ /'jig rten thams cad mtha' 1 ma med pa dang / /de bzhin dpag tu med cing grangs med dang / /mtshungs med bsam yas mnyam —3med gzhal yas dang / /stong pa mi g.yo med pa'i rang bzhin shes/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' lnga pa ste/ /sbyor ba phun tshogs phan dang snying brtsem3ldan/ /de la rjes su bstan pa 'di 'dra ste/ /yon tan kun dang ldan pa rnams kyis bstan/ /de ni sems can mtha' yas thams cad dang / /chos kyi ngo bo nyid la rbongs pa med — //shin tu blo ldan rtog bral rnam rtog med/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pas dbyer mi byed/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /spyod pa'i bsngags dang bsngags dzipa ma yin dang / /sems can chung ngam yang na che'o zhes—/ /thos par gyur kyang bsam las nur ba med/ /sems can nyon mongs can nam rnam dag kam/ /gdul sla zhe'am pagadul bar dka' zhe'am/ /chos dbyings chung zhe'am yang na rgya che zhe 1'am/ /'jig par 'gyur zhe'am 'chags pa par 'gyur zhe'am/ /chos dbyings yod ce'am med ces thos gyur kyang / /dus gsum rtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /nges par sems shing thams cad rnam dpyod de/ /sangs rgyas chos 'dir bsam pa shin du nges/ /mtshan ma med dang mtshan nyid med pa dang / /dngos med rang bzhin brdzun snarme zhing dben pa dang / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin mig yor 'dra ba yi/ /chos mchog zhi ba 'di 'dra nyan par byed/ /de ltar mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /spyod pa yod dam med ces nges par dpyod—/ /'byung ngam mi 'byung zhe na'ang phyir mi ldog /de bzhin gshegs pa 57—131

'das she'amatshom 'das she'amabyu/ /ma byon ce'am ma byon ma yin zhe'am/ /byung ngam ma byung zad dam mi zad dam/ /de bzhin mtshan nyid gcig gam mtshan nyid med/ /gcig dang tha dad rnam pa mang po0dang / /don dam ba tshig 'bru dngos dang dngos med pa/ /thams cad sgro btags rnam pa shegazhan nyid du/ /mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' yid ches byeng / /mtshan ma med dang mtshan ma yod pa dang / /mtshan nyid med dang mtshan gyis mtshon pa dang / /rnam par phye ba phan tshun sbyar ba rnams/ /thos nas 'di la mthar thug 'jug par byed/ /gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /'bras bu yod pa'i las rnams byed 'gyur zhing //ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'dir ni skye ba ston/ /pha rol rnams kyi bsam pa rtog byed cing —/ /de dag rnams kyi mos pa spyodashepar byed/ /sems can spyod snye dang rjes su 'thun 1 chos dang / /zhing rnams 'jig dang chagasalapa rnams kyang shes/ /ji ltar 'dod sbyin41myur du mngon shesathob/ /phyogs rnams kun du yid ni 'jug par byed/ /bde gshegs bsngags pa'i chos rnams thos nas kyang / /de la de ni nur bar 'gyur ba med/ /yongs su shes dang zhing g.yo byed pa dang / /de bzhin byin gyis brlab dang rnam dpyod dang / /ji ltar skad cig grangs med 'gro 'gyur ba/ /zhing du 'gro bar bya ba brjod par bya/ /de ni dri ba grangs med 'dri bar byed/ /lus rnams ci 'drar yid kyi lus kyang ston/ /de la sgra skad sbyor ba 'byam klas ⑫dang / /skad cig la yang sangs rgyas grangs med brjod| /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal tshab gang yin pa/ /sems can rnams kyi 'jug pa ji bzhin shes/ /de dag nyon mongs rgyud dang bag chags dang / /57—132

spyod yul gang yin sbyor ba gang yin dang / /tha dad chos dang rgyu ba ci 'dra dang //'jig rten rnam par bye dang sngon mtha' dang / /brda yi bden dang don dam bden pa dag /ma lus rtogs par bya la mkhas pa yin/ /pho brang 'khor la mkhas pa tshang4'byin te/ /deramakyeyang ji ltar kun du spyad pa dang / /gnas dang de bzhin 'jug par bya ba dang / /pho brang 'khor ni ci 'dra dpyad pa dang //dam chos rgyal po'i dbang bskur ci 'dra dang / /byin gyi rlabs shā dang kazhan gnon ci 'dra dang / /chos la 'jug dang bka' lung brjod bya ste/ /'di ni rgyal tshab sa la 'jub pa yin/ /de tsam gyis na de yi mimathar thug ste/ /ji skad bstan bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /tshe yi 'du byed nam zhig 'dor ba na / /tshul ldan rgyal tshab rgyal bar mngon du phyogs/ /dbang bskur gang yin bde gshegasamamisras gcig ste/ /thu bo khyad 'phags mthar phyin bdag nyid canayi| /skra thigs gcig gis chu tshad gzung du rung / /'dir ni bsam pa bgrang bas kyirtogs ma yin/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa 'di 'dra ste/ /'di na sgyusems can la las zhing rnams kun/ /phra rab rdul du rlags nas ma lus 'grang⑫/ /grangs med 'di snyed cika ces gcod byed pa/ /de kun 'dir4 ni byang chub sems dpas tishes/ /'das dang de bzhin ma byon sangs rgyas dang / /gang dag phyokas bcu dag na bzhukas pa dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin nyan thos kyi/ /sa bon gyur pa byang chub sems de skye/ /thog mar byang chub sems zhes gang brjod pa/ /de ni ji lha'i tshul du'ang grangs zamed de/ /'jig rten khams 'di kun kyang khyab gyur na/ /de las gong du brjod du checi zhig yod//de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 57—133

blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs bshad pa legs par smras so/ /rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming thos pa'i sems can de dag kyang lngathams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nye bar gyur pa yin na/gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang kun chub par byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub tshepar byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/de dag ni shenges par sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi blo gros kyis smras pa/kye rgyal ba'i sras de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ shes rab zab mo dang ldan pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ba yin par rig par bya'o—/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo sang la la zhig gi〈cho rna lam du 'di lta bu'i chos 'di dag grag par gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi 3 chos rnams la lung bstan par rig par bya ba yin na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang dag gis lag tu thob pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i dus bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces bsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sazigs su gsol/ bdag gis 'di lta bu'i chos 'di dag ma 'tshatsha bas bdag ni danus long dang 'dra —dalags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gcig pu danus long lta bur gyur par yang ma bas tsakyi/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dka gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma thos pa de dag thams cad kyang dmus long lta bur gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ gnas brtan de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i 57—134

zhes bgyibaba'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas bshad du gsol—/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe zhal nas ljags kyi dbang po phyung ste—/ rigs kyi bu gang la la dag 3dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di'i don gyi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa de dag thams cad ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro zhes stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad do—/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang kyitshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/④ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu khyod song la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la chos bshad parapapegasol ba thob shigo /de'i tshe 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa shing blag shaka4dang sākula'i drung gzhan 4 zhig na skyil mo krung tsobacas shing lus mi g.yo bar 'dug ste/ nyi ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bas lhag pa'i kha dog bkod kupa chen po dang ldan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa na brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nasaḍū'adug par gyur te/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i lus dang dpal gyis lham ⑫me lhan ne lhang nger 'dug go/ /de nasasatshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rgyu9'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces spras so/ /rigs kyi du de bzhin gshegs pa ni khyod la chos bshad par gsol ba 'debs so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa sha ra4dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i gzhi'i don 'di gang yin/ sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni 57nga 136

shes rab zab pa ste/ kho bos⑪ni khyod dang 'gyed mi nus so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ khyod snying las chung ngur 'dug shig0 dang khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du bstan par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ④ti'i dus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho borazinyan gyisaphung kyis shod cig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs kyis go bar byas so/ /de nas de'i tshepa bstong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas satsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha'i bu ji snyed 'khod pa de dab thams cad 'dus par gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dpung dang g.yob tu bcas pa yang gnod sbyin bye ba du ma dang lhan cig 'dus par gyur to/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyang 'dus par gyur to/ / chos 'dod pa rnams dang / chos 'dod pa ma yin pa'i gang zag rnams kyang 'dus par gyur to/ / balha'i bu mo mang po yang 'dus par gyur to/ /dge slong gi 'khor dang / dge slong ma'i 'khor dang /dge bsnyen gyi 'khor dang / dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor dang / de bzhin du sum cur7rtsa gsum pa'i bar gyi 'khor dang / 'thab 4bral gyi 'khor dang / dga' ldan gyi 'khor dang / 'phrul dga'i 'khor dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i 'khor dang / tshangs pa'i 'khor dang / de bzhin du 'og min gyi bar gyi lha'i 'khor rnams 'dus par gyur to/ /de bzhin du nyan thos kyi tshogs kyang 'dus par gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa kā sgyu'i ⑫bu chen po dang /57—137

tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags chepa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga yā0 'od srung dang /tshe dang ldan papa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa lam phran bstan 6 dang /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa chu klung 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa ltengab rgyas 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang /tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcanapakazin dang / tshe dang ldan pa bzang skyong dang / tshe dang ldan pa rlangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dasa' bo dang / de dag dang nyan thos chen po gzhan dag dang / grags 'dzin la sogs pa dge slong ma lnga brgya yang 'dus par gyur to/ /khams kyi rgyal po dang / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyuram ba dag kyang 'dus par gyur to/ /rgyal rigs dang bram ze dang khyim bdag gi 'khor dag kyang 'dus par grur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te 'di skad ces gsol to| /bcom ldan 'das deng 'di ltar 'khor chen po 'dus pa 'di 5su'i mthu lakas—/ de ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs kyi mthu yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dkon mchoka ta la la'i gzuzus mnyan sgyupar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sha ra dwa ti'i bu song la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la gsol ba thob shig ka /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin rin po che bstan pa dkon mchog ta la la 'di shod cig /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu dkon mchog ta 57—138

la la'i gzungs lha3nyan par 'gyur ba ( su yin/ sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/'khor bzhi 'dus pa 'di dka dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba rnams 'dus pa 'di dag ste/ kho bo yang nyan pa'i phyir 'ongs so/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos nyan pa 'di dab ni sgyu mas mibyung ba sha stag na kho bos su la chos bshad/ nyan pa ni su yin/ 'chad pa 4ni su yid1 gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis shod cib /kho bos mnyana' —to/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bshad ces bya ba de gang gi tshig bla dgas4 yin/ smras pa/ 'jam dpal bshad pa zhes bya ba de ni stong pa nyid kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu stong pa nyid gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ smras pa/ 'jam dpal stong pa nyid ni tshig med pa yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gal te stong pa nyid tshig med pa yin na/ ci zhig bshad par byasgyu/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos thams cad ni bstan du med pa yin te/ de dag ni bstan du med snyecing mnyan du med do/ /ba/nas brtan gyis smras pa/ rigs kyi ba khyod kyis ji lta ba bstasta pa de dag (thams cad ni stong pa nyid bstan pa/nga nga mtshan ma med pa bstan pa/ smon pa med pa bstan pa/ blang ba med pa bstan pa—/ dor ba med pa bstan pa/ spros pa med pa bstan pa ste/ ma spros pa bstan pa yin no/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba de dag kyang rab tu dga' nas mgrinaḥgacig tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / tshe 57—139

dang tsholdan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 1dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di legs par bshad do zhes legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpas midakon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di ji ltar sazung bar bya/ bklagasnyepar bya/ kun chub par bya/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ rab 'byor gzungs 'di ni skye ba med par yid la bya'o/ /dngos po med pa dang / mtshananyid med pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / dor ba med par yid la bya'o/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na 'khor de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /lha dang mi drub cum brtsa gnyis ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po stana'aka)las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas thal mo sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi snying rje chen po ci 'dra ba zhig lags| bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rikas kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi snying rje chen po ni gang khams gsum pa yongs su mi gtong ba ste/ 'di ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /gang sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun du ston pa 'di ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /gang sems can tshul khrims 'chal pa yongs su 'dzin pa 'di ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi 'dor ba 'di ni snying rje chen po 57—140

yin no/ /gang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir lus dang srog yongs su gtong ba 'dikhyani snying rje chen po yin no/ /gang 'dod chabs spyod pa'i sems can rnams la byams pa yang dag par brjod pa 'di ni snying rje chen po yin no/ /gang sems can stobs dang ldan — (rnams la byams pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi snying rje chen po yin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa 'a sems dpa' chen popasnye sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i sems su bya'o/ /'dre —ba med pa mang du bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces kasol to/ /skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba4 dang /'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang snan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyisashā da dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i bzungs bshad du gsol/ sems can thams cad la sman pa dang / thugs brtse ba mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyedam kyi nang na phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa 1 tha ma la dam pa'i chos nub pa'i dus kyi tshe chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang dag par rab tu ston par spro ba su yod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' she'ajam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong dang 1 byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub 57—141

sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs payodang / byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad kyis mngon 'phags rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen ze ba ldan dang / byang chub sems dpa' nor bu 'od dang /byang chub sems dpa' btsug na nor bu can dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par lta dang / byang chub sems dpa' bltar mi mthong dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtaka tu lta dang / byang chub sems dpa' larga na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen phung ngo dang / byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchoka 'byung gnas dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtog —dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' nor dpal dang /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' tsan dan dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' bdud rtsi 1 blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' bsam yas blo gros dang / byang zub sems dpa' bsod nams kyis brgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' yon tan gyis brgyanatshu༅dang / byang chub sems dpa' mtshan gyis brgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu dgod cing dbang po thams cad rab tu dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri'i rtse mo rdob pa'ipa6rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa mkhas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu lag brkyang dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgobs pa myur dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems 57—142

dpa' nyi ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyi bdugs snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' mngon 'phags rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' lhun po chen po dang | byang chub sems dpa' blo gros brtan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa dpa' ba dang / byang zub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / de dka la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag druka cu rngo )rtsa gnyis kyis mgrin gcig tu tshig tu smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i kyidus lnga brgyashetha ma la dam pa'i chos nub pa'i dus kyi tshe bdag cag thams cad 'dus shing tshobs te dkon mchog ta la la zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs yang dag par bshad par spro lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu das 'di ni bya tsu dka' ba ste/ cho ga 'di 'dra ba 'di ni shin tu bya dka' ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde bar 'gyur bapasgyu dkon mchos ta la la'i gzungs nyon cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bkod zupa chen po'i seng be'i khri la bzhugs te sngakas4bka' stsal pa/ detsabazhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzokas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tadru thā/ oṃ mir+ṣa/ bha ra te⑫/ bha ra te⑫| bha rawaṃbha ra na te swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis a la la chos/a la la chos/ a la la chos r+ṣazhes lan gnyis lan gsum nadu ched du brjod pa ched du brjod pa mumadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems 57nga 143

dpa' kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos chos zhes bgyi ba 'di'i gzhi'i don bang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa—/ rigs kyi bu chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i don nishegazhi med pa'i don to/ /chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i don ni dngos po med pa'i gzhi'i don to/ /chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i don ni nam mkha'i gzhi'i don to/ /chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i don ni blang ba med pa'i gzhi'i don to/ /chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i don ni dor ba med pa'i gzhi'i don to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'o na ci'i slad du chos thams cad ces bgyi—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ ribs kyi bu chos thams cad ces bya ba ni mig dang / rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid dang de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/rikas kyi bu 'di ni chos thams cad ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang chos thams cad ni gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir stong pa'o/ /de nas yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di ji ltar rgazung bar bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin nyid bstan pa dang / skye ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'byung ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i de bzhin nyid dang /nam mkha'i de bzhin nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / ngo bo nyid kyi de bzhin nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi de bzhin nyidamami57—144

rde rna / / py-i tre 'a dro / ༷/rngus waX na 65 ga ༷ ra sdud ༷ 'u tsoX / ngas da dzaX sdo sbru cu rna sde shā rngordo du/ ༷ tre chi byu hūṃ ཿ twe na |sgro de rdordoX// gyid 2 ra 'a tre / di ste|| 2༷ /da

du gzungs 'di gzung bar bya ste/ rigs kyi du dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'di gzung ba dang / kun du gzung ba dang / bsgom pa dang / rnam par dpyad pa dang / gdags pa dang / rab tu gzhag pa dang / rnam par dgrol ba dang / rnam par dbye ba dang gsal bar bya ba ni 'di 'dra ste/ ribs kyi bu 'di ni dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs bsgom pa dang / rnam par brtag pa'i don to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'jam dpal gzhod nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yang dag par zhugs nas yun ji srid cig lonalha/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gnyi nug rnams yun ji srid cigar1 nas zhugs pa srid do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang kati mug rnams yun ji srid cigarami nas zhugs/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu sa'i khams yun ji srid cig nas zhugs pa srid do—/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sa'i khams yun ji srid cig4 nas zhugs/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rig pa dang / ma rig pa yun ji srid cig ⑤ nas zhugs pa srid do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/rigs kyi bu rig pa dang / ma rig pa yun ci4 srid cigam3)nas zhugs/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 1 nam mkha'i khams yun ji srid cigashenas zhubs bapa srid do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal nam mkha'i khams yun ji srid cigashenas zhugs/ 'jam dpal tsogyis smras pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi tshochos thams cad yun ji srid cigacanas zhugs pa grid do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon 57—145

nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kho bo skyes bu dam pa 'di lta bu dag dang gtam bya ba'i nus pa ga4la yod/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ khyi dang byi la thams cad dam/ wa thams cad kyis kyang ri'i rgyal po ri rab gzhig par mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di 'dra ba'i nyan thos thams cad kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i bstan pa gcib gi mtha' yang rtobs — par mi nus na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i bstan pa lta ci sbos/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal bzhud la phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na mdo sde'i 1rgyal po 'dzin pa chos smra ba de dag la kun du bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyang bab mdzad par de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba thong shig5 pe /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur grur pas rang gi chos kyi stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyidamabyupa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston par bgyid pa/ chos smra ba de dag gi yon tan gyi khyad par rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal dge slong mdo sde'i mirgyal po 'dzin pa chos smra ba de dag ni nga'i chos kyi sku la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la nye bar 'grur ro/ /de dag la bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu glags lta ba rnams kyis glags mi rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang su dag chos smra ba'i dge slong de la se gol gtogs ⑨pa gcig tsam srid cig mi byams 57—146

bya / hūṃ ni// 2 ༷wa ri rgyu twe rna / trī /rdo pa/du traṃ rdo t+t+waṃ traṃ na ༷༷ khye ṣ+ka sde/ 1 khro rdo bye pye shā3 rgya ༷ nga lnge / wa ༷ traṃ rna spe bye py-i // hūṃ rte rdo / daX / nga 3 rdo / sa gi ru /shāX / // ༷pe
snge zi ༷༷ 'a da su ༷/ rna ṭ+wāṃ treX khro sa nga / ༷ rdo twe wa wa / k+ṣiṃ rdo gaX / / / pre ༷ sdu / khro/ ༷ tha / ḍi sdu ༷ te sdo ༷ — ༷ wa / rda wa su

pa'i sems skyed tsapa de dag ni mir 'gyur ba las kyang ring du gyur pa yin na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'jam dpal gzhan yang gang dag mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams la ma dad pa'i sems skyed gu pa de dag ni so thags ngan par 'gyur/ lce dang sna med par 'gyur/ rka larga phyi phyogs 1 su 'gyur/ lus nad bu can du 'gyur/ mig med par 'gyur/shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can du 'gyur/ brtson 'grus chung bar 'gyur te—/ 'jam dpal 'di dab ni mi gti nug pa de dka gi skyon du gyur pa'o r+ṣa /'jam dpal mdor bshad na de dab 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe de dag gi spu'i khung bu re rer yang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dpab tu med par 'jug ko/ /gal te mir skyes na zayang rtag tu danus long du 'gyur/ lce med par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong ba depa — dag ni tshe 'di nyid la lus mdze can du 'gyur/ mchu 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug par 'gyur1 lus zhom par 'gyur/ lus kacer bur 'gyur/ lus skam por 'grur—/ yi dasas 'dra bar 4 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang mi gnyi nug pa de dag gang du skye bar 'grur ba de darga gi banas ni ngas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bsam gyis khyab pas mkhyen to/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan du sasol/ bde bar gshegs pas lungawaṃbastan du bsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal kha rog de skad ma 'dri shigatshe /'di la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jirga rten sbos par 'gyur te skrag par 'gyur/ dngang bar 'gyur/ rab tu dngang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ sems can 'di dag gis 'di lha bu 57—147

thos༅nas slan chad nam yang5kyidam pa'i chos spong bar mi 'gyur bar bgyi ba'i slad du thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ brtsom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal sa'i 'og na sems can dmyal ba yod pa'i ming la 'di lta ste/ tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / thig nag dang / kun du 'bar bam1dang / rab tu 'bar bamabadang / reg dka' bkudang / drag po dang / mchu non dang / lcags kyi thu lum dang / lcags kyi be con ( —)dang / mun khung dang / mgo bstod dang / spyi'u tshugs dang / spri'u gdongapa dang / rtag tu rabaku'abar dang / rul pa dang / rtag tu dri nga dang / rab 'joms dang / nges 'joms dngashe/ shin tu gnod 'joms dzi rnams te 'jam dpal mi gti nug pa de dgashā1gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i sems can dmyal ba ni 'di dag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos smra ba de dag⑫'di nas shi 'phos nas gang du skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun du bzang po khyod kyis zhus pasnyade legs par zhus so//kun du bzang po rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo chos smra ba de 'di nas shi 'phos nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu brgyan par skye bar 'gyur te/'jig rten gyi khams de na byang chub sems dpa' kun nas mdzes pa sha stag go/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe rigs kyi bu de la sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcuyiganyis mngon du 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu mdor na rigs kyi bu de'i phan yon ni grangs med dpag tu med de/ de dag ni bskal pa stong dag gis kyang brjod par mi nus so//57—148
/rdo bye twe ༷/ wa / snye /sde/ wa wa ༷ raṃ wa rdo wa da / hūṃ spyo rde da nga tswa bye rde wa /sde snye

byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das blad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong bar 'gyur ba'i sems can ji lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa—/ kun du bzang po 'di lta bu'i chos 'di dag spong bar 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag ni phal cher rab tu byung ba dag 'byung ste/ 'di skad du 'di dka ni snyan dngags sbyar ba yin gyi/ 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma yin no/ /'di dag ni rang bzor byas pa yin te/ mdo sde 'di darga ni sngon nam yang ma thos so zhes 'dzer cing de dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong bar 'gyur ro/ /spangs nas kyang mthol zhing 'chags par mi 'grur te/ de dag chos spangs pas 'chi ba'i tshe sems can dmyal ba kun du 'bar ba mi bzad par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes ma thab tu lcags kyi 'khor los mi gti nug pa de dag gi mgo gcad lanas sa la ltungadzakyebar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar gyur nas kyang bskal pa mang po mibaskal pa brgya phrag mang po dang / bskal pa stong phrag mang por danus long du 'gyur ro/ /gal te bskal pa brgya das 'das nas mir skye bar gyurakun yang tshe rabs thams cad du dmus long du skye bar tsa'agyur zhing lce med pa dang / gdong phyin phyogs su 'duka pa dang / ltag sgur dang / mjing rtsepa nub pa dang / rkang gyol dang / nga ro khyi skad lta bu dang / rtas tu bkros shing skom pas nyen pa dang / lus skams 3pa dang / kha mnam pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis mthong ngam thos na pa kayid du mi 'ong bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des mgrin gcig tu tshig 4smras pa/bcom ldan 'das ma 'tshal ba bdag cag gis mdo sde 'di lta bu dag spangs pa 57—149
༷rdo / ༷ dz+wa wa — /bye dhe ༷/ ༷ / ) sdo / ༷ / snge na ༷ khye rte / /dhe/ yo da/ k+to / dro rdeX ༷ ༷༷ za / sdo rdo sdu/ lnge kā ciX twe wa ga lta / /bye ḍa/

dang / chos smra ba de dag la khros pa'i sems kyis bltas par gyur pa rnams nongs pa la nongs par 'chags ཿso/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ji ltar byis par gyur pa dang / ji lhar rmongs par gyur pa dang / ji ltar shes rab 'chal par gyur pa dang / ji ltar blo chung bar gyur pa rnams 'chags shing mchis na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dgongs su gsol/ de nas nyan thos chen po de das dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dke bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma de dag dngangs nas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni bstan pa 'di lta bu 'di pethos nas rab tu dngangs zulags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ grogs po dag de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ khyed pe kyis skrag par bya ba'i rigs so/ /grogs po dag nga thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pa yin na nga nyid kyang skrag na sang dag nga'i slob ma rnams lta ci smos/rigs kyiwaṃ3bu dag chos 'di ni zab pa ste/ de ni mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/lha'am—/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am sus kyang rnam par dkrugapab par mi nus na dge sbyong ngam bram ze gzhan dag gisam —lta ga la (nus te ci smos/rigs kyi bu dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten du gyur pa ste/ rigs kyi bu dag dper na dkon mchog za ma tog ji lta bar mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di yang de 1 bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal bzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni legs par gsungs pa lags 1snyeso/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong des8lta bu de dag gis dad pas stsal ba ji lhar yongs su 'ju bar 57nga )60

'gyur / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' byung pa/ 'jam dpal gang dka chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong ba dang / chos smra ba de dab la mi byams pa'i sems skyed ) pa de dag ni nyi ma gcig gam/ se gol gtogs pa gcig srid tsam zhig dad pas byin pa yongs su spyad pa'am/ tha na dge 'dun la phul ba'i sa la mchil ma thal gcib 'dor du yang ngas ma rganang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po darga 'di dang nye ba lags sam/ 'on teshā1ring ba lags| bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas brtan sha ra dwa ti'i bu kha rog de skad ma 'dri shig1 /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu mtshams med pa lnga po dag ni bla'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spangs pa ni nam yang de lta ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mtshams med pa lnga byed pa ni mtshams med pa lnga po dag myur du zad par byas nas mir skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos spong ba'i gang zag de ni nam yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob zipar mi 'gyur te/ de ni bdag kyang phung la gzhan yang phung bar byed par — 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na ngu zhing 'di skad ces gsol to / /ye ma'o dam pa'i chos spong ba'i sems can rnams ni sdub bsngal lo—/ /las kyi sgrib pa 'di lta bu dag ni bdag gis rmi lam na yang mthong bar ma grur cig/ // bam po gsum pa/pe de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de snyam ma sems shig ngas chos bstan pa ni 'byung ba dang bcas pa yin na 'jib rten ni las bdag 57—161

gir bya ba/ rang gi las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ rang gi las brtan par bya ba ste—/ sems can dag rang rang gi las rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong gi de la de bzhin gshegs pas ni ma lan no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ngas ni dge legs su 'gro ba'i lam bshad de/ bde bar 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pa med par 'gro ba dang / zu ngan las 'da' bar mo'agro ba dang / 'chi ba med par 'gro ba'i lam bshad na/ 'on kyang sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis nyes par spyod pa dang ldan/ ngag gis nyes par spyod pa dang ldan/ yid kyis nyes par spyod pa dang ldan zhing 'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'debs pa dang / log par lta ba dag che ste/ log par lta ba'i las dang / chos yang dag par spangasapamipa'i rgyus lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro loka par lhung ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pas ni ma lan no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sems can thams cad la nga'i snying rje 'di lta bu skye ste/ ngas sems can gcig gi don du yang bskal pa'am/ bskal pa las lhag par sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rnams myong ngar bya'i —sems can gcig po ni yongs su gtang ⑤bar mi bya'o snyam ste/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po ni de 'dra'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/ mi zhig la bu gcig pa gzugs bzang ba 6 mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig yod la/ de rkyen 'ga' zhig dang phrad nas 'chi ba'i dus byas par gyur na/ mi de bu la sems pas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bar gyur4te/ ngu zhing smre sngakas 'don to/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sems can 57—162

sdug bsngal ba dag la bu gcig pa bzhin du dgongs pa mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa dag nyon mongs pa rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa ni ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni shi ba'i ro dang lhan cika mi gnas so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du de bzhinaphagashegs pa dag kyang nyon mongs pa rnams dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste dper na sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pas lam po che'i bzhi mdor skye bo'ikutshogs ched po mngon par sprul te/ bya ba dag kuston kyang bya ba de dag ni yul na mi gnas phyogs na mi gnas te/ ma skyes ma 'gags shing 'gagam4 par mi 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du de bzhin migashegs pa rnams kyang sems can rnamasarwa )yongs su smin par mdzad cing 'dod chags kyi spyod pa yang ston te/ mdzad pa ston kyang spyod pa de dag ni yod pa ma yin no/ /dper na nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par rtog pa med cing spros pa med pa'o/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la yang rnam par rtoka pa med cing spros pa med dodzi / /'on kyang sems can rnams dang 'thun par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'thunayo par mdzad de/ sems can rnams ji ltar 'dul bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'thunalgepar 'jug go/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa mi mnga'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la mi mkhyen pa mi mnga'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyel ba mi mnga'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu nga ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi thu tshobo dang / gtso bo dang / rab dang /mchog dang / phul dang / bla ma dang / bla na med pa dang / gong na med pa dang —/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa yin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshig smras pa 'di 57—153

tre r+sha | tshe / was ༷ di 2 rna / rdo / snge ༷ / diX traṃ | snyi khri / di/ ༷ ca sge twe gli ) zhi ca di ci zloX / wa ṭ+wāṃ )/ sdu da smi ༷ / da shā/bye de la ཿ swā bye rna| wa r+sha swā ༷ /rdo she kha bye r+ṣa spre su da gas

ni bden pa'i rjes su 'thun 1pa'o/ /rab tu byung ba'am/ khyim pa yangadzagerung ste/ sems can gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong ba de dag thams cad ni sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dag rnyed par 'grur robyu/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa 'di thos nas thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can de darga gis ni rnyed pa nongs par rnyed do/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spong bar 'gyur ba de dag lce ci 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur ba lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de dag gi lce ni dpag tshad 'bum par 'gyur te/ de la lcags kyi thong gshol 'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba kun du rab tu 'bar zi/ kun du rab tu mched 1 cing 'bar ba/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa bye ba phrag lnga brgyas rmo bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des ngag ma bsrungs pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor mi bti nug pa de dag gi las kyi sgrib pa ni de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa ni rmad du byung ba chen po lags so zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos smra ba'i dge slong de dag phrag pa la bkur bar bgyi'o/ /me tog dang bdug pa dang sgos dang phreng ba dang byug pa rnams kyis mchod par bgyi'o/ /gdugs lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du phyag bgyi'o/ /bsnyen bkur bgyi'o/ /bste —stang bgyi'o/ /bla mar bgyi'o/ /ri mor bgyi'o/ /mchod par bgyi'o/ /rjed sgyupar bgyi'o/ /gsol bar 1 bgyi'o/ /bstedza —stang bgyi kyib dang / bla 57—154

mar bgyi ba dang / gus pas bsrung bar bgyi'o/ / de ci'i0slad du zhe na/de dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sras te chos kyi sku las nges par byungakuba'i slad du'o| /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i bur gyur pa/ gzubs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ balha na sdug pa de ni 'og ma thams cad kyi mchod pa'i 'os dang / phyas bgyi ba'i 'os lags so| /de bzhin du chos smra ba de dag kyang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod pa'i 'os dang phyag bgyi ba'i 'os lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /rigs kyi bu lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis chos smra ba'i dge slong de dag snying las chung ngur babya ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / kun du bsrung ba dang /bskyab pa'i phyir tshig 'di legs par smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag yis kyang risas kyi bu'am/ribs kyi bu mo de dag kun du bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyab padz+wa④dang /yongs su gzung ༄ ba dang / zhi ba dang bde lesas su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /dpag tshad brgya kho ra khor yug tu yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la rigs kyi bu tshig 'di legs par smras pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /gzhan la phan dang bde ba byed pa bsags pa po 6/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rab mdzes mchog rab tshig ldan pa/ /shin tu dri med bzhin ldan nga kyi bsam pa mchog /yon tan rin chen mi mnyam mnyam pa'i tshigs pelegs smras/ /de 57nga 155

nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag chos du dang ldan na dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'thob par 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag chos gcig dang ldan na dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'thob bo/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'o/ /kun du bzang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gi chos gnyis te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/phrab dog med pa dang / nga sems med pa ste/ kun du bzang po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dab gi chos gnyis so/ /kun du bzang po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad la dbang po gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu bzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad la thams cad kyi thams cad du rnam par 'tshe ba bskyed par mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan brjod pa 'di bshad pa dang / dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs kyi khyad par gyi yon tan yongs su 3)brjod pa bshad pa na lha dang / mi'i skye dgu tsa las sems can dpag tu med pas gzungs thob par gyur to⑤/ /dkon mchocho ta la la'i gzungs kyi khyad par gyi yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te —/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de lokas su thal mo sbyar ba pe btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di 57—166

skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni zab lags so| /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/gzugs zab pa'i phyir zab bo/ /tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa zab pa'i phyir zab bo/ /stong pa nyid zab pa'i phyir zab bo/ /nam mkha'ayopezab pa'i phyir zab bo/ /kun dga' bos sasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong de bzhin gshegs pa las mngon du thos na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu ni nam yang ma thos so bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni shin tu thos par bya dka' ba yin no/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa 4yitha ma la dam pa'i chos nub pa'i dus kyi tshe sems can mang po dag la 1 sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyid par 'grur bar bcom ldan 'das kyis ④chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byid gyis brlab tu ba/sol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa| kun dga' bo ngas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabs zin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa ngas chos smra ba de dag kyang byin gyis brlabs so/ /kun dga' bo gang la labazhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi rgor 'dri ༅ba de ni mig na bar mi 'gyur/ lce na bar mi 'a'ar/ sna na bar mi 'gyur/ so na bar mi 'gyur—/ lag pa dang rkang pa na bar mi 'gyur/ klad pa na bar mi 'gyur/ rna ba da bar mi 'gyur/ lus dman par mi 'grur/ lus dri mi zhim par mi 'gyur / pha rol gyi kanod pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de spros pa thams cad yongs su spangs nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha 57—167

rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dka' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos 'di shābashad pa'i tshe bdud bar chad mi bgyid pa'i rgyu gang lags/rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo bdud thams cad chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bar chad byed mi nus te/ kun dga' bo gang gi tshe bdud sdig can 'di snyam du bdag dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs 'chad pa la bar chad byed du 'gro'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa de'i tshe/ bdud sdig can gyimukarang gi khyim kun du 'bar bar1dmathong ste/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di de ltar zab bo/ /kun dba' bo sa phyogs gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spyod pa'i sa phyogs de mchod rten du 'gyur/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su yang 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa sa phyogs gang na bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs de nyid na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang gnas par gyur 3la/ bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la blta ba'i sgad du mchis shing —/ mchis nas kyang sngar de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag bgyis nas slad kyisaku chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la phyag bgyis na nongs pa ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dasa' bo gang gi tshe khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu bkol te/ nga la phyag 'tshal ba de'i tshe khyod nyes pa nga bcas par 'gyur ro / /kun dga' bo gzhan yang nga lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi thu rngo bo dang ka)/ gtso bo dang / mchog dang / dam pa yin modabakyi/ kun dga' bo ngas sngar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas phyis byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /kun dga' bos kasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gang nyalas ting nge 'dzin rin po che dkon mchog ta la la bstan pa 57—158
pye / sbya wa skre |༷/ ༷snye dardo da wa ༷ tshe rde bye wa/ wa ṭī wa zhe rde ngh+ru dad skre twe swā be — ༷༷ — :bye ༷ ༷ ༷ / pye traṃ wa ṭaṃ

'di gsan pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gong na su mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo mi'i 'jig rten dang lha'i 'jig rten dang dri za'i 'jig rten na nga'i gong na su yang med de/ 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na ngas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes thogs pa med pa brtsegs pa'i snying po 'od zer tsabazang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od zer du ma'i lte ba rgyas pa las mngon du thos te kun dba' bo bya dka' ba chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma stsong nas ngas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos te/de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa des nga lung bstan to/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na khyod kyis sngar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la phyag gyisamunul phyis nga la phyag 'tshol cig/de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 1 'jig rten skyong ba de dag zathams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu tshis 'di skad ces smras so/ /a la la chos a la la chos/chos rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul ba a la la'o/ /sems can gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming thos pa de dag kyang phyag bya ba'i 'os yin na/ gang dag 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa lha smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba snyede dag la kye grogs po dag khyod kyis tshig 'di legs par smras pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyikuzhal nas ljags kyi dbang po phyung ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ljags kyi dbang pos snang bar byas nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /sems can 57—169

gang dab chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mi thos pa de dag ni ji ltar mi dmus long gis nyi ma'i snang ba mi mthong ba dang / ji ltar tshong ba thabs mi shes pa dang / ji ltar mi dbul po gzhan gyi ngor lta ba dang 'dra ste/ de dag gi don du ngas dpe 'di byas na ci nas sems can rnams chos rin po che'i phung po 'di 'dra ba las ring du mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ched dang sems can thams cad kyi don du nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs na rigs kyi bu khyod spro'am/de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas ngu zhing byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po rang gi chos kyi stan las langs ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la stong rgasum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos1 rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/kun du rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg /rab tu ldeb /kun du rab tu ldeg go/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /chem chem/rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/kun du rab tu 'khrugs so/ /'jig rten du snang ba chen po yang byung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos sor mo bcu rkyathal mo sbyar te ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag spro lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag spro lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod ni thams cad mkhyen pa/ sems can thams cad la phan par bzhed pa/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa lags kyi steng du bdag ni de bzhin 57—160
/ /rte rde sa/ / ༷ | ༷ ༵ 'datshe ṭ+wāṃ khri ngh+ru ༷snyeX wa rtse/ /jo wa dhe/ rdo tre rdo rdo t+yā wa rdo ༷ rngo khro kyu zlodaX rtsiX mi dad ༷༷

gshegs pa las skyes pa lags na/ ci'i sbad du de bzhin kashegs pa'i bka' ltar mi bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' ni bdud rtsi'i bka' lags na/ bdag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'bal bar bgyid pa'i mthu bdab la ga la mchis/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni byas pa gzo bar bgyi ba lags kyi/ byas pa mi gzo tshebar bgyi ba ma lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras legs so legs so/ /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi tsa thu bo dang / gtso bo dang mchog dang dam pa dang phul yin te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di khyod la yongs su gtad do/ /'di ni nga'i ston pa yin te/ de'i phyir khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /dus dus su bste tsa stang gyis shig /rin po che'i snod du chug la phrag pam la thogs shig /phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na dge slong sdig par5can de darga la yid ma rton cig /rigs kyi bu 'di ni khyod la rjes su bstan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu byung ba ci 'dra ba de dag 'byung bar 'gyur| bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu kha rog de skad ma 'dri shig4) /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang pos rgasol pa sems can mang po la sman par ④bgyid par 'gyur lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshesas pas 2bshad du sasol/ bcom ldan 'das kyisapha)bka' nga pa/ kun du bzang po bshad kyis tshenyon cig /'khor rgya mtsho lta bu 'did+kudang 'jam dpal dang spyan ras kazigs dbang phyug la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med dpag tu med pa 57—161

thams cad yid la byed pa gzhan thong la/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na rab tu byung ba ci 'dra ba dag 'byungarwabar 'gyur ba de dag nyon cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' nga to| /kun du bzang po rab tu byung ba dam pa'i chos sun 'byin pa/ khyim la chags pa/ rnyed pa la chargas pa/ gtsug lag khang la chags pa/ gnas la chags pa/ lhung bzed dang chos gos la chags pa/ khyimasun par byed pa/sdig pa'i chos kun du spyod pa de dag 'byung ste/ kun du bzang po mi gti nug pa de8 dadag gi don du ngas mdo nya'adi yongs su gtad kyis — mdo 'di nub par gyur ta re/ de nas phyogs bcu das lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za thams cad lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang thams cad 'dus shing tshogs te/ ji srid 'ang tshumibar dang / dam pa'i chos ji srid gnas kyi bar du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba'i dge slong de dag la yang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /bstem —3stang du bgyi'o/ /btsun par bgyi'o/ /rim gror — bgyi'o| /mchod par bgyi'o/ /rjed 1par bgyi'o/ /gsol bar0bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag la yang dag par skul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bsungs so/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa de dag gi/ /yon tan kun bshad thams cad nga las nyon/ /nga rgyal rgyags dang bag med spang byos la/ /dga' zhing mgu ba'i yid kyis mnyan par gyis/ /ma ga ṅgāwaṃ'adir shing dbang byang chub drung / /rang byung mi yi seng ge bzhugs 57—162

zhes grang 3 /nying 'dzin rnam par thar pa mchog la kanas/ /shing rgyal chen po de yi drung na bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rdul snyed dang de thabs cing /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dpa' bo bskor/ /sangs rgyas phal chen zhes bya'idza1 ting nge 'dzin/ /tingapha —'dzin de la mi yi dbang po gnas/ /mi dbang de ni snyoms par zhugs rtogs nas/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu shar gyi phyogs logs nas| /sangs rgyas zhing bcu rdulapo—snyed lhan cib tu/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams dang rgyal drung 'ongs/ /de bzhin sbyar te phyogs bcu'i zhing kun nas/ /sangs rgyas sras po dpal zhes bya ba kun/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rdul snyed dang lhan cig tu—/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams dang lhags par gyuraku/ /der 'dus gyur nas 'jig rted phan 'dod pa/ /'jam dpal grags pa mtha' yas ldan rnams la/ /sems can dam pa bzang po'i dpal gyis dris/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi spyod gang yon tan ci/ /de nas sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba/ /rnyog pa med pas byang chub yon tan dang / /bde —yangs yon tan ldan gyi spyod yul gtsang //sems can dam pa bzang po'i dpal la dris/ /sangs rgyas sras po rnams kyi spyod yul gtsang / /rgyal bas bstenalopa bdag gis 'dir smras kyisache / /khyod kyang sangs rgyas sras kyimatshoyon tan dang / /spyod pa gang dag yin pa brjod par gyis1 /bzang po'i dpal gyis smras pa rgyal sras nyon/ /yon tan mtha' yas ldan de'i yon tan las/ /dpe tshul cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /rgya mang thithis pa bzhin du shin tu chung / /byang chub gzhir gyur pa yiwaṃrang byung sems| /thog ma nyid du bskyed pa gang yin pa/ /de yi yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas te/ /mtshungs med kyis kyang yongs su brjod mi spyod/ /pha rol 57nga 163

phyin dang sa yi yon tan rnams/ /bskal pa mang por spyad pa ci smos te/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyis de dag gitsho/ /yon tan chu bo zad par mdzad mi spyod—/ /yon tan mtha' yas rnams kyi yon tan las/ /dpe tshul cung zad tsam zhib brjod bya ste/ /mkha' la bya rjes 'dra bar chung ba dang / /sa chen rnams las rdul phran gcig dang mtshungs/ /byang chub yon tan gnas kyi sems skye ba/ /rgyu med ma yin gyi na ma yin gyi/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos dang dge 'dun la/ /dad dang dang ba bskyed nas sems skye ste/ /de ni 'dod dang longs spyod rgyal srid dang / /bdag la bde dang snyan dang grags phyir min/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi bya'i phyir/ /'jib rten phan pa byed pa'i sems skye'o| /rtag tu sems can phan par bya phyir dang / /zhing rnams sbyang dang sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / /chos yongs gzung dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang //ye shes rnam par sbyang phyir sems de skye/ /rgyal ba kun dang chos dang de bzhin du/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la rtag tu dad pa dang / /dang zhing mos dang gus pam1 rab bskyed nas/ /bla ma gus par mchod phyir sems de skye/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing / /sangs rgyas sras kyi spyod la dad byed la/ /byang chub bla na med la dad gyur nas/ /skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis mi dag gyur pa rnams/ /bsam yas rgya chen mchod pasakhu mchod byas shing / /chos dang de bzhin mi byed dge 'dun la/ /bsam yas mchod pas mchod nas sems skye'o/ /dad pa sngon 'dren ma ltar skyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad srung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dobasakupa sel cing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde ba'i grong khyer mtshon pa yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa 57—164

med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa gter dang nor dang rkang pa'i mchob /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud0rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa yongs su gtong la dga' bar byed/ /dad pa rgyal ba'i chos la rab dga' skyed/ /dad pa yon tan ye shes khyad par byed/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang ston cing thob par byed/ /dbang po rdo zhing rab tu gsal bar byed/ /dad pa'i stobs la gzhan gyis mi rdzi zhing / /nyon mongs rnam par sel ba'i gzhi rten yin—/ /dad pa rang 'byung 1 yon tan rnams kyang tshol/ /dad pa chabs pa'i sgo la chakas pa med/ /mi dal spangs shing dal ba'i mchog gcig yin/ /dad pa bdud kyi lam las 'da' byed cing / /thar pa'i lam mchog ston par byed pa yin / /yon tan zhing gi sa bon ma rul pa/ /dad pa byang chub zhing ni rnam par skyed/ /ye shes khyad par yon tan 'phel bar byed/ /dad pa rgyal ba thams cad ston pa yin/ /dad pas mos pa'i khyad par dga' rnams kyi/ /de la spyod pa rim gyis brjod par bya/ /'di 'dra'i chos ni 'jig rten rab dkon te—/ /rgya mapa'i4nang na rin chen rgyal po bzhin/ /gang darga rtag tu sangs rgyas dad gus pa/ /de dag tshul khrims bslab pa yongs mi 'dor/ /gang dag tshul khrims bslab pa mi 'dor ba/ /yon tan ldan de yon tan ldan pas bstod//tshul khrims byang chub sems ston shebyed pa ste/ /slob pa'i sa yi yon tan rnams la sbyor/ /tshul khrims basbab pa 'dor bar mi byed pa/ /de dag rgyal bas bsngags pa'i 'os su 'gyur/ /gang dag rtag tu sangs rgyas dad gus pa/ /de dag rgyal la mchod pa rgya chen byed/ /gang dag rgyal la mchod pa che byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas dad pa bsam mi khyab/ /gang dag rtag tu chos la dad gus 57—165

pa/ /de dag rgyal bar 1 chos nyan ngoms pa med/ /gang dag rgyal ba'i chos nyan mi ngoms pa/ /de dag chos la mos pa bsam mi khyab/ /gang dag rtag tu dge 'dun dad gus pa/ /de dag mi ldog dge 'dun dad pa yin/ /gang dag mi ldog dge 'dun rab dad pa/ /de dag dad pa'i stobs kyis mi ldog 'gyur/ /gang dag dad pa'i stobs kyis mi ldog pa②/ /de dag dbang po rdo zhing rab tu gsal—/ /gang dag dbang po rdo zhing rab gsal ba/ /de dag sdig pa'i grogs po rnam par spangs/ /gang dag sdig pa'i grogs po rnam spangs pa/ /de dag chos ldan grogs kyis yongs su bzungapaṭ+wā/ /gang das chos ldan grogs kyis yongs bzungakub/ /de dag dbe ba rgya 2chen sogasamadzidapar byed/ /gang dag dge ba rgya chen sobs byed pa/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyu stobs ldan/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyu stobs gang ldan pa/ /de dag mos pa'i khyad par rgya chen 'gyur/ /gang dag mos pa'i khyad par rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba kun gyis rtag byin brlabs| /gang dag rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /gang dag byang chub don du sems skye ba/ /de dag drang srong chen po'i yon tan brtson/ /drang srong chen po'i yon tan gang brtson pa/ /de dag rigs mtho sangs rgyas rigs su skye—/ / gang dag rigs mtho sangs rgyas rigs skyes pa/ /4de dag mnyam zhing sbyor dang mi sbyor spangs/ /mnyam zhing sbyor dang mi sbyor gang spangs pa/ /de dag dad dang bsam pa rnam par dag /gang dag dad dang bsam pa rnam dag pa/ /de dag lhag pa'i bsam pa dam pa mchog /gang dag lhag bsam dam pa mchog ldan pa/ /de dag rtag tu pha rol phyin pa spyod/ /gang dag rtag tu pha rol phyin spyod pa/ /de dag theg pa chen po 57—166

'di la zhugs/ /gang dag theg pa chen po 'dir zhugs pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas rnams la spub pas mchod/ /gang dag spub pas sangs rgyas mchod byed pa/ /de das sangs rgyas rjes su dran mi byed1/ /bang dag sangs rgyas rjes dran mi zud pa/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas bsam yas mthong / /gang dab sangs rgyas bsam yas rtag mthong snyeb/ /de la nam yang sangs rgyas mi bzhugs 1 min—/ /gang das nam yang sangs rgyas mi bzhugs zu min/ /de dab bar skabs chos las nyams mi 'gyur/ /gang das bar skabs chos las mi nyams pa/ /de dag spobs pa sgrib pa med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spobs pa sgrib pa med gyur pa//de dag chos rab ston pa mtha' yas —'gyur/ /gang dag chos rab ston pa mtha' yas pa/ /de dag 'gro la byams shing phan par 'dod/ /gang dab 'gro la byamasar shing phan 'dod pa/ /de dag snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba brtan/ /gang dag snying rje chen po'i rtsa brtan pa/ /de das chos dasa' dga' ba'i dbang por 'gyur| /gang dag chos dga' dga' ba'i dbang po can/ /de dag 'dus byas skyon gyis yal bar bor/ /gang dag 'dus byas skyon gyis yal bor ba/ /de dag nga rgyal rgyags med bag med min/ /gang dag nga rgyal rgyags med bag med min| /de dag rtag tu bdag dang gzhan don brtson/ /gang dag rtag tu bdag gzhan don brtson pa/ /de dag 'khor bar yongs su skyo ba med/ /gang dag 'khor pebar yongs su mi skyo ba/ /de dag rtun —pa dam pa mchog dang ldan/ /gang dag rtun4pa dam pa mchog ldan pa/ /de dag mngon shes rnam par dag pa skyesarngo| /gang dag mngon shes rnam par dag skyes pa/ /de dag 'gro ba'i spyod pa mang po rtogs/ /gang dag 'gro ba'i spyod pa mang rtogs pa/ /de dag 'gro ba 57—167

yongs su smin byed mkhas/ /'gro ba yongs su smin byed gang mkhas pa/ /de dag 'gro ba sdud shes cho ga mkhas/ /'gro ba sdud shes cho ga su mkhas pa/ /de dag bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la brtson/ /gang dag bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir brtson pa/ /de dag 'gro ba'i don ni mtha' yas byed/ /gang dag 'gro don mtha' yas byed 1 gyur pa/ /de dag shes rab thabs la rten4pa yin/ /gang dag shes rab thabs la rten 1gyur pa/ /dpa' bo de dag bla med lam la gnas//dpa' bo gang dag bla med lamaruganas pa/ /de dag bdud dpung rnams kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /gang dag bdud dpung rnams kyis mi tshugs pa/ /de dag bdud kyi lam las rab tu 'das/ /bang dag bdud kyi lam las rab 'das pa//de dag mi ldob sa ni rjes su 'thobapa/ /gang dag mi ldog sa ni thob gyur pa/ /de dag mi skye bzod pa thob pa yin/ /gang dag mi skye bzod pa thob gyur pa/ /'jig rten sgron te brgyal bas lung bstan to/ /'jig rten sgron gang rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ /de dag rgyal ba kun dang mngon sum〈 gnas/ /rgyal ba kun dang mngon sum gusu gnas pa/ /de dag rgyal gsang rnam 'phrul cho ga mkhas/ /rgyal gsang rnam 'phrul cho ga su mkhas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs pa yin| /gang dag rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs gyur pa/ /de dag yon tan kun gyis leb/sa par brgyan/ /gang dag yon tan kun gyis legs brgyan pa/ / de dag bsod nams dam pas lus kyang sbyangs/ /bsod nams mchog gis gang lus rnamalo)sbyangs pa/ /de dka gser gyi ri bo 'dra bar 'bar/ /gser gyi ri bo 'dra bar su 'bar ba/ /de dag sum cu4rtsa gnyis mtshan rnams rdzogs/ /gang dag sum cu 'irtsa gnyis mtshan rdzogs pa/ /de dag lus dmas dpe byadaku 57—168

da rna /da spra zlo ma da — 3 nga — bya// /rna rna swā nga shā 7 sgyu du/ nga/ rna/// rna/sdu ༷ nga ga ra/spyad pye trī — da zhi rdu rngo dzo kau ṣ+ṭi ṭ+wāṃ 3 ma bye sngu cha ṭ+wā dz+rī zhi rna ༷sdu r+ṣa ༷ ṭī ste /kha /tre / ji sa/ dī da na du rnga la/ ṭī nga/ tso /rna | ༷/ nga /dang zlos tī zhi me / tre( da sdu zi paXs zhi 2 dzha skyi / ba kaṭ+wā | haṃ ci

bzang pos spras/ /gang dag lus rnams dpe byad0bzang spras pa/ /de dag lus kyi 'od ni mtha' yas so/ /gang dag lus kyi 'od ni mtha' yas pa de dag 'od zer bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ /bang dag 'od bkod bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de dag 'od las pad ma rnams kyang 'byung / /gang dag 'od las pad ma rnams byung tsapeb/ /de dag rgyal gzugs pad ma'i gdan 'khod par / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag tu ston byed cing / /don yod gnas pa sems cad 'dul bar byed/ /gang dag rgyal gzubs pad ma'i gdan 'khod par/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dka tu ston byed cing / /don yod gnas pa sems can 'dul byed pa/ /de dag mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas so/ /gang dag mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /de dag bsam gyis mi khyab zhing rgyu zhing / /bsam gyis mi khyab chos rnams ston par byed/ /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab tshim par byed/ /gang dka bsam gyis mi khyab chos ston cing / /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab tshim byed pa/ /de dag so so rig sgyushes stobs rnams kyis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jika rten sems can 'dul/ / gang dag so sor rig shes stobs rnams kyis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul—/ /pede dag rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid/ /ye shes na du 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang / /gang dag rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid/ /ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing rjes 'brang ba/ /de dab smon lam stobs kyis ci 'dod par/ /sems can rgyud na gzugs ni ston par byed/ /gang dag smon lam stobs kyis ci 'dod par/ /sems can rgyud na gzugs ni ston byed pa/ /de dag tshigapaka rnams rjod 0par byed pa'i tshe/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag bsam yas sgra 'byung ngo / /57—169

gang dag tshig mirnams rjod mipar byed pa'i tshe/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag bsam yas sgra 'byung ba/ /de dag 'gro ba ma lus kun gyi sems/ /skad cig gcig la sems kyis rnam par shes/ /gang dag 'gro ba ma lus kun gyi sems/ /skad cig gcig la sems kyis rnam shes pa/ /de dag nam yarnga mi 'chi skye mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs rgyu ba'ang 'byung bar 'gyur ma yinagu/ /sang dag nam yang mi 'chi mi skye zhing / /nyon mongs rgyu ba'ang ma'abyung bar mi 'grur ba/ /de dag yon tan chos nyid ye shes lus/ /chos kyis rab tu phye bas 'jig rten rgyu/ /gang dag yon tan chos nyid ye shes lus/ /chos kyis 5rab bye 'jig rten rgyu byed pa//de dag sa bcu rnams dang dbang bcu dang / /pha rol phyin dang rnam thar mchog la banas/ /gang dag sa bcu rnams dang dbang bcu dang / /pha rol phyin dang rnam thar mchog gnas pa/ /de dag dbang bskur bkod dang rnam 'phrul dang / /ting 'dzin mchog la gnas pa rjes su 'thob ba/ /gang dag dbang bskur bkod dang rnam 'phrul dang / /ting 'dzin mchog la banas pa rjes thob pa/ /de dag phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las/ /dbang bskur thams cad ma lus nod par byed/ /gang dag phyobs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las/ /dbang bskur thams cad ma lus nod byed pa/ /de dag spyi bor phyosas bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis//phyag mthil bdud rtsi kacan gyis dbang bskur to/ /gang dag spyi bor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /phyag mthil bdud rtsi can gyis dbang bskur ba/ /mthu brtan de dag nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /ma lus khyab byas phyokas rnams kun na — gnas/ /mthu brtan gang dab nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /ma lus khyab byas phyogs rnams kun gnas pa/ /mtshungs med de dag spyod yul lhar bcas kyi/ /57— 70
rdo sdi ste/rdo//sna wa waX ca — tha 2༷ / // di /༷ je/ wa /wa bye / bye ne sdo rdo bye ༷ dha / ༷ wa sheXni lnge )tre /hūṃ rde giXrdo / /ma

'jig rten rnams kyis shes par yongatsho mi nus/ /mtshungs med gang dag spyod yul lhar bcas kyi/ /'jig rten rnams kyis shes par mi nus pa/ /de dab rtun mipa kun dang mthong ba dang / /ming thos pa dang sgobs pa don yod do/ /gang dag rtunasgyu9pa kun dang mthong ba dang / /ming thos pa dang spobs pa don yod pa/ /skyes chen de dag sbyin pa sbyin byed kyi/ /sbyin nga thams cad don yod 'gyur ba yin/ /skyes bu dam pa de dag rnams kyi 4)mthus/ /chos kyang gnas shing byams pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /dge ba'i las rnamasam⑤rab tu spyod 'gyur te/ /dkon mchog mthu yang dam 4)pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje mkhregs pa'i rin chen mchokashe yod pa/ /de yi mthu yis rgya mtshor rin chen rnams/ /mi zad mi 'grib 'phel bar mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin yon tan mtha' yas yon tan chu/ /gang na sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing gyur pa/ /de 3ni byang chub rnam par sangs rgyas ston/ /phyogs rnams gang na chos kyang med gyur pa/ /phyosas der chos kyi gter ni ston par byed/ /de dag rtob med rnam par mi rtog cing / /de dag lhun gyis grub par phyogs kun du/ /zla ba lta bur snang bar rab ston cing / /thabs stong dag gis sems can 'dul bar byed/ /de dag4kaskad cig re la phyokas bcu yi/ /'jig rten kun du byang chub sangs rgyas ston/ /'khor lo bskor dang mya ngan 'das zhi dngasnye/ /ring bsrel rab tu rgyas pa'ang dpa' bo ston| /mkhas pa de dag nyan thos rang rgyal sa/ /sangs rgyas bkod pa rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /bskal pa bsam mi khyab par ston byed cingashātshe/ /theg gsum sgo nas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /mos pa kun gyi bsgrub ⑫pa shes pa rnams/ /khye'u dang bu mo bud med lus rnams dang / /lha mi lha min klu dang 57—171

gnod sbyin dang / /grulam1bum lto 'bye chen po'i gzugs rnams ston/ /rgya mapa'i phyag rgya'i cheting nge 'dzin gyi sgos/ /dpa' bo de dag 'gro ba'i gzugs spyod dang / /rtags dang spyod dang sgra skad 'jug pa dag /ji snyed thams cad ma lus ston par byed/ /de dag zhing bkod bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun la mchod par byed/ /gang dag zhing bkod bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun la mchod byed pa/ /de dag 'od zer bkod pa bsam yas shing / /sems can 'grel pa'i ye shes mtha' yas so /gang dag 'od zer bkod pa bsam yas shing / /sems can 'grel pa'i ye shes bsam 1yas pa/ /de dag lus dang ngag gi rnam 'phrul dang / /yid kyir rnam par 'phrul pa bsam mi khyab/ /gang dag lus dang ngag gi rnam 'phrul dang / /yid kyi rnam 'phrul bsam byis mi khyab pa/ /de dag sbyin dang tshul khrims rnam 'phrul dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /gang dag sbyin dang tshul khrims rnam 'phrul dang / /bzod brtson rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas phal chen ting 'dzin sgos/ /bsam gtan rnam par 'phrul dang shes rab dang / /thabs dang mngon shes rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab—/ /yon tan kun gyi shernam 'phrul mtha' yang yas/ /de dag phra rab rdul 'jug ting nge 'dzin/ /rdul rnams kun la mngon par sgrub byed cing / /rdul gcis steng na zhing rnams bsam mi khyab/ /ston par byed kyang rdul la 'phel ba med /rdul de'i steng namasgyusangs rgyas bcas —zhing dang / /sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing yang kha cig ston/ /nyon mongs rnam dag dog pa kha cig dang / /yangs shing phra dang che ba'i zhing yang ston/ /zhing rnams la la 'jig dang 57—172
