'chabs pa dang / /la la byi'u tshugs gyur tsadang 'thun shepa dang / /la la snrel zhi mismig rgyu lta bu dang / /la la mig 'phrul lta bur gyur pa rnams/ /ji ltar rdul gcig steng du ston byed pa/ /de bzhin rdul rnams ma lus kun la ston/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra ste/ /grags pa mtha' yas rnam thar 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag rgyal mchod rnam 'phrul ting nge 'dzin/ /rgyal ba kun la mngon par sgrub byed cing / /lag pa'i mthil du stong gsum rgyas bkang ste/ /skyes bu chen po rnams la mchod pa byed/ /phyogs bcu dag na me tog phreng ba dang —/ /sgos byug rin chen rin che miji snyed pa/ /de dag byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal rnams mchod phyir lag pa'i mthil nas 'byin/ /gos dang bye ma rin chen ji snyed dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan ⑤gdugs mchog sna tshogs dang / /gser gyis brgyan pa'i rin chen bla re rnams/ /de dag lag pa'i mthil nas char du 'bebs/ /phyogs bcu dag na yo byad mtha' yas gang / /drang srong chen po rnams la mchod 'os pa/ /de dag lag pa'i mthil nas char 'bebs shing / /byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba mchod/ /phyogs rnams dag na rol mo ji snyed pa/ /rnga dang rdza rnga sgra snyan pi bang — dang / /sil snyan sgra dang sgra chen gling bu rnams/ /de dag lag pa'i mthil nas rab tu sgrogs pe| /phyogs bcu kun gyi dpe zla med rnams kyi/ /yang dag yon tan bsngags pa sna tshogs dang / /bstod pa'i tshigs r+ṣabacad sgrub pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dag lag pa'i mthil nas rab tu sgrogang / /'od zer gang dag las dges yongs bsags pa/ /lag pa g.yas nas yongs su 'gyed byed cing / /spos chus rgyal ba'i zhing rnams thams cad du/ /'bebs4shing 'jig rten sgron ma 57—173

༷ rwa shā sa// snyi daX tshe ྅ 'a nga — byem skyi // ༷tā tre ji sbye rtsi shākya dri ṭ+wāṃ ༷ su na gyu tswa ༷/ṭā ཿ /)bro swā nga chu nga ca ‘ ma / dī da/ spra snge ji rngo rdo rdo ༷/ nga tre / lnge tre // ḍa ༷༷ ṭ+wāṃ traṃ /rna 3 — mi ji jiX dzod ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ sne ca na ྾ ཿ / sdu ngaX rterte/ skyo

rnams la mchod/ /'od zer bkod dang ldan pa mdzes pa'i 'od/ /pad ma'i rgyan phreng bsam yas rab 'phyang 2ba/ /pad ma mtshan rab gzugs can du ma dag /lag nas rgyal ba rnams la mchod par byed/ /me tog phal chen me tog bla re dang / /me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /me tos sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdaka nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /bdug pa phal chen bdug pa'i bla re dang / /bdug pa bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste—/ /bdug pa sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phal chen spos dang spos kyi bla re dang / /sbos kyisashākyebakod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /sna tshogs spos rnams kun du bkramabyas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod1 /phreng ba phal chen phreng ba'i bla re dang | /phreng ba bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /bye ma phal chen bye ma'i bla re dang / /bye ma bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /bye ma sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dab rgyal ba mchod/ /na bza' phal chen na bza'i bla re dang / /na bza' bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste—/ /na bza' sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /phal chen gdugs dang gdukas kyi bla re dang / /gdugs kyi bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /sna tshogs rgadurgas rnams kun du bkram byas shing —/ /bdaka nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rin chen phal chen rin chen bla re dang / /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /57—174

pad ma phal chen pad ma'i bla re dang / /pad ma bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste| /pad ma sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rgyan phreng phal chen rgyan phreng bla re dang / /rgyan phreng bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /rgyan phreng sna tshogs kun du bkram byas shing / /bdag nyid chen po de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /rgyal mtshan mchog bkod 'od zer rab bkye zhing / /de dag rgyal mtshan dkar dmar ser po dang / /sngo dang rgyal mtshan bkod pa sna tshogs pa/ /du mas 3chorgyal ba'i zhing rnams brgyan par ②byed/ /nor bu 'dra ④ba sna tshogs bkod pa'i kadugs/ /dar gyi lda ldi ba dan rab spyangs zishing / /dril g.yer dra ba rgyal ba'i gsung sgrogs 4 pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rngo dbu la de dag 'dzin/ /lag pa'i mthil nas mchod pa mtha'ad — yas rnams/ /rgyal ba kacib la de das byed pa ltar/ /rgyal ba ma lus kun la'angam— de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /de dag 'gro ba sdud pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rnam par 'phrul dang ting 'dzin mchog bsgrubs shing —/ /bya ba dag dang bsnyen bkur kun gyi sgo/ /thabs stong dag gis sems can 'dul bar byed/ /kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa mchod sgo dang / /sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab gtong sgo dang / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan tshul khrims kun sgo dang | /bzod pa mi zadashemi 'khrugs sgo dag dang / /la cig brtular+shazhubs dka' thub brtson sgo dang / /bsam gtan rab tu zhi bar gnas sgo dang / /don la rnam nges shes rab sgo rnams dang / /spyad shānyapa kun ldanakuthabs kyi sgo dag dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas pa dag dang mngon shes sgo/ /bsdu ba'i dngos pos phan par 'dod sgo dang / /bsod nams bsags dang ye shes sgo dag dang //57—176

bden dang brtenar1 dang rnam par 3)thar sgo pedang / /kha cig stobs dang dbang po lam sgo dang / /nyan thos theka pas rnam par grol jisgo dang / /rkyen gyi theg pas rnam par dag sgo dang / /theka pa mchoka gi rnam par 'phrul sgo dang / /kha cib mi rtag nyid dang sdug bsngal sgo/ /kha cig bdag med srog med sgo dag dang / /mi sdug 'du shes 'dod chags bral sgo dang / /zhi 'gog ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo yis 'dul/ /'gro ba'i spyod pa'i sgo rnams ji snyed pa/ /de snyed chos kyi sgo la rab zhukas te/ /de dag kun du rnam thar sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul/ /gang dag kun du rnam thar sgo dag nas/ / bsams bzhinaku'ajig rten sems can 'dul byed pa/ /de dab sus kyang mtshan mar gzung mi nus/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa de 'dra'o/ /de dag dga' ba bkod pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /'gro ba thams cad yongs smin 'thun — dbyed pa/ /dba' bde spro ba (r+ṣarab dga' kun ldan pas/ /bsams pa brtan rtanas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /gang du lo nyes 'jig rten yo byad gang —/ /bde byed thams cad rab tu dkon gyur pa/ /der ni kun gyis bsams sgyubazhin bya ba yinaskya/ /sbyin pa sbyin tsozhing 'gro ba'i don rnams byed/ /de dag zas skom mchog dang ro mchog dang / /gos dang bgo ba rin chen sna tshogs dang / /rgyal srid nor dang bdag phangs ⑫yongs gtong bas/ /sbyin la mos pa'i 'gro ba 'dul bar byed/ /brtan pa de dag mtshan mchog lus spras shing | /gos dang rgyan mchog bgos shing brgyan byas te/ /phreng bas spud cing spos kyis bskus pa ⑫yi/ /gzugs rnams bstan pas sems can 'dul bar byed1 /mthong na snyidaga' tshim rab tu dga' rnams la/ /blo mchog de dag 57—176

'bar la/ /'jig rten gti mug me chen rab 'bar zhing / /rga dang na dang 'chi ba rab 'bar ba'i/ /'jig rten bstan nas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /de dka sangs rgyas stobs bcu brtson bzhi dang / 1chos kyi khyad par bcwa ⑫brgyad rnams kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag nyid rjod byed cing 1 /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams kyis 'gro don byed/ /de dag kun brjod rdzu 'phrul rjes bstan pas/ /bzugs kyi byin rlabs snyestobs kyis guthams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston byed cing / /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas sems can 'dul/ /de dag thabs tshul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'jig rten rgyu zhing 'gro ba'i don rnams byed/ /'jig rten mi chags chu la pad ma bzhin/ /dga' zhing dad par byed la rnam par rgyu/ /de dka snyan dngags ④mkhan rgyal snyan dngags sbyor/ /gar mkhan rnga mkhan gyad dang rol mo mkhan/ /bzhagapasnye mjos rgyan phreng thogs shing gar byed dang / /sgyu ma mkhan po gzugs mang 6 kun du ston/ /grong pa grong dpon kha lo sgyur bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin ded dpon tshong dpon khyim ༅bdag 'gyur/ /rgyal po blon po mdun 'don —pho nya dang —/ /sman pa 'jika rtenar()bstan bcos cho ga mkhan/ /de dag dgon par ljon loshing chen por 'gyur/ /sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod 'byin sdong kyi po dang / /lam gol dong ba rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ /'jig rten byung nas mi ring shes gyur cing / /sems can las kyi tshul rnams mi shes pa/ /de dag kun la rbos chos ⑫tshong thabs dang / /sna tshogs bzo rnams 'jig rten rjod par byed/ /'tshe med 8 gnod pa med pa'i sbyor ba bang / /sems can bde byed mkhas pas rab bsngags pa/ /rigasaḥ57—178

stobs sman dang bstan bcos sna tshogs kun/ /drang srong de dag rnams kyis rab tu brjod/ /gang la lhar bcas 'jig rten mos 1'gyur ba/ /drang srong spyod mchog dam pa kang yin dang / /brtul zhugs dka' spyad dka' thub mchob kun kyang / /mkhas pa de dag rnams kyis rab tu brjod1/ /de dag spyod can⑧kunadza —rgyu mu stegs can/ /gdung ba go ta ma dang mi smrar spyod/ /gcer bu gos med lhur len dge sbyong la/ /nu stegs can kyi slob dpon mkhas par ston/ /de dag kun du 'tsho ba'i chos 'dzin dang / /bla na yod dang bla na med rnams dang //ral pa ring dang gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag tu yang slob dpon 'gyur ba yin/ /nyi ma'i rjes lta dka' thub lnga ldan dang / /khye dang ba lang brtul zhugs ri dgas spyod/ /gle'u can dag dang mu stebs sum cu —pa/ /de dag tu yang de dag slob dpon 'byur/ /lha yi shes la 'juka pa dga' kyirnams dang | /zu stegs nye reg yul du rgyu rnams su/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu chu spyod gyur nas kyang / /bsam yas chos la de dag dam pa mchos /tsog pur 1'dug dang gcig pu rgyu ba dang / /tsher ma rtswam1pedang thal bar nyal ba dang / /gang dag gtun shing mal can banas pa dang / /de dag tu yang de dag slob dpon 'gyur//phyi rol mu stegs can rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag bsam pa mos pa rtogs byas shing | /bsnyen dka' mi bzad r+shadrag shul dka' thub kyis/ /nu stegs can gyi sdug bsngal spang bar tsha'adul/ /'jig rten lta bas 'khrugs pa shes byas nas/ /lta ba ngan la gnas pa'i nu stegs can/ /kun la phra ba'i gzhi dang thabs tshul gyis| /de dag rnams la bden pa ston par byed/ /la lar 'gro lding ba yi sngags kyi gzhi/ /shin tu gsang ba'i gzhi yis bden pa ston/ /la la dag la 57nga 179

gsal zhing drang tshig gis/ /la la dag la lha yi gsang tshig gis/ /la la dag la yi ge dbye tshig dang / /don la rnam nges rdo rje'i tshig rnams dang / /rgol ba 'dul ba shes pa'i tshig rnams dang / /bstan bcos thub med thar pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /la la dag la mi skad tshig rnams dang / /kun la 'jug pa'i tshig nges tshig rnams kyis/ /la la dag la lha tshig nges tshig dang / /klu yi nges tshig gnod sbyin nges tshig gis/ /la lar⑪srin po 'byung po sha za dang / /dri za grul bum lto 'phye che tshig dang / /mi ci lha min mkha' lding tshig rnams kyis/ /bden pa bstan cing thar par 'dren pararargabyed/ /de dag bden dang nges tshig tshul shes te/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /chos nyid bsam yas tshig lam shes pas ston/ /de dag ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o// // bam po bzhi pa ste tha ma11 de dag 'gro bde mchoka gi ting nge 'dzin/ /'gro ba kun la mngon par sgrub byed cing / /'od zer bsam byis mi khyab rab bkye ste/ /'od zer bkye nas sems can 'dul bar byed/ /mthong na 0legs pa'i 'od zer rab btong zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer de shes pa/ /de dag mthong legs don med ma yin te/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes mchog gi rgyu/ /mi rnams kun la sangs rgyas yongs bstan cing / /chos kyang yongs bstan deramil ma bstan cing / /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mchod rten bstan byas pas/ / des nashāb mthong legs 'od zer grub par 'gyur/ /lha yi ma'od zer zil gyis sa/non pa yi/ /'od zer 'od byed ces bya rabam1 gtong zhing / /rdul dang nun pa thams cad bsal byas te/ /'jig rten phan pa'i 'od des rngorab tu snang / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir sgron 57—180

ma 'dzin/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir sgron bzung bas/ /'jig rten sgron ma mdzad pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /'bru mar mar me mar gyi mar me dang / /rtswa 1 shing 'dam bu 'od ma'i sgron ma dang / /spos dang bcud len rin chen sgron ma dag /rgyal ba rnams la phul nas 'od byed thob/ /sgrol zhes bya ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /de dag sred yangs srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can bsgral ba'i don du go cha gyon/ /bang dag sred yangs srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can bsgral ba'i don du go gyon pa/ /de dag chu bo bzhi las mirab tu sgrol/ /mya ngan med pa bde ba'i grong khyer ston/ /stegs dang zam pa du ma byas pa dang / /chu klung lam la sgrol ba'i gru 'byin te/ /'dus byas sun phyungapamizhi ba bsngags byas pas/ / des na zu sgrol ba'i 'od zer grub par 'gyur/ /skom pa sel ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skom 1pa rab spangs shing / /chos la mos pa'i ro 3ni don du gnyer/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skom pa rab spangs te/ /chos mosamadziro la don du banyer gyur pas//bdud rtsi char pa 'bebs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'jig rten skom pa'i sred pa rnam par sel/ /jing dang chu klung khron pa chu dngo dang / /mtsho rnams byang chub don du byed btsud de/ /'dod pa smad cing bsam gtan bsngags byas pas/ /des na sred pa sel ba grubayopar gyur/ /dga' bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /dga' bsnyergyas shing byang chub mchog don du/ /rang byung 'gyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed do/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i sku bzugs mtshan brgyan pa/ /pad ma'i 57—181

gdan la bzhugs pa rnams byas shing / /rtag tu sangs rgyas yon tan rnams tsa brjod pas/ /des na dasa' byed 'od zer grub par gyur/ /mgu bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can kang dag 'od des bskul byas — pa—/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas la ni dga' mgu zhing / /chos la dasa' mgu dbe 'dun dga' mgu'o/ /de dag rtas tu sangs rgyas dga' mgu zhing / /chos la dga' mgu dge 'dun dga' mgu nas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phabs pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /rtag tu 'grogs thob bzod pa bla med thob/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran chos dang tshosas mchog la/ /sems can mang po bskul cing dran byas te—)/ /byang chub sems kyi yon tan rab brjod pas/ /des na mgu byed 'od zer grub par 'gyur—/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can bang dag 'odalades bskul byas pa/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub don gnyer zhing ka/ /sbyin pa sna tshogs du ma sbyin par byed/ /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin de byed tshe/ /slong ba rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs byas te/ /bsam pa thams cad sbyin pa byin byas pas/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i 'od zer grub par 'gyur / /ye shes ldan pa'i 'od zer rab btong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des baspul byas pa— pa/ /chos gcig sgo mo nas ni du ma yi/ /chos kyi sgo rnams yud (kyis khong du chud/ /chos kyi dbye ba sems can 'dzin btsud de/ /don la nges pa'i ye shes rnam phye zhing / /chos kyi tshig don brjod pa byas pas na/ /des na ye shes ldan pa'i 4 'od zer grub/ /shes rab sgron ma'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing 1 /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pacho—/ /stong pa bdag med ma skyes ma byung zhing / /rang bzhin med pa'i chos la 57—182

rab tu 'jug /bdag po med chos stong pa byed med pa/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla mtshungs 'dra zhing / /rmi lam mtshungs la bzukas brnyan 'dra ba dag /bstan pas shes rab sgron ma de grub po/ /chos kyi rnam 'phrul 'od zer rab gtong zhing⑪/ /sems can gang dka 'od des bskul byas pa/ /mi zad bzod 1 kyi gzungs ni thob grur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mdzod kyang 'dzin/ 1chos 'dzin rnams la yongs su phan gdags 8te/ /drang srong rnams la chos kyis bsrung ba byas shing / /'gro ba chos kyis rjes su bsrung — byas pas/ /chos kyi rnam 'phrul 'od zer grub —par 'gyur3/ 1gtong dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can 'jungs pa gang dag des bskul ba2/ /longs spyod mi rtag mi brtan sgyu shes gyur nas/ /de dag rtab tu btong la dga' mos 'gyur/ /ma dul gdul dka'i sems can ser sna can/ /nor rnams rmi lam sprin dang 'drar shes nas/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis sbyin pa spel byas pas / /des na stong ༄ dang ldan pa'i 'od grub bo/ /yongs su gdung —4med 'od zer rab satong zhing / / khrims 'chal sems can gang dab des bskul ba1 /tshul khrims rnam paraXdag la gnasaXgyur nas/ /rang byung 'gyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed do/ //dge ba'i las lam yongs su dag pa dang / /tshul khrims la yang sems can mang 'dzud cing 1 /byang chub sems kyang tsheyang dag 'dzin 'jug pas/ /yongs bdung med pa'i 'od zer de grub bo/ /bzod pa bkod pa'i 'od zer rab btong zhing / /mi bzod sems can bang dag des bskul ba/ /khro dang tha ba nga rgyal yongs spangs shing / /de dag rtag tu bzod mos dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdig ldan rnams kyi nyesam6byas bzod byas te/ /byang chub don du 'khrugs pa ma byas shing //57—183

bzod pa'i yon tan rtas tu bsngags brjod pas/ /des na bzod pa bkod pa de grub po/ /sbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /le lo'i sems can gang dag des bskul — ba/ /ribs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor ba skyo 1med mchod pa byed par 'byur/ /rigs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas nas/ /de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das te/ /byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur—/ /sems can mang po brtson 'grus 'dzin bcug ste/ /dkon mchob kasum la mchod pa rab byas nas/ /zad pa'i dus na dam chos yongs bzung — bas /des na sbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'od thob bo/ /zhi bar byed pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing 1 /rnam 'khrugs sems can bang dag des bskul ba/ /de dag chags med sdang med rmongs med cing / /rtogs par grur nas mnyam gzhag zi sems su 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i grogs ༄po skyon ldan spyod can dang / /'dre ba yongs su rnam par spang byas te/ /dbon par rngorab zhi bsam gtan bsngags brjod pas/ /des na zhi bar byed pa'i 'od grub bo/ /shes rab bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /shes 'chal sems can ji snyed des bskul ba/ /bden dang brtan 4dang rnam thar tshul rnams dang / /dbang po shes pa rtogs par khong shā chud 'gyugyu/ /bden dang brtan dang rnam thar tshul rnams dang / /dbang po shes pa rtogs par khong chud cing / /nyi ma ⑫sgron ma'i cheting 'dzin thob gyur nas/ /shes rab snang bar mdzad pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal srid nor dang bdab phangs yongs btang ste/ /byang chub don du chos bang btsal tshi byas pa/ / chos de gus par byas nas rab bshad pasashā3/ /shes rab bkod 57nga 184

pa'i 'od zer de grub bo/ /sangs rgyas ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskulaXbyas pa/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag du ma bsam yas rnams/ /pad ma dam pa rnams la bzhugs par mthong sangs rgyas che 1dang sangs rgyas rnam thar dang / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul mtha' yas brjod byas shing / /sangs rgyas stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rab brjod pas/ / de nasam1sangs rgyas ldan pa'i 'od grub bo/ /mi 'jisas sbyin pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jigs nyen sems can gang dag des reg kyipa/ /'byung po gza' dang gsad brdog bcing ba dang / /nad 'bo 'jigs pa kun las thar bar 'grur4/ /mi 'jigs — sbyin pas sems can gang bskyabs dang / /srog chags gsod —las bzlog pa byas pa dang / /'jigs pa skyabs mtshol rnams la skyabasam— byas pas1/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i 'od zer des grub bo/ /bde ba kun byed 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /nad pa na ba gang das des reg pa/ /rnam 6pa kun du nad kyi sdug bsngal thar/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde ba rnams kyang thob/ /nad gsos 'bras bu sman dang rtsa ba dang / /rin chen bcud len spos dang byug pa dang / /bu ram sprang rtsi 'o ma mar dag dang / /'bru mar zas skom byin pas de thob bo/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /tshe zad tha mar bang dag des bskul ba/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag shi 'phos sangs rgyas bzhugs zhingashānya'agro / /'chi ba'i dus su sangs rgyas dran byas te/ /dga' byed rgyal ba'i tshesku gzugs bstan byas shing / /'chi kar 6sangs rgyas skyabs su satong shābarjod pas—/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'od zer de thob bo/ /chos rab rjod tshapa'i 'od 57—186

zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /chos nyan klog cing yi ger 'dri bar 1 byed/ /de dag rtag tu chos la dga' mos 'gyur—/ /chos kyi mu ge byung tshe chos brjod de/ /chos tshol rnams kyi bsam pa rdzosas byas shing / /'dun pa bskyed de chos la brtson gyis zhes/ /brjod pas chos rab brjod pa de thob bo/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams yongs su bskul ba'i phyir / /dbyangs dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten gsum na sgra rgyud ji snyed pa/ /kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung du thos/ /kasang bstod sgra yis drang srong che bstod de/ /rgyal ba'i gsung sgra don du sil snya na dang / /sgra chen dril bu sbyin rnams 'gro kun la/ /rab tu bsgrags pas dbyangs ldan 'od grub bo/ /'chi med sbyin pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa2/ /bag med spyod pa thams cad rab spangs te/ /yon tan kun la brtson pa nyams su len/ /'dus byas rtag tu bde ba med pa ste/ /sdug bsngal 'tshe ba du mas yongs su gang / /'gog pa rtab tu bde zhing zhi skyid ces/ /brjod pas 'chi med sbyin pa de thob bo/ /khyad par ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi tshul khrims khyad par dang / /ting 'dzin khyad par shes rab khyad par thos/ /thub chen 3)rgyal po'i gekhrims kyis mchog gyur cing / /ting 'dzin mchog dang shes rab mchog gyur ces/ /byang chub don du bsto da cing bsngabs brjod pas/ /des na khyad par ldan pa'i 'od grub bo—/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing 1 /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /rin chen mi zad gter rnams thob gyur nas/ /57—186

drang srong che la rin chen dam pas mchod/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten rin chen phul1/ /skye bo nyon mongs rin chen rnams kyis bsdus/ /rgyal ba rnams la rin chen rab phul bas/ /rin chen bkod pa'i 'od zer grub par 'gyur 1 / /spos rab snang ba'i 'od zer rab gtong 1 zhing / /sems can gang dag 'od des bskul byas pa/ /mi la med spos yid 'ong tshor gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la nges par 'gyur/ /mi dang lha yi spos dang byug pa yis1 /mi yi btso la mchod pa rab byas te/ /sbos las rgyal ba'i gzusas dang mchod rten dab /byas pas spos rab snang ba de grub bo/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer rab pa ka/tong zhing / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog sna tshobs dang / /sil snyan bsgrags shing spos kyis bdug dpa yis/ /pho zang dam pa mdzes byas me tog bkram/ /sil snyan dag gis rgyal ba rnams bsu 3zhing / /me tog byug pa bdug sbos bye ma dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs mchog rnams kyis mchod/ /des na sna tshogs bkod pa grub par gyur/ /shin tu dang byed 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sa rnams lag mthil bzhin du gnas par byed/ /mchod rten drang srong banas rnams sbyangs ḍabyas pas/ /des na shin tu dang ba'i rngo'od grub bo—/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /spos kyi char 'bebs sprin rnams kun du sanas/ /mchod rten 'khor sar spos kyi chus btab pas/ /sprin dang ldan pa'i 'od de rab tu thob/ /lhab lhub bkod pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /gcer bu gos yod rgyan rngo dang ldan par 'gyur⑫/ /bos dang babo ba rgyan phrengashesna tshogs dab /sbyin pa byas pas lhab lhub bkod pa grub/ /ro mchog ldan pa'i 'od zer rab btong zhing / /bkres pa kha zas ro mchog thob 57—187

par 'gyur/ /zas dang skom dang ro mchog sna tshokas rnams/ /byin pas ro mchoka ldan pa'i 'od grub bo/ /nor rnams ston pa'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dbul po dag gis rin chen gter rnams 'thob1— / /dkon mchog gsum la gter gzhi mi zad pa/ /dbul ba byas pas nor ston 'od thob bo/ /mig rnam 5sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /de tshe long bas sna tshogs sazugs rnams mthong / /rgyal ba dag dang 6rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /mar me phul bas mig sbyong 'od zer grub/ /rna ba rnam spyong 'od zer rab gtong zhing //rna ba nyams pas sgra mang thos par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ 1sil snyan phul bas rna sbyong 'od zer grub/ /sna rnam ‘pesbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sngon chad ma tshor dri zhim tshor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la / /spos rab phul bas sna sbyong 'od zer grub—/ /lce rnam 8sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /sgra snyan yid 'ong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bstod/ /mi snyan brlang bar smra ba rnam spangs te/ /'jam par smras pas rngo —lce sbyong 'od zer grub/ /lus rnam tshesbyong ba'i 'od zer rab katong zhing / /dbang po nyams pa dbang po ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /lus btud byas pas lus rnam ba sbyong ba thob/ /sems rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /smyos pa thams cad sems dang ldan par 'gyur tsa/ /ting 'dzin dbang rjes sems 'gro byas pas na/ /sems rnam tshosbyong ba'i 'od zer de grub bo/ /gzugs rnam tshosbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /mi dbang rnams kyiwaṃbasam yas sku mthong ste/ /sku bzugs ri mo sna tshosas mang po dang / /mchod rten brgyan byas gzugs sbyong 57—188

'od grub bo/ /sgra rnamamarjesbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong — zhing / /sgra ni sgra mi 1 stong par rab tu shes/ /rkyen las byung bas brag ca zi'adra'o zhes/ /sgra rnams bstan pas 'od zer de grub bo/ /dri rnam sbyong ba'imab 'od zer rab gtong zhing //dri nga thams cad dri zhim mchog tu 'gyur/ 1spos rab mchog chus rgyal ba'i mchod rten dab /khrus byas byang chub zhing bi 'od de yin/ /ro bro sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /dug can dug med ro yi 1mchog tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyan thos bcas dang pha ma la/ /ro mchog thams cad phul ba'i 'od de yin/ /reg rnam sbyong ba'i 'od zer rab btong zhing / /res na rtsub pa 'jam zhing bde bar 'gyur/ /mdung thung rtse gsum ral gri mda' chen char/ /phreng ba 'jam pa pad ma u da pal 'gyur/ /bcos bu'i ras mang — 'jam zhing reg bde rnams/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi bshebs shul — bting bkram ste/ /me tob byug paban bza' 'jam rnams dang / /phreng ba bla re phul ba'i 'od de yin/ /chos rnam tsasbyong ba'i 'od zer rab gtong zhing / /'jig rten phan mdzad rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /spu rnams kun nas chos rnams bsam mi khyab/ 1byung ba thos nas mos pa thams cad tshim/ /rkyen las byung ba ma skyes ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku ni chos sku ste/ /chos nyid mala' bzhin rtag tu gnas so zhes| /brjod pas chos rnams sbyong ba thob par 'gyur1 / /'od zer sgo mo de dag la sobs pa/ /drang srong rnams kyi spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i bye ma snyed 'byung 4ste/ /kun kyang las sbyor tha dad tshul can no/ /ji ltar de dag spu yi sgo gcig nas/ /'od zer gang gā'i pabye ma snyed 'byung ba/ /ma lus spu rnams kun nas de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam lha'aphrul 'di 57nga 189

'dra'o / /yon tan gang gis 'od zer gang grub pa'i/ /yon tan de grogs sngon chad gang gyur pa/ /de dag nyid las 'od zer rab 'byung lhaste/ /drang srong ye shes rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o / /de dab bsod nams sngon grogs gang yin la/ /rjes su yi rang gsol ba sus btab dang / /ba/nga gis mthong ste dge ba bsabs gyur pa —/ /de dag kun gyis 'od zer de dag shes/ /kang dag bsod nams byas mi/nga dge bsags dang / /gang dag yang yang sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing / /sangs rgyas yon tan 'dun te don gnyer ba/ /de dag kun la 'od zer de dag bskul༄ / /dper na dmus long nyi ma mi mthong yang /de med ma yin 'jig rten dab tu 'char/ /mib dang ldan pas shar bar shes gyur nas/ /kun kyang rang rang so so'i las la 'jug /de bzhin skyes chen 'od zer de dag kun/ /rab tu 'byung yang log pas nyen gyur cing / /mos nyams phal pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ / blo gros yangs — pa rnams la de dag mod / / dper rgyan 4 nor bu bzhon snyi pa gzhal med khang / /bcud kyisaXlen dang rin chen byug (pa sbos/ /de dag skye bo che la yod mod kyi—/ /phongs par gyur pa rnams la de dab med/ /de bzhin skyes chen 'od zer de dag modatshe / /de das yoyo kyang lob pas nyen gyur cing / /mos pa nyams pa rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ /blo gros yangs pa rnams la de dag mod/ /gang dab 'od zer dbye rtab 'di thos nas/ /dad cing mos la dang ba —steskyes gyur na/ /bdag ni yon tan cher 'gyur rkomi 'gyur zhes/ /de dab dogs dang som nyi mi skyed do/ /de dag g.yog 'khor bkod pa rnam 'phrul ba/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par grub ma byed cing / /phyosas bcu kun du do zla med rnams kyitsa/ /zham ring sangs rgyas 57—1( )0

sras rnams ston par byed/ /'od bkod de dag pad ma sna tshogs pa/ /stong bsum tshad tsam byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ / skyil krung rtebacas pa'i lus kyis kun khyab ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul —pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de dag zhing bcu'i rdul snyed pad ma gzhan/ /'khor dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs byas shing —/ /sangs rgyas sras kyis thams cad yongs su bskor/ /de dag ting 'dzin ting 'dzin med par gnas/ /drang srong de yis sems can bang dag rnams| /yongs su sminaXbyas sangs rgyas lebs baspubs pa/ /de dag pad ma chen po de bskor cing / /kun kyang thal mo sbyar nas lha zhing 'khod/ /gang das nying 'dzin sanas nga ra rab zhugs pa/ /skyes chen rnams kyi 1 chos nyid 'di yin te / /rang gi slob mas kun kyang yongs bskor nas/ /mar ma'i tshogs kyis zla ba bskor ba bzhin/ /de dag ji ltar phyogs bcig rab 'jug cing / / zhabs 'bring —sangs rgyas sras rnams ston byed pa/ /de bzhin phyogs rnams ma lus kun du ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dra'o/ /de das phyogs kyi dra ba khyab gnas pa'i/ /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par spub byed cing / /kha cig pemanyam gzhab —kha cib ldang bar yang / /phyobs bcu 4kun du rang thi lus ston to/ /de dag shar gyi phyogs su mnyam bzhag cing / /nub kyi phyogs nas dpa' bo rnam par ldang / /nub kyi phyobs su mnyam par bzhag gyur cing — / /bdab nyid chen po shar gyi phyobs nas ldang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu rnams su rab tu 'jug /gzhan kyi phyokas su mnyam par bzhag gyur la/ /ye shes yon tan phyug po rgazhan nas ldang / /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /shar phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na 57nga /91

rang byung ba/ /de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la banas par snang 1 /phyobs der mnyam par bzhag par bstan byas nas / /dpa' bo nub kyi zhing rnams ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum rgyal kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /nub phyosas sangs rgyas zhing rnams gang yin pa/ /grangs med ma lus dag na bzhugs sangs rgyas/ /de dag spyan sngar zhabs drung de dag rnams/ /zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par snang / /phyobs der mnyam par bzhag par bstan byas nas/ /dpa' bo shar gyi zhing rnams ma lus par/ /rnam par ldang zhing mngon sum 1rgya' kun la/ /mchod pa du ma rab tu byed par snang / /de bzhin phyosas bcu dag bi zhing rnams su—/ /phyogs rnams ma lus kun du brtan pa 'jub /ba ciyo mnyam bzhag la cig langs gyur cing / /'jika rten sgron ma rnams la mchod byed snang / /de dag mib gi lam la mnyam bzhab cing / /gzugs kyi lam nas dbadag nyid chen po ldang / /gzubs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ston pa na/ /de la lhar bcas 'jig rten rbongs par 'gyur/ /gzukas kyi lam la mnyam par ba'ag gyur la/ /mig ༄ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /mig gi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de das rna ba'i lam la mnyam bzhas cing / /sgra yi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang la lhar bcas 'jis rten rbongs 'gyur ba/ /sgra dang skad rnams kun la rab tu zhugs /sgra yi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /rna ba ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /rna ba'i lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dag sna yi lam la mnyam bzhab cing / /dri yi 57—192

lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jib rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /dri mchog dam pa 'jub par rab tuzhugs/ /dri yi lam la mnyam par bzhag 1gyur cing / /sna ni ma skyes ma byung rang bathin te/ /stong pa byed pa med pa rab ston cing / /sna yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de dab lce yi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /ro mchorga kun gyi lam nas rnam par ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /bdab nyid chen po ro mchog rnams dang ldan/ /ro mchog rnams la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lce ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lce yi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / 1de dag lus kyi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /reg pa'i lam nas bdab nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jib rten rmongs 'gyur ba/ /'jis rten bde ba skyed pa'i reg la zhugs/ /reg pa'i lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /lus ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /lus kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang —/ /de dag sems kyi lam la mnyam bzhaka cing / /chos kyi lam nas bdag nyid chen po ldang / /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten rmongs 'gyur ba — / /chos la gnas pa'i 'jus pa rab tu zhugs/ /chos lam rnams la mnyam par bzhag pe grur cing / /sems ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par rab ston cing / /sems kyi lam nas dran ldan rnam par ldang / /de das byis pa'i lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /lang tsho shugs la gnas pa rnams las ldang | /lang tsho shugs gnas rnams la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgas shing 'khorgas pa'i lus las rnam par ldang / /zas shing 'khogs pa'i lus la mnyam 57—193

bzhag cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen ma yi shā lus las 2ldang / /dbe bsnyen dad ma'i lus la mnyam bzhag 1cing / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus las rnam par ldang / /dad pa'i dge bsnyen lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /dge slong ma yi lus las rnam par ldang / /dge slong ma yi lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /dge slong mang du thos pa'i lus palas ldang / /dge slong mang thos lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /slob dang mi slob lus las rnam par ldang / /slob dang mi slob lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /rkyen gyi sangs rgyas lus las rnam par ldang / /rkyen gyi sangs rgyas lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab las rnam par ldang / /sangs rgyas sku mchog rab la mnyam bzhag cing / /lha yi lus gzugs las ni rnam par ldang / /lha yi lus gzugs la ni mnyam bzhag cing / /rdzu 'phrul chen po klu yi lus las ldang / /rdzu 'phrul klu yi 3 lus la mnyam bzhag — cing / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus las rnam par ldang / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /'byung po kun gyi lus las rnam par ldang / /'byung po kun gyi lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /spu yi sgo gcis nas ni rnam par ldang 1 /spu sgo gcig la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /spu sgo thams cad nas ni rnam par ldang / /spu sgo kun la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /skra rtse gcig gi khyon las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse sacig bi khyon la mnyam bzhag cing / /skra rtse kun gyi khyon las rnam par ldang / /skra rtse kun gyi khyon la mnyam bzhag cing / /phra rab rdul gyi rdul las de dag ldang / /rdul gcig la ni mnyam par bzhag ka gyur cing / /ma lus rdul rnams kun las rnam par ldang / /rdul rnams ma lus kun la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgya mtsho'i rdo rje'i kazhi las rnam par ldang / /rgya 57—194

wa hūṃ ste dz+wa wa tāX ༷ ga spra ga baX/na wa la ༷ ༷༷ ཿ ༷nga wa ༷ shā ༷/ gyu ci bye / ngh+ru /༷ / spya ༷༷2 — da (3 snyeX glu ṭ+wāṃ shā zi lnga /ta /da nga d+ngha rwa snas rdo / nga rde / hūṃ /na mi ༷ / //— / ༷nga / lo de

mtsho'i rdo rje'i gzhi la mnyam bzhag cing / /nor bu'i shing tos 1dag las rnam par ldang / /shing tog rnams la mnyam snyepar bzhag —gyur nas④/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'od zer sgo nas ldang / /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sgo la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgya mapa'i chu yi chu klung rnams las ldang / /rgya mapa'i chu klung rnams la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdab nyid chen ngo me yi lam nas zi ldang / /me yi lam la mnyam par bzhag —gyur cing / /rlung gi lam las dran ldan rnam par ldang / /rlung gi lam la mnyam par bzhag gyur cing / /bdag nyid chen po sa yi gzhi las ldang / /sa yi sazhi la mnyam par bzhas ‘ gyur cing / /lha kun gzhal med khang las rnam par ldang / /lha kun gzhal med khang la mnyam bzhag cing / /dran ldan de dag mkha' las rnam par ldang / /yon tan bsam yas bsabs pa de dag gi/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar de dag bsam mi khyab/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bskal pa bsam yas su/ /bshad pa mdzad kyang zad par mdzad mi spyod/ /'gro las rnam smin bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /rgyal ba kun kyis de das bsungs 1 pa ni/ /klu yi rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dang / /bsam byed bsam btan rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de das la yang dpe bstan brjod par bya/ /de dag 'dra ba'i dpe zla sgyu cang med de/ /mkhas shing rig pa'i skye bo dpe rnams kyis/ /bstan na myur du don r+sharnams shes par 'gyur/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi dbang la gnas pa yi/ /nyan thos gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur/ /mang por gyur nas phyir yang gcig gyur te/ /mkha' la bsam gtan 'cha'41zhing 'bar bar byed//smad nas me 'bar stod nas chu yi rgyun/ /stod nas me 'bar smad nas chu yi rgyun| /'gro dang 'greng dang nyal dang 'dug pa dang / /lus 'phrul skad cig 57—195

gcig la bsam mi khyab/ /de ni snying rje che dang mi ldan zhing / /byang chub mi tshol 'jika rten yal 1'dor yang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /'jig rten phan 'dod ci phyir ston mi byed/ /nyi zla mkha' la 1 rnam par rgyu 'dong zhing / /phyogs rnams kun gyi chu yi dngo 1dag dang / /mtsho mtshe'u mtsho bran snod dang rin chen dang / /rgya mtsho chu klung rnams su gzugs brnyan ston—/ /de bzhin gzugs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo phyogs bcu kun du ston/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar kun gyi tshul la mkhas/ /de la de bzhin gshepos pa rang byung dbang / / dang ba'ipazumatsho la yan lag bzhi pa'i dmab /de dab so so rang yi kazugs brnyan mthong / /ral gri mda' chen yozhu dang mda' rnams dang / /go gyon bzhon da dang theg par bcas su mthong / /bang gi gzugs gang gnas gang cha byad yong / /de dang de dag de ltar chu las mthong —/ /'on kyang chu — —la byams sdang rnam rtog med/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra'o/ /rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan zhes bya ba/ /sems can rgya mtshor ji snyed skyes rnams kyi/ /sgra yi yan lag dbyangs kyi tshul mkhas te/ /rang gi skad kyis ba skad kun tshim par byed/ /sgra ldan chags sdang gti nug can de yang / /skad rnams kun gyi sgra yi tshul mkhas na/ /gzungs dang chos kyi — stobs la dbang thob rnams/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten ci phyir mgu mi byed/ /tum bu ru yi — chung ma dbyangs ldan ma/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo yid las byung ba de/ /bden dang dam bcas mi 'tshe dasa' rnams kyi/ /sems dang yid dang kha yi sgor 'jug ste/ /dbyangs ldan chags can zhe sdang can de yang / /brtul zhugs grub tsa'athun dbyangs kyi yan lag gim/ /yid 'ong skad kyis 'jig rten 57—196

mgu byed na/ /ye shes yon tan phyug rnams 1dacis mi byed/ /risab —sngasas tshul mkhas sgyu ma'i mkhan po ni/ /sna tshobs gzugs mang mtha' yas ston par byed/ /nyin mtshan yud dang zla ba lo brgya dang / /khyim bzang rgyas pa shin tu mdzes pa ston—/ /'dod chags sdang —ldan sgyu ma'i malan po yang / /sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis 'jig rten mgu byed na/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam thar rab bslabs bapa//spyod tshul mkhas rnams ci phyir mgu mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po 'thab pa'i tshe/ /rgyal 1ldan lha yis lha min pham byas na/ /de dag 'jigs pas gdubs ba )bcas bzhin 3bcas shing / /theb bcas dmag bcas go gyon bzhin du 'byer/ /'dod chags sdang daldan lha dbang de dab kyang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul dbang sanas dpa' bo rnams—/ /lus kyi rnam 'phrul ci phyir ston mi byed/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i glang po sa srung bu/ /dbang ngo 'i 'khor gyur rdzu 'phrul chen po de/ /mgo bo sum cu ḍa)rtsa kasum mngon sprul cing / /mgo rnams kun la'ang mche ba drug drub ste/ /mche ba de dka so so re re la'ang / /rdzing bu chus sang bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /rdzing re la yang ka pad ma sna tshogs pa/ /rnam par bkod pa bdun bdun sprul pa byed— /pad ma re re'angashā — lha yi bu mo dag /sgyu rtsal kun shes bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /de dag rtsed mo glu gar tshu' la mkhas/ /sum cu tshertsa gsum dbang po de dang rtse/ /glang po de yang lus ni bsgyur byas te/ /lha rnams kun dang 'grosas shing 'dre bar byed/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang longs spyod kun kyang 'thunalha —/ /glang ngo mchog gi rnam 'phrul de ltar snang / /glang ngo chags sdang gti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rab tu ston byed na/ /shes rab 57—197
// — bye| ོ bye da bye bya wa ༷ shā rna snye wa ༷ /bye wa 'i khro snge ṇ+ḍaṃ //sdi ༷ / ngh+ru /// rdoX hūṃ 2 ༷ ཿ rngo rmye hūṃ rna ༷ wa rte
rdo/ bye traṃ /sdu sde sdu bye/ sdu rnang shī ༷ rdo bye bhā mi ༷ ༷༷ / na la jiX trī rte tre shātshoXrde / mi ri da/ /sheX rte bye sdo /nga wa 〉 /wa ༷ ga wa / twe

thabs kyi stobs la sbyangs pa rnams/ /ting 'dzin brgya yis rnam 'phrul cis mi byed/ /sgra bcan ji lhar 'dod bzhin lus 'phrul te/ /rdo rje'i gzhi la rkang pa 'jog byed cing / /rgya mtsho lte bar phyin pa tsam du ston/ /ri rab rtse dang nyid kyi mabo yang snyoms 1/ /sgra sacan chasas sdang sa/ti mug ldan de yang / /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rab tu ston byed na/ /'jig rten sgron ma bdud rnams rab 'joms pa/ /rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas ci phyir ston mi byed/ /brgya byin rnam 'phrul bsam yas rab snang ste/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha min bye ba 'phyes 1—pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed brgya byin rang gi lus las sprul/ /lha min dbang dang lha min phal kun gyis/ /brgya byin rang rang mdun gen 'dug par shes/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang bas bzung ngo zhes/ /lha min dbang po kun kyang 5mgo myos gyur/ /'jigs par byed pa'i mis stong rab bstan te/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba thogs byed cing / /lus la go bgos bzi brjid bsnyen dka' ba'i6/ /brgya byin mthong nas tholha min dbang po 'byer/ /de yang bsod nams phal pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /lha rgyal don du rnam par 'phrul byed na—/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi skyabs gyur pa1 /bsod nams mi zad rnams lta cis mi 'phrul/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i tshelha yi rnga/ /lha las rnam par smin pas grub gyur pa/ /lha rnams bag med sanas par shes gyur nas/ /rnga de nam mkha' las ni sgra sgrogs te / /'dod pa thams cad mi rtag ther zug min/ /tha shal mi brtan dadu ba'i rngo ngo bo nyid/ /sgyu ma smigarwa rgyu chu zla mtshungs shing 'dra—/ /srid pa thams cad rmi lam sprin 4— dang mtshungs/ /bag med thams cad dgrar babacas mya ngan can/ /'chi ba'i lam yin 6mi 'chi tsalam ma yin/ /ji 57—198

de trī tsha da khro ༷ rde ༷ ༷ ༷ ze ༷ /khro//pa da dri mi /sto da da / / na tshe wa wa / raX na rna ṭī trī nga darte rna rngo dz+wa na // / tswa jis/ /༷ / sdo ༷ /jiX ༷/ traṃ dro wa dab rdo sdu ༷ t+t+waṃ pa/ snge ni sdo / wa da wa rte

snyed su dag brga med gnas gyur pa/ /de dag 'chi bdab chu srin chen pos zin//sdug bsngal rtsa ba yongs 'dzin thams cad yin/ /skye ba thams cad 'phasas pa rnams kyis smad/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams kyi —yul la rmongs/ /chos kyi stobs la rtag dga' gyis zhes bskul —/ /rnga des bskul nas brgya byin lha rnams dang | /lha yi 'dun sa chos bzang 'dug nas su/ /gtam gang zhi zhing 'dod chags bral 'thun —pa/ /chos kyi gtam de lha rnams kun la brjod / /rnga de gzugs med bstan du mi rung yang / /de ltar rnga sgras don chen rab byed na/ /bsam pa ji bzhin sazugs ni yongs ston rnams/ /'gro ba kun gyi don chen cis mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po g.yul 'gyed tshe/ /lha yi bsod nams khyad par mthu stobs kyis/ /lha la skul ma 'debs pa'i rnga yi sgrad/ /lha rnams ma 'jigs shig ces sgra 'byin te/ /rnga yis bskul nas lha rnams rab dga' zhing | /skrag pa med de stobs kyang skyes par gyur — / /lha min dbang po skrag pas nyen pa rnams/ /'jigs nas dmag bcas de yi mod la 'byer/ /de ltar sgra skad 'byin pa'i rnga 'dra ba/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen po//nyon mongs bdud bcom snying rje che ldan rnams/ /zhi ba'i sgra bsgrags nyon mongs sel bar byed/ /dbang po'i 3lha yi ——bu mo dgu bcu gnyis/ /dbang po'i sprul pas kun kyang dga' bar 'gyur/ /bcib kyang bdab dang brgya byin rtse bar shes—/ /kacig ltar lha mo kun kyang de bzhin no/ /lha mo kun dang dga' bar gnas snang yang / /chos bzang 'dun (sa na yang de bzhin 'duka /lha rnams kun la chos rab ston snang zhing / /brgya byin skad cig gcis la rnam par 'phrul//brgya byin chags sdang gti nug ldan pa yang / /sprul pas rang gi 'khor rnams 57—199

dga'abyed na/ /'gro don mi skyo sbyor rnams ci yi phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'jig rten mgupa mi byed/ /bdud kyi dkrugs ma 'gro ba'i dbang sgyur ba/ /de yi dbang du sems can 'di kun 'dong / /las dang nyon mongs kun du zhugs pa yis/ /so so'i skye bo thams cad bdud des bcings/ /chabs sdang gti mus ldan pa'i bdud de yang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur byed na/ /dbang bcu dbang thob 5rnams lha ci smos te/ /'gro — ba thams cad rang gi phyogs mi 'jog 1 /stong gsum gnas kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang / /stong gsum tshangs gnas ji snyed yod pa na/ /de dab kun na 'dug par rab snang zhing —/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs shin tu yid 'ong sgrogs / /tshangs de 'jig rten pa yi tshangs lam gyi/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'jig rten rab 'das bla na med pa yi/ /bsam gtan rnam thar kagadas pa cis mi 'phrul/ /dbang phyub chen po'i shes pa'i rnam 'phrul ltos/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis char thigs rab bkye ba/ /skad cig gcib la thams cad 'grang ba — byed—/ /thikas 'ga'i zer kyang ma shes de med na/ /bslab pa bskal pa bsam yas rab bslabs te / /byang chub bla med ye shes thob pa rnams1 /ci pa phyir skad cig gcig la sems kyis ni/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi sems mi shes/ /sems can las smin — bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /'jig rten 'di kun rlung las yongs su byung tsha/ /rgya mtsho ri dang mulha yi gzhal med khang / /rin chen rnam phye sa bon bkram pa'ang byung / /rlung las sprin byung char pa'ang kun du 'bab/ /rlung gis sprin kyang rab tu zhi bar byed/ /'jig rten lo toka 'phel ba'ang rlung byed de/ /rlung ni 'gro ba kun la phan pa skyed/ /rlung de pha rol phyin la ma 57—200

bslabs shing mi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la ma bslabs 1kyang / /'jig rten rnam smin bsam yas ston byed na/ /dam pa thob rnams 1ci phyir ston mi byed| /rgya mtsho'i 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi chu tshokas ni/ /bya skad ri dgas skad dang skyes pa dang / /bud med bu mo khye'u skad ci rngo snyed pa/ /kun gyi sgra snyan sems can rnams la sgrogs she/ /de ltar sgra snyan rang bzhin med shes nas/ /sgrib pa med pa'i spobs dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /'gro ba kun la sgra snyan brjod byas nas//yid 'ong sgra yis 'jig rten mgu bar byed/ /rgya mtsho 'di la ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos| /'gro kun rgya dang mtshungs pas rgya mtsho ste/ /chu dang 'byung po rin chen yo nga mi zad/ /chu rnams bzung bas ngoms par 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin de dag 'gro kun rgya 'dra ste/ /bsod nams bsam satan rnam par thar rnams dang —/ /shes rab ye shes yon tan kun mi zad/ /bsod nams yon tan sogs —pas ngoms pa med/ /rgya mapa'i klu ni rnam par rtse ji ba na/ /sa yi sazhi nas dbang sgyur paganas kyi bar/ /gling bzhi bcas par sprin chen rgyas 'gengs te—/ /de dag kun kyang sna tshogs bkod pa mang / /de ni dbang sgyuram gnas su 'dzam gling gi/ /gser gyi mdog gi sprin rnams rnam par sgrub/ /'phrul dbar nu tika dmar po'i mdos lha bu/ /dba' ldan gnas su kha ba ba mo'i mdob /'thab bral gnas su mthon mthing bai drur+ya2/ /sum cu tsartsa bsum rdo yi snying po 'dra—/ /skyong ba'i banas su shel gyi mdog lta bu/ /rgya mtshor rdo rje mi phyed mkhregs 8'dra ba/ /mi ci miganas su spos mchos 'khrigs lta bu/ /klu yi banas su pad mam mdog 'dra ba/ /gsang ba'i gnas su ngang pa bya — gar mdoka /lha min gnas su ri brab mdog 'dra ba/ /byang du bser gyi 'od zer mdog ston 57nga 201

te—/ /gling rnams gzhan du sna tshogs bkod pa ston/ /'dzam bu'i0gling du ri sngon 'dra ba ste/ /gang na ci mtho sprin rnams de bzhin no/ /dbang sgyur banas su gser sprin nges —bstan nas/ /nyi ma'i mdog 'dra glog kyang rab tu 'gyed//'phrul dga'i ziganas su zla 'od bzang 'dra dang rdzu/ /dga' ldan kanas su 'dzam du'i gser mdog 'dra/ /'thab bral gnas su kha ba ba mo'i mdog /sum cu rtsa gsum — gser kyi 'od zer 'dra/ /skyong rtoba'i gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdos /rgya mtshor mu tig dmar po'i mdog 'dra bkod/ /mi ci gnas su mthon mthing bai drur+ya — / /klu yi gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdog /gsang ba'i gnas su shel kyi mdog 'dra ba/ /lha min banas su rdo yi snying po 'dra—/ /byang du nor bu skar mdog kha dog 'dra/ /gling gzhan rnams su'ang — bkod pa gzhan dang bzhan/ /'dzam bu'i gling du zla ba'i nor bu 'bar/ /sprin gyi mtshan nyid 'thun pa'i glog kyang 'gyed/ /de ni dbang sgyur banas su tshangs sgra sgrogasacho/ /'phrul dga' tsarga/nas su rnga sgra sgroka lopar byed/ /dga' ldan gnas su sil snyan rol mo'i sgra/ /'thab bral gnas su lha yi bu mo'i sgra/ /sum cu geka/sum du mi ci mang po'i skad/ /skyong ba'i banas su dri za'i skad du ste/ /rgya mtshor ri 'thab sgra skad 'dra ba'o/ /mi ci ⑫gnas su gling bu ku nal sgra ka / /klu yi gnas su ka la ping ka'i sgra/ /gsang ba'i gnas su klu yi bu mo'i sgra/ /lha min gnas su lha yi rdza rnga'i sgra/ / mi yi 1 kanas su rgya mtsho logling bu'i sgra/ /de ni dbang sgyur gnas su lha spos zhim/ /me tog sna tshogs bkod pa'i char yang 'bebs— /'phrul dgar༄ zla ba zla bzangs 1 'dra ba yi/ /me tog man dārakasgyuphreng dang byub pa 'bebs/ /dga' ldan gnas su nor bu chen po'i mdog /57—202

rgyan gyi dam pa rin chen sna tshogs dang / /gtsug gi nor bu zla ba 'dra ba dang / /gser mdog 'dra ba'i dar la'i char yang 'bebs/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang ba dan sna tshogs dang / /phreng ba rnams dang rgyan dang byug pa dang / /nu tig dmar dang gser dang dar la dang / /sil snyan yid rje 'ong 'thab bral kanas su 'bebs/ /sum cu rdogasum du yid bzhin 1 nor bu mchog /skyong ba'i gnas su tsan dan snying po'i mchog /gur gum sil ma lha shing ta ma la/ /spos chu'i rgyun dang me tog rab tu 'bebs/ /skyong ba'i gnas su klu yi dbang po de/ /nyam ba stobs skye ba'i kha zas skom bgyi rnams/ /kha dog dri zhim ro dang ldan pa dang —/ /de min rin chen bsam yas char yang 'bebs/ /de ni rgya mtsho chen por rgyun du yang / /char rgyun mi 'chad gnya' shing tsam dag dang / /rnam rgyal chen po mdzod rnams mi zad pa/ / rin chen bkod pa mtha' yas char yang 'bebs—/ / mi ci rebanas su rgyan phreng sna tshogs dang / /pad ma ud pal ras dang rin chen dang / /me tog bar sha ma lim(phye ma tshuspos/ /pi bangad+ku gling bu sgra snyan rdza rnga 'bebs/ /klu yi gnas su mu tika dmar po ste/ /gsang bar nor bu rin chen skar mdog 'dra/ 1lha min gnas su ral gri mda' chen dang / /dgrar tsa'adul gzhu dang ste'u ka'i char pa 'bebs/ /byang du de ni rgyal phreng rin chen dang / /me tos bar sha ma li tsam pa'i phreng / /ku ran gtsang dang a ti mug ta tsha'abebs/ /gling gzhan rnams su'ang bsna tshogs char pa 'bebs/ /'dzam bu'i gling du chu bsal dang ba yi/ /char rnams chos bzhin phra ba'i rgyun du 'bebs—/ /me tog 'bras bu sman dang sgos dang shing / /lo tob bde byed 'jig rten rnams su skyed/ /de ltar sprin bkod bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /57—203

glos 'byin 'brub sgrogs 1 bkod pa'i char 'bebs kyang / /gnas nas mi g.yo rnam par rtog pa med/ / klu yi rnam 'phrul de ltar bsam mi khyab/ /rgya mapa'i chu na gnas pa de ltar yang / /klu yi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor zhubs pa'i yon tan phyug /rnam 'phrul bsam yas ci phyir ston mi byed/ /bag tsam smos pa'i dpe tshul 'di dab gis/ /skyes chen de dag rnams kyi 1brjod pa byas/ /dpa' zu bo de das dpe rnams kun dang bral/ /de dag de 'dra'i rnam thar dbang bsgyur ༄ ro/ /blo gros dam pa blo gros rgya chen ldan//ma nor blo gros mtha' yas blo gros can/ /ye shes mchog ldan khyad par blo can gyi—/ /rnam thar mchog rnams 'di lta rnams gyekyis bshadal/ /rnam thar dam pa 'di dag sus thos nas/ /yid ches 'dzin cing 'jib rten sgrog byed pa/ /de dag ngo mtshar rmad byung chos ldan te / /de dag dga' byed mi yi 'jig rten na//'di 'dra'i — chos 'dir —bang dag dad gyur pa/ /sems can so so'i skye bo'i tshogs na dkon/ /sang dab dge bsags bsod nams byas gyur pa/ /de dag rgyu yi rta stobs kyis 'di la dad/ /gang dag nyan thos theg pa'ang zoyid ches pa'i / /mi dag mi yi 'jig rten rnams na nyung / /de bas rkyen gyi theb par 8rab tu nyung / /theb pa chen por de dayo de bas nyung / /theg pa che la zhubs nga de dkon te/ /gang dag chos 'dir dad pa'ang rab dkon na/ /'jug cingaḥ 'dzin pa smos kyang ci dgos te/ /gang dag de bzhin sgrub tshe pa smos ci dgos/ /gang dag stong gsum ri dang rgya mtshor bcas ma/ /phyi ma'i bskal par mgo bos 'deb — byed kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bya dka' ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra tshode ni de la yod ma yin/ /la las stong gsum rdul snyed sems can la/ /bde ba 57—204

kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur kyang / /chos 'dir rtedad pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba/ /bsod nams khyad par de 'dra de la med/ /la las 1zhing bcu ri dang rgya mtshor bcas/ /lag pa'i mthil du bskal par mkhar 'dzin kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bya dka' ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra de ni de la yod ma yin/ /la las zhing bcu'i 1rdul snyed sems can la/ /dge ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur kyang / /chos 'dir dad pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba/ /bsod nams khyad par de 'dra de la med/ /la las zhing bcu'i rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams—/ /bde ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur bas/ /bang bis chos kyi le'u 'di gzung byas pa/ /bsod nams de ni de bas khyad par 'phags/ /rnam thar de dab rab tu bstan nga 'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad sayos par gyur/ /bdud kyi gnas rnams mob mog byas gyur cing / /sgra rab phyung bas ngan song rab tu zhi/ /phyokas bcu kun gyi mi yi seng ge rnams/ /de dag kun gyis mngon par zhal bstan te/ /phyag brkyang mdzad nas yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /bzang po dpal gyi mgo la bzhag par grur/ /phyag yi mthil gyis mgo la byug mdzad de/ /rnam thar 'di dag lesas par bshad pa legs/ /khyod kyis legs bstan rjes su nged padagyes zhes/ /sangs rgyas de ba kun gyis gsung brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di dka bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas stong bsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gang dag 'khod pa'i lha thams cad dang —/ mi dang mi mapa yin pa de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin sashegs pas 'di legs par bka' stsal to/ /kye ma de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo pā7—205

ra /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/3 ra /rgya gar skad du/ /ār+ya bo dhi sa twa so tsa ra u pā ya bi ṣa ya ji kurba ṇa nir — de sha 1nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zu thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag 'is thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul 'phags rgyal na rgyal po gtum po rab snang gi skyed kamos tshal shing sā — la dang / ta la dang / ta ma la dang / dong ka'i shing kadang / n+ya gro dha dang / blag sha dang / thu dum bā ra dang / bar shi shi — ka dang / dha nu ka rari dang / a ti mug ta — ka dang / tsam pa ka dang / mya ngan 'tshang dang —/ skya snar dgyis legs par brgyan pa/ 'bab chu'i dngo chedang / mtsho dang 1 mtsho bran dang / mtshe'u dang / rdzing dang / lu ma mang pos mdzes 57—220

cad mkhyen pa nyid la mos pa mi zlogs 1pa'i yid dang ldan pa/ shes rab dang ye shes rnam par mthong ba'i dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ thabs kyi yul dang spyod yul la nges par byang 3ba sha stag ko/ /dge slong ma skye dgu'i snyebadag mo chen mo dang grags 'dzin la sogs pa dge slong ma brgyad 'bum dang yang thabs cig ( —ste chos dkar po shin tu yongs su bsdus pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam rab tu rtogs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang nye bar gyur pa/ dngos po med pa'i chos kyi tshul shin tu rtogs pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi tshul la rtobs pa 1/ chos thams cad yang dab pa'i mthas mtha' med par shin tu mos pa/ sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa thob pa/ gdul ba'i 'gro ba ji lta ba de bzhin du gzugs kun tu ston pa la malas pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa ya phrag bdun dang nyis 'bum gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang yang thabs cigamadzi ste 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shugs chen dang / shugs chen 'dzin dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po'i rgyal po dang / brtson 'grus chen pos rnam par sanon pab pa dang / rtsal chen dpa' bo dang / cher bsgyings dang / cher bsgyings stobs ldan dang / tshogs chen dbang po dang /glang po chen po sgos kyi glang po dang / zla ba chen po dang / zla ba bzang po dang /yon tan zla ba dang / rin chen zla ba dang / kun tu snang ba'i zla ba dang /chos dri ma med pa'i zla ba dang / rnam par snang byed zla ba dang / rnam par grakas pa'i zla ba dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa'i zla ba dang / rgyas pa'i zla ba dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po ltar sgrogs tsapa'i 57—222

dbyangs dang / sa la nges par sgrogs (pa'i dbyangs dang / chos kyi dbyings nges par sgrogs bapa'i dbyangs dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad sma 'bebs pa'i dbyangs dang / chos kyi sgra nges par sgrogs — pa'i dbyangs dang /thams cad du go bar byed pa'i dbyangs dang / rnam par mi rtogs bapas rnam par ma brtags pa'i dbyangs dang / sa steng snyenges par sgrobs rtsepa'i dbyangs dang — dbyangs kyi yan lag mthams cad zil gyis mnon repa'i dbyangs dang /kun nas snying po dang / yon tan snying ngo dang / chos dri ma (med pa'i snying po dang / rnam par snang byed snying po dang / rin chen snying po dang / zla ba'i snying po dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / snang ba'i tsosnying ngo dang / pad ma'i snying po dang / pad ma'i 4 cedapal gyi snying po dang / bsod nams dpal gyi snying po dang / ye shes dpal gyi snying po dang / blo gros chen po dang / khyad par blo gros dang / rnam gragasayoblo gros dang / rlabs chen blo gros dang / bla ma'i blo gros dang / rin ched blo gros dang / 'phel ba'i blo gros dang / mtha' yas blo gros dang / rgya chen blo gros dang / sangs rgyas blo gros dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dang / lhun po'i sgron ma dang / sgron ma chen po dang —/ chos ta la la'i sgron ma dang / phyosas thams cad rgyas par 'bengs pa'i sgronawaṃm dang / kun tu sgron ma dang / mun pa thams cad sel ba'i sgron ma dang / 'gro ba thams cad snang bar byed pa'i sgron ma dang / shin tu snang ba'i sgron ma dang / zla ba'i sgron ma dang / nyi ma'i sgron ma dang / ngan song sel ba dang / bdud pham byed dang / bdud chen pham byed dang / mngon par 'byung dka' dang / thub dka' dang / kating dpag sna dka' ba dang /57—223

blo rtogs dka' ba dang / ngan 'gro skems tsudang / mthu chen thob dang /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal bzhon nur gyur pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sa ya phrag bdun dang 'bum phrab gnyis dang thabs cig 1ste/ thams cad kyang skye ba sacig gis thosas pa/ gzungs thob pa du/ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ spobs pa mtha' yas pa thob pa/ thobs pa med pa'i mi 'jigs pa thob pa/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par 'gro ba'i mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse ba/lus dang sems rnam par grol ba/ chags pa med cing sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangasaXrgyas 'byung ba kun tu ston pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo khyad —par thob par byed pa la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad la so so ci rigs par chos yang dag par ston pa/ zur mi zlogs —pa'i chos ston pa/ blang ba med pa dang /dor ba med pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshul la zhugs pa/ stong pa nyid rjod5 pa/— seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs —ra pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad sma 'bebs pa/bdud phyir rgol ba thams cad bcom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang /rdzu 'phrul thamasasacad job pa/ rjes su chasas pa dang / khong khro ba med pa/chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / sa lta du'i sems dang ldan pa/ de bzhin sashegs pa thams cad kyi sasang ba'i sanas su chud pa/ sems can thams cad la—/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pas nye bar gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bstod bsngags snyan par brjod brjod cing bkur ba/ phyi ma'i mtha'i 57—224

bskal par byin gyi rlabs4)kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ de bzhin gshekas pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul yang dag par 'dzin pa/ chos rin po che'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/ yon tan gyi bsngabs pa thams cad mthar phyin pa dang ldan pa/'jig rten gyi dbang por gyur pa/ sngon gyi smon lam phun sum tshogs nga / de bzhin sashegs pa la mos pa'i spyod yul la nges par byung ba/ sngon theg pa chen po la spyad 1pa lesas par spyad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi tshul gyis dri ma med cing yongs su dag nga rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod cing rim gro byed pa la brtson pa/ phyir mi zlogasab pa'i go cha babos pa/snying rje chen po mngon du gyur pa/ rang bzhin gyis rgya chen po la mos pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ nem nur dang the tsom bdang yid rtosanyis thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ de bzhin sashegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa sha stag bo/ 1dge bsnyen dang / dbe bsnyen mam— 7 du ma dang yang thabs cig go/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na lha'am—/ lha'i dbang po'am/ klu'am/ klu'i dbang po'am/ gnod sbyin nam/gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'am/ dri za'am/ dri za'i dbang po'am/ lha ma yin nam ( lha ma yin gyi dbang po'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'am/ mi'am ci'am/ mi'am ci'i dbang po'am/ lto 'phyetshu chen po'am/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang ngo 'am/ mi'am mi'i dbang po sazi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba ༄ rtargya che ba rgya che ba/ g.yog 'khor 'bum phrag du ma dang ldan pa gang dka gnas pa de dag thams cad kyang 'khor de nyid du 'dus te 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'bum phrag du mas yongs su 57—226

bskor cing tsamadun byis bltas nas dpal gyi snying po'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nya —/ sku mdog dang / gzi brjid dang / sku'i 'od kyis 'khor 1thams cad zil gyis mnanapa0nas lamar me lhan no lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na ri'i rgyal po ri rab rgya mang nang nas mngon par 'phags shing / ri nab po bzhan zil gyis mnan nas lam me lhan ne lhang nge ba de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das gdan seng se'i khri la bzhugs pa yang rtselha dang mir bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba yar gyi ngo'i zla ba nya la bab ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa ni rgyu skar dang skar ma'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis mnan te mog mog por byas nas lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o— /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan te/ moka mog por mdzad nas lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ dag cing dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' sprin med pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gyi dra ba rab tu 'phro bar 'dug pa ni srin bu me khyer thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ mog mog por byas nas shin tu lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa yang brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi 'od zil gyis mnan te/ mog mog por mdzad nas lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ mtshan mo ri chen po'i spo la me chen po 'bar ba ni lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhusas pa la bayang lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lha ste dper na— nor bu rin po che bai drur+ya 4yan laka brgyad dang ldan zhing dri ma med pa 'od 57—226

zer rab tu 'phro ba ni lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i 4khri la bzhubs shing phyogs bcu thams cad snang bar mdzad pa yang lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po ni gling bzhi'i sems can thams cad zil gyis mnan cing lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das sadan seng bo'i khri la bzhugs pa yang lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste dper na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin brgya byin thosas pa'i nor bu rin po che thogs shing lha'i 'dun sa chos bzangs ( na banas pa ni lha thams cad zil gyis mnan cing lamaka me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du brtsom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de lta bu'i 'khor chen po 'dus par yang rig cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsnyen par dka' ba de yang mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das bdan seng be'i khri la bzhugs pa yang shin tu lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'khor chen po 'di yang 'dus par grur na 'di go ba cici snga lhas zhig tu 'gyur/ bdag yis de'i don de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar bya'o snyam nas de'i tshe 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de—/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do| /stobs bcu mnga' bas lhar bcas 'jis rten 'di/ /zil rmis 1mnan nas nga ni lhan ner bzhubs/ /srid pa gsum na khyod 'dra ma mchis na/ /57—227

lhab pa'i sems can mchis par ba la 'gyur/ /dper na lha gnas gyur pa lhun ngo ni/ /ri bo kun gyi nang nas mngon 'phags te/ /ri bo bzhan dag zil gyis mnan nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun nas lhan ner rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin thub pa yon tan mnga' ba po/ /ye shes ri bo'i dbang po 'jig rten las/ /mngon par 'phags shing 'khor kun zil mnan te/ /rtag tu lhan ner bzhugs ( thing rnam par mdzes/ /dper na mkha' la banas pa'i dgung zla ni/ /mar gyi ngo la mdzes pa ma lags kyi/ /dpa' ldan dgung zla nya ba rgyas pa ni/ /skar ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad zil gyis banon/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa khyod/ /rang gi slob ma skar tshogs zhabs 'bring 1mnga'/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis mnan mdzad cing / /ye shes 'od rnams kyis kyang simaXpar mdzad/ /drang srong dper na gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'jig rten thams cad zil mnan rab tu lhan/ /mi yi nyi ma khyod kyang de bzhin te/ /blo gros 'od kyis 'jis rten kun zil gnon/ /dper na ri mchog mchis pa'i zhugs kyi tshogs/ /gzi brjid kyis ni phyogs bcu rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin ye shes ri bzhugs thub pa yang / /phyogs bcu dab tu rnam par mdzes pa lags//dper na ri dasas 1rgyal pos ri dgas phran/ /zil gyis mnan cing der gnas mngon par mdzes/ /mu stegs can bzhan kun gyi nangabaziganas shing / /thub pa khyod kyang de bzhin rnam par mdzes/ /dper na 'di na mi bdag 'khor los sgyur—/ 1'gro ba zil gyis mnan cing rnam par mdzes/ /mgon po chos mchog 'khor los sgyur ba yang / /'gro ba'i nang na de bzhin rnam par mdzes/ /dper na sum cum gsum dbang brgya byin ni/ /lha rnams zil gyis 6 mnan nas 57—228

mngon par mdzes/ /mtshungs pa ma mchis de bzhin tshogs pa rnams/ /thams cad zil gyis mnan nas rnamapar mdzes/ /de nas 'jam dpa' gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang thos pas rgya chen po la mos pa'i sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag pa ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ba dang / dman pa la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyang rgya chen po la 'jug pa la gnas par 'gyur ba dang —/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nga 'i sems can rnams kyang byang chub la dmigs pa rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / dman pa la sbyor ba'i sems can rnams kyang brtsam pa chen po rtsom par 'grur ba dang / lam las nyams pa'i sems can rnams kyang byang chub kyi 'a ma du 'jub par 'gyur ba dang /byang chub kyi lam du zhugs pa'i sems can rnams sgyukyang de bzhin gshesas pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par bskrubs nga 'i dbongs pa'i tshul la 'jug par 'gyur ba/byang chub sems dpa 'i spyod 1yu la gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de 'khor 'dir bstan du sasol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshebs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ldem po dag dgongs te bstan pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis pamos par dka' ba/ shes par dka' ba—/ rtobs par dka' ba/ rnam par shes par dka' ba/ 'jug par dka' ba—/ yongs su rtogs pa ra dka' ba yin pas cho ga nyams pa'am/ lta ba nyams 57—229

pa'am—/ tshul khrims nyams pas/ yongs su shes pa'am/ rnam par shes par mi nus so/ /dman pa la mos pa rnams kyis mos par mi nus so/ /bsam pa nyams pa rnams kyis yid ches par mi nus so/ /sdig pa'i grogs ( pos yongs su zin pa rnams kyis 'jug par mi nus so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma —zin pa rnams kyis rtogs par mi nus so/ /chos de lta bu ni yang dab par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis ma brlabs par mnyan par yang mi nus na/ mos par lta ga la nus te/ de bzhin gshesas pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1pam gtogs par de ni banas med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'diXdab bka' stsal to/ /yid 'ong snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan khyod kyis/ /ngatshe4la gang dris don de ngas dbastan nyon/ /sems can dman pa mrun pa —bsgribs pa yis / /chos tshul dam pa khong du chud mi nus/ /gang dag sngon sangs rgyas la spyod spyad cing / /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyis byin brlabs pa/ /de dka chos tshul dam pa 'di thos na/ /mi rtog shin tu gya nom 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sang dag sdig grogs sprul gyis sems zin cing / /dge ba'i bshes kyi dug sman rnam spangs pa/ /de dag dam chos dkon mchog 'di thos na/ /kye ma bag med g.yang sa che las ltung / /gang dag sems chung dman zhing zhum gyur dang / /gang dka lhag pa'i bsam pa che med pa/ /yid ches med pa mos pa nyams pas na/ /thos rngo kyang de dab dga' bar mi 'ang ro//chos mchog 'di la dad par ma gyur pa/ /de dag yun ring sdug bsngal ltung 'gyur te/ 1kye ma sdug bsngal rnams la gnod 'gyur zhes/ /de la snying rje mngon byas de ma bstan/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'jam dpal 57—230

gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'dus pa 'di ni dag pa lags te/ spyad pa rnams legs par spyad pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnams legs par bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dge ba'i bshes — gnyen rnams kyis legs par yongs su bzung〈kub/ dad pa'i mig legs par yongs su dag pa/ mos pa'i spyod yul la nges par byung ba bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa legs par yongs su dag pa rnam pa bzang po rtobs —par 'gyur ba sha stab ste/ 'khor 'dus pa 'di ni de lha bu lags pas de dab gis chos kyi tshul 'di 'tshal bar 'gyur zhing / rnam par 'tshal bar 'gyur na sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lesas par yang das par bshad du gsol/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 2'di dka kyang gsol to/ /drang srong chen po gang dag chos 'di 'tshal 'gyur ba'i/ /sems can dpal yon ldan pa 'di na mang du mchis/ /gang dag sngon pa sangs rgyas la spyad pa legs spyad pa/ /de dag rnams la thub dbang de ring chos bstan gsol/ /de dag gus dngarartsibacas shing thal mo sbyar mchis nas/ /mi yi lha yi zhal du lta zhing mchis lags na/ /drang srong chen po de sgad thugs rje bskyed mdzad cing / /dam chos char pa dgyes pa bzhin du bab tu gsol/ /chos rgyal khyod la bdag ni gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /chos kyi dam pa gya nom rab tu bstan du gsol—/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchob bsdu slad du/ /mabon po dam chos phyab mdzod dbye ba mdzad du sasol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /'jam dpal khyod de bzhin 57—231

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa legs so lekas so/ /'di ltar 'jam dpal khyod ni chos 'di das la mngon sum du gnas pa/ chos thams cad la the tsom sgyumed cing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs la mkhas pas nges par 'byung ba ste/'jam dpal khyod ni skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa'o/ /'jam dpal khyod ni ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la snang ba bya bar 'dod pa'o//'jam dpal de'i phyir lesas par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shigasnye /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 'tshal lo zhes 'jam dpal sazhon nur gyur pa dang / byang zub sems dpa' de das bcom ldan 'das kyi lhar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa/ ribs kyi bu chos bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i rikas kyi bu 'am risas kyi bu mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gnyis sang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin gyis rgya chen po la mos shing dman pa la mos paXmed pa yin/ rang bzhin gyis snying rje'i spyod yul dang ldan zhing dkar po'i rang bzhin can yin/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i lhab pa'i bsam pa 'i spyod yul dang ldan zhing yi dam la brtan pa yin/tshogs shin tu bsags shing spyad pa legs par spyad ༄pa yin/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba legs par bsnyen bkur zhing dkar po'i chos legs par yongs su bsdus pa yin/ lus dang ngaka dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' kha na ma tho ba med pa dang ldan zhing sdig pa'i las thams cad bor ba yin/ sdig 3pa'i grogs po 57—232

thams cad yongs su spangs shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten ba pa yin/ ji ltar smras pa de bzhin du byed cing slu ba med pa yin/ bged pa'i ngang tshul 3 can yin zhing ro bro ba rnams la ma zhen ma chasas pa mang ba —yin/ de bzhin —gshekas pa'i byin gyi rlabs pekyis byin gyis brlabs shing bdud kyi byin gyi rlabs rto dang bral ba yin/ sems can thams cad la yang dang yang snying rje chen po yang dag par 'jub pa yin/ bdob pa thams cad yongs su btong zhing ma chags pa'i sems dang ldan pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu yon tan gyi chos bcu sanyis po de dka dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skye ste/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad bde bar bya ba'i phyir phan pa'i sems so/ /sdib pa thams cad mi byed pa'i phyir snying rje'i sems so/ /sems can thams cad kyi khur bkur sheba'i phyir snying rje chen po'i sems so/ /ngan 'gro thams cad rab tu rgom par 4 byed pa'i byir byams pa chen ngo 'i sems so/ /theg pa gzhan mi 'dod pa'i phyir dag pa'i sems so/ /nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa sel ba'i phyir nyon mongs pa med pa'i sems so/ /rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i phyir 'od gsal ba'i sems so /rdzas med pa'i phyir sgyu ma lha du'i sems so/ /dngos po dang bral ba'i phyir dngos po med pa'i sems so/ /mi sgul ba'i phyir brtan pa'i sems so chos thams cad nges par rtog pa'i phyir —mi zlog pa'i sems so/ 1ji skad smras pa de bzhin du byed pa'i phyir sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i sems so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshisas su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rgyal gras gang dag spyod pa legs spyod cing / /dkar po'i chos kyis rtsestebasam pa pā7—23 3

yongs dag la/ /dgra la'ang byams shing snying rjes sems brlan pa3/ /de dab byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /gang dag sdis grogs dgra bo rnam mispangs shing —/ /byang chub ston 1)pa'i dke bshes bsten gyur te/ /byang chub theg par smon lam sbyong babyed pa/ /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /gang das sngon mthar spyad pa spyod pa na/ / nams kyang 1skyo ba'i sems ni mi skye la/ /rdo rje lta bur mi zlogs —sems ldan pa/ /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /gang dag skye bo kun la byams sems ldan/ /sems can thams cad bde la sbyor 'dod cing / /sdig pa thams cad spang ba'i kabasam pa can/ /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /theg pa sazhan gyi yon tan mi 'dod cing / /byang chub rgya chen yon tan mchog sems shing / /rnam dag nyon mongs med pa'i sems ldan pa/ /de dab byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /srid pa zhi ba gang la yang dab tu/ /skad cib tsam yang yod med rtog med cing / /me long sadong ltar 'gro ba kun lta ba/ /'di ni yang dag tu na byang chub sems/ /nyon mongs skyon gyi rdul rnams rnam spangs shing / /dri med nam mkha' lta bur rnam mdzes la/ /tshig lam (nges tshib thams cad mthong dasa' ba/ /'di ni bzang po'i byang chub sems zhes kabya/ /sazungs dang so sotsakarig dang spyod mchog gi/ /rtsa ba 'di yin mtshan gyi 'byung gnas te/ /dpe 'i byad bzang po 'bar ba lus kyi rgyu/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi ribs su gnas/ /gleng gzhi'i ⑫le'u ste dang po'o// //'jam dpal yon tan gyi bachos de lta bu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems 17—234

dpa' yon tan gyi phan yon bcu gnyis yang dag par mthong ba des sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bcu gnyis po dag kang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub kyi sems kyi lam ston par yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i〈 pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / longs spyod chen po yongs su sgrub pa'i lam 3 yin par yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang 1 'dod pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur bar 1yang dayo par mthong bas —sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / ser sna tshar gcod par 'byur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / gtong ba'i rgyun 'phel bar 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / yi dasas kyi grong khyer gyi sgo ba gcod par byed par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / skye bo mang po dang thun mong gi longs spyod rnams las snying po len par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / yo byad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar ‘ yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang /bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba la goms par byas par 'gyur bar yang dka par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / dngos po thams cad la 'dzin pa'i sems bdag la med par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / bdag gi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar yang dag par mthong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes 57—236
