sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe don 'di nyid shin tu gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rtse gcig sems su dbang po mnyam zhog tsaste/ /de ring ngas smras 'di don mnyan par gyis/ /de bzhin bshegs la brdzunarkagyi tshig mi mnga'/ /bde gshegs rang byung tshig ni gzhan du min/ /skye bo de dga' bden smra 'di nyid ni/ /das cing dri med gnod med bskal papa —la/ /bskal pa grangs med mang pos 'jib rten du/ /'tshang rgya bden pa'i blo gros tog gi rgyal/ /nyon mongs gnod pa de la mi 'byung ste/ /de phyir bskal pa de ni gnod med pa/ /'jig rten ming yang rnam par bltas pa ste/ /bskal pa de ni dpal gyi phung por 'gyur| /rnam par 'dren pa de yi bskal pa de/ /lha mi rnams kyis blta ba'i 'os 'gyur te/ /rin chen tshobs kyi 'obs dang rta babs rnams/ /nyams dga' kun nas shin tu mdzes par 'gyur / / 'dzam bu klung gi 2gser gyi dra bas bayogs/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba bsgrags/ /seng ge'i rgyal mtshan rab rnams rtag tu bsgrong dzi/ /rin chen tshogs kyi lda ldi brgya dag spyangasam—/ /rtsib pa'i rgyud ni rin chen dri med de/ /de ni lha yi khyim dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /mtshe'u dang lu ma pad ma'i mtsho ṭ+wādag gis/ /de ni rtab tu legs par brgyan par 'gyur/ /de yi chu dang pad ma thud pal dang / /pad ma dkar po dag this kun khebs 'gyur/ /gling bzhi pa yi 'jig rten bar ma de1 / /ming ni blta na sdub cing yid 'ong ste/ /de ni bde gshegs de yi skye ba'i sa rngo / /rang byung de ni bram ze'i rigs las 'byung / /thub pa'i yum ni shugs dang ldan 57—360

zhes bya/ /yab ni tshangs pa'i dbyig ces bya bar 'gyur/ /de yi bu ni rnam grags sgra zhes bya/ /dper na nga'i bu sgra kacan zin 'di 'dra/ /bde gshebs de yi btsun mo dam pa ni/ /blo gros chen mo nga yi sa 'tsho bzhin/ /de yi ma ma mingashā3ni grags chen te/ /nga yi skye dgu'i bdapo mo chen mo bzhin/ /thub pa'i rim gro byed pa'i sems can 'phabs/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhes bya ba ste/ /nga yi rim gro rngo'adun pa gus ldan bzhin/ /de ni 'dren pa de la rim gro rnyibyed/ /thub pa de yi rta mchob 'gyur ba yi/ /shugs can zhes bya'i ming dang ldan 'gyur te| /bde sashegs mngon par 'byung tshe bcibs par 'gyur/ /nga yi rta mchog bsngags ldan gyur pa bzhin/ /bde gsheg —de yi rdzobs pa'i byang chub shing / /chos kyiyo'aphags zhes bya ba de tshe 'byung / /shing mchog brgya phrag stong du bsgyur ba yinashā3/ /phrag ni brgyad cu kadag gis de bskor 'gyur/ /shing mchog de drung kye ma chos kyi rngorgyal/ /rang byung zla med bden zhes bya bzhugs nas/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub rab zhi ba/ /zu ngan med pa mngon par 'tshang rgyar 'gyur/ /de na bdud med bdud kyi phyogs kyang med/ /bdud kyi las kyang deratshu —'byung mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba thub pa gang zag zla med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni gnod bdo tsomed par 'gyur/ /mi dang lha tshogs mang po 'du 'gyur te/ /rnam dag shin tu sbyangs pa de tshe 'byung / /de kun me tog phreng ba gos dang glu/ /rol mo sgra yis bde sashegs drung 'dong 'gyur/ /rgyal bas de dag bsam mkhyen mdo sde 'di/ /mdo bzhan lhan cib drang srong gsung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba des ni rab tu gsungs pa yi/ /mdo sde khyad par 'phags pa 'di thos nas/ /sems can dpag yas bang gā'i bye ma snyed rke/ /thub dbang byang chub mchog tu 57—351

khye sdu traṃ wa shā // /dro skre nga sgru ༷ sdu cad ༷༷ byeskyi ༷ / / tā sdu rtse rdzi da rnas/ ༷ — pe/ zhi —4 swā rna mi / shā rnga rgya nga bye pe du/ ཿ na 4 / khro smi / rlo/ bye rdeX she twe / ༷ shā / na ༷sa/sdo 2 rda ge ci mi nas sdug

mi ldog 'gyur/ /theg pa dman pa der 'byung mi 'gyur te/ /rang rgyal theg pa'ang zhing der 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgyal ba de yi sgyusangs rgyas zhing mchog der/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'byung kun dpa' zhing mdzangs / /rkang gnyis mchog de'i 'dus pa dang por ni/ /rgyal sras grags pa'i 'odam1 ldan gang 'byung ba/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog /rnam das gang gā'i rdul bas mang ba 'byung zu/ /blo bzang ldan pa'i 'dus pa gnyis pa ni/ /skye ba gcig gnas khrag khrigaXbargyad cu —'byung / /'dus pa gsum pa byang chub sems dpa' mchos /dkrigs phrag drug cu dzi dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bde bar rgashegs de'i tshe yi rto tshad 'gyur ba/ /bskal pa bar ma drug cu — tshang ba ste/ /rgyal ba de ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /mi yi 'dren pa'i chos kyi sgron ma yang lo grangs bye ba khrag khris stong phrag ni/ /brgyad cu ḍatham par gnas par 'gyur ba yin—/ /rang bi sku sadung ring bsrel gergyas mdzad cing / /de ni gdul ba dzirab mang 'dul bar 'gyur/ /drang srong che de byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /tog chen lung bstan mdzad nas mya ngan 'da' tsa1 /'di ni bkod mchen zhes bya'i thub dbang 'gyar/ /rgyal ba dgra las rgyal bar 'di 'gyur ro1 /rgyal ba de yi ༄zhing bkod 4'di 'dra ste/ /'jig rten phan par mdzad pa 'di bzhin no/ /rgyal ba'i byang zub mnyam med dri med pa/ /rab zhi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon por 'gyur/ /nga yi mkhyen pa de 'dra nam mala'i tshad/ /bskal pa 'byung ba mang po rab tu shes/ /'das pa'i losaloshes da lhar ci zhika sems/ /ye shes kun du thobs pa med pa mnga'/ /nga yi tshig ni dag cing brdzun mimed de—/ /brdzun midu mi smra don dam bden pa la/ /nga sanas nas ni nam yang mi 57—352

smra'o—/ /ji skad gsungs pa mi'adi la yid ches gyis(1/ /drang srong chen po'i gsung 'di thos gyur nas/ /'khor rnams kun kyang dga' ba'i sems gyur te/ /de tshe khams der skye bar shog shig —ces/ /zhing mchoka der skyerabab dad pas smon lam btab/ /'jig rten khams mchog der ni skye 'gyur te/ /'jig rten 'dren pas de dag lung bstan te/ /der ni khyed kyis bde gshesas thob gyur nas / /kunamarngokyang sems can don mang byed par 'gyur/ /mdo sde rgyal po 'di bstan de yib —tshe/ /sa chen 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad mar banas pa dag /de tshe thal sbyar thub la 'di skad gsol/ /khyod kyis chos tshul dam pa 'di gsungs pa1 /thub pa zla med rang bzhin shin tu lekas—/ /chos kyi tshul rab dam pa mnyan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i chos 'tshal bdab cas 'dir mchis lags/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de tshim zhing mgu ste/ yimarngorangs la rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas gos re re bzhag ste/ /gos gzhan darga bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gsol nas tshig 'di skad kyang smras te/ kye ma 'jig rten du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gnyis pa byung — bar gyur 4 te/ dang po ni grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr yi bskor to/ /chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis de ring 'dir bskor to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi chad tshipar chos rin po che 'di lta bu dzi'adi dang mi 'bral zhing skyes bu dam pa 'di dang mi 'bral bar shog shib 8ces smon lam btab bo/ /steng gi bar snang las kyang lha'i rnga chen po dag sgra mngon par 'byin par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog ud pa la dang /pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po'i char chen po yang bcom ldan 57—363

'das kyi zhabs kyi drung du mngon par bab par gyur to/ /steng gi bar snang la yang lha rnams kyis lha'i gos dag g.yab mo'i tsathabs su bskor te/ /tshig 'di skad kyang brjod par gyur to/ /skyes bu dam pa gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa de dag ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / 'jam dpal sazhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces bsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston pa dang / glesas bam du bgyis shing 'chang ba na bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed cig 'phel bar 'gyur lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /'jam dpal gal te rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/'du shes can ma yin pa ji snyed pa dang sems can gyi khams na sems can ji snyed cig yod par 1sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis mkhyen pa de dag thams cad snga phyi med par mi'i lus thob ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzog/sa pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la de dag thams cad la rigs kyi bu'am ( rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis bskal par gnas pa'i tshe bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gro byas/ bla mar byas/ bstepasgyustang du byas/ mchod pa byas na/ 'jam dpal 'di ji snyam du sems/ ribs kyi bu'am/ rika/sa 57—354

kyi bu mo de bsod nams mang du skyed dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang labs so/ /bde bar gshebs pa mang lags te/ 'di ltar bgrang ba'am/brtsi bar yang sga ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal de bas kyang bang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin tam/ klog gam| kazhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston tam/ glegs bam du bris te 'chang ngam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bstan na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lung 'bobasam— 3pa de bsod nams mang du skyed do/ /de skad ces bka' nga pa dang / 'jam dpal sazhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshebs pas 'jig rten thams cad la sman pa'i slad du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring po ji srid cig tu 'dzam bu'i — gling na mchis par 'gyur lakas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal nga spru ngan las 'das nas kang yi tshe rgyal po brgyad kyis nga'i ring bsrel 1rgya cher bya ba'i phyir brgyad du bgos nas za ma tog brgyad du bcug ste/ rang rang gi yul du mchod rten gyi khang pa yangs par 'jog par 'gyur te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras ni nga'i ring bsrel rnams las brgyad cha blangs nas rin po che'i za ma tog tu bcug ste/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i phyi rol tu sa brkos nas ring bsrel —la pog snod la gab bcad nas spos kyis ni bdugs/ rga/dugs dang rgyal mtshan ni btsugs/ rin po che'i me tog ni gtor/ lo brgyar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mar me me lce gcig tu 'bar ba ni bus shing ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 'joka par 'gyur nga / rgyal po 57—356

mya ngan med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba bsdad pa'i phyir mdo'i 1 rgyal po 'di gser gyi 1 glegs bam la bris nas ring bsrel da)gyi za ma tog de nyid du 'juka par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta ste/ rgyal po mya ngan med pa de nim mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ni mo'u r+ya'i mirigs su skyes pa/ 'dzam bu'i mi gling la dbang ba/ mthu dang brtson pa thob pa1 stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur te/ de nga'i rnam pa las rjes su dran par byed par 'gyur ro/ /nga'i bstan pa la yang dad rtopa thob parar — 'gyur ro1 /de'i tshe de'i dus na dbe slong dbang po bde ba zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul che ba/mthu che ba/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa/ shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'dzin pa/ rgyal po'i ribs las rab tu byung ba/ rgyal po mya ngad med pas bkur ba grong du 'jug pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal de ltar rgyal po mya ngan med pa des nga'i ring bsrel rgya cher bya ba'i phyir skye bo mang pos yongs su bskor cing bkod 4 pa chen po dang rgyal po'i mthu chen pos me tog dang tshe/ phreng ba dang / spos dang / bye ma dang / byug pa dang / sil snyan dang / pheg thogs te rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por song nas mchod pa'i cho ga mngon par 'du bya ba chen po byas te sa'i phyogs de nas ring bsrel — gyi za ma tob de phyung nas/ nyi ma bdun gyi bar du spos thams cad dang / me tog thams cad dang —/ me tog phreng thams cad dang / phye ma thams cad dang / byug pa thams cad dang / mil snyan thams cad dang / pheb rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs thams cad kyis mchod pa rnam pa du ma byas te/ skar ma dang / sbyor ba dang ldan pa gcig la yul sna tshogs su chos kyi rgyal pos byas pa'i mchod rten 57nga 356

nga nga brgyad khri bzhi stong byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe snapechos smra ba dbang po bde bas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ring bsrel gyi za ma tog nas phyung nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud kyi yul chen por 'jog par 'gyur te/ skye bo mang pos shes par mi 'gyur/skye bo mang pos ris par mi 'gyur/ skye bo mang pos yongs su bzung bar mi 'grur la chos kyi rnam grangs 'dzin pa nyung ba dang / klob pa 1nyung bar 'gyur te—/ 'jam dpal chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni rtaka tu sgrom du bcus pa dang snod du bcug par 'grur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na 'di ltar chos tshol ba med cing snod ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni mos par dka' zhing yid ches par dka' la/ rtogs par dka' ba ste/ mun sprul du mngon par yid ches pa'am/ 'juyo par mi nus so/ /'jam dpal phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe lnga brgya pa tha ma la bab pa'i tshe chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang la la dag gis thos te/ yid ches par gyur tam/ tshol lam rtog na de dka ni 'jam dpal khyod kyis sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen pa bkur byas pa/ legs par spyod pa spyad pa/ theg pa chen po 'di'i snod du gyur par nges par rig par bya ste/ rigs kyi du'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dab chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /glegs bam du byas shing 'chang ba de dag thams cad kyis kyang bdag cag gis ni sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag mthong bar gyur to/ /mnyes par byas so/ /bsnyen bkur byas so 'es bya ba dang / de dag gis ni nga yang skyed —mos tshal 'di na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa dang / 'khor 'dus pa 'di yang mthong ngo zhes de ltar shes par bya'o/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 57—357

'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di long shig /zung shiganyacho /kun chub par gyis shirga /dbang po non po rnams ma gtobs par gar 1 bab bab kyi mdun ⑫du ma ston cis /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba yin pa dang / 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen yin pa dang /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar chad pamed pa'i chos bstan pa yin pa dang /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya yin pa dang / 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsrung 5ba bsgom pa yin pa dang / 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i kater gyi mchog yin pa'i phyir te/ kun dga' bo de bas na nga'i bu thu bo chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ chos kyi mdzod srung ba de dag la sbyin par bya ba ma btogs par 'di ni shin tu sba bar bya zhing su la'ang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /kun dga' bos bsol pa bcom ldan 'das bdag be+es chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung lags na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lakas/ 'di ji ltar gzungapa— bar bgyi—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya bar zung shib tsa /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang dziba'i gnas zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshesas pa'i bar tsho med pa'i chos bstan pa zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul zhes bya ba dang /theg pa gcig tu bstan pa zhes bya ba dang / 'jam dpal gyis yongs su dris pa zhes bya ba dang / bden smra lung bstan pa zhes bya ba dang / bden smra'i le'u zhes bya bar yang zung shibatsa /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa'i tshe sroka chags 57— 358

khrag khrig phrag sum cu sna sngon bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems ma skyes pa las sems skyes par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' drug ka khris ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par kyur to/ /sems can tshad med pa dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor dke slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar — bcas pa'i 'jib rten yi rangs te — / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /lung bstan pa'i le'u ste — bcu pa'o// //'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi — yul la rnam par 'phral pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so // //pa gar gyi mkhan po pratshwa bar ma — dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha (ba ban de rngoye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa — // //tsa 57——359

༄ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po res par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 1ba /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ru bhā ni ra da — sha nā ma ma hā yā zin sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen ngo 'i mdo/ bam po dang po/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag yis thos pa'i dus ka/cika na/ bcom ldan 'das chorgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri/ sngon rgyal ba bzhugs〈 dbazhugs pa'i mchod rten chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis brlabs pa sa'i snying po/ byang chub sems dpas 4mngon par bstod pa/ chos kyi gdan sgyusgyulha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin gyis phyaka byas pa'i sa phyogs/dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par skul ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba chos kyi sgo mngon par brjod pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba/ yon tan (tshad med 57—377
rte / dro na twe ༷ dro she nga rte twe bye — ga / ༷ k+tsi sbya bye ṭī / snye rna / ༷ ༷ kau tre ༷ k+to 'ad ce ngh+ru ca khros dardo bye sdu nga /༷ be / 'a da du/ nga mi /ri — dz+wa bye ༷rngo bye /

pa las yang dag par byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul na/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas—/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor/ slob ma shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa'i tshogs ni mnga'/ chos thams cad la mnga' dbang ni brnyes/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa sgrub pa 3ni lebs par mkhyen/ dbang po dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni brnyes/ sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba lebs —par 'joms pa la ni mkhas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa ni rgyun mi 'chad 1cing dke slong stong phrag drug cu'i zi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cib tu bzhubs te/ thams cad kyang cang shes pa/glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad legs par bcom pa/ de bzhin gshebs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ chos zab mo la gnas par mkhas pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyis nges par byung ba/ spyod lam mdzes pa phun sum tshogs pa/ sbyin pa'i gnas chen por gyur pa/ de bzhin gsheb/sa pa'i bka' la shin tu zhugs pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dpag tu med pa dang yang thabs cig —ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ngo thams cad mkhyen pa chags pa med pa'i spyod yul gyis nges par byung ba/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'i chos kyi sprin las lhag mthong dang / rig pa dang / rnam par grol ba'i glog phyung zhing bdud rtsi'i 57—378

chu'i rgyun gyi char 'bebs pas 'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed pa/ sems can thams cad la sems sa dang mnyam pa rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba dang bral ba/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sna tshosas kyi lo thob yang dag par 'phel bar byed pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bas lhag pa'i shes rab kyi 'od zer rab tu gtong bas gti mug gi mun pa sel ba'i lam gyi snang ba thob pa kun tu ston pa dang | sems can gyi pad ma kha 'byed pa dang / dbe ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par byed pa dang / sred pa'i chu skems yopa dang / shes pa'i las kyi mtha' la rab tu 'jog pa la mngon par shes pa chen po dang / zhi sanas kyis rgyu ba/ zla ba lta bur 'gro ba thams cad la sems mnyam ba sa mngon par zhi bar bya ba'i bsam pa tshim par bya ba'i thabs la mkhas pas 'grib pa dang 'phel ba kun tu ston pa/ ri rab lta bu'i lhag pa'i bsam pas tshangs pa'i sanas pa'i rin po che shin tu brtan te/ ngos bzhi nas yul gyi rlung thams cad kyis mi sgul cing 'jig rten gyi chos las mngon par 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kun tu bstan pa snang bar gyur pa/ rgya mtsho chen po lhar gzungs dang dran pa'i snod rgya chen po chos kyi chus yongs su gang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rin po ches 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba/ ri dgas gukyi rgyal po ltar bden pa'i rkang pa dang / byams pa rab tu 'phel ba'i mjug ma dang / zhi gnas dang lhaka mthong gi mis dang ldan zhing chos zab mo la skrag pa med pas pha rol rgol ba thams cad 'joms pa/ bskal pa brgya stong phrag dpag tu med cing mtha' yas thug pa med par 1byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun ma bcad pas yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa sha stag dang thabs cig pa la 'di lta ste/ 57—379

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas snang zhing sgrib pa med par lta ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhing thams cad kyi rgyun bkod ( pa kun tu ston pa thes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs las byung ba'i spyod pa'i blo gros zhes sgyubya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod lam thams cad kyis 'dul ba mi 'khrugs pa 1kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbobs pa mtha' yas pa'i tog gi rgyal mtshan rnam par sprul pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' 4 sems dpa' chen po gser bzang po rnam par babasags pa'i 'od kyi gzi brjid kyi 'od zer zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyis rnam par nges pa'i tshig la spobs pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas brtan pas bsabs pa zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med dpag tu med —pa dag dang thabs cig ka go—/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jus pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i chos kyi (shernam grangs yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas lo bcu drug bzhes te/ tshangs par spyod pa rgyas par gyur par mkhyen/byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa chen po de yang 1 gzigs shing mkhyen te/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa 'di dag ni de bzhin gshebs pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin par mkhyen nas 'di snyam du gang gi phyir ngas byang chub sems 57—380
༷ dhe khro pri rde hūṃ / rde rdo dro hūṃ rna hūṃ twe / bye bhe/ rdo twe pa ji ༷ hūṃ hūṃ // k+ṣiṃ bye kā wa sa/ rdo /wadhe wa / khro na/ ) bye rdes ci/ / trī pa sa chaX na

dpa' rgya cher rjes su yongs su sazung ba dang / 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la bzud pa'i — phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / de bzhin gshebs pa'i cho 'phrul chen pos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jurga pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i chosaXkyi rnam grangs yang dag par bstan par bya'o snyam du dasongs so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi yu la rnam par sprul pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshesas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi yul rnam paraXsprul pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang darga par ston pa zhes bya ba de la stoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus steng bi bar snang la 'dod pa'i khams dang /kazugs kyi khams kyi bar du 'khor kyi khyams/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mngon par grub pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa yongs su sbyong ba1 / phyogs bcu'i 'jib rten rmi khams snang bar byed pa—/ sems can tshad med pa'i bsam pa tshim nga ra byed pa/ lha'i gzhal med khang thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par skul ba 3/ sazhi bai drur+ya dkar po'i dbyibs 5 dang / 'dzam bu'i 6 gling yi gser gyi lang pa das dang / dpal gyi snying po'i rta babs dag dang /rin po che rdo'i snying po'i sgo lang 3dka dang / nor bu rin po cheka— snying po'i la khyer dag dang / rin po che dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi stekas bu dag dang / rin po che kun nas 'od kyi khang pa brtsegs pa dka dang / rin po che thams cad kyis — 57—381

dgab pa dang / nu tig gi rgyan phreng rab tu spyangs tshepa dang / gdubs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sgreng ba dang / lha'i dar gyi lda ldi mngon par spyangs rngo pas bsngags pa bstan pa dpab tu med cing thug pa med pa stong gsum gyi stong chen ngo 'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad tsam zhig byung ste/ 'khor gyi khyams de yang tsan dan sbrul gyi snying pos bskus pa/ tsan dan dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dri yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ dri'i mchog a ka ru dam pa'i snying pos bdubs pa—/ klu'i mu tig dang rin po che'i me tog gis 1rnam par spras pa/ me tog sil ma bkram pa/ rin po che'i shing dang / rin po che'i mkha' rten gyis mdzes par byas pa ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rgyan mdzes pa bkod pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'khor gyi khyams de nyid na kun tu snang ngo / /der gdanamasnyeseng ge'i khri bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po dpag tu med pa/ grangs med pa/ sna tshogs pa/ blta na sdug pa/ mtho ba/rab tu bzang ba/ yangs pa/ rgya che ba1 yid du 'ong ba/ yid dga' bar byed pa dag byung bar gyur to/ /gling bzhi pa'i 'jika rten gyi khams 'dir them skas kha khyer mi bdun gyi 'phang tsam gyis bskor ba/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed kyis yongs su bzung ba/ rin po che san da rnyil dang / mthon kha chen pos snying por gyur pa/ brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po'i bdugs can/tshangs pa'i ne tso 'am ci dang / rin po che ser pos spras pa/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yer kha'i dra ba kun tu bskyod pas sgra 'byung ba/ sa'i steng nas 'khor gyi khyams la thug gi bar du gyen du mngon par 'phags pa/ drang ba ma yo ba bzhi stong byung gebar gyur to/ /gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ji lta ba pā7—382

skas kyi dbus nas 'khor gyi khyams bkod pa ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi la sosas pa rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhugs par rib nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i me tog gi sprin gyi char rab tu phab ste thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ nyi zla smome dang nor bu'i 'od dang lha yul pa yi lha 'od shin tu dri med pa/ /thub pas 'od kyis thams cad zil gyis mnan nas ngan song gsum po dag kyang zhi bar mdzad/ /ri bo lhun po dang ni kho ra khor yus rtse mo bsnyil dz+wate zhing rnams gsal bar gyur pas na/ /dga' zhing yid rnams mgu nas don rnams thams cad grub pa'i spyal ba la ni skyabs su mchi/ /de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod nas bcom ldan 'das gshebs pa'i zhabs 'bring kadu 'brang ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa sum cu 4rtsa kasum gyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhugs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i spos kyi sprin gyi char rab tu phab ste—/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod zhe pa/ rdzu 'phrul dam pa brnyes shing rab tu mtshungs pa med pa rnam par 'phrul pa shin tu ston/ /rgyal ba nyi ma ji bzhin 'phags te zhing rnams bye ba brgya dka tu yang rab tu sada'—/ /rgyal bas rang gi yon tan kun gyis zhing rnams thams cad brgyan te shin tu mdzes mdzad pa/ /gang zhig shin tu mnyam med mtshungs pa med cing rdzu 'phrul dbang du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sum cu 1 rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyis —bcom ldan 'das la tshikas su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod nas 57—384

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 'bring 1pedu 'brang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab 'thab bral la sogs pa 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhugs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i na bza'i sprin byi char rab tu phab ste thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ bde gshergas khyod kyi mkhyen pa mtha' yas yangs pas sems can bsam pa mkhyen/ /mkha' 'dra'i lam gyi chos gsum dag la chakas med thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /sems kyi 'jug pa gcig gis 'gro ba'i sems kyi spyod pa thams cad mkhyen/ /des na srid pa gsum po dab na lus can rnams kyis mchod par 'os/ /de nas 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 'bring 2du 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan la sogs pa dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhubs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i rin poXche'i sprin gyi char rab tu phab ste thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/gang gi slad du sgra dang yi ge ma mchis gang du'ang rgyu ba ma mchis pas/ /khyod kyis chos rnams mi g.yo ya ma brla ba )dang sgyu ma smig rgyu 'drar mkhyen nas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis thubs rjes sems can rnams la ched du chos mchog gsungs pas na/ /chos kyi dngos po'im1rang bzhin mkhas pa bdaka med gsung ba'i rgyal la phyag 'tsha' lo/ /de nas dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshibs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod nas bcom ldam 'das kyi zhabs 'bringarakadu 'brang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga'atshugel 57nga 386

tre ༷ da ga sten ༷ dbye gyi phre di d+ku skre — spyo la rdo byu ngh+ru sdus 2 rna —4 dgu na t+t+waṃ ṭī dro /bye skre ཿbye mi du sde rna cho tho 'a ja da ཿ dī nga rte nga dros ༷ /pa rto 2 nga /la hūṃ / sa ༷ dī / traṃ cwa rnapa ༷rdo sa /nga

sogs pa 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhugs par rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i4rgyan kyi sprin gyi char rab tu pha ste/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la tshisas su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod do/ /chos kyi zong gis rang gi stobs bcu mkha' 'dra 'od zer ldan pa dang / /thugs rje brnyes nas byams pa'i dgongs pas sems can rnams la bzubs ston pa/ /gru tshul chos la gnyis su med par zhugs kyang rgyal ba mtshungs par mkhyen/ /chos kyi khyad par sems lhag don kun grub pa'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 'bring —— du 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das them skas su zhugs pa dang 1 'khor gyi khyams su mngon par phyogs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir mu tig gi do shal gyi sprin gyi char rab tu phab ste/thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /tshul khrims dri ma mi mnga' rnam das rnam par nges pa dam pa ting nge 'dzin mchog mi sayos pa/ /mnyam med blo ldan rgya mtsho 'dra bar banas shing srid las rnam grol dbang sgyur zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rim gyis byams dang 4ldan pa'i thugs rje yis ni bden pa'i lam gyi rnam pa darab tu gnas mdzad pa/ /rnam thar bsum gyi lam gyi khyams —na gnas pa'i bde ba/shegs seng getsho3khyod la bdag caka phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i chu bo ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam 'phel shāb/ /zhi gnas 'dabs(— ma rnam par grol ba'i me tog rgyas/ /slob ma'i 57—386

sde — sdu ༷ nga /ne sa sras rna / lnge skye mi / rde ༷ kau shā 2 rnarā sta/ bye dze+e mi sbya tre rna sna rngu sa / lhu rjo— rna da pa/ sgor+sha / /ge shā nga ca / / pya rdo nga rtsi/ shāzi rdo 'i sa shā di ༵ nga ṭā/sa/ ci dī sa rngoX 4 / rngog rdophri nga spya ji na shā nga ji dzi mi nga
wa sde hūṃ d+ngha bye/ mi tshe wa rdo skre wa bye ༷rdo rde | lnge / rdo / ༷ ༷ rte wa she 'i wa / lnge

khams mi mjid 'dir them skas nas 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par gshegs pa shes pa de bzhin du/ stong kasum rmi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang bshebs par shes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi khyams stong gsum gyis yongs su gzung 3 ba rin po che bkod par gdan seng be'i khri ji ltar bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos chen po dag kyang stan 1ci rigs pa la 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par thar pa sgrib pa med pa la sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par thar pa sgrib pa med pa la sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba la snyoms ༷par zhubs ma thab tu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i spu'i khung bu thams cad kyi spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang 'od zer gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed byung ste/byung nas kyang shar phyosas kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas so/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang yi phyogs rnams dang / 'os dang /steng dang / phyogs mtshams rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnams snang bar byas mamathag tu/ de nas sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyun chad do/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdus bsngal gyi tshor ba yang rgyun chad do/ /sems can thams cad kyang skad cig de la 'dod chags kyis gnod par ma gyur cing / zhe sdang gis ma yin/ yoti nug gis ma yin te/57—388

nyon mongs pa kazhan gyis kyang gnod par ma gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad kyang tsabyams pa'i sems dang / pha ma lta bu'i 'du shes su gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dka par bskul ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi mthus de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od de las tshigs su bcad pa 'di byung ngo / /gang gis brtson 'grus stobs ni mtha' yas yangs pa brtan pa brtsams gyur ba/te/ /sang gis brtson 'grus chen po'i stobs kyis bskal pa dag las phyir phyobs spangs/ /gang gis 1yon tan dab ni phyobs bcu rnams na mthu ldan rab brjod pa/ /shākya thub pa'i 'od yangs 'gro ba thams cad snang bar byed pa mdzes/ /gang chos rgya chen bla med mnyan sbad de yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// /mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa dag ni bskal pa grangs med rtas tu nyan/ /blo rgyas gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa tshim skyed pa/ /thub pa des ni gang phyir sems can bde bar bzhed pas 'od 'di phyung / /mnga' bdag gang zhig brtson 'grus kyis ni bdud stobs mu stegs tshogs bcas pham mdzad nas/ /pad+ma byung ba bzhin du 'phags shing phyogs bcu dag tu lhun po ji bzhin mdzes/ /gang zhika nyi ma bzhin du sku yi zi'od kyis 'gro ba ma lus snang mdzad pa/ /de yi chos kyi 'khor lo gzhag pa don chen gsan du rgyal ba bshegs su gsol/ /rab tu bskor bar ma gyur mtshungs pa med cing rgyal ba kun gyis bslor gyuraXpa/ /'khor lo dam pa stobs bcu sems can thubs brtse phyir ni de ring skor bar — mdzad—/ /srog chags rnams kyis bsten par rnyed dka' lebs pa rgya chen de ring 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang dag dad pa dang ba che ma yangs don du gnyer ba de darga de ring ltos/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 57—38 9

tshirgas su bcad pa 'di dag gis go bar byas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yang dag par bskul/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu g.yo bar byas| sems can thams cad bde bar byas/ nyon mongs pa'i khams thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ nun pa mun nag thams cad bsal)/ bdud kyi khyim thams cad mog mog por byas nas byang zub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dab dang 'jirga rten gyi khams mi mjid du slar 1'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas shar phyogs na de bzhin gshesas pa dri med rnam dag rin chen 'od byang chub kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i chos rgyun mi 'chad 1 pa'i 'od zer bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan mtha' yas pa'i rin po che'i bsod nams bkod pas rgya che ba dang ldan pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' me tog dpal kyi snying po chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing bamadun du bdar te / lhan cis tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig she yud tsam de la 'jika rten gyi lams mi mjed 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te(6 / lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir lha'i nor bu bai dur+ya'i dra ba'i char rab tu phab ste/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /bcom ldan rab tu mtshungs med yon tan pha rol phyin/ /khyod —kyi yon tan bsngags phreng (phyogs bcu kun na brjodatshe / /khyod kyi yon 57—390

tan tshogs mchis zhing gang yon tan gter/ /der ni chos don banyer ba bdag cag rab tu mchi/ /chos dbyings mnyam nyid rnam rtog ma mchis ji bzhin du/ /bcom ldan dri med 'od kyis mnyam pa nyid mkhyen kyang / /shin tu bslab tupa'i sgyu ma malan ltar chos kyi rgyal/ /sems can rnam par dgrol slad tha dad bstan 5pa mdzad/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dka gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod pa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas/shar phyogs logs su gnas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang yi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas lho phyogs na de bzhin bshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas rin chen spobs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jis rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen srog shing 'es bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing 1mdun du bdar te/ lhad cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig —yud tsam de la 'jis rten gyi khams mi mjid 'dir — phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalabate/ lan khri bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kal mchod pa'i las byed cing gser gyi dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab steka / tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /bcom ldan thusas rje'i sprin gyis 'jis rten rgyas bkang nas/ /'od kyi glog phyung stong pa bdag med sgra bsgrags te/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i lam gyi chu yis zhi mdzad cing / /dkar po'i stobs dbang nags tshal gel pa 'phel 57nga 91

bar mdzad/ /bde bshegs shes rab 'od kyis gti mug mun bsal nas/ /ring nas srid mtshor gnyid log sems can sad 1mdzad de/ /lam yang bstan cing sred pa dab kyang skams 5par mdzad/ /thar pa'i grong gnas rnams kyi mika kyang rnam par sbyong 1/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa'i zubastod pa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas lho phyobs logs su gnas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang bi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas nub phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams snang ba dang ldan pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' sgra bsgrags pa'i stobs kyi pergyal po zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thas tu byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ lhan cigam3tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cib thang cig — yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal — te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing nor bu mu tig gi do shal gyi phreng ba'i dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab stetsho / tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /khyod kyi sku yi 'phrin pa las nam mkha'i lams 'dra zhing / /smon lam dbe bas dag pa bye ba phrag mang ldan—/ /dri med rnam par dag cing zas pa med pa des/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams bsam gyis mi khyab gsal/ /khyod kyi tshig ni rgyun chags gsal 57—392

zhing mtshungs pa ste/ /'gro ba bsam dag bsam ( pa mnyam nyid yongs tshim bgyid/ /sems kyi rgyu dang rnam rtog gang yang mi mnga' yang sems can bsam pa rnams la rgyal ba dag be+e 'byung / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod 1pa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas nub phyosas logs su gnas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul rtadagyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang yi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas byang phyogs na de bzhin bshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas rin chen sgobs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad kyis spras sepa na byang chub sems dpa' blo mchos rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu/byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ lhan cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig payud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams —)rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba 3byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing nor bu'i do shal dang rin po che'i dra ḍabs bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dab gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ / 'dzam bu'i tshochu gser btso ma lta — bur ser ba'i sku/ /kun nas spyan mnga' phyobs bcu dag tu rnam par mdzes/ /mtshungs med sku la sems can gang dag nges rtog pa/ /de dab skyon med bde zhing dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /kang gis lhun po brtsegs pa lta bu'i khrun tsam du/ /'jis rten 57— 39 3

mkhyen pa mtshungs med rgyal ba bltas kyang ni/ /de yi rdzu 'phrul kun gyi stobs dang brtson 'grus kyi/ /rnam par sprul pas rgyal ba'i spyi satsug mthong mi nus/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod pa yo tshad med pa dab gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas byang phyogs logs su gnas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang gi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas shar dang lho'i mtshams phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan thams cad bcom pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan med pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' snye kun nas snang ba zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing 2mdun du bdar te/ lhan cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig zuyud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan lngar 'dug nas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 5te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing rin po che'i dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /spu yis —mtha' dbung ma mchis pa yi pezhing 'dzin kyang —/ /sems can rnams la mi gnod zhing la mi gnod pas/ /mig med rnams kyis rgyal ba'i spyod yul 'tshal bar dka'/ /sangs rgyas sras ni rgyal ba'i byin gyis yang dag 'tshal/ /zhing gcig baphyogs la zhing mang rab 'byam ston — mdzad de/ /kun tu bstan kyang rnam par 'phel dang 'grib ma mchis bsam 57—394

pa chen po dag ldan ci 'drar gyur de la/ /dpag med rdzu 'phrul rnam par sprul pas de ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod pa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams logs su sanas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang gi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas lho dang nub kyi mtshams phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad la gzig/sa pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mig bzang po 3na/byang chu ba sems dpa' snying rje chen po sems pa zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu—/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing rngo mdun du bdar te/ lhan cib tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid zu 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan lngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi 5zhabs la mako bosam —phyag 'tshal bte/bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing na bza'i dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/tshigs su bcad pa 'di das gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /sems can dam pa g.yag rnga thobs pa ji bzhin du/ /tshul khrims dri med nor bu rin chen 'drar ba srung tsa / /tshul khrims med gzigs mgon po shin tu thugs rje zhing —/ /bdag la bstod pa mi mdzad bzhan la smod mi mdzad/ /lhun po ji bzhin khyod brtan bla ma rgya chen stenaka/ /chu gter zab mo bzhin du shin tu rgating dpag dka'/ /srid pa thog mar bcings pa kun nas grol ba ste/ /57—396

sems can khrag khrib nyes pa chen pos bcings las grol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod tsupa tshad med pa das gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas lho dang nub kyi mtshams ( baphyogs logs su banas te/ rang sga rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang thi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas nub dang byang gi mtshams phyorgas na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams nun pa dang bral ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer dra ba can zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' 1 gang gra'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ lhan cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar grur nas skad cig thang cig ziyud tsam de la 'jiyo rten gyi khams mi mjid 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dub nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 6te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing rgyan gyi dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rang bzhinanartogs mdzad nas/ /byed pa sgyu ma lta bu dngos ngo med par ston/ /sgyu ma lta du sems can khams ni 'dul mdzad kyang / /'di na sems can rang bzhin ma mchis khams ma mchis/ /dper na mi zhig gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na/ /gzugs mthong yang dag 'du shes de bzhin mthong ma lags/ /'dus —byas dngos po ma mchis rmi lam 'dra bar gsung / /chos rnams snang yang 'di na chos la chags ma mchis de 57—396

nyid dang ldan/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod pa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams logs su gnas te/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyishā stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang gi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas 'og gi phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen nga la dmar po'i dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang byed du snang ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa'i rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing ༄gemadun du bdar te/ lhan cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig thang cig ṭ+wāyud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjid 'dir ④phyin te/'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhete/ bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing nor bu rin po che'i gling gi phreng gi dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag this bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /gal te khrag khrig zhing na snyed rdul mchis pa/ /de snyed bde gshegs sras po rgyal ba'i drung lhags te/ /bskal pa bye ba stong mang zhu ba zhus pa dab /de dag thams cad tshig bcig dus kyis go bar mdzad/ /blo la mkhas pa rab rdzogs shes 3rab shin tu rdzogs/ /gzungs 1dang ting 'dzin rab rdzogs bsod nams mtha' yas te/ /bskal pa mang po mtha' yas bsngags pa rab brjod kyang / /skra rtses rgya mtsho ji bzhin zad par mi nus so/ /de nas 57—398
