byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i bstod zapa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas 'og gi phyogs logs su gnas te/ rang bi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang gi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de nas steng gi phyogs na de bzhin gshegs pa sgra bsgrags mchog yi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rgyan gyis brgyan pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'od des bskul ma thab tu/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis yongs su bskor cing rdomadun du bdar te/ lhan cis tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nas mi snang bar 1 gyur nas skad cig thang cib zi yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal —te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan khri bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las byed cing rgyan thams cad bkod pa dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ka'i )dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bkab ste/tshigs su bcad pa 'di dab gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /bde gshekas sku yi 'phrin las mtha' dang dbung 5 ma mchis/ /bla med rnams kyi gsung thugs spyod yul mtha' yas pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas mkhyen gyi sems can gzhan gyis min/ /dper na nam mkha'i mtha' ma skye bos mi rnyed bzhin/ /mtshungs med spyod pa mtha' dbung 1)med pa ji bzhin du/ /byang chub 'khor lo de bzhin 'on te mya ngan 'das/ /sa bon ji bzhin de ltar 'bras bu 'byung ba ltar—/ /de bzhin phyogs bcur rgyal ba'i sanas kyang tshad ma mchis/ /de nas 57—399

— —byang chub sems dpa' de dag bis byang chub sems dpa'i bstodabapa tshad med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas steng thi bar snang la dong ste/rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis sprul pa'i rang rang gi stan dag la 'khod do/ /de ltar phyosas bcu dag nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu 'dus pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dang 'a tshad med pa dag 'od des bskul ma thag tu skad cig thang cig 1yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir phyin te/ 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dran pa dang ldan zhing mkhyen bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te—/ bsung bsal 1ba'i sgra mdzad nas/ gsung bsal ba'i sgra des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs kyis go bar gyur te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gang dag dad pa dang ldan zhing snod du gyur pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang /dbe bsnyen ma dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung bsal dba'i sgra de thos nas lus dang / sems tshim par gyur te/sangs rgyas kyi mthus ji ltar byung ba'i them skas dag nas skad cig thang cig ( ba yud tsam de la 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par phyin te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalapalanas phyogs gcika tu ji ltar 'thun da pa'i stan dag la 'khod do/ /gsung bsal 4 ba'i sgra de nyid kyis tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang /tshangs 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chen dang / 'od chung dang /tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge 57nga 400

ji sdu da ṭ+wāṃ rna rdoX ༷ wa ༷ / sgo༄ / traṃ / / wa sa rā sa pe ra da/ / ༷ / /lnga ༷/ ༷/di skre kau shā nga rna miX 'a tre two da ༷ rna / /༷zhu ga sa/ ༷ ni bya dro/ ༷/gli/ hūṃ trī — ’ / — rdo rto rgya de sta

— ——nga nga nga nga — — — dang | dbe rgyas dang / sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras du che ba dang / 'du shes med pa'i sems can dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang dang / shin tu mthong dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang bskul nas skad cig thang cib sgyuyud tsam de la 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod par phyin te/ de dag rgos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalam1nas stan rab tu brtan pa dag la 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa chen po de 'dus par mkhyen nas smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas byang chub sems dpa'i stobs nye bar ston pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ste/ des thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub zisems dpa'i —tshogs la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i ke— tshogs de nyid kyi spyi bor mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' me tos dpal gyi snying po chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba 'od des reb ma thag tu/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyan thams cad bkod pa zhes bya ba la stoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' me tog dpal gyi snying po chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyan thams cad bkod pa la stoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe 'khor gyi khyams rin po che bkod pa'i dbus nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan seng ge'i khri 'phang du shing tapa— la bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu zatsam du mtho ba/ rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa/ kha khyer rgyan thams cad las byas pa/ ras bkod pa thams cad bting ba/ me tog sil —zhem sna tshogs thams cad bkram bapa/ bla re yid du 'ong ba thams cad bres pa/ byang chub 57nga 401

sems dpa'i lus thams cad kyis yang dag par bzung ba/ 'khor thams cad kyi sgyumig gis bltas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta btsa(bzhin du ston pa/ bsam pa tshim par byed pa zhig byung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' me tos dpal gyi snying po chos thams cad la dbang sgyur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri chen po bskul bar bsngags pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba mngon par sprul nas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ gus pa dang bcas shing zhe sa dang bcas par thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i dbos pa rab tu bgyid/ /lha dbang gzi brjid yon tan sum cu kyartsa gsum dga'/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten rnam par mdzes—/ /sangs rgyas mthu yi yul gyis shernam par 'phrul pa 'di/ /chos rnams mi snyegayo nam mkha'i rang bzhin ya ma brla6 / /sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bu chu yi zla 'dra zhing —/ /rje med byed pa po dang tshor ba po med par/ /mkhyen nas mgon po 'dir ni rnam par sgrub pa ston/ /bkod pa'i sems kyi dbang 'gro sems ni gzugs can min/ /rnam spub thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin 3dbang du 'gro//bkod pa thams cad 'dir ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'dra/ /rnam sgrub bdag gis ma mchis gang na'angangaganas ma mchis/ /gang gis sems rgyun ma mchis rang bzhin dag 'tshal ba/ /de la glo bur gnas pa'i nyon mongs ma mchis so 1rtos dang kun rtob yongs su rtog las sems grol ba/ /de ni sgyu ma'i rnam par sprul pa sna tshogs ston/ /sa steng rdul tsam mngon par 'phakas pa ma mchis kyang //sa steng nor bu rin chen sna tshogs kun tu bstan ༅ / /gdan gang bzhugs nas 57—402

2 ༷ wa ༷ / ji ཿ/ ༷ rte traṃ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༷sa/ bye/ shā ༷ rdo bya/ ༷ saX tre rni sa/ bye ༷ 2 rte rnge traṃ bye sa sdu/ / ༷/ traṃ nga dro ༷ da stu gi ༷ ༷ be r+sā skyu r+ṣa 2 tre zi ma nga twe ca cha ༷ / — snge

sems can bye ba 'dul 'gyur ba 1/ /khyod kyi seng ge'i khri gdan rab mdzes bdag gis bgyis/ /sadugs dang rgyal mtshan mchoka dang dar gyi phreng ba bsgreng0 / /de ni sang du'ang 'gro ba ma mchis 'ong ma mchis/ /khyod kyis gang nas chos rnams 'du ba mkhyen nas kyang / /sems can dam pa rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs ston/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan legs shing gushin tu bsrungs pa'i gsung / /'jig rten sgron ma mdzad pa bsod nams gzi brjid mang / /bdag la thugs brtse'i slad du 'dzegs zite gdan la bzhugs/ /rba dang 'chi dang na ba sacod pa'i chos bshad gsol/ /khyod la bsnyen bkur bgyi 1dang chos ni mnyan slad du/ /rnam dag sems can 'di rnams phyogs bcu dag nas lhags| /gang yi don du lhags pa'i don de stsal du gsol/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te chos kyang bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' me tog dpal gyi snying po chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas gdan seng ke'i khri de la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa brnyes kanas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo kazhes bya ba'i sa kyi dam grangs byang chub sems dpa'i lam bkod pa la dmigasapa— pa dang —/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jikas pa yongs su sgrub pa dang / ye shes kyi 'byung gnas chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i sgor 'jug pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa la rnam par rgatan la dbab pa la gzhol ba'i sgor 'jug pa/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i ye shes la gzhol ba'i sgor 'jub pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor 57—403

la 4mi skye ba'i chos ston pa/ theg pa thams cad theb pa gcig tu mnyam pa nyid du yang dab par 'duXb/ chos kyi dbyings tshul bcig cing ma 'dres pa la 'jug pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang dbang po la 'jug pa/ston pa snying po dang ldan pa/ chos rnam par kadon mi za ba/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms kapar byed pa/ tshul bzhin gyi chos kyi tshul la gzhol bar 'jug pa/ nyon mongs pa dang lta bar gyur pa thams cad 'dul ba| chabs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'jub/ nga / thub pa med par yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa'i thabs dang ye shes ston pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la 'jug pa/ chasas pa med pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1kyi sgor 'jug pa/ chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par nges pa ston pa/rtog pa med pa dang rnam par rtog pa med pa mnyam pa nyid du 'juka pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad bsags pa'i phyir rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo mnyam pa nyid rtogs ba par byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang 5 /blo gros dang / rtogs zhepa dang / mos pa dang / shes rab zad mi shes pa mngon par sgrub pa/ nyan thos kyi theb pas 'dul ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i bden pa'i tshul la 'jug pa3/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas 'dul ba'i phyir lus dang / ngag dang / sems rab tu dben par shes pa/ theg pa chen pos 'dul ba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sar dbang bskur ba rab tu thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad brjod pa'i phyir chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i tshul la 'jug pa 'di lta bu'i chos kyi rnam grangs 57—404
lnge shā bye lnge dro sdo / traṃ ༷ / / jiX bye ḍi rga / ༷ rdo kha rna bye sde hūṃ pyi ༷/khro/ ka /dbye nga ngas / ༷ rna ༷ 'a da / tre da mi ༷ / / shaṃ tre ḍi mi/rte t+na —

nga —— —yang dag par rab tu bstan pa dang (/ bsnyad pa dang / bshad pa dang /bklab papa dang / gzung ba dang / rnam par shes par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshosas thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su bskang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par sprul pa yang dag par bstan pa dang / 'khor gyi the tshom snye thams cad gcad zupa dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad tshar rgacad pa dang / de bzhin sashegs pa'i bstan pa 'bar bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa chen po yongs su thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das gdan seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs so// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' rin chen srog shing zhes bya bas sangs rgyas kyi rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' sgra bsgrags stobs kyi rgyal pos pad+ma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhug (nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi lag pa rnams su me tob gi lda ldi dag dang / me tog thi skon bu rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ me tog gi lda ldi dang / me tob bi skon bu de dab gis bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la mngon par 'thor ro//de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' rtseblo mchog rgya mtshos dri bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs genas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi spu'i khung bu thams cad du tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i drir tshabyin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' 'od zeraX57nga 405
blo — /spa ༷ mi/sde wa rna trī / sna // rdo sto ṅge / ཿ khro rdo rte rdo/ /sa ri / ga chi sgyu da ༷/ ༷ gli rā gus di/ ༷ sbya / rdo / na sdu sdi rte da /lnga tre ༷//de

— nga nga dra ba can gyis 'od bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ⑫nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la lus kyi 'od mtha' yas par mibyin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po sems pas mig mi 'dzums mipa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par phyokas shing migami 'dzums ④par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' blo mtha' yas dri med kyis chos la mchog tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor chos don du gnyer zhing chos la dga' ba dang mos par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa'i rgyan bkod pas rab tu zhi ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor sgrib pa lnga rnam par sel bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos brjed r+ṣapa med par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor byang chub kyi sems dran zhing de bzhin gshegs pa la dmibs pa mi brjed par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas snang ba zhes bya bas 6zil gyis mi non pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor bdud dang / phyir rgol ba bcom par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' bdud rab tu 'joms sgyupas 57—406
skre 2 — gyi t+natre 5 bye ṭī bye ༷ / ༷ ༷ swā ༷shad sdu ṭ+wāṃ rdo ༷༷ bye bye /༷ bho bye / khro hūṃ khro wa bye ༷ /du wa sho two /bye snyi rdo / ༷da snye | sdo bye

'da' ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /grogs po das 'di lta ste/ dper na mun pa nun nag lo du mar bsags pa ni mar me gcig gis med par 'grur ro/ /grogs po dag de bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i zun pa nun nag bskal pa brgyar sgyu bsags pa yang ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pa gcib gis med par 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na zlaba'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig dang / nor bu rin po che chen po gcib gis nun pa mun nag thams cad sel to/ /grosas po dag de bzhin du dbe ba'i sems lharga mthong dang ldan pa gcig gis mi shes pa'i nun pa nun nag thams cad sel to/ /grogs po dag de'i phyir khyed dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rim rmis mi shes pa'i mun pa mun nag thams cad bsal nas chos kyi snang ba chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'duka pa des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces bsol to//bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi yul de bzhin gshebs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / kun tu bstan pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi pakhyab bo/ /deng ni de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo zhes bgyi ba 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad par bzhed par the tshom ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das e ma byang chub sems dpa' rnamam kyi 'dus pa 'di ni che ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go cha bgos pa/mngon par shes pa'i ye shes chen pos rnam par rol pa/ phyogs bcur sgra 57—408

bsgrags tshopa sems shin tu byang 5bar bgyis te dri ma ma mchis par 1rig pa dang —/ rnam par grol bas snang bar gyur pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags pa/ chos thams cad la dbang phyug gis dbang sgyur ba/pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa/ thabs la zi mkhas pa thams cad las nges par skyes pa/ bdud kyi las dang rtsod pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad bsal ba/ phas kyi71chol ba dang / ngan pa'i tshogs can gyi tshogs thams cad rab tu 'dul ba/ tshig thams cad rab tu dbye ba bstan pa shes pa la mkhas pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chags pa ma mchis pa 'i pha rol tu son pa/ dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / khrel yod pa dang /mos pa dang / gzungs dang / ye shes rab tu thob pa/ byin gyi rlabs thogs pa ma mchis shing spobs pa rgyun mi 'chad pepa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang / mchog ma lags pa shes pa la mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston pa/ 'khrul pa ma mchis par kha na ma tho ba ma mchis pa'i chos ston pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sgra dang skad la mkhas pa/ mi 'am ci dang / bya ka la ping ka 1dang / khrung khrung gi sgra dang /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ shin tu bshes banyen bgyis pas sems can thams cad yongs su zu ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa/ byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ brtan zhing shin tu gnas la mi sayo zhing ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bgyid pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan yang dag par bsgreng rke bar bgyid pa/ rdo rje ltar sra zhing mi shigs — nyapa'i khor yug lta bu/smon pa ma mchis pa'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 57—409

zab mo blta dka' zhing rtosas par dka' ba la zhugs pa/ chad pa dang /rtag pa'i mtha' sanyi ga dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba yang dag par bcad pa/ tshogs can chen po'i tshogs kyi rgyal po yongs su 'gugs pa/ ded dpon chen po bskal pa grangs med par chos dkon mchog gis bsod nams yang dag par baspubs0pa/ smanamami pa'i rgyal po chen po sems can thams cad kyi hon mongs pa gzugs can ma lags pa'i nad gso bar bgyid pa/ seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogasapakapa/ snrel zhi'i rgyud dang /byi'u tshugs kyi rgyud thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsang ba la mi skrag pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos lus lesas par brgyan pa/ katan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin bgyid pa/ thams cad la sems dpa' ba④/ bdud bzhi dang / nyon mongs pa'i g.yul 'dul ba/ mnyan ༄pa lta bur gyur pa/dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa —)/shin tu yongs su sbyang ba bgyis pa/ sems can thams cad rab tu sgrol ba la brtson pa/ ri lta bur gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po rnyed pa dang /ma rnyed pa dang / grags pa dang / ma grags pa dang / smad pa dang /bstod gepa dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal las log pa/ dka' ba dang /dang ba dang 1 mchog tu dga' ba'i chos la sems zhugs pa/ chos dkon mchog gi 'od zer dang ldan pa/ shes rab kyis ngoms nas ngoms par bgyid pa/pad+ma lta bu 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad kyis mi gos pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i 57—410

'od mog mog por bgyid pa/ rgya mang phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 1 thob pa1 chos dkon mchos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol rngo ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcod pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang | 'dul ba'i cho ga 'tshal ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dkon mchog thams cad kyi mdzod yang dag par 'dzin pa/ bsngags pa mtha' yas pa dang yang das par ldan pa/ bsod nams tshad ma mchis pa bsags pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la nye bar byur pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bskal par bsngags pa mthar mi phyin pa 'di lta bu rnams kyi 'dus pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de la bdag 'di snyam du/ bcom ldan 'das ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pas nges par 'byung ba sgrib pa med pa'i sgo zhes bgyi ba 'dus tshupa chen ngo 'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad par bzhed pa snyam bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni phan 'dogs par 'gyur ba/ sems can thams cad tshim par 'grur ba/ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang das par skyed pa—/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su sbyong ba/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul gcig la 'jug pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos la dbang bskur ba/ skye ba sacig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu chud mi za ba/ nges pa'i sems can rnams la rkyen nye bar sgrub pa/ ma nges pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen ④po nye bar sgrub pa/log pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can rnams lam la 1'dzud pa/ theg pa gsum 57—411

la mos pa'i sems can rnams la rnam par dgod pa ston pa ste ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgyan lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas byung bar gyur na ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos 'di lta bu 'di dayo 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'grur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'di dag gis 'khor gyi khyams 'dir sems bskyed pa gcig gis bkod pa gang byin kyis brlabs pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskal pa brgya phrag stong du yang ston pa'i rngo mi thogs bo)/ /bcom ldan 'das de la bdag 'di snyam bgyid de/ e ma ji tsam du bang rdzu 'phrul gyis 3 rnam par sprul pa'i cho 'phrul 'di lta bu 'di mthong yang nyan thos kyi thes pa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la re ba skyed pa'i sems can shes rab 'chal pa can de dag ni ngo mtshar che ba snyam bgyid do/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa nyid kyis nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis non pa'i sgad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can gyi mi la la zhis nor bu rin po che bai dur+ya — bor nas nor bu mching bu la dmirgas pa snyam du sems pa dang —/ bcom ldan 'das bang dag jig pa chen po bor nas nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theb pa la dmigs snyepar bgyi ba snyam du sems pa'i sems can dag ni 'dra ba nyid du bdag la bda'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am—/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag lhag pa'i bsam pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzobs pa'i byang chub tu sems 6bskyed pa dang / skyed par 'gyur ba de dag 57nga 412

dad rda nga mi shā nga /— na ༷ kānā / ཿ mi du ra/ /nga — lnga/ ma 7 tre nga /|/ / nga ngh+ru du nga ca wa nga na naX /bye mi /khro ༷ kā gyuX rna ngaX waX)/// dgo sdukhro // na /༷ naX rna 2 sdu ji /ri hāX rnaX r+sha sdu mi ༷ /ga ༷ 2 sa twe bya ngaX rdo rda rna da da da ca/ / na 'i/shā/

thams cad ni ring por sgyu mi thobs par chos 'di lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' tsachos kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos bstan pa 'di bshad pa na—/ lha dang mir bcas pa'i skye dgu'i ka'akhor de las srog chags bye ba khrab khrig brgya stong phrag sum cus 3bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba 'dus pa'i le'u'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa chen po de gzibs nas/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa 'di dayo ni chos don du gnyer ba de bzhin gshekas pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin par mkhyen nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jub pas nges par 'byung ba/ sgrib pa med pa'i sgo'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs rab tu bshad pa 'i phyir/ mi 'jigs pas sbobs pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer skyes bu chen bapo'i mtshan spyi gtsub nas byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis 6 'od zer de phyung ma thag tu de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshorgas la lan bdun bskor ba byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po'i lus la lan brgyar bskor ba byas nas/byang chub sems dpa' sazungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po'i spyi btsub tu mi snang bar grur to/ /'od des byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la reg ma thag tu/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshosas kyi 'od dang / seng be'i khri dang / lus brgya 'gyur du zil gyis mnad nas lam metsa / lhang nge / lhan ne'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs —rig 57—413

nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng gi bar snang la rin po che'i gdubs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yu ba ni bai dur+ya 33/g.yogs ma ni gser/ snying po ni rin po che ne tsho 'amasheci/ rtsibs ni san da tsu rnyil las byas pa/ mu tika gi do shal rab tu spyangs zipa/ dar gyi lda ldis mdzes par byas pa/ dril bu g.yer ka'i dra ba 'khrol ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i ④lus kyis bzung ba/ rgyar stong kasum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad tsam zhig byin gyis brlabs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rin po che'i gdugs de lta bumachebyin gyis brlabs nas me datog gi char yang phab ste/ sil snyan dang / sgra dbyangs rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad sgyupar sgra 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /kun du snang ba kun nas 'od zer can/ /don rnams ma lus ston pa kun nas spyan/ /rang byung chos kyi ngo bo nyid la mkhas—/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan kun dang ldan/ /skyes bu khyu mchog gis ni 'odadazer phyung / /zhal yang rnam par sbyong zhing 'od mdzad pa/ /'dren pa de ni bdag gi lus la yang / /lan brgyar bskor ba bgyis nas spyi bor zhi/ /mi yi 'dren pa'i 'od kyis reg pas na/ /gang dag bdag gis sngon thob dran pa dang —/ /blo gros spobs pa snang ba de bzhin gzungs/ /rnam pa stong du khyad par 'phakas par gyurar/ /bdag lus rab sim sems ni rnam par dag4 /bdag gi blo gros dga' mgu mnyam par gyur ⑫/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas mkhyen pa 57nga 414

mtha' yas rtsadang / /sgobs pa bdag sga lus la ra tu zhugs/ /sangs rgyas mthu chen bsnyen tsapar dka' 1—ba la/ /nyam ④ chung das gis mnyes par bgyid mi nus/ /sangs rgyas gnang nas 'gro kun phan tha da du/ /sangs rgyas la ni zhu ba zhu bar 'tshal/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug dang / /'jig rten rnam 'dren dag gi 'byung ba dang / — /snang dang nges 'byung rdzurnam par sprul pa dang / /dbang bskur ye shes yobayosu zhu bar 'tshal/ /theb mchog dam pa rtogs par khong chud cing / /mtha' yas rgya che ba yi 'khor lhakas dang 1 /gang dag rgya chen chos don gnyer ba dag /de dag phan slad sangs rgyas la yang zhu/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu tshar gcad nicing / /sangs rgyas bstan — pa 'di ni shin tu kazung / /bcom ldan phung po ma mchis dam chos mdzod—/ /lus can rnams la bshad pa'i dus 'di lags/ /skyes bu khyu mchob mkhyen pa mtha' yas pas/ /bcom ldan de la bdag gi blo mi chud/ /bde gshegs mkhyen pa shes pas mi dpogs tsu pas/ /mabs pa yangs pa bdag ni zhu bar 'tshal/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi mkhyen 'jug dang / /ji ltar yun ring nas ni bslabs ḍa pa dang / /chos kyi dbang phyusakal po rab bslabs hūṃ3pa /'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul bshad du gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kazungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po'i 1tshisas su bcad pa 'di dab gis kyibacom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul ni tshad ma mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das bdab gis de bzhin gshegs pa ni yongs su mi skyo bar chos—ston pa lags par rig 57—416

cing | de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams cad mi gtong ba'i ༅ thusas rje chen po la banas par mthong nas don 'di zhu bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyan dag ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das —byang chub sems dpa' rgyan gang dag gis brgyan na byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na mdzes pa labs/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob shenas gti mug gi mun pa dang bral zhing the tshom ma mchis pa dang / chos kyi sgo chen po shin tu yongs su sbyangs pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji lhar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad chomi gtong ba'i pa snying rje chen po dang snying rje chen po la gnas pa mchog dang ldan zhing sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong bar ba gnas pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji lhar na byang chub sems dpa' dag byang chub sems dpa'i las yang dag pa la zhugs pa dang / legs par bgyid pa'i las bgyid pa dang / las kyi mtha' gdung ba ma mchis pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ci nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' bdud dang phyir rgol ba bcom zhing the tshom dang bral nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yul la mngon 3du 'phags par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa dag yongs su 'tshatsha bar 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnamasas1 rnam par sbyong bar 'gyur ba dang /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor tshar gcod par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshebs pa'i bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / myur du chos thams cad la 57—416

dbang sgyur tsab 'thobarwa par 'gyur bar tsade bzhin gshegs pas blo shin tu rnam par nges pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pas mngon par 'phags pa'i chos kyi sgo de legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod lebs so/ /legs so/ /khyod ji ltar de bzhin gshebs pa'i spyod yul tshad med pa la rnam par nges pa thob nas—/ khyod blo rnam par nges pa 'di lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa bani skyes bu dam pa khyod legs so/ /de'i phyir rigs kyi bu khyod shin tu legs par nyon la yid la zung shib kyidang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 6chen pos ji ltar yon tan 'di dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan tshad med pa bzhan dag kyang yongs su rdzobs par 'gyur ba dang / myur du chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba 'thob kapar 'grur ba ngas khyod la bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug tsa gi rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes bsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang | bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyan ni bzhi po 'di das ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/'di lha ste/ tshul khrims kyi rgyan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan dang / shes rab kyi rgyan dang / gzungs kyi rgyan te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyan ni bzhi po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni gcig ste/ gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/57nga 417

sems can thams cad la banod pa mi byed pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhe sdang ba'i sems med pa ni sems can thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing dga' ba ste/rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan gcig sgru bo—/ /risas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni gnyis po 'di dag ste/ sanyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ngan 'gro'i sgo gcod pa dang — bde byukyi'agro'i sgo 'byed pa ste/ gnyis po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni gsum po 'di dag ste/gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ lus rnam par dag pa dang / ngag rnam par dag pa dang / yid rnam par dag pa ste/ gsum po 'di dag go/ /rirgas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni bzhi po 'di dag ste/bzhir bang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ kang 'dod pa de 'byor pa dang / gang smon pa de yang dag par 'grub 3 pa dang / gang 'dod pa de 'thob nyapa dang / gang rtsom pa de nyams 'oka tu chud par byed pa ste/ bzhi po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni lnga po 'di dag ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgyu med pa yin—/ shes rab sgyu med pa yin/ rnam par grol ba sgyu med pa yin/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba sgyu med pa yin/ yongs su zu ngan las 'das pa chen po bla na med pa sgyu med pa yin te lnga po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni drug po 'di dka ste/ drug gang zhe na| 'di lta ste/ yid 3la chags pa med pa'i tshul khrims kyi phyir skyon med pa'i tshul khrims dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshul khrims kyi phyir nyams pa med pa'i 57—418

tshul khrims dang / 'dren ma4 ma yin pa'i tshul khrims kyi phyir 'dres pa ma yin pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i chos shin tu rnam par 'phel ba'i phyir sra sre ma yin pa'i tshul khrims dang / gang gis 'dod par 'gro ba'i tshul khrims kyi phyir rang dga'i tshul khrims dang / gzhan la rag ma lus pa'i shes pas rang si dbang sgyur ba'i tshul khrims te drug po 'di dag go/ /rikas kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni bdun po 'di dag/ ste/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa rnam par dag pa dang /bzod pa rnam par das pa dang / brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa dang / bsam gtan rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab rnam par dag pa dang / thabs rnam par dag pa dang / bag yod pa rnam par dab pa ste/ bdun po 'di dab ko/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni brgyad po 'di dag ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spobs snye pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /sa phun sum tshogs pa dang / rnam par 'phro ba med pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /lhod pa med pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khonas —du 'dzin pa med pa phun sum tshokas pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa dang | dal ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mgu bar byed pa phun sum tshogs pa ste brgyad po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni dgu po 'di dag ste/ dgu gang zhe na—/ 'di lta ste/ 'jigs pa med pa yin/ skras pa med pa yin/ bsam pa nges pa yin/ nye bar zhi ba yin/ bsil ba yin/ bcings pa lhod pa yin/sems las su rung ba yin/ sems cang zushes pa yin/ dul ba'i sa rjes su 57—419

tre / sa /pe sdu 3)dru rna tho /dpa tso byuji mi spros ༷༷ ༷da / rdo / ༷ rte| traṃ tā thaX rna wa ༷/ da da mdu midaX // ༷ subye da0 / ka / dzi rtsi bye ḍo ni / twe // rgya/ pa / nga//༷ / /༷ na sun traṃ rgya twe nga / nga da snyi the /trī/ pyaX ༷ na ༷༷/ ru ste dro rngoXpa jiX ṭ+wāṃ ri / ji shi wa twe

'thob (pa yin te/ dgu po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste—/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir lus kyi rgyan dang /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa'i phyir ngag gi rgyan dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir sems kyi rgyan dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir zhing gi rgyan dang —/ bsam pa yongs su spyod pa'i 1 phyir sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i rgyan dang / sdig pa thams cad mi byed pa'i phyir skye ba'i rgyan dang / de bzhin gshesas pa'i spyod pa la rjes su slob pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyan dang / nga rgyal med pa'i phyir shes pa'i rgyan dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ②ba'i phyir byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan dang / tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba la ka/nas pa mi 'dor ba'i phyir stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i rgyan te/ rigs kyi bu bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi rgyan no/ /rigs kyi du de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan gang zhe na/ ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni gcig ste/ rgacig gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad la byams pa ste 'di ni gcig go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni gnyis po 'di dag ste1 gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ drang ba dang / mnyen pa ste rganyis po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni gsum po 'di dag ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sgyu med pa dang —/ g.yo med pa dang / bcos ma med pa ste gsum po 'di dag go/ /57—420

rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni bzhi po 'di dab ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta stenya/ 'dun pas 'gro ba ma yin par mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis 'gro ba ma yin par mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba ma yin par mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba ma yin par mi 'gro ba ste bzhi po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni lnga po 'di das ste// lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sgrob pa lnga spong ba ste/ lnga po de dayo bang zhe na/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa 1dang /gnod sems dang / rmugs pa dang / banyid dang / rgod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / the tshom ste/ sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag sgong ba'o/ /ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni drus po 'di dag ste/ drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa zi dang / chos rjes su dran pa padang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / gtong gyeb rjes su dran pa dang /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa ste drug po 'di dab bo/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni bdun po 'di dag ste/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang zub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bsgom 4pa ste/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rab tu 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan larga dang /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan snyelag dang / btang snyoms yang dka byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ bdun po 'di dab go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub 57—421

sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni brgyad po 'di dag ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lab brgyad pa bsgom⑪pa ste/'di ltar yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dka pa'i rtog rje pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang —/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dka pa'i nying nge 'dzin te brgyad po 'di dag go/ /ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni dgu po 'di dag ste/ dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste1/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' brjed pa med pa'i sems kyis snying rje chen po'i gnas la gnas te/ sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong bar gnas nas 'dod pa dag las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dkai ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtos shepa dang bcas pa/ dang pa dang bcas pa dben pa las skyes pa'i dasa' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po rdzobs par byas te gnas so/ /de rtog pa dang / dpyod pa dang bral zhing nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud kacig ka3tu gyur pas rtog nga med pa dpyod papamed pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam rgatan kanyis pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas btang snyoms la gnas shing dran pa dang shes bzhin can yin te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis gang de dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la banas pa btang pesnyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa'i 1bsam gtan gsum pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs te/ snga nas sdus bsngal ba yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang /57—422

yinan bde ba yang nub 4 sa bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa/btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa bsam btad bzhi pa rdzokas par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du bzugs kyi 'du shes rnams las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyim3 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam nas / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/rnam par tsu shes pa51mtha' yas so snyam nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ ci'ang med do snyam nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du ci yang med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das nas 'du shes med 'du shes med gemin skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes med 'du shes med4min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug kyang thabs mkhas pas yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du'ang mi byed la/ sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis yang dag par gnas/ sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed pa ste/ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni dgu po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ mi 'khrugs pas nges par sems pa dang / zhi gnas yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mngon par brtson pa mi 'dor ba dang / nang du 57nga 423

yang dag 'jog sbed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba dang /sems dben pa dang / lus shin tu sbyangs pa dang / chos rnams la sems shing 'jal la so sor rtog pa dang / sems la dbang sgyur ba dang / 'phabs pa'i rigs rab tu rngothob pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin kyi rgyan ni bcu po 'di dka bo/ /rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni gcig ste/ gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad la the tshom med pa ste/ 'di ni rgacis go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan pani sanyis po 'di dag ste/gnyis bang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'gyod pa dang bral ba dang / kun nas ldang ba dang bral ba ste/ gnyis po 'di dka bo/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni sasum po 'di dag ste/ gsum ba/nga zhe na/'di lta ste/ gti mug spong ba dang / ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs nges par gcog pa dang / nun pa mun nag sel ba ste/ gsum po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni bzhi po 'di dag ste / bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sdub bsngal yongs su shes par bya ba'i shes pa dang / kun 'byung ba spang ba'i snang ba dang / 'argog pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon gsal dang / lam bsgom pa'i pebyin gyi rlabs mite/ bzhi po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni lnga po 'di dag ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dmigs pa med pas tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su dag pa dang / shes rab mchog gis bsam gtan pa yin pas 57—424

ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po yongs su das pa dang / gnyis dang bral bas rnam par grol ba'i phung po yongs su dag pa dang / dus bsum mnyam pa nyid pas rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su dab pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos nyid pas chos kyi phung po yongs su dka pa ste/ lnga po 'di dag go1 /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni drug po 'di dag ste/ drug gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sgyu ma dang mnyam pa nyid pas bdag gi 'khor yongs su dag pa dang / rmi lam dang mnyam pa nyid pas sems can gyi 'khor yongs su dag pa dang / rnam par smin pa la re ba med pas byang chub kyi 'khor yongs su dag pa'o/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzugs brnyan lta bu'i phyir lus kyi 'khor yongs su dag pa dang /brag cashālta bu'i shes pas ngag gi rnyi 'khor yongs su dab pa dang / sgyu ma dang mnyam pa nyid pas sems kyi 'khor yongs su dag pa'o/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni nyes par smras pa'i tshig rnams la khong khro ba shāspeng ba yongs su dag pa dang / bstod pa dang / bsngags pa dang /rjes su chags pa spong ba yongs su dag pa dang / yan lab dang nying lag gcod pa dag la chos kyi sku la rab tu rtog pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /'khor bsum yongs su dag pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'khor ba rmi zilam lta bur mos pas yongs su mi skyo ba yongs su dag pa dang / rdo rje lta bu'i bsam pas brtan 5 pa yongs su dag pa dang / mtshan ma thams cad las sgrol bas blang ba med pa dang dor ba med pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /'khor bsum yongs su dag pa'i 57—426

bsam katan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'gyur bar shes pas de la ma chags pa yongs su dag pa dang / mngon par zhen pa med pas lhag mthong yongs su dab pa dang / mngon par shes pa skyed pas dmigasayipa yongs su dag pa'o/ /'khor bsum yongs su dag pa'i thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sems can yongs su smin par byed pas bsdu ba'i dngos po yongs su dag pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pas sazungs yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan gyi phyir smon lam yongs su dab pa ste/ drub po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni bdun po 'di dag ste/bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag kapa rnams la dran mi pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa dang / yang das par sgong ba rnams la skye ba med pa dang 'gag pa med par shes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis lus dang sems dbenaXpa dang / dbang po rnams la dbang po yongs su shes pa dang / stobs rnams kyis bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad tshar gcod pa dang —/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid dang /lam rnams la 'ong ba med pa dang 'gro ba med par shes pa ste bdun po 'di dka go—/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni brgyad po 'di dag ste/ brgyad sang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shin tu zhi ba'i phyir zhi gnas shes pa dang / rab rib dang bral ba'i phyir lhag mthong shes pa dang / chos kyi phang po rjes su rtogs pa'i phyir phung po shes pa dang / nam mkha'i khams dang ༄mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir khams shes pa dang / grong stong dang mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir skye mched shes pa dang / bdag med pa'i phyir rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ④57——426

shes pa dang / mi 'khrugs lha3pa'i phyir bden pa shes pa dang / yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu rtogs pas chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa shes pa ste/brgyad po 'di dag go/ /rigs kyi du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni dgu po pe'adi dag ste/ dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste1/ sngon gyi mtha' dag pas 'das pa shes pa dang phyi ma'i mtha' dag pas ma 'ongs pa shes pa dang / bar gyi mtha' dag pas da ltar byung ba shes pa dang / rgyu chud mi za bas nges pa rnams shes pa dang / rkyen phye shebar sgrubapaka pas ma nges pa —brnams shes pa dang / yongs su smin parabyed pas log pa nyid du ma ngesapa rnams shes pa dang / chos kyi skus rab tu bye ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang / 'dod chakas dang bral ba'i chos kyi phyir chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba'i phyir 'phags pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ste/ dgu po 'di dka go/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi rgyan ni bcu po 'di dag ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ rnam par bsgrubam —nga 'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir sgyu ma lta dur shes pa dang / yongs su rtogamatrepa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir mi lam lta bur shes pa dang / rnam par 'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir smig rgyu lta bur shes pa dang /'pho ba med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir gzukas brnyan lta bur shes pa dang / 'du 'phrod kyi mtshan nyid kyi phyir mig yor lta bur shes pa dang / rkyen kyi mtshan nyid kyi phyir braka cak+ṣalta bur shes pa dang / chos kyi dbyings 'dres pa med pa'i mtshan nyid du shes pa dang / de bzhin nyid kanas med pa'i mtshan nyid du shes pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan nyid du shes pa dang /57—427
