ba'i༅lha nas bzung ste/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi bar gyi lha rnams 'dus so/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma stong phrag mang po yang 'dir 'dus par gyur to/ /de ltar skad cig thang cigadamiyud tsam de la dpag tshad stong phrag bcur 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gcib tu gnas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dran pa'i blos 'khor 'dus pa chen po de mthong nas/ rang gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang / ye shes kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / gzungs kyi stobs dang / sgobs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs gupa'i stobs dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasar④dang stobs kyis dri ba ched du mdzad pa bye ba phrag brgya po de kun du bzung nas/bcom ldan 'das de'i spyan sngar thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de'i mdun du dri ba bye ba phraka brgya po re re la bstan pa bye ba phrag brgyas lan btab ste/ phyad 1 pa dang / rgyun chad pa med pa dang / rjes su ldan pa dang ⑫/ rjes su 'brel ba dang / tshig dang yirga 'brur —ldan pa dang / shin tu nges pa'i tshig rnams kyis de'i lan btab pa dang / 'khor de las srob chags stong phrag drug cus tsa bla na med pa yang dgarakyipar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bzhi bcu ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu ⑫thob par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal sbas des de la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jika rten gyi khams dbyangs kyis bo bar gyur4 to/ /sa bla pa'iwaṃlha nas bzung⑫ste/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi bar gyi lha rnams kyis/ kye ma gang shes rab dang / spobs pa dang / bstan pa 'diwaṃ'adra ba 'di niwaṃbyang chub 57—697

sdu rna rdo ༷ bya ji di ji dzi / ༷ zi ḍi shā/ (3 ci // ri — 1khyer ༷ s+t+ri / / rde /zhin ༷༷ caX traṃ sag ༷rtsigi shā ༷ ji me wa/gaX 2 sto — bye snyi/ / ༷ ༷ sdo ༷ ji / rdo shā bye 'i ma / rna ༷ shā /k+ta

sems dpa' shes rab brtsegs su 'gyur ro zhes sgra phyung0ste sgra bsgrags so/ /de ltar na de shes rab brtsebs shes rab brtsegs zhes ming du btags so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' dran pa'i blo zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan yin pa —snyam du dogs shing yid gnyis su gyur tam/ the tshom za ba lta na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes rab brtsegs 'di nyid de'i tshe de'i — dus na byang chub sems dpa' dran pa'i blo zhes bya bar grur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tsudon 'di rgya cher brjod pa'i phyir de'i tshe tshibs su bcad pa 'di dag bsungs so/ /ma mos gyur nas ma thos chos rnams rtag nyan pa/ /shes rab rtsa —ba sems can dag pas thob nas ni/ /'dzin cing byams pas 'gro ba dag la ston byed pa/ /shes rab las te byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu byed/ /dpyod pa'i dran pa chen po 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /dpyad nas 'gro la rtag tu ston ཿpa shes rab las/ /gal te tshul bzhin rab sreb 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /de la sbyar nas ston pa shes rab las zhes bya/ /yang dag sbyor la gal te sbyor ba shes rab rtsa/ /sgrub cing ston par byed pa dade ni shes rab las/ /sems la nges par sems rnyed 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /nges par sems papaspyod pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /gcig pu dben par spyod pa — 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /lus dang sems la nga'i med 'di ni shes rab las/ /gang tshe 'du 'apa'i tso'ajigs gyur de ni shes rab rtsa/ /gcig pu bgrod pa'i lam la rig byed shes rab las/ /zhi kanas lhag mthong dga' ba 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /rika dang rnam par grol la reb 'di shes rab las/ /rnam thar gsum la mngon par brtson pa shes rab rtsa/ /rig gsum mngon du 57nga 598

byed pa shes rab las zhes bya/ /gal te dran pa nyer gzhag sgom pa shes rab rtsa/ /dran med yid la byed med de ni tsheshes rab las/ /sdig pa spangs te dge ba spyod pa shes rab rtsa/ /chos 'di rang bzhin spangs pa de mini shes rab las/ /kal te rdzu 'phrul long pa bzhi sgom shes rab rtsa/ /lhun grub rdzu 'phrul thob pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /dad pas mos nas yid ches pa ni shes rab rtsa/ /chags pa thams cad gang bral de ni shes rab las/ /zhum med rtag tu brtsonar1dpa de geni shes rab rtsa/ /lus dang yid sems rab sbyangs de ni shes rab las/ /dran dang shes bzhin mkhas pa 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /rganas rnams kun la mi gnas 'di ni shes rab las/ /rang gis ting 'dzin rtosas pa de — ni shes rab rtsa/ /rang bzhin mnyam par bzhag la spyod 'di shes rab las/ /kal te shes rab dbang por rab kanas shes rab rtsa/ /'gro ba'i dbang po thams cad shesapa pa shes rab las/ /stobs lnga po dag rjes su sgom pa shes rab rtsa/ /bcom nas ye shes thob pa de ni shes rab las/ /byang chub yan lab rjes 'thun bzod pa shes rab tsa)rtsa/ /chos kun rjes su gang rtogs de ni shes rab las/ /lam gyi yan lag skye banas skrub pashe shes rab rtsa/ /chos dang chos min spong ba ka'adi ni shes rab las/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin mkhas pa 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /gal te 'gog pa mngon sum byed 'di shes rab las/ /drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde tshig 'dzin shes rab rtsa/ /nges pa'i don la rton tshipa 'di ni shes rab las/ /thams cad thos pas mi ngoms 'di⑫ni shes rab rtsa/ /don la rab tu rtonawaṃpa 'di ni shes rab las/ /rnam par shes la tshul bzhin tshol ba shes rab rtsa/ /ye shes la ni rab tu rton 'di shes rab las/ /gang zag gang la'ang ma zhen 'di ni 57nga 699

༷ /bye shā| ༷ rdo ༷ ༷ kroX dī dres wa rngo skre dzo rdo rngo trī mi ngh+ru 5 0 lnge sdu dī kha bhū ༷bas mi / /sdu ——rte ༷ ༷ traṃ 1/ sdu — 6 rdo dī rde ༷ sdu rdokhye ༷ /rgyu pa la lnga sa skre rngo na skre

shes rab rtsa/ /gal te chos nyid rton pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /'du byed mi rtag ༅yongs su tshol ba shes rab rtsa/ /gal te kazod nas5(ma skyes shes pa shes rab las/ /'du byed sdug bsngal mos par byed pa shes rab rtsa/ /chos rnams 'dus ma byas su mos pa shes rab las/ /chos rnams bdas med the tshom med pa shes rab tsa1/ /sems can 'di dag gdod nas dka de shes rab las mya ngan 'das la4 zhi bar mos pa shes rab rtsa/ /'gro ba shin tu mya ngan 'das 'di shes rab las/ /don gyi rjes su rtogasam1pa 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /don rtogs so so yang dag rig pa shes rab las/ /gal te chos nyid mos par byed pa shes rab rtsa/ /chos la so so yang dag rib pa shes rab las/ /sgra rnams kun la skrag pa med 'di shes rab rtsa/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig 'di shes rab las1 /skras med blo yis sgobs pa de ni shes rab ka rtsa/ /spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa shes rab las/ /gal te sems can gnas pa'i byams de shes rab rtsa1 /dmigs pa med pa'i byams thob de ni shes rab las/ /bdag dang gzhan la snying rje 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /gang gis rganyi gar mi rtog de ni shes rab las/ /mchog tu dga' la dga' ba thob 'di shes rab rtsa/ /dga' med gdung ba med pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /byams dang gnod par mi byed de ni shes rab rtsa/ /gnyis las sems grol thob pa de ni shes rab las/ /blo gros ldan pa sangs rgyas dran 'di shes rab rtsa/ /gang tshe chos sku rjes su rtobasasapa shes rab las/ /chos kyang rtag tu dran pa 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /chos rnams 'dod chags bral bar rtogs pa shes rab las/ /yon tan las ni dge 'dun dran de shes rab rtsa/ /de yang 'dus ma byas su rtogs pa shes rab las/ /blo ldan 57—600

gtong ba dran pa de ni shes rab rtsa/ gang phyir nyon mongs kun 'dor 'di ni shes rab las/ /tshul khrims shin tu dag pa dran 'di shes rab rtsa/ /tshul khrims zag pa med la gnas ni shes rab las/ /che ba'i bdag nyid lha dran 'di⑪ni shes rab rtsa/ /dag nas dag pa dran pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /gang phyi ra bsgrims 9te thos pa tshol ba shes rab rtsa/ /gzhan dag las ni phyis mi tshol ba shes rab las/ /legs par byed pa'i las byed 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /las phyis mngon par 'du mi byed pa shes rab las/ /nga rgyal med cing 'dud 1par byed pa shes rab rtsa/ /ye shes che ba'i bdag nyid thob 'di shes rab las /bdag gi don la brtson 'gyur 'di ni shes rab rtsa/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed 'di ni shes rab las/ /gal te chos kyi phung po 'dzin byed shes rab rtsa/ /sems can spyod pa rjes su rtogs byed shes rab las/ /gzhanagyi blo la yang dag thob byed shes rab rtsa/ /sems can theg gsum nges 'byung byed pa shes rab las—/ /blo gros ldan pa sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /don byed sems can yongs su smin byed shes rab rtsa/ /gal te don 'thun pa yis sangs rgyas yon tan 'god/ /'di ni skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi shes rab las/ /srid pa kun du 'bar shes skrag bapa shes rab rtsa/ /mi skye bzod pa thob pa de ni shes rab las/ /phyir mi ldoka pa'i sa 'di shes rab rtsa ba ste/ /dbang bskur de yi sa thob de nim sheshes rab las/ /gal te byang chub shing drung 'dug pa shes rab rtsa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes regapa —pa 'di ni shes rab las/ /byang chub sems 'di shes rab rtsa ba zhes kyang bya/ /sems ni gnas su gang byed de ni shes rab las/ /gang dag byang chub sems la rtag gnas mi g.yo ba/ /de dag shes rab kyis ni rtag tu 57nga 601

las bya byed/ /rtsa ba 'di 'dra byang chub spyod pa mchog gi tshesems/ /sangs rgyas stobs dang de bzhin so so yang dag rig /de yi bsngags pa bskal pa bye ba mang brjod kyang / /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' mar thug par 'gyur ba med/ /sang dag 'das pa'i bde gshegs de bzhin da ltar byung / /gang dag ma 'ongs pa dang phyogs bcu'i thub dbang po/ /tshad med pa la bsnyen bkur tshadarashemed byed 'dod kang / /de ni ma myos byang chub sems la dasa' ba yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' bzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal pos ༅'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ kye ma ji tsam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di 4 shin tu rnam par nges shing / yi ge rnams kyis bstan pa mtha' yas pa/ don gyis 'jug pa mtha' yas pa/ mi brtson pa rnams kyis 'jug par dka'ar1ba/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba4 brjes su rtogs pas zab pa/ gnyis la spyod pa rnams kyis 'tshal bar dka' ba/ skye mched drug la brten ༅pa rnams kyis mthong bar dka' ba/ theg pa dman pa la mos pa rnams kyis yid ches par dka' ba/ nyan —thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyisashālam lags pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod yul/ chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya/ chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid pas phye ba ma mchis pa/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid tsākyi slad du 'gyur ba ma mchis pa/ shin tu 'das pas kun gzhi ⑪ma mchis pa sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa rab tu shes pa/ rgyu thams cad yongs su shes pa/shes rab kyi pha rol tuwaṃphyin pa'i snang ba/ nges par 'byung ba rnams kyimatshe'abyung ba—/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi thabs/ so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa 57nga 602

rnams kyis rnam par dbye bar bgyi ba/ mngon par shes pa thob pa rnams kyis rnamashepar dgrol rje 3bar bgyi ba/ tshul bcig la gnas pa rnams kyis mnyam pa nyid du rtogs par bgyi ba/ sna tshogs ma mchis par spyod pa rnams la khyad par ma mchis pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid pas mnyam pa/ gnyen po ma mchis pas mnyam pa ma mchis pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid pas mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa/ 'gog pas rab tu bye 1bas gnyis dang bral ba—/ yi ge rnams kyis dpyad du ma mchis pa/ don gyi yang dag par bzhag pa/sgras rnam cho par rig par bgyi ba/ don dam par brjod du ma mchis pa/ kun rdzob tu mchis pa/ dkon mchog bsum gyi mthu dang ldan pa/ theg pa gsum la rnam par rtog pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum po dag rab tu ston pa/khams gsum pa las shin tu 'das pa/ ris pa gsum po dag khong du chud par bgyid pa/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge shā'adzin bskyed pa/ chos thams cad kyi gnas/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las byung ba/ sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba/sangs rgyas thams cad kyisaphatsusasal bar mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub bstan pa tshad ma mchis pa 'di la mos par bgyid pa dang /bla na med pa yang darga par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang sems skyed par kabagyid pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'ishā dasladaXdu mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di mnyan par babyid pa dang / mos par bgyid pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgyas par yang dag par ston par bgyid pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das 1357nga 603

bsod nams mang du skyed rkyapa lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang byas pa bzo ba dang / byas pa 'tshal ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ de dag bsod nams mang du skyedakupar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che thams cad kyis rab tu bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la sbyin pa byin pa bas gang gis dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung ba midang / dkon mchoka gsum rgyun mi 'chad pepar bya ba'i phyir mdo sde 'di lha bu 'di nyan tam/ mos sam—/ 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ kloka pegam/ kun chub par byed dam/ston tam/ gzhan dag la yang rgyas par yang dag par ston tam/ bsgomapa— pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par gnas na 'di ni de bas bsod nams ches mang du skyedatshudzido/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' nga to/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis zhing gang ngas mthong ba/ /rin chen bkang ste de bzhin gshegs byin 1yang / /'di lta bu yi chos 'di ma thos na⑫/ /de ni bsod nams chung zhes nga spra'o/ /gang gis dam pa'i don ldan phra zab4pa/mdo sde bzang po 'di ni thos gyur na/ /kun du 'dzin cing bzung tshenas klog byed pa/ /'di ni de bas bsod nams mchog tu 'phags/ /'di lhar rgyal ba'i chos kyis nyer gnas shing / /chos kyis nges par 'byung gi zang zing min/ /de bas gang zhig bde gshekas chos 'dzin pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun la byas pa gzo—/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu dam pa dag khyedasnyekyi nang nas nga yongs su zu ngan 57—604

las 'das pa'i phyi na dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgyas par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub 'di yongs su bsrung 1 bar su spro/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cusam1mgrin ba/cig tu tshig ⑤smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdab cag rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub bskal pa grangs ma mchis par bsgrubs pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / sbad ma'i tshe sgad ma'i dus de na yang rgyas par bgyid par spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'on gyis kyang ci nas de'i dus na skye bo mang po kanas par 'gyur ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'i sems can de das gi rna bar grags par 'gyur bar de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bden pa gsung / /bden pa'i chos la rab tu gnas/ /byin gyi rlabs —)kyis de dag la// /mdo sde 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /snying rje chen po'i go cha bgos/ /byams pa chen po rab tu sanas/ /kun la byams pa nyid kyi phyir—/ /mdo sde 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /bsod nams tshokas ni phun sum tshogs1 /ye shes tshogs kyis byung gyur pa ༅/ /tshogs rnams kun dang ldan pa yis—/ /mdo sde 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /bdud rnams thams cad nges 'joms la/ /smra ba thams cad rab 'dul zhing / /lta ba thams cad rgyun gcod pa/ /mdo sde 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /'jika rten skyong dang brgya byin dang / /de bzhin lha ma yin rnams dang / /lha dang dri za klu dag kyang / /ngas ni byin gyis brlabakyipa byas/ /sa dang de bzhin bar snang la/ /lha rnams 57—605

nga nga mang po gang 'khod pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabasamacho kyis/ /tshul 'di rab tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'khor 'di bsrung༅bar bya ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa'i gdas pa rnams ldan zhing / /bden pa bzhi yis brgyanam1gyur pa/ /mdo sde 'di ni byin gyis brlabs/ /nam mkha' gzugs can byed kyang srid/ /gzugs ni gzugs med byed srid kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabasapabani/ /rnam par dkrugs 1 par mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis mgrin gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag rnams/ /mdo 'di5 —kun du bsrungatshu4 slad du/ /rtsa lag dang ni bcas rnams kyis/ /bsrung dab bzang po bgyi bar 'tshal/ /mkhas pa byang chub blo gros kyis/ /gang dag 'dzin par bgyid pa das/ /de dag la ni phyogs bzhi nas/ /rtaka par kun du bsrung ba bgyi / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis ⑫gsol to/ /bdaka ni bcom ldan mdzad pa gzo rtsesnye / /'dren pa chos kyi dbang bdag lakas/ /mgon po mdo sde mchog 'di las/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab tu bstan/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /mdzad pa gzo ba bsrung ⑫bgyid cing / /'di 'dra'i mdo dang de bzhin du/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa bsrung 3bar 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mi mjed 8kyi bdag po tshangs pas tshikas su bcad pa 'di gnyis gsol to/ /bsam gtan tshegang dang tshad med dang / /thegawaṃpa kun gyis 'byung ba gang / /de dag don ldanakazab mo yi/ /mdo sde 'di las nges par 'byung / /bdarga di tshangs pa'i bde bor te—/ /gang na tshul 'di 'chad par ni/ /mnyan pa'i slad dang de bzhin du/ /57nga 606

bsrung ba'i slad du mchi bar bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu rab dga' ldan gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis yigasol to/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas gsungs par1yi/ /mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin 'gyur ba/ /skye ba gcig gis rab gnas nas/ /dga' ldan rnams su kanas par 'gyur/ /mgon po bdag ni lha yul ba'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa bor nas su/ /tshul 'di rab tu ston bgyid cing / / 'dzam bu4༅gling du gnas par sbo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bdud kyi bu ded dpon gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di sanyis gsol to/ /gang zhig gdonapakudang ldan pa yi/ /mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin 'gyur ba/ /de dag bdud las 'di spangs —pas/ /bdud kyi dbang du mi mchi'o3)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag kyang di/ /mdo 'di kun du bsrung slad du/ /ci nas kyang ni rgyas 'gyur bar/ /brtson par bgyid cing 'dun bapar bgyid/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la bdud sdig can gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis gsol to / /rnam par 'dren pa gang zhig ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad tshar gcod rngopa—/ /'di 'dzin bgyid pa de dka la/ /bdag ni sgrib par mi bgyid do/ /mdo sde mchog ni 'byung ba der/ /bdud kyi go skabs ma mchis so/ /mgon pos gsungs pa dran bgyid pa/ /del bsrung tshib bgyid par 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i bu mtshams rab kyis 1rtetshisas su bcad pa 'di gnyis gsol to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub ni/ /mdo sde 'di las rab bshad pas—/ /gang zhig mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas kun la mchod/ /mgon po bdag ni mdo sde 'di/ /lha ni bye ba rnams la bshad/ /gang dag gus par nyan pa dang /byang chub yang dka 'dzin du stsal/ /de nas bcom ldan 57—607

chag /'phags pa nam mkha' mjod kyis thus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ shā ba /rgya bar skad du/ ār+ya ga ga na gañja pam— ri dṛts+tsha —nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa nam mkha' —mdzod kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyarga 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig 3 na—/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ bsod nams chen po'i rgyan gyis dzitshogs bsags pa/ spyod pa chen po'i rgyu 'thunashāpa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'adzasnyechen po'i sanas mtha' yas pa nges par bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par sprul pa'i byin gyi rlabs((da/ mi chabs pa'i spyod yul gyi ye shes la ngo'ajug pa/ dga' ba rgya chen po rab tu skyed pa/ dran pa dang / blo 57—637

gros dang / rtorgasarwapa la 'jug pa/ kun nas ma smad pa/ ye shes kyis rnam par dpyod pa/ de'i rang bzhin ma yin pa la 'jug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par mngon du bstod pa/ yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad dpag tu med pa na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni rab tu bskor/ slob ma shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa'i tshogs ni mnga'/ chos —thams cad la ni mnga' brnyes/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i bya ba ni shin tu mkhyen/ dbang po dam pa'i pha rol du ni byon/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis4bamatshams sbyor ba yang dag par 'joms 4 —pa la ni mkhas shing / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa ni rgyun ma bcadamadzido/ /dbe slong sa ya phrag drug gi dge slong gi dke 'dun chen po dang thabs cig zuste/ thams cad kyang — 7cang shes kyi sems dang ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi bag chags kyis〈 mtshams sbyor ba yang dka par 'jomasabapa la brtson pa/ de bzhin kashegs pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sras chos zab mo la gnas par mkhas pa/ dmigs su med pa'i chos las nges par byung ba/ spyod lam mdzes pa phun sum tshogs pa/ sbyin pa'i gnas chen por gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la shin tu zhugs pa sha starga go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dparga tu med grangs tshemed bsam gyis mi khyab mtshungs pa med pa gzhal du med pa tshad med pa brjod ⑫du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po dang yang thabs cig tshoste/ thams cad kyang sems 57—638

kyi skad cig gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par 'gro ba la mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim grokubya ba la mkhas pa/chos nyan pa la mi ngoms par yang dag par tshol ba/ rtag tu rgyun mi chad par sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa la brtson pa/ thabs dang shes rab dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ sgrib pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa la rab tu gnas pa/ rtog pa dang / rnam par rtos pa 1dang / spros pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la nye bar gyur pa sha staka la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' glog gi —lha zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' g.yu la las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad snying po zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gnon pa dpa' bo zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yid gnyis ( yang dag par 'joms rjepa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bsgrags ldan zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par lta ba'i mig ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpag tu med tshad med grangs med bsam gyisam6mi khyab mtshungs pa med gzhal du med—/ dpag gis mi lang brjod tsudu med pa'i yang brjod du med pa 3dag dang yang thabs cig 1go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dus pa chen po'i le'u zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' bachen po rnams la rab tu ston te shārte'adus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na⑫ | thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod cing 57nga 639
tai rdo wa skre dro rdo ༷ ༷ wa ju ༵ // ༷ skre lnge nga ḍi ༷// rde bye wa wa sgre ||

—— ——— — —bkod pa chen po'i khang pa brtsegs 1pa'i nang na bdag/ 'dug pa snyam du sems so—/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gi bkod pa nyid sems can rnams kyi mig sngar 1snang bar gyur tsute/ khang pa brtsegs pa na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang ba/ gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za'i 'khor de dag thams cad ma btogs par stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gzubs su snang ba lhag ma gzhan thams cad med par gyur te/ thams cad kyang nam mkha' she lta dur gyur pa snyam du shes so/ /'di lha ste dper na/ bskal pas shin tu bsregs te nam mkha' —bzhin du gyur pa na/ stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs su snang ba gang yang mig sngar snang bar mi 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ de'i tshe na ༅gang bzugs su snang ba rnams sems can dag bi mig sngar mi snang bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshebs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa'i 'jib rten gyi khams bkod pa chen po zhes bya ba na byang chub sems dpa' de dag si khang pa ( 3brtsegs pa yongs su longs spyod pa de 'dra ba'i khang pam —7brtsegs pa de na snang ngo / /nam mkha' la khang pa brtsegs pa 'dug pa de dag ma gtosas par stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sa'i steng dang / gzhi'i bar du thams cad kyang mi snang ba snyam du rab tu shes te/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / khor yub gi ri dang —/ khor yug gi ri chen po dag sems can gang gi mib sngar yang mi snang bar grur to/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang /yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams kyang mi snang ste/ gzhan du 57—640

na rkya nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i khang pa brtsekas pa de dag nyid du shes shing /bcom ldan 'das kyi 1seng ge'i khri ni 'phang du dpag tshad khrir 'phags par ② rab tu snang ngo / /gang la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i seng ge'i khri de'i 'od kyis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jib rten gyi khams snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur te/ bang stong bsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de'i nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / skar ma dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jis rten skyong ba'i 'od de dag thams cad kyang mos mog por byas par gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag thams cad kyis zu'adi lta bu'itshu1cho 'phrul ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba mthong nas phan tshun du smra ba dzikhang pa brtsegs pa 'di'ipa3bkod pa ci 'dra ba de ni bdag cag gi pa'i tshad bskal par 'dug par gyur kyang bdag cab bis pa1 rgya cher rnamapar dbye ba bstan par sla ba ma yin te/ de tsam du khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dag gi yon tan bkod pa ni tshad med do zhes 'dzer to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus gnas brtan shā 1 ri'i bu khang pa brtsegs pa de nas langs nas nam mkha' la 'dug ste/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logasasu thal mo sbyar ba btud de rngo bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' la mchis pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa 'di ma lags 1rkepa gzhan stong sasum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi lams thams cad nam malar ༅ gyur cing nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du gda' snyeb 'di su'i snga ltas lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod kyis khang pa brtsegs pa 'di mthong ngam/ kasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags soche bcom 57—641

ldan 'das kyisayobaka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod kyis khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dab gi bsngags pa yongs su brjod pa'i mtha' shes par nus sam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bdag gi nga tshad bas par gyur kyang khang pa brtsegs pa 'di dag gis 1 bsngags pa'i mtha' rtosas par mi nus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu ji ltar 1'khor 'di dag thams cad nam mkha' la song zhing khang pa brtsegs 3pa bkod pa chen por zhugs par snang ba dbazhin du bkod pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khang pa kabartsegs pa de yang 'di 'dra'o/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bkod pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams depa1gang gi phyogs na mchis—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'im6bu de ni 'di nas shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul gyis yongs su gang ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams 'das pa na bkod pa chen po zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod ༅pa gcig pa zhes bya ba da41lta nashebazhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu bkod pa chen po'i 'jis rten gyi khams de nasgyurte/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che las rin po che bzhan mi 'byung ngo / /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa de rin po che bkod pa gcig pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de yang /nam byang chub sems dpa'awaṃde dka la chos 'chad pa de na/ seng ge'i khri dang bcas te/ ta la bye ba phrag brgyad cu esrid kyi nam mkha'i dkyil du mngon par 'phab go8/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang khang pa brtsegs pa bkod pa chen po der/ nam mkha'i dkyil du mngon par 'phags nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de la chos nyan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de yang nam mkha'i dkyil 57nga 642

yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi phyag rgya yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /shā ri'i bu bkodarwa pa chen bo'i 'jig rten gyi 3khams de na/ gang byang chub sems dpa' de dab gi khang pa brtsergas pa'i yongs su longs spyod pa de ni bskal par yang brjod mi nus so/ /shā ri'i bu khyod kyis nga'i seng ge'i khri 'di mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa—/ shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa de'i seng ge'i khri yang 'di 'dra snyeste/ de la bcom ldan 'das de bzhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la rnam pa sum cu —rtsa gnyis la 'jug pa/ nam mkha'i dkyil yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rnam pa sum cu ka rtsa gnyis la 'jug pa nam mkha'i dkyil yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi phyab rgya de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po med pas chos thams cad yod pa dang med pa dang bral ba dang / rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid pas chos thams cad dngos po med pa dang / snang bar4— gyur pa med pas chos thams cad rnam par rig pa med pa dang / rgyu dang dmib/sa pa med pas5lachos thams cad snang bar gyur pa med pa dang / nye bar zhi ba'i mtshan nyid pas chos thams cad dmigs pa med pa dang / gnyis su med pas chos thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / so so tha dad pa med pas chos thams cad gnyis su med pa dang / tshul gcig la zhugs pas chos thams cad tha dad pa med pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang bral bas chos thams cad tshul gcirga pa dang / dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa dang / thams cad la mi gnas pas chos thams cad nam mkha'i 57nga 643

— —dkyil dang 4/ thams cad du mi snang bas chos thams cad mi gnas pa'i sgo dang —/ yul gyi lam las yang dag par 'das pas chos thams cad snang ba med pa dang / nang dang phyi'i rnam par dag pas chos thams cad yul med pa dang /rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin pas chos thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyis nye gubar zhi bas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa dang / sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa med pas chos thams cadaXnye bar zhi ba dang / bzod ba ma nas ma byung bas chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa dang / nga'i ba med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med pas chos thams cad gzod ma nas ma byung ba dang / bdag po med pas chos ④ thams cad nga'i ba med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med pa dang rang bzhin gyis bdag med pas chos thams cad bdag po med pa dang / gzod ma nas rnam par dag pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis bdag med pa dang / ldog pa med pas chos thams cad ba/zod ma nas rnam par dag pa dang / sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyis rang bzhin pas chos thams cad ldob pa med pa dang / dngos po med pas chos thams cad sgyu dam lta bu dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i mtshan nyid pas chos thams cad dngos po med pa dang / sems dang sa dben pas chos thams cad mngon par 'dus ma byas pa dang / mtshan nyid med cing mtshan nyid kyi bzhi'i mtshan nyid med pas/ chos thams cad dben pa'i mtshan nyid dang /rang gi mtshan nyid las ma g.yos pas chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa dang /gnas dmigs su (med pas chos thams cad ma g.yos pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'i mtha' la rab tu gnas pas chos thams cad gnas med pa dang /57nga 644

kun gzhi med pas chos thams cad dmigs pa med pa dang / kun gzhi dang bral bas chos thams cad kun gzhi med pa ste/ shā ri'i bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa de byang chub sems dpa' de dag la rnam pa sum cu ཿrtsa gnyis la 'jug pa nam mkha'i dkyil yongs su dag pa'i chos kyi phyab rgya yang dag par rab tu ston te(— )/ de thos pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa dab mngon ba par shes pa rnam par dag pas rnam par shes pa la bzod pa chos thams cad la dbang byed pa rjes su 'thobab po/ /yang shā ri'i bu bkod pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyimapakhams de'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pas brgyan cing / bskal pa grangs med par gtong ba'i rjes su song ba/tshul khrims kyis brgyan cing blo shin tu byang yeb/ bzod pas brgyan cing sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ brtson 'grus kyis brgyan cing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi tshogs bsargas pa/ bsam gtan gyis brgyan cing bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang | snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa thams cad kyis rnam par rtsen ‘pa/ shes rab kyis brgyan cing bas chasas kyis — mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral ba/ byams pa chen pos brgyan cing sems can thams cad sgyu yongs su skyob par gnas pa/ snying rje chen pos brgyan cing sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong bar gnas pa/ dga' ba chen pos brgyan r+ṣacing sems can thams cad dga' ba dang bde ba dang4 rab tu dga' ba la so sor 'god pa'i rgyun mi gcod pa/ btangaXkasnyoms chen pos brgyan cing sems can thams cad mi mtho mi dma' ba la 'bod pa rgyun mi gcod par sbyor ba 57nga 646

pya khye sde bye ༷ rtsa twe /skye pa / sbya sdu/ ༷ ga spyad sdu ༷ — sdi ཿ / / sbya tre /ca snye traṃ na 2 r+sha ciX wa khri tā dazil 〉 ༷ dad nga na rgya shā ༷ ༷/ sto da/ ༷ rte sdu lnge jiX / / ༷/ da/ /la de zuX rdeg / cing

༷/ ming rna pa pa da dri bye ༷ hūṃ zha hūṃ la rjo shā — / cha —3 tha rngoḥ / bye wa treX ༷ tre /༷ ji 2 pa dz+wa ༷ ra/ ༷ rna ༷༷da nga rna / ṭī /rdoshe sdo / / ga pa // ci sdu ༷ gyi ra ha da ra ca myu rna/rje

sha stag4go/ /yang shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i mdzod ces bya ba 'dus ste/ bsod nams kyi gzi bajid kyis shin tu bajid pa/ ye shes mthong ba thogs pa med pa/ mtshan rnams kyis lus brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis byams pa brgyan pa/sbobs pas ngag brgyan pa/ gzungs kyis sems brgyan pa/ thos pas dran pa brgyan pa/ nges par sems pas bden pa brgyan pa/ rtogs mipas don rtogs pa brgyan pa/ bsam pas dam bcas pa brgyan pa/ khyad par du 'gro bas lhag pa'i bsam pa brgyan pa/ sbyor bas brgyan cing chos thams cad la the tshom nyamed par gyur pa/ btang snyoms chen pos brgyan cing mthon ⑤dman med pa/mngon par shes pa chen pos brgyan cing rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtsen pa thams cad mngon par shes pa/ bsod nams kyis brgyan cing laka na rin po che gtang 3 bas mngon par grub pa/ ye shes kyis brgyan cing sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi bsam pa la zhugs pa/ blos brgyan cing sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rtogs par byed pa/ mig gis brgyan cing mig lnga'i yul la shin tu rnam par dag pa/ rna bas brgyanatshugecing sgra dang don thams cad rtogs pa'i snying po dang ldan pa/ so so yang dag par rig pas brgyargya cing don dang chos dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa mi zad par ston pa/stobs kyis brgyan cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rjes su thob pa/ mi 'jibs pas brgyan cing phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis zil gyis mi non pa/yon tan gyis brgyan snyecing sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' yas pa thob pa chos 57—646

kyis brgyan cing spu'i bu ka thams cad nas chos sgrog pa/ so sor rig pa'i rjes su song ba/ snang bas brgyan cing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du thob pa/ 'od kyis brgyan cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing rje7thams cad snang bar byed pa/kun nas ston pas brgyan 1cing phyadar par lung ston pa/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pas brgyan cing de byed pa'i chos tshar phyin pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 4 'phrul gyis brgyan cing rdzu 'phrul rnam par dab/ pas rnam par grol ba thams cad ston pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon par bstod 2pas brgyan 5zhecing gzhan la rag ma las pa'i ye shes la gnas pa/ tshogs thams cad kyi yon tan gyis brgyan cing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 'dul 7ba'i rjes su zhugs pa ste/shā ri'i bu gang bkod pa 'di lha bu kun du snang ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' 4mdzod kyi rngo 3byin gyi ⑩rlabs so/ /shā ri'i tshedu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod de nga la blta ba dang /phyag 'tshalayob dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tshirab tu yongs su bzung mib dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag chos kyi dga' ba dang / bde ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba skyed tshepa dang / theg pa chen po 'di'ang rab tu yongs su gzung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyang yongs su gzung ba'i phyir nga'i ban du 'ong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa de la gsol nas/byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag tshobacu gnyis kyis yongs su bskor te mdun du 57nga 647

bdar nas/ lhan cig tu mngon du gyur pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mi byed pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi nyu rkang pas bkod pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de nas mi snang bar gyur te/ sems kyi skad cig sacig byung ba tsam gyis mi mjid kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phyin nas de bar 1snang la 'dug ste/ bkod pa chen po'i 'jika rten gyi khams kyi me zutog dang —/ phreng ba dang / phye ma dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / bdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i char rab tu phab pa/'di lha ste/ zla ba dang / zla ba chen po dang / shin tu mdzes pa'i zla ba dang /nyi ma'i 'od dang / nyi ma rab tu 'bar ba dang / me shel dang / mdog mdzes dang / mdob mdzes chen po dang / mdog mdzes par 'dug pa dang /spru la dang / sgra la chen po dang / sba la rab mdzes dang / dri ma med pa dang /kud du dri ma med pa dang / rnam dag 'od dang / gser du snang0 dang /nam mkha' snang ba dang / reg grur dang / dri chen dkar dang / 'dab brgya pa dang / ze ba stong ldan dang / zu ngan sel ba dang / dga' byed dang / lhas stod —— dang / klu'i me tog dang / dga' ba bde ba shā—kun skyed rtsapa dang /bsam gtan yan lag dang / dris dga' ba dang / lus sems tshim byed dang — stong gsum dri dang / nad kun zhi byed dang / nad kun sel dang /bdag gi gzi brjid kyis brgyan cing / dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams kyis grub pa/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpas rika pa/ de lta bu'i me tog gis stong gsum gyi shārjestong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di kun du khebs par byas pas—/ bcom ldan 'das kyiḥ'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du me tog sgas 57—648

bye/ sna rdo skre / nga ga ji skre ci be rdo /sa ste 'jupyi/ ste dzi /byed /bye/2 che /bye da ngadang/treX/ tsheX 'i ༷/ṭā ts+tsha ga 2 da / nga tshan nga//dri /rna da rgyu be/ kau /// gyi na / kau rna / / phyi lo sa / ciX/ sde / /bye //tho miX ༷ rda dritā sdi spro rngol /rngo ༷ gyu / / sdu

pus mo nub tsam du gang bar grur to/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des—/ sngon ma thos ma mthong ba'i me tog de mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces sasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i me toka blta sgyun sdug pa 'di dag ga lasam mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu dam pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' — ramadzod de/bkod pa chen po'i — 'jig rten kyi khams de nas 'dir 'ongs te/ de —penam mkha'i dkyil du 'durga nas/ 'di lta bu'i me tob gi char rab tu phab po/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkhra'i mdzod byang chub sems dpa' bye waṃb phrag bcu gnyis po de 3dag dang lhan cig tu nam mala'i dkyil de nas babs te mi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 4zhabs la mgo bos phyaka 'tshal kanas/ lan bsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che bkod pa gcig pa dem/ bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba chung ngam/bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde bar reg pa la gnas sam zhes rngortesnyun bsol zhing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod la sobs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bcu banyis po 'dus pa chen po'i le'u'i chos zakyi rnam grangs nyan 'tshal ba/ 'di dag ji ltar chos thams cad la dbang bgyid cing / chos chen po dang ldan pas slar ldog par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi bka' mchid kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis mgu bar mdzod cig ces de skad kyang bsung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri'i 6 steng gi bar snang la dpag tshad stong phrag bcu tsam 57nga 649

gyi rin po che'i gdugs byin gyis brlabs nas bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal༅nas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod pa1 /chos dang don dang yon tan 2ye shes 'phags pas na/ /yongs dag rnam dag snga nas dag cing dri ma med/ /gnas med nam mkha' 'dra bar zu mi g.yo rab tu brnyes—/ /rab zab kun nas spyod yul min la phyab 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba chos kyi skus ni rab bye sku mnyam yang / /gzugs mdzes ldan zhing gzugs bzang sku yang ston par mdzad/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i thukas rje rab bskyed nas—/ /bsod nams brgya tsapa'i mtshan gyi sku yi mchog kyang ston/ /khyod ni mi gsung rtog 1 med sgra dang tshig kyang med/ /tshig gi rang bzhin brag ca'i bamatshan nyid gzung du med/ /sgra med rtag med yi ge med pa mkhyen nas kyang / /byams pa nga ni snying rje can pas rgyal ba'i tshig kyang gsung / /sems can kun gyi sems dang sems byung rjes su rig /khyod ni sems kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid mkhyen/ /sems kyi rgyud kyi rang bzhin ji 'dra rab mkhyen kyang / /sems dang yid rnams la ni khyod kyi sems mi gnas/ /'gro ba rnams la khyed kyishā spyod pa kun bstan te/ /bde bar sashegs pa'i sku ni 'gyur ba yong ma mchis/ /gang gi gzugs dang sems dang yon tan ci 'dra bar/ /maman dang spyod lam dag kyang de4yi tshul du ston/ /bde gshegs chos 'di la ni nga yir 'dzin pa med| /nga ni chos la gnas pa med cing 'dzin pa med/ /sems can mang po kun rtog tsa chos kyis dzo'adul mkhyen nas/ /khyod ni bla na med pa'i chos rnams rtag tu ston/ /rgyal ba'i sku la 'khor 'di kun gyis bltas pa tshon/ /gzugs dang mtshan ma tha dad bskal tsapa mi mnyam nas/ /khyod kyi sku ni mi 'gyur rtog 57—660

med mtshan med de/ /'khor rnams ji lta'i sems dang bsam bzhin tshim par mdzalta—/ /chos 'di thams cad rgyu dang rkyen las skyes pa ste/ /byed med ngo bo nyid med kun du rtoka la —skyes/ /bde gshegs de 'dra'i chos kyi tshul rnams mkhyen nas su/ /byang chub mi 'gyur zhi ba bla na med pa brnyes/ /mtha' dang de bzhin dbus bcad rnam par rtog pa med/ /stong zhing bsog la rang bzhinapa 1 gsob ste ya ma brlab / /khyod kyis de 'dra'i chos nyid rnam dag mkhyen nas su/ /'gro ba rnams la rgyu dang las dang byed pa ston/ /chos 'di sems can med cing srog dang gang zag med/ /nam mkha' mtshungs mnyam pas na ming yang rnam par dag /sems can gan du nyer gshegs yang dka bdab med pa/ /mi 'chi 'dus ma byas la sems can mang sad mdzad/ /brtson 'grus mthu dang stobs kyis byang chub 'di tshol phyir/ /khyod kyis — bskal pa bsam yas bye ba phrag brgyar spyad/ /sgrub pa med pa'i nan tan 6mtshan nyid byang chub ste/ /gang phyir spyod pa'i don de rjes su thob par 'gyur/ /chos rnams mnyamaXpa nyid ni mnyam par bzhab 3mkhyen pas/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma das kyang mnyam par mkhyen—/ /mnyam pa nyid la mnyam nyid rtag bzhugs rnam mi rtog /de phyir rgyal ba mnyam par bzhag cing mi 'gyur ba/ /phung po khams dang dbang po ji ltar sgyu ma bzhin/ /'jig rten bsum po chu zla 'dra ste 'pho ba med/ /sems can rnams ni mi lam lta bur dngos med de/ /mkhyen pas mi lam bzhin du rtogs nas chos 'di gsung / /byang chub mchos rab brda yi rang bzhin nga kyis brnyes| /de ni thob dang ma thob pa zhes brjod du med/ /ji ltar byang chub khyod kyis de bzhin 'khor lo yang / /tshul dang tshul min 'jug — pa'i mtshan bral 57nga 651

rngo tri te ༷shā blo ༷ma ye snyi shā hūṃ — ༷ mo da 1 sdu trī khye pri kā na ༷ sngu rnakau 2 ༷ ༷/rnan slo ba kā nga rngo /ba ji / ༷༷ na/ zi ༷ da tre tī na sdu byu pya trī ཿ dzi r+sha tha ra 2 2 nga pyi rtsa 3 / bye nga/ pya two ༷ sdu/ / rdzu ca sdi ji rdo tā di

nga —— nga na chos rnam par nges pa la 'jug pa'i bka' mchid chung tsazad cig bdag zhu'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das ni mi chags pa'i ye shes can te sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchoka dang mchog 1ma lags pa mkhyen pasheye shes la mkhas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni snang ba brnyes pa ste mun pa thams cad dang—zu3bral ba/ bcom ldan 'das ni don mkhyen pa ste tshig 3thams cad rab tu dbye ba'i ye shes la mkhas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni dus mkhyen pa ste tshod las mi 'da' zhing phyad bapar lung ston pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni tshod mkhyen pa ste sems can thams cad la so so ci rigs 33par chos ston pa/bcom ldan 'das ni rnam par rol pa ste mngon par shes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnam par nges pa'i ye shes la mkhas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni shin tu rnam par gzigs pa'i blo dang ldan pa ste sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa phyag mthilapa1 du 'jog par kun du ston pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni mngon par 'phags pa ste spyi gtsug tsabaltar mi mthong ba/ bcom ldan 'das ni zil gyis ma non pa ste stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na dpa' bo gcig po1 bcom ldan 'das ni rang byung ba ste slob dpon med par chos thams cad rang gis gemangon par rdzobs par sangs rgyas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni 'dren pa ste 'dren pa med pa dang lam ngan par zhugs pa rnams la yang dgawaṃpa'i lam ston pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni sman pa'i rgyal po ste thoka ma dang tha ma ma mchis pa'i 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / kun du bsgribs pa dang / shin tu bsgribs pa dang / kun nas ldang 3bas bsgribs pa'i 'jig rten gnas pa rnams nad ma mchis pa 'chi ba ma mchis pa'i gnas kyi lam la rab tu 'god copa/57nga 654

—— ——bcom ldan 'das ni stobs dang drag shul 'chang ba ste gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa la mkhas shing gsum rig pa'i rig pa brnyes pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni mi 'jigs ཿpa chen po brnyes pa ste zab pa zad cing mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang rnam par byang ba mkhyen pa la mkhas pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mdun du khyu mchog seng ge'i sgra sgrogs tsupa/ bcom ldan 'das ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang ldan pa ste dus gsum la thogs kupa med pa'i ye shes can bcom ldan 'das ni sku dang gsung dang thugs yongs su dag pa ste 'khrul pa dang ca co mi mnga' ba/snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa/bcom ldan 'das ni byams pa chen po la gnas pa ste zhe 'gras pa med pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer gyis bzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni thugs rje chen po la gnas pa ste legs par byas pa dang / nyes par byas pa dang —/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal bas mi bskyod pa/ sems can thams cad la mnyam par 'juka pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa ste mnyam pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa la zhugs pa/bcom ldan 'das ni bye brag med pa ste nam mala' lta bur shin tu rnam par dab cing sems can thams cad la mnyam —par sbyor ba/ bcom ldan 'das ni 'dod pa med pa rtoste shes rab kyis ngoms pa/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang /tshigs su bcad pa dang bral ba/ bcom ldan 'das ni thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa sprun lnga'i tshul yongs su dag pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'dasarwa ༄57nga 666

de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dang chos dang ye shes tshad ma mchis pa dang ldan par bdag gis rig nas chos rab tu brjod pa'i sgo yongs su zhu bar 'tshal te gus pa dang bcas shing chos la gces spras rngo su bgyi ba dang ldan pa ste/ nga rgyal ma mchis shing sems can thams cad chos la sbyor ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par bsgrub (pas chos 'tshal ba'i sbad du de bzhin gshegs pa la yongs su zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pom1nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /legs so lekas so/ /skyes bu dam pa ji ltar khyod zagang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la dris pa rnams — lung bstan pa thob pa rigs kyi bu khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa de bzhin gshebs pa la dris shig dang dris pa de dang de nyid tsulung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi rgyal po rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba 'khor der 'dus par gyur te/'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mala' ༄dmadzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci zhig bi phyir rigs kyi bu khyod de bzhin bshegs pa la zhu bar 'dod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 3mdzod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi kargyal po rab tu snang ba la tshisas su bcad tshepa slar smras pa/ bang rnams sems dang sems la sems yid mtshungs/ /shin tu bsams cosems ye shes mnyam la kanas/ /sems la sems med par ni zhubs pa'i tshul/ /de dag don du rgyal la bdag zhu'o| /snang ba thob cing mun pa dri ma med/ /yid gnyis can gyi yid gnyis blo 57nga 656

nga — —gcod pa/ /des byas rnam par thar pa la gzhagayopa/ /de dag ched du bde bar kashegs la zhu/ /bdag la bdag med shin tu rnam dag yid/ /sems can don zhugs sems can med la dga'/ /sems can bdag med gnyis las thar byed pa/ /rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi gtam 'di'o/ /cho ga spyod yul brtul zhugs yongs su dag /bsam pa dag cing sems ni nam mala' 'dra/ /lhun po lha bur brtan cing mi g.yo ba/ /de das ched du don yod mdzad la zhu/ /mi zlogs brtan gupa brtson 'grus kun nas 0bzang / /dpa' bo bdud kyi dgra yi nga rgyal bcom/ /nyon mongs rab tu nyon mongs dri sbyong 4ba/ /mthong dka' de dag don du 'di zhu'o/ /thos sbyin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dga'/ /bsamar༄gtan rnam thar shes rab mchoka tu gyur/ /mngon shes bsam gtanashā rnam par grol ba'i 'od/ /rab dga' ba dri med don du bdag zhu'o/ /stong pa mtshan ma med cing mi smon gnas/ / bsams bzhin shushi 'pho dang ni skye ba ston//skyes pa med cing mi gnas 'chi 'pho med/ /de dag don du mi yi spyod pa zhu/ /nyan thos rang rgyal skye bo gzhan dab gis/ /rtogs par dka' zhing zab mo mthong dka' ba/ /skye bo kun gyi yid rnams kun skul ba'i/ /chos kyi btam ni bde bar gshebs la zhu/ /lesas par byas pa rdzogs pa'i chos la darga'/ /chos la chos med 'dzin pa banyis las grol/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag ḍamachog gi chos la dba'/ /sems kyang panam mkha' mtshungs pa'i don du zhu/ /gang darga sangs rgyas rigs gnas chos la dga'/ /rtaka tu sangs rgyas bstod pa kun med blo/ /grags pa mtha' yas 'jig rten gsum du thos/ /yon tan rgya mtsho de phyir 'di zhu'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems 57—657

dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sbyin pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams lab/sa/ tshul khrims nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang /bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / brtson 'grus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang / bsod nams nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa dang — ye shes nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams lags/ sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjesayosu dran pa dang / satong ba rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral ba rnams lags/ sangs rgyas kyis rngoganang ba'i lha rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral ba rnams lags/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang mnyam pa thob cing byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa yang spyod de ba3sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa'isgyu༅mtshan nyid dang cho ga shes pa rnams lags/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das — rnams kyi chos dkon mchorga gi mdzod 'dzin pa dang / mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi chos gang de bzhin bshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid de'i rngochos thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa dang /thog ma nas sems can rnam par dag pas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrub pa'i slad du tshul bzhin du'ang rab tu sbyor ba rnams lags/ mngon par shes pa las ma nyams shing chos thams cad la dbang bgyid pa rnams lags/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i chos kyi tshul zab 57—668

rdo r+sā gyi ci ji dmi ༷ nga jerngo sdi /sdi ༷ ma tre/ji bye sdu ḍi sdu wa bye ) tre pi /rna tre / ga pa kā da rga ṭ+wāṃ byeX 4 ༷ / bgyi/ sdi nga tsho / ༷༷ rna ༷༷ byed rte /༷ traṃ | | zi da ༷༷ / sde sdi

la 'jug pa dang / sbyin pa rnam par dag pas bsngo ba rnam par dag pa la 'jug pa dang / bsngo ba rnam par dag pas byang chub rnam par dag pa la 'jug pa ste/rigs kyi bu chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /des rnam par dag pa brgyad kyi sgo nas sbyin pa de sbyin 4 te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ngar 'dzin pa rnam par dka par sbyin pa de sbyin/ nga yir 'dzin pa rnam par dag par 1sbyin pa de sbyin/rgyu rnam par dag par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ltam1ba rnam par dag param④sbyin pa de sbyin1 mtshan ma rnam par dag par sbyin pa de sbyin/ tha 3dad pa rnam par dag par yi sbyin pa de sbyin/ rnam par smin pa la mi re ba rnam par dag par basbyin pa de sbyin/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa 'i sems rnam par dag par sbyin pa de sbyin te / de rnam par dag pa brgyad po 'di dag gi sgo nas sbyin pa de sbyin no/ /ji ltar nam mkha' mtha' med pa de bzhin du sems mtha' med par byas te sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji lhar nam mkha' rgya che zhing bsgribs 5pa med pa de bzhin du byang chub tumarngobasngos te sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' la gzubs med pa de bzhin du gzugs thams cad la mi gnas par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' la tshor ba med pa de bzhin du tshor ba thams cad dang bral bar sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' la 'du shes med pa de bzhin du 'du shes thams cad kyi sna1mdud pa med par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' 'dus ma byas pa de bzhin du 'dus byas thams cad med par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji lhar nam mkha' mtshan nyid rnam par rig pa med pa de bzhin du rnam par shes pa mi gnas par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la khyab 57nga 661

pa de bzhin du sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par sbyin pa de sbyin/ji ltar nam mkha' mi zad pa de bzhin du dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mi zad par bsngo zhing sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' la mun pa med pa de bzhin du nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi mun pa med par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' rtag par rab tu snang ba de bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin yongs su das par sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar nam mkha' sems can thams cad kyi go skabs 'byed pa de bzhin du sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar sbyin pa de sbyin/ji ltar nam mkha' 3la nga'i mib med pa de bzhin du sems can thams cad yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral bar sbyin pa de sbyin/ ji ltar sprul pas sprul pa la sbyin pa de sbyin pa lta snyebur rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub ste/ sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral zhing chos thams cad la re ba med pa de ltar gnyis dang 'azal— ba'i phyir sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rnam par das par byang chub sems dpas sbyin pa de sbyin te/ risas kyi bu kang de lta bur sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba de ni shes rab kyi ye shes kyis ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su 'dor zhing thabs kyi ye shes kyis ni sems can thams cad mi gtong ba ste/ rigs kyi bu de lta bur ḍa gtong ba'i sems ni byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na mar me zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba 'di 'dra ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/57nga 662

rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang de dag tho rnam pa med pa ste/ rnam papagernam par dag pa/ sems can gyi rnam pa ste/ sems can rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi rnam pa ste/ chos rnam par dag pa/ ye shes kyi ②rnam pa ste/ ye shesamachornam par dag pa/ shes rab kyi rnam pa ste/ shes rab rnam par dag pa/ sems kyi rnam pa ste/ sems rnam par dab pa/'jig rten gyi rnam pa ste/ 'jib rten rnam par dag pa/ kazugs med pa migazugs su ston pa dang mi ston pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa/ nun pa med cing mun pa rab tu snang bar byed pa/ mtshan ma thams cad rnam par bshig 63pas mtshan ma med pa'i mthar gyur pa/ mthar phyin pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa/mi zad pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa 3)/ de bzhin gshebs pa'i ye shes bamakhyen pa'i lung bstan pa thob pa/ mtshams bcad cing byang chub sems dpa' nges par gyur pa la zhugs pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i phyas rgyas btab cing dbang bskur ba thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la yang dka par zhugs shing ngemanyam pa nyid kyisar+shamanyam par spyod pa/ legs par spyod pa la spyad pa/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa'i mtshan nyid dang chog shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi spyod yul te'u/ skyes bu dam pa de dang de dag ni de lta bu'i sbyin pa sbyin par byed do/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa na byang chub sems dpa' khri drug stong nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i sbyin pa la bzod pa skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /dag pa'i sems kyis rtag tu sbyin pa sbyin/ /byang chub phyir te rnam smin yong mi 'dod—/ /dga' zhing mgu nas rjes su gdung med de/ /rab tu grol nas rtag 57nga 663

nga — tu sbyin pa sbyin/ /mkhas pas chos rnams sgyu 'drar shes nas su/ /lus dang sroka la'ang chags par mi 'gyur zhing / /de dag la ni nams kyang tsho 'dzin pa med1 /de ltar de dab bsam pa byang chub nges/ /thams cad gtong 1yang mi dka' bar pemi 'gyur —/ /de la zhum pa med de gong ba med/ /de yis nam mala' mtshungs par chos rnams bsgoms/ /de bas dga' bar mi 'gyur zhum pa med| /bdag gi chorang bzhin snga nas rnam par dab /byang chub rnam par dag pas sbyin pa sbyin/ /de ni sems kyi rgyud la mi chags par/ /spros pa med par sbyin pa rab tu sbyin/ /sems mnyam yid kyang mnyam pas sbyin pa rgatong / /rab 'bring tha ma gsum yang med par sbyin/ /bsam pa yongs dag dri ma med pa yis—/ /thams cad gtong yang rnam par smin mi 'dod/ /lus dang tshe ni mi rtag sgyur — ma 'dra/ /longs spyod rmi lam glog bzhin snying po med/ /'jig rten kun la snying rje brtse bskyed nas/ /'jig rten chos kyis ma gos sbyin pa sbyin/ /nyon mongs dag phyir bdag gi nor kun btong / /rgyal ba'i tshib gi gnas su 'gyur snyam ste/ /bdud rnams kyis kyang bdag la glags mi rnyed/ /de ltar brtags nas thams cad ga/tong ba yin/ /stobs bcus sbyin pa rtsa ba yin zhes bsungs| /de la rab tu gnas na tshul khrims ldan/ /tshul khrims yon tan gnas nas bsam gtan rnyed/ /bsam gtan ma chags shes rab rdzobs par byed / /sbyin pa dang ni dul bas sems rab tshim/ /nyon mongs rnams kyang tshib nas phyir mi skye/ /sbyin pa bdag dang gzhan la phan par rgasungs/ /phan dang bde ba 'dus byas sbyin pas ④mgu/ /sbyin gtong nyon mongs spang zhing dge ba'i phyir/ /des na 'dzin pa la ni chabs mi 'gyur/ /pha rol nyon mongs 1 57nga 664

— nga — — — ——— — nga phyir ni mi gtong ste/ /bdag blo rnam dag 1byang chub phyir satong ngo / /ji lta ji ltar ma zhum sems kyis gtong / /de ltar des ni byang chub yon tan mthong / /ji lta ji ltar byang chub yon tan mthong / /de lta de ltar sems can brgya tshim byed—/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' kamadzod la bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzubs brnyan lta bu'i lus mnyam pa nyid dang / brag ca lta bu'i sgra mnyam pa nyid dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i sems mnyam pa nyid dang / nam mkha' lta bu'i blo mnyam pa nyid de/rigs kyi bu chos bzhi po de dab dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu brgyad po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ste/ brgyad bang 'e na/'di lta ste/ sems rnam par dag pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba dang | tshad mar gyur pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems med pa dang / dam bcas chopa rnam par dag pa'i phyir bslab pa thams cad mi 'dor ba dang / smon lam yongs su das pa'i phyir skye ba thams cad du mi 'jus pa dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa yongs su das pa'i phyir 3 mi lhod pa rjedang / mtshan ma yongs su dag pa'i phyir byang chub tu bsngo ba dang /nyon mongs pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir kun nas gdung ba med pa dang byang chub yongs su das pa'i phyir smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rigs kyi bu brgyad pos3 de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims yongs su dag pa'o/ /57nga 665

— nga gzhan yang tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ni nam mkha' dka pa ste tshul khrims de yang dag pa'o/ /nam mkha' dri ma med pa ste tshul khrims de yang dri ma med pa'o/ /nam mkha' zhi ba ste tshul khrims de yang zhi ba'o/ /nam mkha' mi mtho ba ste tshul khrims de yang mi mtho ba'otsu )/ /nam mkha' mi dma' ba ste tshul khrims de yang mi dma' ba'o/ /nam mkha' gzung du med pa ste tshul khrims de yang gzung du med pa'o| /nam mkha' gnas med pa ste tshul khrims de yang gnas med pa'o/ /nam mkha' med pa ma yin te tshul khrims de yang med pa ma yin pa'o/ /nam mkha' rtag pa ste tshul khrims de yang rtag pa'o/ /nam mkha' mi zad pa ste tshul khrims de yang mi zad pa'o/ /nam mkha' mtshan ma med pa ste tshul khrims de yang mtshan ma med pa'o/ /nam mkha' rgyu ba med pa ste tshul khrims de yang rgyu ba med pa'o / /nam mkha' spros pa med pa ste tshul khrims de yang spros pa med pa'o/ /nam mkha' zag pa med pa choste tshul khrims de yang zas pa med pa'o/ /nam mkha' 'dus ma byas pa ste tshul khrims de yang 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /nam mkha' mi 'gyur ba ste tshul khrims de yang mi 'byur ba'o/ /nam mkha' rnam par mi rtog pa ste tshul khrims de yang rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /nam mkha' thams cad du song ba ste tshul khrims de yang thams cad du song ba'o/ /nam mkha' mi chod mi byed pa ste tshul khrims de yang mi chod mi 1phyed pa'o/ /nam mkha' mtshungs par sbyor ba ste tshul khrims de yang mtshungs par sbyor ba'o/ /nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa can —ma yin pa ste tshul khrims de yang rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni tshul khrims nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /de nas bcom 57nga 666

—ldan 'das kyis tshide'i tshe tshigs su bcad zapa 'di dag gsungs so/ /sems kyi tshul khrims dri med srung zhing gdung ba med/ /lus dang sems kyang rnam dag ngag yid thams cad bsdams6/ /mkhas pa rtaka tu nang zhi tshul khrims dregs mi snyems④ / /blo 'chad sems la mi gnas byang chub sems la rton/ /las gang ma byas ma bsamasam de bzhin ma brtags te/ /de ni dmar sngo ser min kha dog gzugs mi gnas/ /gzugs med mi bden mi g.yo dben pa nam mkha' bzhin//tshul khrims lta ba'i gnas med mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags/ /tshul khrims de ni rab zhi zhi byed nyon mongs zhi/ /zhi gnas lhab mthong dag gi — mthar phyin mtharakadziston pa/ /gang su bcings las grol ba de dag tshul khrims bsnyenaṭ+wā/ /de bas tshul khrims thar byed byang chub rtsa ba'i gzhi/ gang su sbyangs pa dgon gnas 'dod nyung chog shes pa/ /yo byad bsnyungs shing bsam gtan dben tshogs sems sbyangs pa/ /tshul khrims de yi gnas des sems rkang thar pa'i rten—/ /de phyir tshul khrims brgyan pa lam bde thar gnas pa/ ba/yo ba nga sems kun bral lta ba'i nyon mongs gcod/ /nam mkha' mtshungs mnyam byams pas khyab cing mthar 'dzin spyod/ /byang chub phyir nges mi gtong byang chub kun mi rtog /gang mkhas chog 1dashes de 'dra tshul khrims pha rol phyin// //'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba/ bam po gnyis pa/rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshig nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir gshe yang slar mi gshe ba midang /57—667

lus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir brdegs kyang sgar mi rdeb pa dang sems nam mala' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir spyosabakyang slar mi spyo 1ba dang / bsam pa nam mala' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir khros kyang slar mi khro ba ste/ ribs kyi bu chos bzhi po de dab dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzod pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yongs su dag pa 'di brgyad de/ brgyad gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ nam mkha' la zhe 'gras pa med de sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / nam mkha' la rjes su chags pa med de rnyed pa dang bkur ste la rjes su chags pa med pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang nam mkha' ni mnyam par sbyor ba ste sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / nam mkha' ni ma snadadz+wa1 ma nyams rngopa ste lus dang sems zad pas nyams pa med pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / nam mkha' ni bab la nyal thams cad spangs pa ste bab la nyal med pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang / nam mkha' ni yid dang dmisas pa med pa ste yid dang dmigs pa med pa pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa dang /nam mkha' ni ma skyes ma byung ba ste ma skyes ma byung ba'i bzod pa can gyi bzod pa — yongs su dab pa dang / nam mkha' ni gzubs dang gzubs med pa thams cad la khyab pa ste byams pas khyab pa'i bzod pa yongs su dag pa'o / /rigs kyi bu brgyad po de dag ni byang zub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzod pa yongs su dag pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa ni snye 'di brgyad de/ brgyad gang zhe na/57nga 668

'di lta nga / stong pa nyid la bzod kyang lta ba gzhig pa'i phyir ma yin pa dang /mtshan ma med pa la bzod kyang mtshan ma sel ba ma yin pa dang / smon pa med pa la bzod kyang byang chub tu smon pa med pa ma yin pa dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa la bzod kyang 'dus byas rnam par gzhib pa'i phyir ma yin pa dang /skye ba med pa la bzod kyang 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid kyis ma yin pa dang /'byung ba med pa la bzod kyang skye ba dang gnas pas ma yin pa dang / sems can med pa la bzod kyang dngos po rnam par gzhis pa'i phyir ma yin pa dang /ji lta ba bzhin du bzod kyang dus rnam par gzhis pa'i phyir ma yin pa ste/rigs kyi bu brgyad po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'aXrnams kyi chos la nges par 1 rtog pa'i bzod pa'o/ /bzod pa zhes bya ba ni 'di dag bdag la gshe yang bzod do snyam pa de ni nga yir 'dzin pa'i bzod pa ste/ 'di ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i bzod pa ma yin no/ /'di dag gshe ba bdag 1gis bzod par bya'o snyam pa de ni ngar 'dzin pa'i bzod pa ste/ de ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i bzod pa ma yin no/ /'di dab ni yi ge bsnor ba'o snyam pa de ni sgra dang skad kyi bzod pa ste/ de ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa 'i bzod pa ma yin no/ /'di yang stong pa bdab kyang stong pa'o snyam pa de ni yid la byed pa 5 sbyor ba'i bzod pa ste/ de ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i bzod pa ma yin no/ /bdag gis bzod —pa bya'o snyam pa de ni rnam par rig pa'i bzod pa ste/ de ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i bzod pa ma yin no/ /'di lta ste/ dper na shing sā bal ched ngo 'i tshal yod par la la zhika 'ongs te/ shing sā —la bcad na de la shing sā sgyu la bcad pa'i lhag ma rnams 'di snyam du 'di dag ni bcad do/ /57nga 669

tu shes pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba mngon par 'du byed lhong de bzhin gshegs pa rnams chos kyi sku mnyam par yang dka par rjes su mthong ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed kyang sems can rnam par dag pas sems can mi dmisas pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin kyang 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i chos yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus yongs su dag pa 'di brgyad de/ brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta sterngo/ brtson 'grus bang gis rnyilus brgyan pa'i lus de gzugs brnyan lta bur rig pas mi dmigs pa dang / brtson 'grus gang sgas tshig mngon par 'du byed pa'i tshig de ya ma brlaratshe1rnam par brtags te mi dmigs pa dang / brtson 'grus gang sgas sems ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas su 'jog pa'i sems de sems kyi chos nyid kyis rnam par brtabs te mi dmisas pa dang / brtson 'grus bang gis da pha rol tu phyin 'i phyogs thams cad —rab tu sdud par byed kyang de gcig nas sacig tu sems zad pa'i chos nyid kyis shin tu brtags te mi dmigs pa dang / brtson 'grus gang gis byang chub kyi phyobs kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrubapa —kyang byang chub de dngos po'i mtshan nyid du — rnam par brtags te yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba dang / brtson 'grus gang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i zhing de yang nam mkha' dang mtshungs pas rnam par brtags te mi dmigs pa dang / brtson 'grus gang gis thos pa thams cad 'dzin par byed pa 57—671

sto tso'u traṃ / k+ta / ཿ nga py-i pe dro ṭ+wāṃ — ༷༷ bye spe ༷ traṃ / je ༷ rna ༷ hūṃ / rde ge wa / //khroskre sdu sda wa / sdu bye ṭ+wāṃ ra snyi/ shāX twe wa da nga da swā sa tha ༷/ ri kwa mu skre nga sku'i ༷tre shā dī nga — ༷/ na 3 pa — sdi bye

skre / /// )dri da/shā ༷ ༷ nga pre / trī //kā dī ༷ / rte ༷༷ ༷ sdu ri sang wa / ngh+ru ༷ hūṃ tā ༷ /rta /gli sdu chi nga — / rna //khri s+t+ra kwa 'du rtsi shā ༷/ — ༷ ṭaṃ ༷ bya / ༷༷ lko / ༷༷ gye / ma / be k+tsi ngas bye

de yang sgra brag ca 1dang mtshungs par yang dag par rjes su remathong ba dang /brtson 'grus gang gis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu spub pa de yang chos kyi dbyengs dbyer med pa'i gumatshan nyid du rnam par brtabs nas mi dmisas pa ste / rigs kyi bu brgyad po zide dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus yongs su dag pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus te/ yonyis gang the na8/ 'di lta ste/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / yongs su chad pa'i brtson 'grus so/ /de la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni lus dang ngag dang sems dang rab tu ldan pa'o/ /yongs su chad pa'i brtson 'grus ni len pa med pa/ 'dor ba med pa gnas med —pa ste/nam byang chub sems dpa' lus dang ngag dang sems sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rtsa ba nas mi gnas par shin tu brtags nas mi dmigs shing yongs su chad pa'i brtson 'grus ni chos kyi dbyings kyi brjes su 'jug pas rjes su 'gro ba ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus nam mala' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /ji ltar 2nam mkha' gzubs med cing sems can thams cad rab tu rgyu ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus de yang chos thams cad la mi banas shing sems can thams cad — yongs su smin par byed do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs thams cad la go skabs 'byed cing bla gab med pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus de yang sems can thams cad la bo skabs 'byed cing lta ba thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /ji lhar nam mkha' las rtswa dang / nabs tshal dang / lo tog skye yang rtsa ba med cing kanas med pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus de yang sangs rgyas kyi 57—672

— — —— ——— —— — chos thams cad skyed 1kyang 'jis tshogs la lta ba'i rtsa ba la gnas pa med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' thams cad du song yang 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid ma yin pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus de yang dge ba'i 1chos thams cad kyi rjes su song yang 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid ma yin no1/ /ji ltar nam chomakha' mtshungs par sbyor zhing gzugs tha dad par ston pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus de yang sems can thams cad la chos thams cad mtshungs par sbyor zhing spyod pa sna tshogs kun du ston to/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' gang kun du sgrub par byed pa 5de mnyam pa nyid pas yang dka par rjes su mi mthong zhing / kang la rtsom pa de yang rnam par brtabs nas mi dmigs te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus namaXmakha' dang mtshungs pa yin no—/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /brtson 'grus dag blu stobs kyis mthu bskyed nas/ /lus dang srog la'ang phangs pa )par mi byed cing / /bdag nyid chen po byang chub spyad pa rto spyod— /sems can phan pa'i don byed phan sems pa/ /sngon gyi srid par 'dus byas ci srid pa1/ /byang chub yon tan phyir ni de srid 'khor/ /de dab skyo bar 'gyur ba'ang yong med de1 / /phyi saphyir brtson 'grus das ni rab tu skyed—/ /sems can bsam mi khyab pa dgrol ba bar brtson/ /sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab pa mchod tshepar brtson/ /zhing rnams bsam gyis stomi khyab blta 'ubar brtson| /bsam gyis mi khyab bdud rnams gdul bar brtson/ /sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab btang che bar brtson/ /tshul khrims bsam gyis mi khyab bsrung 8bar brtson/ /bzod pa bsam gyis mi khyab bsgom par brtson/ /brtson 'grus 57—673

bye je — ma byeḍa nga snye ༷ tsā ji wa ༷ sku/ ci ༷ /sho/ phyi tram̐ ༷ rde / ༷ lnge pya mas/ me ༷ tsā hūṃ / na /nga byu spyo zi tre ma/ rmi pa skre she ri be ( spyo / sde / pyi / ri rdo / ༷ kru ༷༷ byung pya ༷ —

— ——bsam gyis mi khyab dge bar brtson/ /bsam gtan bsam gyis mi khyab sems par brtson/ /shes rab bsam gyis mi khyab bsgomatshopar brtson/ /byams pa bsam gyis mi khyab bsgom (par brtson/ /don dang yon tan sgrub pa rab tu brtson—/ /srog dang lus kyang mi phangs brtson par byed/ /nyon mongs 'thab pa kun las rnam par grol/ /stong pa rnam thar bdag med mngon par brtson/ /bdag la bdag med che ba'i bdag nyid brtson/ /lta las rnam grol byang chub phyir yang brtson/ /sgyu ma smib rgyu'i ngo bo nyid du brtson/ /sems med sems kyang —sems ma yin pa thob/ /g.yo ba med pa'i chos rnams ston par brtson/ /'gro ba kun du spyod cing rnam par grol/ /bshad cing klog pa la ni rtag tu brtson—/ /chos dang chos min gnyis las shin tu 'das/ /sgra dang yi ge'i ngo bo nyid la brtson/ /'gro ba rnams la mdo sde stong rnams smra/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams ni mtha' yang med/ /sems can spyod pa rnams la'ang mtha' med de—/ /mkhas pa de la rtag tu brtson 'grus sbyor/ /sems can spyod mtha' med la rab tu 'jug /chos 'di rnams ni skye med 'asag med de/ /mkhas pa de dag sems kyang mi 3zhum zhing / /phyi phyir brtson 'grus rlabs chen rab bskyed snyede—/ /'di 'dra'i chos la sems can bsgom —du btsudazhe/ /ribs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin zhe na— rikas kyi bu chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste sems nang du yang dka 'jog la nang du sems gnas par yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba dang / sems phyi shārol nas kyang zlog la phyi rol du sems rgyu ba yang mi 57nga 674

nga ——— —dmigs pa dang / bdag gi sems mnyam pa nyid kyis sems can thams cad kyi sems kyang mnyam pa nyid du snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sems mnyam pa nyid de yang sems shā sgyu ma'i chos su mnyam pa nyid du snyoms par 'juka pa ste/risas kyi bu chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin no/ /ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan yongs su dag pa 'di brgyad de / brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste— bsam sa/tan byed kyang phung po la gnas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang /bsam gtan byed kyang khams la sanas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang / bsam gtan byed kyang skye mched la banas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang / bsam katan byed kyang 'jig rten 'di la banas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang /bsam gtan byed 1 kyang 'jis rten pha rol la gnas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang —/ bsam katan byed kyang 'dod pa'i khams la kanas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang / bsam rgatan byed kyang gzurgas kyi bams la gnas te bsam gtan mi byed pa dang / bsam gtan byed kyang gzugs med pa'i khams la kanas te bsam gtan mi byed pa ste/ rikas kyi bu brgyad po de dka ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam gtan yongs su zidag pa'o/ /gzhan yang nges par rtoka pa'i sems ni bsam gtan yongs su dag pa ste/ de la nges par rtorga pa'i sems nyid gang zhe na/ gang chos rnams la mi mtho mi dma' ba/ mi stod ༄mi smod pa/ 'gyur ba med pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ stsogs pa med pa/ 'bri ba med paka/ 'dzin pa med pa/ katong ba med pa/ mun pa med pa/snang ba med pa/ rtog zhe pa med pa/ rnam par rtog pa med pa/ 'du shes med 57nga 676

/ ༷/ bye na sdu 'a / 2 ji da da / nga/ da/ na mi /pa / rngo rdoX nga ci / mi pyi 'a ༷bye nga nga pa dpe ca da nga sdu snye /༷ rna 1 r+ṣa pa rdo ra tre hūṃ / 'a/ twe skre ste/tshe pa rdo tso ṭī ༷ / da/ r+ṣa// tre rda rdo ༷/ sa / rte rto tā she/ ༷swā pa wa ༷ ༷ rngo gang byas stu da cadapa chi rngon spya ma(/ masang

nga pa / yid la byed pa med pa/ gcis pa'ang ma yin/ gnyis pa'ang ma yin/kanyis ma yin pa'ang ma yin pa/ bayo ba med pa/ nga sems med pa/ spros pa med pa/ stsogs4dpa med pa/ bri ba med pa/ sgom pa med pa/ 'jigs pa med pa ste/ gang mtshan ma dang dmikas pa thams cad la mi gnas pa/gang sems mi gnas pa de ni sems nges par rtoka pa'o/ /sems nges par rtog pa ni gzubs rnams la mi rgyug ste/ mig dang gzugs dang rnam 1 par shes pa rig cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dag par bsam satan byed do/ /sems nges par rtob pa ni sgra rnams la mi rgyus ste/ rna ba dang sgra dang rnam par shes pa rig cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dag par bsam gtan byed do/ /sems nges par rtog pa ni dri rnams la mi rgyug ste/ sna dang dri dang rnam par shes pa rig cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dab par bsam gtan byed do/ 1sems nges par rtog pa ni ro rnams la mi rgyug ste/ lce dang ro dang rnam par shes pa rig cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dag par bsam gtan byed do/ /sems nges par rtog pa ni reg 4 pa rnams la mi rgyug ste/ lus dang reb pa dang pa rnam par shes pa rib cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dag par bsam gtan byed do/ /sems nges par rtog pa ni chos rnams la mi rgyug ste/ yid dang chos dang rnam par shes pa rig cing rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dab par bsam btan byed do/ /risas kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ bskal pas sreg pa na ༄ nam mala' mi 'tshika cing / chus 'jig 33pa na nam mkha' gsher bar mi 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yang nyon mongs pa snye thams cad kyis mi 'tshig cing bsam gtan dang / rnam 57—676

— ————— —— — ——— — ——— —nga par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la'ang ma chags lhapa yin no/ /mnyam par bzhag pa yang yin la sems rnam par g.yengs pa'i sems can rnams kyang shin tu 'god do/ /mnyam par bzhag pakyang dga' ba med la langs nas kyang khong khro ba med pa yin no/ /'phags pa'i skye bo rnams la zhi ba nye bar ston kyang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i skye bo rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rab tu 'bar bar yang byed do zhe / /mnyam par bzhag cing mnyam pa yang yin la mi mnyam par spyod pa rnams la tha dad par ston pa yang rab tu ston to/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis mi mnyam pa yang mi mthong lazi/ mi mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid dang 'gal bar yang mi byed do/ /de ni mi 'akal zhing 'gal ba med pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyi ༄bsam gtan pa zhes bya'o/ /shes rab che ba'i bsam gtan pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par shes pa rab tu mi gnas pa'i bsam btan pa zhes bya'o/ /gang gis bsam gtan de ltar mngon par rtokas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de bsam gtan nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa ste/ mi sanas pa'i bsam gtan yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 1— tshibs su bcad pa 'di dag/ gsungs so/ /bsam gtan rnams kyis dbang po yongs su dag /dran pa rtse gcig yid ni mnyam par bzhasasmo /gnas rnams thams cad la yang mi gnas shing / /'gro ba kun la mnyam nyid stoms par bzhag /nang dang phyi rol das na gnas pa yi/ /phung po skye mched lams la mi gnas shing / /nye bar zhi ba dben ——pa spyod yu la te| /mkhas pa de dag rtab tu mnyam par bzhag1 /mnyam pa nyid kyis rtag tu mnyam bzhag rapa/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa'i yid/ /shin 57nga 677

tu dben pa'i sems kyang nyuston byed cing / /mkhas pa bsam gtan kun la'ang mi chags so/ /'gro ba rnams kyang yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /'chi 'pho skye ba 'chi ba nyer ston kyang / /nying nge 'dzin las de dag mi nyams te/ /de ni sems rtogs dbang gis de 'dra'o/ /gzubs med ting nge 'dzin kyang spyod yul la| /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /'dod pa'i khams su'ang rab tu snang byed de/ /de dag bdag dang sems can mi sanas so/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs pa'i spyod yul te/ /sgyu ma dang yang mtshungs shing smig rgyu 'dra—/ /rmi lam chu zla sprin gyi mtshan nyid du/ /chos rnams shes nas rtag tu mnyam par bzhag /'gro ba kud gyi zusems kyi spyod yul du/ /'gro ba rnams la sems dang blo 'jug cing / /sems rgyud la ni sgrib pa med pa ste/ /rang gi sems kyi rgyud kyang rab tu shes/ /bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul mngon shes mkhas pa yis—/ /zhing rnams 1mang po bye bar der 'gro zhing / /mi shes nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa'i — yid/ /rgyal ba bsam mi khyab la mchod par byed/ /dbang po rnams ni dul zhing zhi ba'i yid/ /zhi gnas pha rol phyin cing mi rtog pa—/ /de ni 'gro ba rnams la zhi ba'i yid/ /rtas tu ye shes stobs la mnyam par bzhag /mnyam pa nyid dang mnyam pa'ang yong med la/ /mnyam pa nyid ces bya bar mtshan med de/ /mnyam nyid de la gang dka rab kanas pa/ /de dag rtag tu mnyam ra bzhag 1pa yin/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' 57—678
