pad ma de mthong ba dang dri bsnams 1pas byang chub sems dpa' de dab ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba de bdagapharjegis mthong ste/ 'khor 'dir de 'dra ba'i pad ma'i char phob shig du snyam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' myur bar spobs pas bsams zu ma thag tu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis nam mkha'i —ngos las de 'dra ba'i pad ma'i char mngon par phab ste/ de nas 'khor de dag thams cad pad ma de dag gi dri mthong zhing tshor bas dga' ba'i zas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'khor de thams cad ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' nam maba' mdzod la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /skyes bu dam pa'i byin gyi rlabs —)dang ye shes kyi stobs legs so lebs so/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'di 'dra ba'i byin gyi rlabs ḍathob par gyur cib /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bkod pa zhes bya ba 'dus par gyur te/ 'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so1 /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nam mkha' las gser phye'i char phob shirgakyi /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bkod pas tshibabade skad ces smras ma thag tu/ de'i mod la nam mkha' las saser phye'i char mngon par phab bo/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bkod pas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nam mkha' las rin po che thams cad kyi char phob shig6 /tshis de skad ces zhesmras ma thas tu de'i mod la phyobs bcu nas ri rab kyi tshad tsam gyi rin po che grangs med dpag tu med pa ming tha dad pa kha doka tha dad pa yod ༄ rdopa de dag gi char chen po mngon par phab pa 'di lta ste/57—729

gser dang / dngul dang / shel dang / bai byur+ya 7dang / rdo'i snying po dang /mu tigapapa dmar po dang / spug dang / dpal gyi snying po'i shāze ba can dang /dri medadazi dang / rin chen byi 3ru dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / me shel dang /snang byed dang / 'odam —mchog dang / 'dzam gling 'od dang ༅/ me 'od dang /dung dang / man shel dang / byim5ru dang / an da sgyu rnyil dang / yon tan 'byung gnas dang / rab tu zhi ba'i 'od dang / chu 'od dang / chu mdoka dang —/ chu dang bar byed dang / sa'i 'od dang / mi phyed pa'i gnas dang /mig mi bzod pa dang / brgya byin thogs pa ldadang / rgyal ba dang / cher rgyal ba dang / gzi bajid 'bar ba dang / dpal gyi snying po'iwaṃ rgyal po dang /rdo rje'i ze ba can dang / 'jig rten snang ba dang / skar ma dga' dang /'od 'dzin dang / zla gam dang / 'dzam bu'i tsachu 'od dang / 'dzam bu'i tshogling gi 'od dang / 'od stong ldan dang / skar mda'i sgo dang / me'i 'od dang | rgyal bas brgyan ⑫pa dang / tsha ba zhi byed dang / gdung ba med dang /nad sel dang / mig sbyong dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang —/ yid sbyong dang / yan lag rnam par snang ba dang / rnam par snang ba'i 'od dang / 'od sngon po dang 1 'od ser po dang / dkar po dang /shel gyi kha dog dang / rin po che'i dra ba dang / rin po che thams cad yang dag par bsdus pa dang / ming de lta bu dang / ming de ma yin pa'i rin po che'i char rab tu phab ste/ nor bu rin po che de dag gi ming niwaṃbaskal par yang zad par sla ba ma yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dus kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba des byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod la 'di skad ces spras so/ /57—730
sdo bye skre ༷༷ / gyi ṭā bye gu // ga rdo hūṃ ༷ khro | rde sko — spyo nga ngh+ru 5 traṃ traṃ / pya ༷ ༷༷ skre rdo bye bye / lnge | ༷ ma di rda |༷/ — twe khye wa ༷

rirgas kyi bu mi mjid kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na sems can sdug bsngal zhing dbul ba/ zas dang skom med pa/ kacer bu gos med pa/ gos ral po gyon pa dang / yi dgasam1 rnams bkres shing skom pas yongs su zin pa/ gcer bu rang gi skras yob pa/ mchil ma dang ngar snabs 1dang / khrag dang / rnag za 'dod pa de lta bu'i sems can de dag bskyab 1dpa'i phyir zas dang / skom dang /gos kyi char khyod kyis phob shigazu /de nas de ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' ba mdzod kyi byin gyi rlabs —kyis bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang /myang ba dang / bldag pa sna tshogs kyi char rab tu phab ste/ ro brgya dang ldan pa'i khu ba dang / btung ba thams cad kyi char gyi rgyun shing rta'i srog shing tsam gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /gos kha dog du ma dang / kha dog tha dad pa dang /kha doka brgya stong du ma dang / phra zhing 'jam pa ka tsa lin dishā ka ltar reg na bde ba'i char rab tu phab 3ste/ de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bkren pa dang / dadul po thams cad dang / yi dgas tsa thams cad kun rngotshim par byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' — sman pa'i rgyal po zhesasabya ba des byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ribs kyi bu sems can na ba bayog med pa nad du mas reg pa yod pa de dag gi don du sman chen po'i char gang gis na ba de dag thams cad nad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba phob shigatsha /de nas de ma thag tu bar snang las bdud rtsi'i sman gyi char mngon par rab tu phab ste/ des nad thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ngan song spong zhe zhes bya ba des byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so//57—73

rigs kyi bu khyod kyis0ngan song bsum zhi bar gyis shig /de nas de ma thaka tu bar snang las 'od rab tu btang ste/ sems can dmyal ba pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa dang / rgashin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can rnams 'od des reg pa de dag thams cad bde ba dang rab tu ldan par gyur te/ ngan song gsum po thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur te/ 'di ltar sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba la rab tu sbyor ba'i bar du me tob dang / phreng ba dang / sbos dang / byus pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / bdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan la sogs pa dang / rol mo sna lnga dang ldan pa dang / glu'i dbyangs dang —/ bran pho rjedang / bran mo dang / chung 1 ma dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang —/ slas dang / rta dang / bal zuglang dang / shing rta dang / dpung bu chung dang / bzhonaka1 pa dang / khyim dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yu la 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang —/ skyed mos tshal 3dang / yang tos tsudang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang /khang bzangs 1dang / rta babs dang / skar khung dang / zla ba lam pa ltaXbu dang —/ khri dang / khyobs dang / glang babazhi pa dang / glang — — bcu drug pa nas rta cang shes stong gis drangs pa tsa dang ldan pa'i shing rta'i bar gyi char bar snang las mngon par rab tu bab bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis de lta bur byin gyis brlabs nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshobs mang po la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu das 'di dag long tsal byin cig /yongs su satang babar bgyis dzite/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzosas par gyis shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi rgyan ces bya ba des byang 57—732

chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i char ni phab na/ da —yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i char phob shig — /des tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu phyokas bcu na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams tshul khrims kyi yon tan gyi rgyan gyi bsngags pa ji snyed brjod pa de snyed kyi tshul khrims kyi yon tan bsngags pa'i sgra bar snang las byung ngo / /de bzhin du bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi yon tan gyi sgra yang ci tsam phyogs bcu na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams yi be dang nges pa'i tshig dang brda —das gis chos kyi sgo brgya stong ston pa'i chos kyi sgra de dag thams cad ma chad ma lhag khyad ma zhugs par bar snang las ma lus par yongs sushā rdzobs par byungamapango / /chos kyi sgra des stong gsum kyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad go bar byas so/ /de nas tshad med grangs med pa'i sems can theg pa gsum la yongs su smin par byas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du snang ba zhes bya ba de 'di snyam du sems so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod kyis bkod pa 'jig rten 'di 'ba' zhig ( — na'am—/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan das na'ang yod snyam pa dngapaka/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun du snang ba'i sems kyi kun du rtog pa sems kyis shes so/ /shes nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun du snang ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rikas kyi bu nga shin tu dri ma med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lha'i mig rnyed na/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jika rten gyi khams rnams su ci mthong ltos shirga /de nas 57—733

daX ṭ+wāṃ bye2 traṃ rdo kyi da nga//byeX rte rngo/ wa di/ ༷ hūṃ sa ci sdu | / // ṣ+ṭṛ ru ༷ /༷ / da ༷/ pa 5 tso /tre ༷ ༷ sna spra dpa ṅge ༷ twe dze+e ḍi sna ciX bye diX rdo ༷ / ṭī dro hūṃ shā byer ṭ+wāṃ nga hā/bye da

byang chub sems dpa' kun du snang bas lha'i mig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su bltas na/ des phyokas bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med dpag tu med pa dag na ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir rin po che thams cad kyi char rab tu phab tsa pa dang / chos kyi sgra thams cad grag snyepa dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi 1 zhing de dag na yang ma chad ma lhag khyad ma zhugs par 'di lta bu'i bya ba rnams rab tu 'byung ba mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun du snang ba ngo mtshar du gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi sbon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs grub pa de ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ga lar yang cig —ce car sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skyes bu dam pas 'di 'dra ba'i char mngon par rab tu phab po zhes ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' pemadzod kyi byin gyi rlabs 1kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des bang du rin po che'i char dang / chos kyi char rab tu 'bab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag mthong ngo —/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis rin po che'i char dang /chos kyi char gyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas bgrang 4ba las 'das pa'i sems can rnams byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab nas bud med yugs tshi sa mo lnga brgya byung nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod ba la ba der dong ste lhasas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so—/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa rdzogs par mdzad na bdag cag la'ang khyo nga cig /de nas de ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi byin gyi rlabs ( kyis/ bud med de dab gi sngon gyi khyo'i kha 57—734

dog dang mtshan ma dang dbyibs ci 'dra ba de lta bu'i skyes bu lnga brgya nam mkha' las babs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdun na 'khod do| /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis dud med de dka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sring mo dag 1bdag bdag gi khyo ji lta ba bzhin du khrid cig /de nas bud med de dag gis ji ltaXbur rang rang gi khyo gang yin pa khrid nas dga' mgu rangs shing rab tu dasa' ste yid bde ba skyes nas rang rang gi khyim du dong ngo / /de nas sprul pa'i skyes bu de dab gis zhaka bdun ②du bud med de dag ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzog/sa pa'i byang chubashelas phyir mi ldoka pa de lta de ltar smin par byas so/ /de nas yang bud med lnga brgya po de dka byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi thad du lhabs nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces zismras so/ /chos kyi rang bzhin stong pa sgyu ma 'dra/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid de ni sngon ma 'tshal/ /de phyir khyod kyis sprul pa'i khyo stsal te/ /bdag cag theb pa'i mchog 2la des smin bgyis/ /chos 'di thams cad yang dag sprul pa ste/ /kayo ba med cing byed med snga nas stong / /zag med ye shes bdag gis༄gerab rtogs te/ /slan chad nyon mongs dbang mi mchi'o ku /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad mgron sgyu du rganyer bar bgyi/ /sems can rgya chen khyod kyis phab pa bzhin/ /bdag cag gis kyang chos mchog char pa dbab/ /'dren mchog thub pas de dag lung bstan pa/ /khyed cag ma 'ongs dus na 'gyur ba ni/ /spyad pa spyadasgyukanas rgyal ba'i dbang po dag /shin tu dul zhes bya ba'i bde gshekas 'gyur/ /yang de'i tshe na mi lnga brgya gsad tshopar chad de gsad kudu khrid pa las de dag gis bar snang 57—735
bye/ | sdu nga mu dz+wa ༷ sdu lnge spe je da / ji ༷ gi 2 ni sdu / tsher+shaswāX nga sdu shes / khye ༷༷ twe / 'a cha ga wa mo rta naX 2 sdu ༷ dz+wa ༷ /༷ skre 3 3 / dro

las sems can rnams byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod ces bya ba gang 'jisas pa'i sems can rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhig yod kyis (de la khyed micaka phyag 'tshol snye cib dang gsad pa 'di las thar bar 'gyur ro zhes sgra ༷zhig thos so/ /de nas de dag thams cad shi bas 'jigs skrag pas sgra skad bcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes tshig de skad ces smras so/ /tshig de skad ces smras ma thag tu skad cig de nyid la bar snang las mi lnga brgya babs te/ der lhags nas gshed ma'i mi de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed cag gis mi dbul po 'di dag gsad jide ci rung / nged dzicag gi gos dang rgyan rnams khyer la nged cag gi srog chod —zlade mi 'di dag khye shig —re /de dab chags pas non pa'i phyir gsad par chad pa'i mi — lnga brgya po de das btang loste/ sprul pa'i skyes bu de dag bsad do/ /de nas mi bsad — pa las btang ba de dag gsod pas 'jisas shing skrag pa las dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la yang mako bos phyag 'tshalar/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la yang ⑫thal mo sbyar te phyab 'tshal banas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis bdag cag sga srog dang dbugs 'byin pa rnyed par bgyis na/ bdag cag chos gang la nan tan du bgyis pas bdag la sman pa dang / gzhan la sman pa la zhugs par 'gyur ba'i chos bstan pa bdag cab la sprul du gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis smras pa/ ribs kyi bu khyed cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzosas pa'i byang chub tu sems skyed dz+wacig dang / 'di lhar 57—736

/ ༷/ bhā su / / / snge /smi sa /tre bye // shā da da da/ trī nga rto rnga ༷ rdichung / ḍa /rngo/ dang ༷ sdi shā /rdo (/ 'a sdu / sdu bye ༷ lo rdzi ṭī 7 rnge rna pe maX/ dab rna da kyi / sdidī ༷ byu tso dzo 5 — mi de — ste rnarna tre rde bye ༷ ra ji su/ kyi rten/ rdo ༷ wa

khyed rnams bdas la phan pa dang / gzhan la phan par zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la de skad ces mismras pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de dag la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis brgya stong ri ba'i ras bcos bu zung cig byin te/ grogs po dag ras bcos bu zung 'di de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol cig /de dag thams cad kyis ras bcos bu zung de de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la mngon par sasol te/de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis bskal pa bgrang ba las 'das pa na/byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos tshul yang dag par bsgrubs nas mi 'jibs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig brten du 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ribs kyi bu khrod kyis kang mi skam mi zad mi dengs pa'i nam pemakha' la snyemadzod bzhag —nas ji srid lon/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis smras pa1 btsun 3)pa shā ri'i bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ ji nam mkha' skam pa'am zad pa yod dam dengs — —par 'gyur ram/ smras pa ribs kyi bu de lta ma yin no//smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du byang chub de ni nam mala'i (ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid de la bdag gi dbe ba'i rtsa ba rnams der bsngos pas de bas na nam mkha' la mdzod mi skam mi zad mi dengs so/ /yang khyod kyis nam mkha' la mdzod bzhas nas ji srid lon zhes zer ba ni kho bos byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ji srid lon pa de srid do/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu khyod kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ji srid lon/ smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi kyimakhyen pas mkhyen to/ /de nas kanas brtan shā ri'i bus1 bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad 57—737

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ji srid lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ shā ri'i du 3gal te de bzhin gshegs pas gnas 'di bstan na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams myos par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di na dzusems can gang rnams rtog pa mang zhing dad par 'gyur ba dag mchis kyis zabashad du rgasol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste dper na gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na gang gā'i klung gi bye ma ji snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyis yongs su gang bar51)gyur te/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul de dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi bskal pa brgya stong zhing rdul phra mo cig —bzhag la de lta bur bgrang ba dang mtshan ma bzhab pa de snyed kyi rdul phra mo thams cad ni zad par 'gyur gyi ji srid nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzobs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyedatsho3pa'i bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong de dag la zad pa gang yang med do/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang gi ba thad nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis dang po byang chub tu sems bskyedayopa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan ci zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ yang shā ri'i bu de'ibatshe de'i dus na rin po che bkod pa zhes bya ba'i bskal pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dab par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshekas pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba 57—738

bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sbon lam thams cad las shin tu byung ba rin po che'i gzi bajid 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ yang shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa de dag ni sgyu che'i tshad bskal par gnas kyang bshad par sla ba ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 'khor gye dkyil 'khor ni 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi tshad du gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ni bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig byung ngo / /shā ri'i bu de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams de na stong gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ rin po che'i mdzod bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de'i bu rdzus te skyes pa rang gi —gzi bajid kyis mngon par grub pa dgu khri drus stong yod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na bud med kyi ming yang med do/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa de'i che'i tshad kyang 4 bskal pa stong phrag brgya thub bo/ /de nas rgyal po lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur bas bar gyi bskal pa bzhi bcur/ bcom ldan 'das de la bsnyen bkur dang rim gror byas te nyin bcig la 'god pa yang ri rab bye ba stong snyed kyi rin po che'i 1phung po zad par 'gyur ba de lta bus bsnyen bkur dang rim gro byas so/ /de nas rgyal po de bsod nams kyis brtan pas bu'i tshobs dang /grong gi mi rnams dang / 'khor rnams dang bcas te bla na med pa yang dab par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /shā ri'i bu de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur nyaba'i rgyal po lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod sems na de de ltar mi balha'o3/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/57—739

sto/ ske khye t+ta /༷ miX sa na/ sde klo / spya tho di/ dīX ༷ snyi shes 2 ngang ༷ ༷ sdu ༷/ giX /tre dī nga / 2 ཿ / 2 / da ṭā khri nga bye ༷ r+sha /khyi / / nga/ dī nga bye pyo k+tsi ༷༷ /sto bye dā trī // /kau / nga/ (5 snyo mi ༷ ༷phyi sa rdo rngo ya ༷ sa tre

——byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod de'i tshe de'i dus 3na stong —snye gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur (( ba'i rgyal po lha thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod 'dis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go cha bgos te/ bcom ldan 'das de srid nas theg pa la rab tu zhugs pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das de 'dra ba'i spyod pas 'di 'dra ba'i chos kyi mthu chen po rnyedaXpar nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod 'dis gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gro dang bste (snyestang byas te byang chub kyi sems yongs su sbyangs so/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi byang chub kyi sems yongs su dag pas bsam pa yongs su sbyangs te —/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsam pa yongs su dag pas sbyor ba yongs su sbyangasaka/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sbyor ba yongs su dag pas lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su sbyangs / gang gā'i klung bi bye ma snyed kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs sususbyangs/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su das pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs/ gang gā'i klung 'i bye ma snyed kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas 4bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs/ bang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dab pas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs/ bang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 57nga 710

sbyangs| gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs/ gang gā'i klung blu bye ma snyed kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pas sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'i sems dang /thosas pa med pa'i 'od zer yongs su sbyangs/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'i sems dang / thogs pa med pa'i 'od zer yongs su dag pas byams pa chen po yongs su sbyangs pa nas/ snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen ngo dang / btang 33snyoms chen po dang / mngon par shes pa chen po'i ye shes kyi bar du yongs su sbyangs so/ /de bzhin du lus yongs su dag pa dang / ngag yongs su dag pa dang / sems yongs su dag pa ste—/ gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems yongs su dag pas skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rga/cis yongs su sbyangs so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu dz+wartsa banyis thams cad nas/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan thams cad yongs su dag pas dbe ba'i rtsa ba'i bar du des/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su dag pas nam mkha'i mdzod 'di yongs su dag par byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod 'dis yongs su sbyangs so/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod 'dis nam maba' las byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad ston te/ shā ri'i bu ji ltar nam mkha' la zad pa med pa de bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad yongs su dab pas gang la yang zad pa med do/ /des nabami 57—741

'di nam mkha' mdzod ces bya'o/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa da byang chub sems dpa' khri longs spyod mi zad pa dang / lag na rin po che dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi smon lam yongs su bskang ba'i bzod pa skyes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba des byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu bdag cag gis nam mkha' las chos bsgrags pa'i mdzod mnyan to1 /nam mkha' mdzod kyis smras pa/ de'i phyir rikas kyi bu gus pa dang bcas shing zhe sa dang bcas par 'dug la/ nam mkha' 'di la ston par 'du shes skyed4cig dang / chos mnyan pa'i mdzod thos so—/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal po dang 'khor de dag thams cad thal mo sbyar nas nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal — te 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod kyi byin gyi rlabasapasgyukyis bar snang las tshirgas su bcad pa 'di dka byung ngo / /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i yid rnams kyi/ /thams cad chos kyi tshul gang yin/ /de la 'jug pa'i b.rab bstan gyis(1/ /khyed cag mthar gyis mnyan par gyis/ /nam mkha' la ni mtho ba med/ /dma' ba'ang yod pa ma yin te/ /gang gi chos nyid mtho dma'amadzi med/ /de la 'dud pa ga la yod/ /nam mkha' la ni skye ba med/ /'gog pa dab kyang mi dmigs so/ /ma skyes pa yimazhechos rnams la/ /de la rnam par rtog pa med/ /nam mkha' la ni bri ba med/ /gang ba dag kyang mi dmigs so/ /chos rnams gang med bri med de—/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs mnyam mo/ /nam mal/ 'a la ni nun pa med/ /de ni de yis snyon mi smongs —/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /de bas nams kyang snyon smongasayomed/ /nyi zla yi ni 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha' 57nga 742

nam mkhar sgyu'agro mod kyi/ /de la 'gro ba'i rjes —rjekyang med/ /sems can byang chub phyir spyod kyang / /de ni spyod pa'i mtshan ma min/ /ji ltar sngon rmi mtha' yi lus/ /nam mkha' dang no mtshungs 'dra ba/ /de bzhin phung po'i ngo bo nyid//nam mkha' dang ni mnyam zhing mtshungs/ /khams bzhi dag kyang nam mkha' dang —/ /mtshungs shing45 'dra bar rab tu gsungs 4/ /'di ltar sreg pa'i bskal pa la'ang / /nam mkha' dang ni khrams 'di mtshungs/ /ji ltar sems can thams cad kyis/ / nams kyangatsheye yongs su gang mi nus/ /de bzhin yul rnams kun gyis kyang / /sems kyi rgyud ni mi gang ngo / /tshig chen seng ge'i sgra dag gis/ /'jig rten mabon gyis —gsungs pa ni/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i shes rab gang / /de dag bstan pa 'di la ngoms/ /ji lhar nam mkha' rgya che bas—/ /tha ma dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos rnams kyang —/ /mtha' ma dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /chos rnams thams cad sangs rgyas so/ /gang gis yang dag nyid shes na/ /de dag dngos po mi 'jig cing / /dngos po dag la'ang mi rganas so/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam shes shing / /yang dag mtha' la gang ga/nas pa/ /dngos po dang ni dngos med pa/ /lha ba mkhas pas mi 'dzin to/ /stong pa nyid ni sgra yis bsgrags/ /sgra la stongaXpa nyid med de/ /de ni sgra med brjod pa med/ /de phyir stong pa nyid ces bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad kyang ni/ /stong pa nyid ni brjod du med/ /gang de stong zhes pebya ba yang / /de yi don ni brjod du med/ /sgyu ma khrig (dargyu rmi lam dang / /mig yor dang ni brag ca dzirnams/ /de la sogs pa bshad pa yis/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos ston to/ /sems can rnams ni drang ba'i phyir/ /dpe rnams 57—744

nga —shin tu kun bstan te/ /rab tu zhi ba'i chos rnams la/ /gnyen po rnams ni mi dmikas so/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kun kyang / /mtshan nyid du ni rab tu bstan—/ /mtshan gzhi mtshan gzhi med pa dag /chos kyi dbyings la mi dmigs so| /mtshan gzhi 1nam maba'i — mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha'angar1mtshan nyid med pa yin/ /gang gis tshul 'di rab rtosas pa/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /chags pa med cing bcings pa med/ /shin tu cung zad med pa ste / /spros med spros dang bral ba de/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /sems can las ni ma grol ba/ 1sems can la yang mi gnas shing / /sems can rang bzhin ye shes kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes de bya/ /sems can rab tu mya ngan 'das/ /thos nas dngang bar zumi byed de/ /gang de byang chub rab zhugs pa/ /dpa' bo dag gi go cha 'di/ /sgyu ma byed pa'i sems can dag /mang du sprul nas der bsad kyang / /de la bsad pa kang yang med/ /sems can mtshan nyid de bzhin no/ /sgyu ma dang ni sems can dang / /zu ngan 'das dang sangs rgyas kun/ /rnam pa kun du rang bzhin bcig /rang bzhin rang bzhin med par rtogs/ /nam mkha' las ni nam mkha'i pa mdzod/ /mi zad pa yi mdzod grub ste/ /sems can thams cad mgu —byed cing / /mdzod de zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshad med bsod nams chu bos 4ni/ /mdzod 'di rnam par sbyangs pa ste/ /chos rnams la yang 'pho med par/ /chos rnams chos nyid balha bar bya/ /rgyu la rten 4te 'byung ba yi/ /chos rnams thams cad rab shes na/ /de yi mdzod ni mi zad de/ /chos kyi mdzod ni bsam mi khyab/ /chos bzhi 'di dag mi zad par/ /'jib rten mgon pos rab mgasungs te/ / 57—745

nga nga —nga sems can nam mkha' byang chub sems/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos rnams so/ /de ste de dag rdzas tsa yin na 6/ /de dag yongs su zad 'gyur gyi/ /de dag med pas mi zad ces/ /de bas de ni mi zad gsungs/ /chos ni rab tu skad cig pa1 /zad pa chos ni mi zad de/ /mi zad de la zad pa med/ /de phyir mi zad pa zhes bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gis/ /chos bstan 'di ni rab shes na/ /des ni byang chub rnyed mi dka'/ /byang chub phyir la yang dag zhubs//tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa 'di byung ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /lha'i bu nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa khri nyis stong ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed 1 do—/ /de nas 'khor de nyid du byang chub sems dpa' ltad mo can zhes bya ba 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to—/ /bcom ldan 'das sgra 'di ga las byung snyam du bdag ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la dris shig dang / 'disarabakhyod la lan ldon no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ltad mo can gyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu sgra 'di ga las byung snyam du bdag ltad mor 'dzin par gyur to/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ brag ca'i 1sgra ga las byung / smras pa/ rigs kyi bu pha rol gyi sgra'i rnam par rig byed las brag ca'i — da sgra 'byung ngo / /smras pa/ rigs kyikyi bu brag ca 5 la lus sam/ sems sam/ gzugs sam/ kha dog gam/dbyibs gang yang yod dam/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de ni med do/ /smras pa/57nga 746

sdu ra / /shā nga ṭ+wāṃ ( 7 / rngo kā ༷ ༷ kā ༷ waXr shā pe / / mi ba sa na /da di nā /rdzu ṭā me | shā traṃ pa'i rdo rdo sdu 2 / rdo bye | dze+e je ༷༷ sna stoX rno khye ༷ rdo — tre — traṃ ci bye traṃ / nga ci sa/ be su ji rnaX /

rigs kyi du de de bzhin no/ /ji ltar brag ca 3 yongs su ma grub kyang sgra skad go bar byed pa de bzhin du/ nam mkha' yongs su ma grub ste/ sgra skad go bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ rigs kyi bu sgra 'di go bar byed pa su/ gang nas dbyangs 'di 'byung / smras pa/ rikas kyi bu ye shes kyi so sor rnam par rig pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ kho bos yid kyi sems pas bang bsamasam1pa de bar snang 'di las 'byung yang sems 1der 'gro ba yang med/ de 'dir 'ong ba yang med mod kyi/ sgra'i sgra brnyan kyang 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ji tsam du zab pa la ltos/ /kang rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung yang rgyu — 'bras bu 'grub par mi 'pho la / /rgyu med pa las kyang 'bras bu 'byung ba ma yin no/ /'di lta ste ༄ / /rgyu dang rkyen las 'bras bu mngon par grub pa'i chos 'di gnyi ga la yang bayo ba med cing byed pa med do/ /gang de lta bu'i 'du shes pa dekudag ni bral ba ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gang kun nas nyon mongs pa/ shes pa de nyid de'i rnam par byang ba zhes gsungs so/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa bsal bas rnam 1 par byang ba ma yin te/ /gang kun nas nyon mongs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid de ni rnam par byang ba'o/ /'di lta ste / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba zhes bya ba 'di gnyi ba 8yang brda'i tshig go/ /don dam pa'i mtha' la kun nas nyon mongs pa tshidang rnam par byang ba yang dmigs su med do/ /don dam pa'i mtha' ni mtha' ma tshi yin te/ gang 'di mtha' ma yin pa de ni yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya'o/ /gang yang dka pa'i mtha' de stong pa nyid kyi mtha'o/ /gang stong pa nyid kyi mtha' de bdag gi mtha'o/ /gang bdag gi mtha' de ni chos 57—747

khro tre /rdomi ༷ ༷/ 5 sgo ༷ / rte di wa ༷su /na ༷ / sdi ṭī ༷ // rā rngo be/ /tre lnge she / da / 4 / / di dī gi pas s+t+ri traṃ sgo sto she / skre ste ni/ /wa rngordo dī / /nga ne+e da rtsi /de/ /༷ rde

— thams cad kyi mtha'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /chos thams cad ni de'i mtha'/stong pa nyid kyi mtha'/ nye bar zhi ba'i mtha' ste/ gang mtha' de gsum gyi sgo la mi chags pa de ni chos thams cad la mi chags pa'i ye shes rnyed do/ /de nas gnas brtan shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' ltad mo can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ltad mo can zhes ming sus btagasahu/ smras pa/btsun pa shā ri'i bu khyod gang dang pong du chos la 'dun pa dang brtson pa de dang der ltad mor mi 'gyur ram/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /smras pa / btsun pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du kho bo chos thams cad la 'dun cing brtson pa de dang der kho bos nam 1sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur snyam du ltad mo dang ldan te/ de'i phyir kho bo ltad mo can zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la kho bo ltad mor gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa la 'jug pa shes pa la kho bo ltad mor gyur te| de'i phyir kho bo ltad mo can zhes bya'o/ /kang la kho bo 4ltad mor mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes de gang yang med/ 'jug pa de gang yang med pas de'i phyir kho bo ltad mo can zhes bya'o/ /gang du kho bo ltad mor gyur pa der nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bdud kyi lasapabathams cad kyi skabs med de de'i phyir na kho bo ltad mo ku can zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la banas brtan shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'i ming 'di nyid las sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su brjod de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ston kyang gang la 'ang mi chags te3/ /chags༄— pa ma mchis par sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang ston pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /de nas 'khor de nyid du byang 57—748

chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal zhes bya ba 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'aXmadzod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu nga kyis ting nge 'dzin rab tu bstan pa las brtsams (te/ gang ci 'dra bar ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyang ba — bya ba la sbobs par gyis shig /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mala' mdzod kyis byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi snying por thogs pa med par 'gro ba bsam pa dag pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /ribs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'i 'od zer ces bya ba yod de/ de bdab dang gzhan bsrung ba'i phyir bzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /dri ma med ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems yongs su dab par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni dge ba'i chos thams cad rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dbe ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rnyog pa med par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni spyi gtsug bltar 1༄mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par sel ba 'es bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni nyon mongs pa thams cad 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /'khyil pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni bayas phyogs kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zlos pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgyu dang lta ba las rnam par zlog par 'grur ro/ /dga' byed ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos kyi kun dga' la darga' zhing mos par 'gyur ro/ /skar ma'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sbyin gnas yongs su dag 57—749

———par 'gyur ro/ /mthu drag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems mi 'jum nyu par 'gyur ro/ /mtshungs par mnyam pa nyid la 'jub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad la sems mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /byed pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni las rnam par smin pa la 'jug par 'gyur rorje /seng ge'i tob pa(ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'jigs pa dang spu zing zhes byed pa med par 'grur ro/ /sems dpa'ab1 zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni nyon mongs pa'i bdud thams cad skrag par 'gyur ro/ /pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi gos par 'gyur ro/ /pad 4 ma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems kyi rgyan du 'grur ro/ /'od bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bya ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba spong bar 'grur ro/ /rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la snang bar 'gyur ro/ /skar mda' ldan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni bag chags thams cad 'jomasar3par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mun pa mun nag med par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma 'khyil pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad kyi sems la rnam par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /yon tan gyi 'byung gnas — zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni yon tan gyi chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur ro—/ /sred med kyi bu lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni pha rol rgol ba thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /snying po'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rdo rje'i lus mi byed par 'gyur ro/ /snying po dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i 57—760

hūṃ snye / rto rte ཿru du/ sdu/ pyes nga rdo rtsa / nga/do dzi na sna zhi ca/ swā| kwa / trī 2bya / mi/ nga — khro nga da traṃ ji ci tre da/ /nga ༷ rji zlo sto — / tredage wa ji raX ༷ rna / ngaX khrod /da di / dzi na sa rdo t+ta ṭ+wāṃ rte nga skre ’ / /// / ༷

ting nge 'dzin ni dam bcas pa 3thams cad nyams 'og tu chud par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mngon par shes pa las mi nyams par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos thams cad rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa la 'jub pa'i ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /sa 'dzin ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chabs pa dang zhe sdang med par 'gyur ro/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms — pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni bdud bzhi las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /lus rnam par 'jig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni gzugs thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /mi 'dzums zu pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems rtse gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo dri ma ༄med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /glog 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems kyi skad cig 'jig pa la rnam par lta bar 'gyur ro/ /legs par byas pas rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs spu rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par sbyong ba — zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spong bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ngas gi rgyan 57—761

ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni tshangs pa'i sgra skad bsgrags pas sems can thams cad kyi sems mgu bar 'grur ro/ /sems kyi rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin las mi nyams par 'gyur ro/ /brtan 1pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /mtshungs par gtong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can tha dad pa med par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims bsags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//bzod pa'i bo babos pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni lus dang srog la mi lta bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mngon par shes pa myur bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad med pa'i rnam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni tshangs pa la dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /ci yang med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni gzusas med pa'i khams yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /lhun ngo 'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /lhun po'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni phyosas bcur rnam par lha bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi skar mda' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sgrib pa dang / chod pa dang / kunananas ldang ba thams cad rnam par sel bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya mapa'i phyab rgya 'es bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni las dang bya ba sna tshogs la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' yas 'khyil pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni lta ba thams cad yongs su gcod par 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni dmigs pa dang lta ba thams cad spong bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rtob pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa thams cad sgong bar 'gyur ro/ /smon pa med pa zhes 57—762

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni g.yo ba dang sems pa thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /sgra dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni spobs pa thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /kun 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni thos gepa thams cad 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i nying nge 'dzin ni tshad med pa'i snod kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshol — bar 'grur ro/ /mi zad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad mgu bar 'gyur ro/ /rin chen bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni lag na rin po che rab tu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rjes su 'gro ba 'es bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems can thams cad kyi sems shes par 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'gro ba thams cad rtobs par 'gyur ro/ /blo gros la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems dang yid rnam par dab par 'gyur ro—/ /sprin dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi char rab tu 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 4zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni bdud rtsi'i chos rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /chos rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'dod chasas dang bral ba'i chos mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbe 'dun rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /gtong ba rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i nying nge 'dzin ni phung po thams cad rab tu 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi rtsa ba la rab tu 'god par 'gyur ro/ /lha rjes su dran pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 57—753

sna wa snye rna / miX ji / ༷ ngh+ru ༷ /rte sdu/ wa 'i khro/ sna tre /bye // ṭ+wāṃ nga ༷ 〉 waste / da ༷ 2 ༷ // sa rtsa bye tre mi rte nga ji 3 dro ji dzig rna /ni// / na wa zhir rgya mi shā ka/khro mi tre ཿ / sde skre sa sa ṭā traṃ / ca gi /༷/༷ ༷ / ne+e zhi|
/ nga khro ༷ da/ /ko ༷ / / 2 khyerto ༷ bye rwa ji/rte / ༷// sa// / ༷ | // lnge sdo / khye wa rde ༷ khro / khro bye / /sde twe lnge sde/ sdo rnaX hūṃ / ༷ di / ༷/ snye dhe /nga /rde nga

nga — — —'dzin ni rnam par dag pa'i chos la kha na ma tho ba med par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi dbyings she la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /nam mala'i ngo bo nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni chos thams cad la chags pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud chags pa dang rgyud ma yin pa'i rjes su rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni yi ge thams cad dang tshika rab tu dbye ba shes pa mil mkhas pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu sbyangs pa dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni ting ngeX'adzin gang dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de sems che skad cig gcib dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de dka ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgyad cu ziste/ ting nge 'dzin de re re la yang 'khor ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo lnga brgya lnga brgya yod do/ /de dag thams cad bsdoms na ting nge 'dzin bzhi khrir 'gyur te/ de dag nishā kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bas ting nge 'dzin brgyad khrir 'gyur ro/ /de dag sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang sgyu da ltar byung ba mi zad pa'i ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin ji snyed pa chos kyi sgo mo yang de snyed/ chos kyi phung po yang de snyed de/ de'i phyir sems can gyi spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong de bzhin gshekas pas bshad ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang spyod pa la 'jug pa sems can rnams shes par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi mdo'o/ /gang sangs pā7—764

rgyas kyi ye shes mtha' dag dang / sems can gyi spyod pa mtha' dag la 'jug pa de ni tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bskal pa brgyad stong gi mthar 'dug kyang bshad par sla ba ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'di yongs su bstan cing ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'di dag bshad pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' khri drug stong ni ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes kyis mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to4/ /lha'i bu brgyad khri bzhi stong ni bla na med pa yang dab par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la legs so zhes bya ba byin te—/ skyes bu dam pa nga kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'di bstan pa ni legs par smras te/ lus mngon sum pa sa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa'i chos rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes yongs su brjod pa 'di shin tu yongs su bstan pa ni legs so lesas so // //'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ bam po lnga pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi thad du byang chub sems dpa' namamakha' mdzod kyis thog mar nam mala' 'di las rin po che thams cad kyi char rab tu phab/ de skad ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /ribs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bgrang ba las 'das pa'i pha rol gyi yang ches 1 pha rol tu gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang darga par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su 57—755

nga — —— —— —ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba 3ska rags zhes 1bya ba'i 'jig rten kyi khams su yon tan gyi 'od ces bya ba'i bskal pa la 'jig rten du byung ste/ yang rigs kyi bu ska rags zhes bya ba'i 'jis rten gyi lams de yang 'byor pa/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ rgyas pa/ skye bo mang po dang mis gang ba/ rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan pa/ 'jam zhing mnyen pa/so/sa ka tsa lin di ka ltar reg na bde ba/ 'dzam bu ༄ chu bo'i —gser gyi pad ma bkram pa/ rin po che gsal ba sna tshogs kyis rnam par spras pa/ mig mangs 4ris su bres pa/ lag mthil ltar mnyam ste/ 'jis rten gyi khams de 'di lta ste dper na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi longs spyod dang /kun spyod pa — ltar 'dug go/ /mi de dag thams cad kyang gzhal med khang dang /khang pa brtsegs pa na kanas — par gyur 6cing bsam pas zas dang skom rab tu 'byor to/ /de yang rigs kyi bu de bzhin bshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal ngo 'i byang chub sems dpa' khras khrig phrag drug cu'i shā byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen ngo byung ngo / /yang rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur nyaba'i rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ yang rigs kyi bu rgyal po bsod nams kyis pa— brgyan pa de'i khang pa 'dzam bu'i bagling gi dbus su brtsibs par gyur temi/shar phyogs spu yang dpab tshad bzhi/ nub phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang /byang phyogs su yang dpag tshad bzhi bzhi pa tshobakra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ rin po 57—756

da sa/ ༷ trī byu ji ji — ji di ga / ste/ sheX ske / rngo da rte ) ri rda sna — ༷ / na — sde sde/ je rna nga ngaX shā ༷ // / da/ ( ba kāngasdu / ḍiX ༷ tre ri bye /pa/ ༷bye shā ca dh+ra je pa khro sa dro ga/ —'ad da ni zhi sbya da jirte
༷ ༷ dz+wa shā skre byu rte rngo bye bye sdo ṭ+wāṃ ༷ / 'a rde bye pye ༷ /khro ༷ / /sdu sde ༷ nyid traṃ ji wa ༷ 4 sdu ngh+ru sdu sa traṃ ༷ dhe mi ༷sa | sdo /was

— —che sna bdun las byas pa/ skyed mos tshal lnga brgyas rab tu brgyan pa'o/ /yang rigs kyi bu rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa'i btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yod de ༅/ thams cad kyang yul gyi bzang mo sha stab go/ /khye'u brgyad khri bzhi stong yod de/ thams cad kyang tshan shāpo che chen po'i stobs dang drag shul 'chang 1 ba sha stag go/ /yang rigs kyi bu rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa la btsun mo rin po che gnyis yod de/ gcib gi ming ni dpal kyi gzi brjid/ gcig gi ming ni dpal byi 'od do/ /rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa de/ dga' ba bkod pa zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal du zhugs te/ btsun mo'i nang na 'dug pa'i tshe lha mo de gnyis kyi pang 3 pa nas khye'u gnyis byung ste/ brdzus te skyes pa0 sngon gyi sbyor ba phun sum tshobs pa/ smon lam rdzogs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par zhugs pa ste/ gcika gi ming ni seng ge zhes bya/ gcig gi ming ni seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba zhes bya ste/ /de gnyis byung ma thag tu sgra skad dang dbyangs gcig tu pha bsod nams kyis —brgyan pa la tshibs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sngon byas dge dang mi dge chud mi za—/ /de bzhin gshebs la mchod byas chud mi za/ /bsam pa byang chub sems kyang chud mi za/ /baspub — pa gtsor (byed thos pa chud mi za/ /sbyin dang dul dang sdom pa chud mi za/ /bzod dang des pa rnams kyang chud mi za/ /byas pa bzo zhing dge ba'i las byas phyir/ /brtson rtse'agrus brtsams pa de yang —zhechud mi za | /rtse sacig bsam gtan dang ni rnam thar sems/ /nges par rtogasaḥdang shes rab sems mi nyams/ /ye shes las byas rtag tu mi 'khrugs te/ /mi 'khrugs chos las byang chub rnyed mi dka'/ /de ni nyon mongs pa yis mi gos te//57nga 757

de ni slar yang mngal du mi gnas shing / /de ni pad ma'i snying por brdzus te skye//mi gos pa ni pad ma chu las ltar/ /shar phyogs loyos kyi rgyal ba sman pa'i rgyal/ /dus sasum mi chags ye shes dam pa yi/ /bde gshegs dri med 'od kyi gan 3 nas su/ /chos 'dod phyir ni de nas bdag cag 'ongs/ /u dum bā rtara'i me tog ji lta bar/ /de bzhin bshegs pa 1 'byung ba rnyed par dkasami/ /de la bsnyen bkur bgyi dang blta slad du/ /bde gshegasamasnyethad du yab kyang bzhud par bgyi/ /rgyal pos rjes su bstan pa 'di thos nas/ /bu dang btsun mo 'khor dang lhan cig tu/ /srog chags bye ba stong gis yongs bskor te/ /rgyal ba de yi gan du nye bar dong / /me tog dri zhim byug par bcas pa yis de la tshul dang 'dra ba'i mchod byas nas/ /zhabs la phyab 'tshalaka4rab tu bskor byas te/ /thal mo sbyar ba btud nas spyan sngar 'dug /seng ge dang ni seng ge'i rtsal 'gro yang / /de bzhin gshekas pa'i zhabs la bzung nas su/ /gtugs nas chos dang don ldanam shemakhas pa yi/ /'phags pa des ni tshigs bcad 'di dag smras/ /khyod ni skyabs dang mgon sgyu dang dpung gnyen te/ /'jig rten long ba rnams kyi sgron mar gyur/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam spyod gyur la mkhas/ /ji ltar mos pa de bzhin gnas par mdzadartse/ /rgyal po 'di ni phyug cing skyid pas mos/ /gzukas dang sgra dang dri dang bcas pas bcings/ /nam yang ston pa la ni mchod phyir yang / /nye bar mi mchi chos lta ga la nyan/ /mgon po thugs rje rab tu skyed tshemadzod la/ /ji ltar de kun lhan cig thos nas su—/ /theg pa mchog las ldog par mi 'gyur ba/ /byang chub lam mchob de ni legs par ston/ /bcom ldan mgon po ta la brgyad cu shārtasrid/ /nam mkhar ge 57—758

/rna ngaX wa la —/rngochi rto / twe ༷nga shāX rna rngo su rje hūṃ rdo /'a ༷ ༷ ༷ rdo da ga rdo ༷ gas/ ne /bye/ dhe da/ ༷༷ 2 rngo raṃ tre wa ༷ wa mi kru nga rde stu ma 'u da snye sde twe — ཿji da traṃ ra nga/ sdo — ༷rjo

'phags bzhugs mi dbang de la gsungs/ /nga yi chos mchoka rgyal po khyod nyon la1 /thos nas de la tshul bzhin nan tan gyis/ /'dod pa mi rtag de bzhin rgyal srid srog /srog ni rtswa yi zil ba'i thibs pa 'dra/ /brtsetshob de bzhin 'dod bde rmi lam 'dra/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'di la dga' ba skyed/ /sems can gang yang 'dod pas ngoms med de/ /phyir yang de bzhin 'dod pa kaskom zhing rgyu/ /byis pa ngoms mi shes shing yul la gnas/ /shes rab gang ngoms de dag shin tu ngoms/ /sgyu ma slu zhing snying po med pa ltar/ /de bzhin phung po lnga yang sgyu ma 'dra/ /khams rnams 'di dag sbrul kadus bzhin du bstan/ /dbang po drug ni stong pa'i grong dang 'dra/ /bu dang chung ma rgyal srid yul 'khor yang | /'chi bar gnas pa'i grokas su gyur pa med/ /sbyin dul kun sdom tshul khrims phung po ni/ /de dka pha rol 'gro ba'i grogs yin no/ /nga yi sazugs dang yon tan sbobs pa rdzokas/ /rdzu 'phrul dag kyang ji 'dra rab ltos la/ /gal te 'di 'dra bar yang 'gyur 'dod na/ /byang chub dam pa 'di phyir sems skyed cig /rgyal po glang po des ni chos thos nas/ /srog chags bye ba stong phrag bdun cu pedang / /sras dang btsun —zhemo stobs bcas grong mi rnams/ /byang chub dam pa 'di phyir sems bskyed — de/ /bdab cag mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer bar bgyi/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyod re par bgyi/ /'gro ba bla med sangs rgyas 'gyur bar bgyika—/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyal potsa bsod nams kyis brgyan pa des bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la lo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du rung ba yid du 'ong ba kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bde ba'i yo byad dang yongs su longs spyod pa 57—759

—thams cad kyis rim gro byas so/ /khye'u seng ge dang / seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba de banyis bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de dag rab tu byung bas rgyal bu phyi ma nyi khri yang khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de nas seng ge dang / seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba'i dge slong byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / yo shābyad bsnyungs pa dang / dben 1par spyod pa la sbyor zhing brtson pas ring po ma lon par mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do/ /de dag mngon par shes pa rnyed pas 'jib rten gyi khams thams cad du rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang / smon lam gyi stobs kyis chos bshad nas de gnyis kyis sems can tshad med grangs med pa yongs su smin par byas te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar lo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'das nas rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa de/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal po ga la ba der song ba dang / /des khye'u de gnyis rab tu byung bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ngas ni lo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa la bde ba'i yo byad thams cad gukyis bsnyen bkur byas na 'di rngoganyis rab tu byung nas/ ngas ma byas pa ci zhig byas snyam du brnyas pa'i sems skyes so/ /rigs kyi bu de nas yang de bzhin gshesas pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal ngo saka/ rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa de lha bur sems pa mkhyen nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i —rtsal rmis 'gro ba la 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /rikas kyi bu khyod kyis shes rab dang / /mngon par shes pa dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi stobs ston la 57—760

'khor thams cad dba' bar gyis shig /bdud kyi gnas thams cad mog mog por gyis shig /byang chub kyi lam 'bar bar gyis shig /sems can thams cad tshim par gyis shig /phas kyi rgol ba rnams tshar chod cig /chos kyi sgron ma 'bar bar gyis shig /nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar gyis shis /byang chub sems dpa'i tsarnam par rol pa'ang ston cig /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sengam1 ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro bsade'i dus na nam mkha' la lag pas byusas nas des nam mkhra' la lag pas byugs 1pa dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos so/ /des yang nam mkha' la lag pas byukas pa dang / de nas de'i tshe bar snang las sil snyan bye ba khrag khrika brgya stong ma dkrol bar sgra byung ngo / /des yang nam mkha' la lag pas byugs pa dang / de nas bar snang las sngon ma thos ma mthong ba'i dri zhim zhing 'jam pa ka tsa lin di ka ltar reg na bde ba'i me tog rnams kyi char bab bo /des yang nam mala' la lag pas byugs pa dang / /de nas de ma thag tu bar snang las rin po che thams cad kyi char rab tu mngon par bab bo/ /longs spyod dang kun spyod pa thams cad kyi char rab tu bab bo/ /ji lta bur stong kasum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten rmi khams der yo byad thams cad kyi char mngon par rab tu 'bab pa de de lta bu'i zas dang skom dang bro'i char mngon par rab tu bab bo/ /de nas de bzhin bshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal pos rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis sbyin pa yongs su btang ba dang rin po che'i char bab pa 'di gang zamang 1 gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i char 'di ni 57nga 761

dper bgyi ba yang sba ba ma lags te/ de tsam du tshad ma mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' seng be'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba 'di mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi stobs kyis 'dod na/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'di 'dra ba'i rin po che'i char mngon par 'bebs so/ /bang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sems can de dag la ji lta bur 'dod pa bzhin du ngoms shing tshim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar de'i tshe de'i dus na sang sa bla'i lha rnams kyis ma la 'dis 1 sems bskyed kyim thab tu nam mkha' las rin po che thams cad kyi char mngon par rab tu 'bab 1 pa las na byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni nam mkha' 4mdzod du 'grur ba snyam zhes sgra phyung ngo / 1ji ltar sa bla'i lha rnams kyis sgra phyung ba de bzhin du bar snang dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum cu —rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' nas 'og min gyi 3 bar gyi lha rnams kyis kyang ma la 'dis sems bskyed ma thag tu 'di 'dra ba'i rin po che'i char rab tu bab pa las na/ kye ma byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni nam mkha'apha mdzod du 'gyur ba snyam zhes sgra phyung bas ming de la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin bshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mtha' yas 'od zer gyi rgyal po de rjes su yi rang ngo / /bang la de 1 rjes su yi rang ba de la gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa des byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba'i mngon par shes pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs de mthong nas khye'u rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba rgyal por bcug ste/ dad pas khyim 57—762
// zu / mu /pa spra/glu /bye bye go/da traṃ dī rngo lnge // de / ༷ ṭā sna ༷ 5 sa na di/ su lnge /bye rdo skre bye sdo | dhe rdo / ༷ rte ṅge — bye bye / kau bye / ri shā 'ag dzha / miwa snye

nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas sbyin pa 'di ni sems kun du chags pa'o/ /rab tu byung ba ni sems yongs su dag pa'o/ /sbyin pa 'di 4ni lus dang ngag gi bgegs 1so/ /rab tu byung ba ni lus dang ngag yongs su sbyong ba'o/ /sbyin pa 'di ni bgegs —chen po'o/ /rab tu byung ba ni bgegs zithams cad nye bar zhi'opa— /sbyin pa 'di ni rtswa dang lo ma'o/ /rab tu byung ba ni snying po dang 'bras bur 'grub pa'o/ /sbyin pa 'di ni nga'i dzi ba dang bcas shing yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rab tu byung ba ni yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad 'dor ba'o sgyu / /sbyin pa 'di ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba las mi bskyod pa'o/ /rab tu byung —ba ni lta ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'o (/ /sbyin pa 'di ni byis pa'i rtsed mo'i tsasbyor ba'o/ /rab tu byung ba 'di ni dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / rtse cang shes pa'i sa'o snyam du de de ltar tshul bzhin rab tu sbyor zhing / sems de lta bu dang bsam pa de lta dus de ltar rab tu byung ste gcig pu mi 'dre dzi ba bag yod pa—/ brtson pa rab tu dben par gnas pas ring po ma dzithosas par mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyalapo bsod nams kyis brgyan par gyur pa de gzhan 4zhis yin pa snyam du khyod sems na de de ltar mi blta'o—/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig de mide'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur kaba'i rgyal po bsod nams kyis tshobargyan ces bya bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod 'di ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba zhes bya bar gyur te/ des thog mar nam mkha' tshemadzod las rin po che'i char phab bo/ /de tshun chad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med grangs med par nam yang nam 57—763

byang chub sems dpa' gzugs mi rtaka par rig nas sbyin pa sbyin 3 no/ /gzugs sdug bsngal bar rig nas sbyin pa sbyin —no/ /gzugs bdag med par rig /gzusas zhi bar rig /gzugs stong par rig /gzubs mtshan ma shu med par rig /gzugs smon pa med par rig /sazugs mngon par 'du mi byed par rig /gzugs ma skyes par ris /gzugs ma byung bar rig /gzugs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar rig /sazugs dben par rig /gzugs gzung ba med par rig /gzugs kun gzhi med nga ra rig /bzugs 'byung ba med par rig /gzubs sgyu ma lta bur rig /gzubs rmi lam lta bur rig /gzugs smig rgyu lta bur rig /gzubs chu zla lta bur rig /gzugs brag ca milta bur rig /gzugs mig yor lta bur rig /gzugs gzugs brnyan lta bur rig /gzubs rtswa dang shing dang rtsib pa dang lam dang / mig yor lta bur rig nas sbyin pa sbyin yete/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid kyis —rngosbyin pa'i de bzhin nyid la 'jug go/ /sbyin pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid kyis byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang /sems can gyi de bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi de bzhin nyid dang / bdab gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de rtoni de bzhin nyid med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyidar—do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas (sbyin pa ste/ sbyin pa 'di r+ṣani risas kyi bu byang zub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /57—766

/ sde wa nga pa ba ༷ rdo / ༷ sdu sa // wa twe ༷ la/ / dze+e sto skre / / ༷ mi twe ༷ rna/ nga rngo / rdo/ dre r+bha da / rna ༷ / ༷༷ rdzu sa byi da sdu/ traṃ sgo ṭ+wāṃ da nga pa // ṭ+wāṃ ste wa 2/ riṭ+wāṃ di ga ༷ / ༷ // nga /da/ jiX

—— — 'du byed rnams dang tshe / rnam par shes pa mi rtag par rig nas sbyin pa sbyin dz+wa no—/ /rnam par shes pa sduka bsngal ba dang / bdag med par rig /rnam par shes pa zhi bar rig /rnam par shes pa stong par rig /rnam par shes pa mtshan ma med par rig /rnam par shes pa smon pa med par ris /rnam par shes pa mngon par 'du mi byed par ris /rnam par shes pa ma skyes par rig /rnam par shes pa ma byung bar rig /rnam par shes pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar rig nas sbyin pa sbyin 1 no/ /rnam par shes pa dben par rig /rnam par shes pa gzung ba med par rig /rnam par shes pa kun gzhi med par rig /rnam par shes pa mi 'byung bar rig 1rnam par shes pa sgyu ma lta bur rig /rnam par shes pa rmi lam lta bur rig /rnam par shes pa smig rgyu lta bur rig /rnam par shes pa chu zla lta bur rib 4/rnam par shes pa mig yor lta bur rig /rnam par shes pa gzugs brnyan lta bur rig /rnam par shes pa rnam par rig pa med pa'i mtshan nyid du rig nas sbyin pa sbyin tsute/ de rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis sbyin pa'i de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /sbyin pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid kyis byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang / sems can gyi de bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi de bzhin nyid dang / bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid do 1 /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas sbyin pa sbyin — pa 'di ni rigs kyi bu byang chub 57—766

— —sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gzugs mi rtag par rig nas tshul khrims srung shāb nas/gzugs rtswa dang / shing dang / rtsika pa dang / lam dang / bzugs brnyan lta bu'i bar du rig 1 nas tshul khrims srung ngo / /de gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid kyis tshul khrims kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /tshul khrims kyi de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / bsngoba'i de bzhin nyid kyis byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang —/ sems can gyi de bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi de bzhin nyid dang /bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid med de/ / ma nor ba 1 de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid de / de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas tshul khrims de srung ba 'di ni rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi rtag par rig nas tshul khrims bsrungam kub nas rnam par shes pa rnam par rig pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bar du rig nas tshul khrimasasasrung ste/ de rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis tshul khrims kyi de bzhin nyidarjes su shes so/ /tshul khrims kyi de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid kyis 6byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang 1 sems can gyi de bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi de bzhin nyid dang /bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /57—767

༷ pyi / ༷rngo shāX / twe ga di 'i traṃ gyi ji nga ༷/sdetwe ngh+ru ’ skyes / smiskur/// skre / // /rmi2 nga bye rdo / na bye ṭ+wāṃ tsu / /rdo pa ༷ di d+ku bye 2 wa sdu skre / bye rto / tre / ༷ rdo na/ | / rni/ ༷ ༷ wa py-i rjo rtsi

nga — —nga gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas tshul khrims de srung ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gzugs mi rtag par rig nas/ bzod pa sgom pa nas/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rjes su shes pa 'di lta bus brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog go/ /shes rab rnam par dpyod do/ /des gzubs mi rtag par rig nas shes rab rnam par dpyod pa nas/ bzugs rtswa dang shing dang rtsib pa dang lam dang mig yor lta bu'i bar 2 rig nas shes rab rnam par dpyod do/ /de gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid kyis shes rab kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /shes rab kyi de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid kyis byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang / sems can gyi de bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi de bzhin nyid dang —/ bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid med de/ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas shes rab rnam par dpyod pa 'di 1ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bya'o —/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi rtag par rig nas shes rab rnam par dpyod pa nas/ rnam par shes pa rnam par ris pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bar du rig nas shes rab rnam par dpyod do/ / de rnam pe 57—768

par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid kyis shes rab kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /shes rab kyi de bzhin nyid kyis bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid dang / bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid kyis byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid dang / byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid kyis sems can gyi de bzhin nyid dang / sems can gyi tsapede bzhin nyid kyis bdag gi kade bzhin nyid dang / bdag gi de bzhin nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid 1 rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / kazhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas shes rab rnam par dpyod pa 'di yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpas gzubs mi rtag par rig nas lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar bzhag — pa sgoma'aka pa nas gzugs rtswa dang shing dang rtsib pa dang lam dang mig yor lha du'i bar du rig nas lus la lus kyi rjes su lha zhing dran pa nye bar gzhag mipa sgom mo/ /sazugs kyi de bzhin nyid kyis lus kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes so/ /lus kyi de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pa nas chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi bar du rjes su shes so/ /gang chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de ni de bzhin nyid 3med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar gzhag —pa sgom ste/ lus dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtoyo ḍa pas rnam par mi rtog pa 'di ni rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i r+sha'ajis rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang —/ 'du shesab dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mi rtab 57nga 769

—— nga par rib pa (3nas rgya cher de bzhin du sbyin pa sbyin pa'i bar dang / de bzhin du tshor ba dang / sems dang / chos rnams kyang rgyas par bya ste/ gzukas mi rtag par rig pa banas chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar gzhagamarngopa sgom pa nas/ rtswa dang shing dang rtsig pa dang lam dang / mig miyor lta du'i bar du rib rngo nas chos la chos kyi rjes su lha zhing dran pa 3nye bar gzhag shā pa sgomatshu— )mo—/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa mi rtag par rika nas chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar bzhag ⑫pa sgom pa nas/ rnam par shes pa rnam par rig pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bar du rig nas chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar gzhag shā pa sgom mo/ /de ltar phung po'i de bzhin nyid bang yin pa de dran pa nye bar gzhag ma pa'i de bzhin nyid do/ /dran pa nye bar kazhag kapa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid do/ /bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid do/ /byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de sems can gyi de bzhin nyid do/ /sems can gyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de bdag gi de bzhin nyid do/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid bang yin pa de chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid de—/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ni de bzhin nyid med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas chos la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing dran pa nye bar gzhagabatshepa sgom yang chos dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtoka pas rnam par mi rtog ste/ bang de ltar rjes su shes pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ de ltar 17—770

dran pa nye bar gzhag tsu pa la ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi 5rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi 1)dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang /sazugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga yang de bzhin du rgyas par byas te/ des gzugs mi rtag par rig nas mngon par shes pa'i ye shes sgrub par byed de/ bzusas sdug bsngal ba dang / bzugs bdag med pa dang / gzugs zhi ba dang / gzugs stong pa dang / gzugs mtshan ma med pa dang / bzugs smon pa med par ris /gzugs mngon par 'du mi byed par rig /ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / dben pa dang / gzung ba med pa dang / kun sazhi med pa dang / mi 'byung ba dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / rmi lam lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / — chu zla lta bu dang / brag ca 1lta bu dang / mig yor lta bu dang / bzugs brnyan lta du dang / yozugs rtswa dang shing dang rtsig pa dang lam dang mig 6yor lta bur rig nas/ mngon par shes pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub bo/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa mi rtag par rig nas mngon par shes pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub ste/ rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal bar rig /rnam par shes pa bdag da pa dang / rnam par shes pa zhi ba dang / rnam par shes pa stong pa dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang | ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 57—771

dang 1 dben pa dang / gzung ba med pa dang / kun gzhi med pa dang /mi 'byung ba dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / rmi lam lta bu dang / smig rgyu lhalta bu dang —/ chu zla lta bu dang / brag ca lha du dang 3 / mig 1 yor lta bu dang /gzugs brnyan lta du dang / rnam par shes pa rnam par rib pa med pa'i mtshan nyid du rib nas mngon par shes pa'i ye shes mngon nga ra skrub bo/ /'di lta ste/phung po'i rngode bzhin nyid gang yin pa de mngon par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid do/ /mngon par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de bsngo 1ba'i de bzhin nyid do/ /bsngo ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid do/ /byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid bang yin pa — de sems can gyi de bzhin nyid do/ /sems can gyi de bzhin nyid bang yin pa de bdag gi de bzhin nyid do/ /bdag gi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid do/ /chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ni kade bzhin nyid med de/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang —/ pozhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pas mngon par shes pa'i ye shes rab tu sgrub ste/ gang de ltar rjes su shes pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam de ni gzugs kyis ba de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pa ste/ gzugs 'jig pa ma yin/ chad pa ma yin/ rtab pa ma yin/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ḍab rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'o/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid rjes su shes pa ste/ rnam par shes pa 'jig pa ma yin/ chad pa ma yin/ rtag pa ma yin/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rang bzhin 57nga 772

gyis ma skyes pa'o/ /gang phung po'i 'jig rten las rgal 3ba de ni 'dod pa dang /gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i 'jib rten gyel yang mi chags pa ste/ de mi chags pas 'gro ba lngar skyes pa'i sems can rnams la — 'jig rten las 'da' ba'ipa — phyir chos ston te/ gang 'jig rten 'jig par mi byed pa de ltar chosa'ashe ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid de 'jib par mi byed do/ /'jig rten ni sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ bdas med pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhi ba'i mtshan nyid/dzi / stong pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan ma med pa'i mtshan nyid/ smon pa med pa'i mtshan nyid/ mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i — mtshan nyid nas de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi 1bar du ste/ 'jib rten 'jig par mi byed pa 'di ni/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yongs su dag pa'o/ /gang lam yongs su dag pa la rab tu banas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni lam ḍalog pa la gnas pa'i sems can rnams la chos kyi snang ba chen po byed do/ /de dag snang ba rnyed nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam de nyid la rab tu gnas so/ /byang chub kyi 7snying po thobashā par byed pa'i phyir ༅lam 'di ni rab kyi mchog bo/ /mi dge ba thams cad kyi ka sems med pa'i phyir lam 'di ni mchog bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rtse mo rnyed pa'i phyir lam 'di ni dam pa'o/ /chu bo thams cad las sgrol ba'i phyir lam 'di ni bla na yam̐med pa'o/ /nyi tshe ba'i lam thams cad las 'das pa'i phyir lam 'di ni gong na med pa'o/ /gnyen po mi dmigs pa'i phyir lam 'di ni mnyam pa med pa'o / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyi lam du yang dag par 'gro ba'i phyir lam 'di ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /bdud dang phyir rgol ba thams cad bcom pa'i phyir 57—773

— —lam 'di ni bde bar 'gro ba'o1 /mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par rol pa'i phyir lam 'di ni mi thogs 1 par 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyis snang ba'i 'od rnam par dka pa'i phyir lam 'di ni mun pa mun naka med pa'o/ /sgyu dang g.yo med pa'i phyir lam 'di ni drang po'o 1 / /sems gya tsagyu med pa'i phyir lam 'di ni gsal ba'o/ /sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa'i phyir lam 'di ni mnyam pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la go 'byed pa'i phyir lam 'di ni rgya che ba'o / /phan tshun du 3sanod par mi 'grur bas lam 'di ni yangs pa'o/ /yongs su mi skyo bar 'gro bas lam 'di ni rnal du 'dug pa'o—/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni bsod nams kyis brtan pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni bdung ba med pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni 'jig 3pa med pa'o/ /brtson rje'agrus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni mi zlosasam1pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni rdul thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas lam 'di ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'gro ba'o/ /nga rgyal med pas lam 'di ni ye shes kyi rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /dke ba'i chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs (pas lam 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su sgom pa'i kyi rjes su 'gro ba'o/ /sngon thos pa mi slu ba'i phyir lam 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor shā ba rjes su 'gro ba ste/ rigs kyi bu de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yongs su dag pa ste/ lam yongs su dag pas gang la banas nas byang chub sems dpa' ko cha chen po bgosab tsha te| theg pa chen po de la zhugs nas byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der 'gro ba'o/ /57—774

swā wa ri ri ma sa chas nga na rte ṭā rna ngh+ru / / sde da rngo kyi/wa pa ༷ traṃ hā ba byedam be pa ne ༷ ba'i ཿ sdu / dzā di dhe sdu / ru skya ri /da rdo rtswa rtelta/ 3 / ༷ ༷༷ / ḍi / / wa/ / ji / tho tru na da / sna wa/ rga da bya /rdo rī re

——de la 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi go cha ste/ gru chen po yang dag par sbyor bas ma rgal ba sgrol ba'i go cha'o/ /nyon mongs pa dang / lha ba'i bcings pa thams cad las yongs su 'grol bas ma grol ba 'grol ba'i go cha'o/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'dor bas dbubs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa'i go cha'o/ /med pa la phyin ci los tu gyur pa mnyam pa nyid du ston pas yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa mya ngan las bzla 1ba'i go cha'o/ /bdaka dang sems can dang srog dang gang zag mi dmisas pas sems can thams cad yongs su grol ba'i go cha'o/ /lus dang srog la mi lta bas dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i go cha'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs nga sa —pas ngoms mi sbong bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i go cha'o/ /sbyin pa'i tshogs sna tshosasasgyu1bsags pas mtshan dang dpe byad babazang po lus kyi rgyan gyi go cha'o/ /mngon par shes pa thob pas bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad btul ba'i go cha'o| /so so yang dag par rig pa'i ye shes kyis sems can thams cad shin tu tshim par byed pa'i go cha'o/ /gzungs 5kyi ye shes kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad nyan pa dang tshol ba'i bo cha'o/ /mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyis sems can thams cad kyi sems la lta ba'i go cha'o/ /shes rab kyi ye shes kyis sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa'i go cha'o//shes rab dang ye shes kyi stobs yang dag par bsgrub 4pas stobs bcu yongs su bskang ba'i ko cha'o/ /thams cad du sems gong ba med pas mi 'jigs pa thob pa'i go cha'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spangs shing / dbe ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs 3 par byed pas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 1 57—776

brgyad yongs su skongab1ba'i go cha'o/ /chos thams cad sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang —/ mib yor dang / brarga ca —)dang / chu zla lta bur thos kyang mi skrag /mi dngang rje dngang bar mi 'gyur ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi skrag pa'i bo cha'o1)/ /sems can zams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par shes kyang sems can thams cad yongs su mi btong bar gnas pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po'i go cha'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma byung bar thos kyang tshe dang /'chi 'pho dang / skye ba kun du ston pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i go cha'o/ /chos thams cad nges par grur pa )la zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid du shes shing 'du byed thams cad skye ba med par rig kyang 'gog par mi ltung zhing 'bras bu mngon sum du yang mi byed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs yemi 'khrugs pa'i go cha'o/ /go cha chen po nyi shu po de dka bgos nas de theb pa chen po la mngon par zhugs pa yin no/ /theg pa chen po de ni bsdu ba'i dngos pos 6phang lo bzhi dang lesas par ldan par byas pa bsam pas dbe ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngos pas rtsibs shin tu sbyar ba/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i kaye shes lhab par che bas lte ba zab cing lekas par byas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi khur bskya — ba'i phyir srog shing dang ldan zhing shin tu bzung ba/ byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen pos yang dag par zin pas shing rta'i mda' brtan par sbyar ba/ chos rin po che thams cad kyis legs par brgyan pas rin po che thams cad kyi la ran gyis bskor ba/ sngon 57—776
khri sa |/ skre ༷/ byed ngh+ru |bye hūṃ bye/ bye wa/ ṣ+ṭṛ bye ༷ ཿshā ༷ /rdo da/ stu dzi da da ji ༷ ༷ / khroX sdo/ wa rde | ༷ ༷ rte rde ༷ 2 nga wa ri be sgo ༷/༷
