rje'ang bgyi/ /sems can rnyed 3)dang 'dod banas pa/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa mthong nas su/ /de yi 'gro ba cir 'gyur zhes/ /mchi ma'ang rab tu dbyung 2 bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos la sbur 'debs pa/ /de dag 'phral du mthong na yang —/ /de dka gshe bar mi 'gyur bar/ /ring nas byams pa btsal bar bgyi//rab tu bsdams nas ngag gi las/ /nyams kyis ci nus bsrung bar bgyi/ /sdig pa la ni rab gnas pa/ /de la glo babur gtam mi bgyi/ /nor sbyin de bzhin bste 1stang gis/ /mi rnams yongs su smin bgyis nas/ /yang dag sdika/ med spyod yul gyis/ /slad kyis de dka bskul bar bgyi/ /khyim dang sten —pa kun spangs te/ /don nyung ba dang bgyid nyung ba/ /bas mtha' dgon pa'i spyod yul ba/ /ri dasas rngobazhin du 'gyur bar bgyi/ /'phags pa'i rigs la dga' ba dang / /sbyangs pa'i tshul khrims banas pa dang / /mnyam bzhagaka shes rab ldan pa dang / /g.yel ba ma mchis 'gyur bar bgyi/ /dul ba dang ni zhi ba dang / /grol bas grong du zhusas nas kyang / /sems can gang dag chos tshol ba/ /de la bdag cag chos bstan to(1/ /chos 'dod par ni rtobs nas su/ /shin tu ring du'ang mchi bar bgyi/ /chos la dga' zhing mos rnyed nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don yang bgyi/ /sems can rnams kyi 'khrul mang po/ /de dag mngon par mthong nas kyang / /chos dang nges par rab banas nas/ /bdag la rab tu brtag par bgyi/ / bsnyi stang bgyis dang ma bgyis la/ /ri rab lta bur gyur nasasu/ /'jig rten gyis ni mi gos pa/ /'jig rten 'dren par 'gyur bar tshebagyid/ /dbe slong tshul las nyams rnams kyi/ /mi snyan pa dag rtogs nas kyang / /las ni bdas gir bya bar bgyi/ /de dag las ni smin 57—829

ma )'gyur/ /chos rnams la ni gnas pa la/ /nged la de 'dra'i chos rnams ni/ /ji lta bur yang yod med ces/ /gshed ma das kyang 'gyod 1 par 'gyur/ /bdag cab ming gi dge sbyong ste/ /dge sbyong yon tan med do zhes/ /yang dag bskul ba thos pa dang / /mdo sde 'di ni spong bar 'gyur/ /sna dang rna chad de dab ni/ /meparjelong dga' bar mi 'gyur ltar/ /yang dag bskul ba thos zupa das /de dag dam chos spong bar 'gyur/ /dge slong gang dag dam pa'i chos /rab tu 'dzin par 'byung 'gyur te/ /de dag bzhin du tshul 'chos kyang / /gang yang chos 'di mi nyan to/ /rgyal po rnams kyang slu bar bgyid/ /skye bo chen po 'byed 'gyur yang / /sangs rgyas kyi ni byin rlabs —snyekyis/ /sems can de rtag — chos nyan 'gyur/ /dus ngan de tshe bdag carga rnams/ /sems can dag la sman slad du/ /lus dang srog kyang rab btang ste/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /'jig pa chen po'i dus de na/ /tshig tsam du ni ma lags kyi/ /skrub pa snying por bgyid par yang / /mgon pos bdag caka bsam pa mkhyen/ /dam chos 'di ni yongs bzung na/ /bsod nams tshobs ni ji tsam mchis /chos kyi rgyal po 'od mdzad pa/ /'jirga rten snang bar mdzad la zhu/ /de'idz+wamatshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la bka' sprul pa/rikas kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ shar phyosas kyi stong sum cu'i da'ajig rten gyi lams re re yang rdul phra rab kyi char khya rdul phra rab kyi rdul du bshig la/ de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / steng dang / 'og dang /phyogs bcu kun du stong sum cu'i r+sha'ajig rten gyi khams re re yang rdul phra rab kyi rdul du bshis ste/ de nas rdul phra rab de dag thams cad ji snyed par shar 57—830

phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed 'das shing rdul phra rab kyi rdul tshegacig bzhagam1la/ tshul de lta bur shar phyogs su rdul phra rab de thams cad zad zadakhu du bzhag kyang / shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi mthar thus pa gang yang med do/ /shar phyogs su ji lta ba de bzhin du phyogs bcu kun kyi phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag si rdul phra rab rnams tshul de lta bus phyogs bcur bzhag pa las tshad dam mtha' rtogs par nus sam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni mi nus so/ /gzhan du na de bzhin gshebs pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chasas pa mi mnga' bas mkhyen pa ni ma gtobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed pa de dag las bang du rdul phra rab de dag bzhag par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad grong khyer gcig tu gyur te brtsigar4pas bskor nas 'og gi chu'i phung po nas bzung ste/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi grong khyer de dka yungs 'bru mi rtsub pa 'ba' zhig gis ༄yongs su gang bar gyur na/ rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ yungs 'bru de dag mang ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas ji ltar dpe 'di —3btsal ba ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dpe 'di thos nas dad par ge'agyur ba'i sems can de dag kyang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin bshegs pa ni yungs 'bru de dka brgya phrab 'di snyed cigar ༄ce'am/ stong phrag 'di snyed cig (ce'am/ brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ dkrigs rngopa dang / gtams pa dang / khyad phyin 57nga 831

༷ dro trī / nga mi ༷ rto / de wa sdu wa / rdo / ji byeX sto ༷ / dri ༷ trī tho ༷ /༷ / wa / / di / rdo ༷ / du/rdo mi hūṃ sa// ༷ ༷/ / rngo / shad 2 nga/da/snye rne ༷ ra dri sdu ༷ bye ༷ ༷ skre da ji da nga na ༷ sdu

dang —/ mi 'khrugs pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di snyed cig ce'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag 'di 3snyed cib ce'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig yod do/ /zhes rab tu mkhyen to/ /rigs kyi du byang chub 'dod pa la la zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu bkang ste/sbyin pa byin pa —bas ji ltar skyes bu dam pa dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa gang yon tan gyi chos 'di lta bu la gnas pa de dag gis de bzhin bshegs pa gcig gis — dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung na 'di de bas bsod nams ches mang du skyed do/ /yungs 'bru ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom lhaldan 'das rnams la kang la la zhig gis bstekasnyestang du byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas te mchod pa byas — gang zab mo'i chos la bzod pa de ni de bas bsod nams ches mang du skyed do/ /yungs 'bru ji snyed pa de snyed kyi gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byin 3pa bas/ bang gzhan zhig sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa'i sems kyis chos la rab tu dba' zhing bzod pas gom pa bdun bor na de bas de bsod nams ches 8mang du skyed do/ 1yungs 'bru de dag ji snyed pa de snyed du brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'khor los sgyur rdzuba'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' snyed pa mabs gzhan kang 1 gis 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal bar rig cing chos thams cad la bdas med par rig la/mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar rig nas/ sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi 'chad /rtepa'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ de ni de bas ches 57—832

bsod nams mang du skyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sgad ma'i tshe sgad ma'i 1dus na ci nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzam bu'i 1gling du spyod cing rgyas par yang 'gyur bar de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu de'i phyir rgyal po chen po babazhi dgug pa'i tshig bshad par bya ste/dgug pa'i tshig de dag gis rgyal po chen po bzhi 'ongs nas/ chos kyi ༄rnam grangs 'di yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / rgya cher rnam par dbye zhing rab tu bstan pa'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di dag ni dgug pa'i tshig go//'di lta ste/ dhu dhu re/ rnyi rnyi re/ dh+wa dza ba ti/ dh+wa dza a lo — ka ra/ a ba dwa sgyuni| sha me sha ma ba ti/ shā na ti mu khe/ ni gra ha pa ra pa k+ṣa/ a no dha ra/sprustu —ri ji ba ma/ sa ma ༄zapā tha/ pā tha shurnyi — / pā tha sa nu ga ma/ pā tha sarnyi—/ pratshwa nu khe/ ār+ya ku le/ stu lota rak+ṣe 4sa me sa tsa/ me ne+e sa tsa/ta ma sa tsa/ ta ta ma sa tsa/ burtse pā da/ dharma a nu sarnyi/ ār+ya ga na nu kha ma—/ ār+ya nir+gha tsata ni/ rurto pra sā tshod ni/ ste shā ra pa da lo ka tsirnyi kṛ nyata/sa nu rā tshog yaskyo/ i marnyarma sarnyi/ ji bha tsaskyo rani ruk+ta ba/ nibyā she rapra ti rak+ṣaskyo—/ dhasmo dha ra ṇin —/ rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni rgyal po chen po bzhi dgug pa'i tshig go/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'jigs shing skrag ste spu zing zhes byed nas bcom ldan 'das rga la ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /brtsom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi chos kyi rnam ༄ grangs 'di 57—833

bsrung ba (dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / yu na ring du gnas par bgyi ba dang / rjes su gzung ba'i slad du gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 1'di spyod pa der lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang —/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci gang dag chos ma lags pa 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de dka shin tu tshar gcad ② par bgyi'o/ /gang dag chos 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de dag gi sems rab tu dga' bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de'i —'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang yongs su legs par gzhag ༄par bgyi'o| /tshig blu mtshams su tshis gi mtshams sbyor bar bgyi'o/ /spobs pa yang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtobs pa dang / dga' ba yang 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po de bzhi la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /grog/sa po dag 'di lta ste—/ khyed pa63ni nga'i bu chos las skyes papa chos kyis byungaka —ba ste/ khyed rnams nga'i dam pa'i chos yongs su kazung ba'i phyir spro ba ston pa ni legs so legs so/ /khyed rnams chos kyi rgyu 'thun ()pa 'dis 'jig rten du 'jig rten gyi bdag por 'gyur te/ 'jig rten thams cad las yang dag par 'das nas 'phakas pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dbyings su yongs su zu ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ribs kyi bu lha'i dbang po brgya byin dgug pa'i tshig bshad par bya ste/ rig r+ṣapa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig de dag gis lha'i dbang po brgya byin chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba dang / yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir kanas par 'gyugyu ro/ /de la tshig ni 'di rnams so/ /'di lta ste/57—834

shu snye/ shu bha ma ti/ shu bha byu he 1du da re/ da ri da du ra ni/ da me sha me/u pa sha me/ khu be/ u ba sha me/ kha be 1 / u 1 sa/ kha ra/ a so —)mu khe/ ṅgā ra ṇitsa/ a raji / shu shu ṣepe/ sa nyi te/ sa snye de snye da sarnyi sotshu —me sa ma ba te nya sa ma rasmi/ sa she/ hu tu/ he he/ khu ru khu re/ a na ti kra me/de brlak+ṣa kyis te te dzim hā bha ba bha sa pra me/ ā gats+tsha tshidu sha kro tshode ba dzāwaṃman+d+ra/da sha sha ta na ya na/ bar ma ku ta dha ra/ i shwa ra u ma rut+pa bha dzon ni ba si/rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dgug pa'i tshig ste/ dgug pa'i tshig gang gis lha'i dbang po brgya byin bkus྾nas/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir gnas par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin chos kyi shugs kyis dga' ba skyes nas/ sum cu cortsa gsum gnas kyi lang pa thams cad rab tu g.yos tshopar byas te/ g.yog lha brgya stong mang po dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong nas lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal rtsenas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin te/ sum cub rtsa gsum pa'i lha la dbang bkyid de/ g.yog lha'i tshogs dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzam bu'i༄ gling du rgyas par bgyi ba'i slad du nan tan du bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de dag dang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba de dag la ji lhar mi gnod pa dang /dga' ba dang / mchos tu dga' ba dang / mos pa rnyed cing chos kyi rgyan gyis brgyan te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grong dang tsa / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang —/ yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du zhusas nas rab tu 'chad par 'gyur ba de ltar chos kyisashārtebasrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /57nga 835

bcom ldan 'das bdag cag chos mnyan pa'i slad du chos smra ba de dag gi gan du mchi bar bgyi'o/ /khro (zhing gshe yang dang du blang bar bgyi'o/ /bdud bar chad bgyid pa'i kanod pa thams cad las kyang bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang /sba bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ko shi ka ji lta bur khyod lha'i dbang po thob pas rjechos kyi dbang por zhugs nas/ nga dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos yongs su kazung ba'i phyir seng ge'i sgra sgrosas zhu pa legs so legs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ko shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi dam pa'i chos yongs spu bzung — na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung 1ba yin no/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la ——bka' stsal pa/ de la rigs kyi bu mi mjid kyi bdab po tshangs pa dgug pa'i tshig bshad kyisarngo / /dgug pa'i tshig gang das gis mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba'i phyir yonas par 'gyur ba nyon cis /de la dgug pa'i tshig ni 'di rnams so/ /'di lta ste/ mi tre/ shu bha mi tred/ dharma mi tre/ mi rngunyu— / nu sa nyi te sa mi tre sarnyimi tre/ a nu ga ma mi trege/ sa khye nu ga k+ṣa mi tre/ a nukhyo tshe ra mi tre/sa tra mi tre/ dharma mi tre/ a nu gra ha mi tre/dzi a pra ti sā ⑫ri mi tre/ u la lo ka na mi tre1rta/ bi tshelo ka na mi tre/ bi lo ka na mi tre/ be bh+yaḥ 8sa nu ga ma na mi tre/ burta a dhi ṭī tsan mi tre/ a nu rā shā ga k+ṣa mi tre/ a nu rā nyag kha sha mi tre/ dharma pra ti sārtse ra ṇa mi 'utre/ mo kha sha mi tre / o lono o no nu ro dhe—/ bi ro dha mi tre/ tsheto mo mi tretso/ brad+ma bawaṃtha mika tre/ rgyamashen a laṅka 57—836

kyang rung / chos kyi btam bgyid kyang rung ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgya cher 'chad na bsam par bgyi'o/ /bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o—/ /de dag la spro ba nga bar bgyi'o/ /stobs yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o—/ /dran pa bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /blo gros yongs su gzung bar bgyi'o/ /rtogs pa'i rjes su 'jug par bgyi'o/ /sbobs pa stsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa rnams dad par bgyi'o/ /dad pa rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul bdaka/ cag migis yongs su bzung 2ste rgya cher 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi mjid kyi bdag po tshangs pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /legs so lekas so/ /tshangs pa dam pa'i chos yongs su bzungs —bas de bzhin kashegs pa khyod la rjes su yi rang ngo / /ji ltar ngas da ltar bskor ba bzhin du tshangs pa khyod kyis gekyang ringaXpor mi thogs par chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar khyod kyis da ltar nga'i dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung kab de bzhin du tshangs pa gzhan dag kyang khyod kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa ji tsam du sazung 4— ba dang /bcang ba dngam4/ bklag pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dka par rab tu bstan par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa kazo zhing byas pa shes pa bskyed pa dang / bdag gi 1bsam pa yongs su rdzosasasapar bya ba dang /sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyas pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos snang ba thob par bya ba dang / bdud thams cad 57—838

rto ma ji de / ཿ dzi ོ r+sha sna stsa/ ma sa cing ca shā 2 da 2 tred sdu 'a blo ra/ —1 ma 2 rna mgus //sdumi ga na rngo t+ma pa tre nga zlo rtsu /ca ci ci nga — spyo phyiX sdo smi ༷ d+dha peṃ' dzi/ / tsha ṭ+wāṃ traṃ sbya shā dzi /rna pa dī be bye — da ḍa tre dī da bye rga stu /tre mi zlo dro dz+wa dbye/ zi sdu rgya nga pa ra/ dis ཿ /shā —— bye

tshar gcad 2pa dang / nu stebs can thams cad gzhom pa dang / don dam pa'i chos yongs ( su gzung ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mi chadab par bya ba'i phyir bskal pa bye ba phrag grangs med par yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di khyod la yongs su gtad do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces bsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de bzhin gshekas pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i slad du 1bla na med pa'i chos dkon mchog gi mdzod 'di bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdab dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dam pa'i chos lags so /bcom ldan 'das bdag dga' ldan gyi gnas na mchis te/ 'di lta bu'i mdo sde dag kun du bsrung ba dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du nan tan bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na 'di lta bu'i mdo sde dam pa su'i rna bar grag ——par 'gyur ba dang /thos nas 'dzin pa dang 1 'chang ba dang / klob sgyupa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu ston cing bdag nyid kyang sbyor bar bgyid pa de ni bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i 1 byin gyi rlabs ba )su rig par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe bdud kyi phyosas kyang g.yos par gyur mute/ 'on kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba gang gisashāzhebadag gi spu'i khung bu re re grub pa de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jib rten gyi khams kyi sems can de dag thams cad bdud sdig can du gyur kyang / de dag bdag bi/ spu'i bu ga gcig gis yongs su bzung ma57—839

nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyis brgyan pa la sbar tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu rgya cher dpag tu med pa yi/ /zhing rnams sangs rgyas spyan gyis gang gzigs pa/ /de dag thams cad rin chen rab bkang ste/ /byang chub sems dpas sbyin pa byin pa bas| /gang gis sangs rgyas mang pos bshad pa yi/ /mdo 'di tsa'adra batshu— )rab bzang ma gos pa/ /'chang ngam klog 1pegam gzhan la ston byed pa/ /de yi bsod nams de ni ches mchog go/ /me tog dri zhim byug pa gdugs rnams dang //ba dan rgyal mtshan lda ldi gos rnams kyis/ /zhing de thams cad yongs su gang byas nas/ /byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas mchod pa bas/ /bde gshegs bstan pa dam chos rab 'jig cing / /'bag pa'i tshe na gang zhig bas yod pa ra //dam pa'i chos ni yongs su 'dzin byed pa/ /de yi bsod nams de ni ches mchog go—/ /phyogs bcu dag na rgya mtsho gang yod pa/ /de dag 'bru mar dri zhim rab bkang ste/ /snying po ri rab tshad tsam byas nas su/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten me mar bus pa bas/ /gang gis chos sgron 1'di ni rab 'jig tshe/ /'jig rten 'di dag nun pas bsgribs shes nas/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos 'di 'dzin byed na/ /de yi bsod nams de ni ches mchog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni byang chub mchog tshol zhing / /zhing rnams bye bar 'dren pa gang mthong ba(6/ /de dag la ni bskal pa bye mang du/ /lha rdzas 'du byed yid 'ong mchod pa bas/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas byas pa gzo ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum ni rjes su gzung ba dang | /chos 'di la ni sems can gzud pa'i pephyir/ /dam chos 'dzin pa de 3 ni ches 4mchob go/ /ji ltar mgon po rnams kyiwaṃchos 'dzin ltar/ /sems 57—842

can gang ngas ⑫sangs rgyas spyan gyis sazigs/ /de dag gang gis brgya byin tshangs par bkod/ /de yi bsod nams de snyed mi 'phel lo/ /sems can de kun dgra bcom bkod pa dang / /rang rgyal theg par rab tu bkod pa bas/ /gang zhig byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /dam chos 'dzin pa de ni khyad par 'phags—/ /gal te bsod nams de la kazugs yod na/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad kang bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu khyu mchog ye shes ma gtogs par/ /bsod nams de yi snod ni yod ma yin/ /ji ltar bskal pa bye ba stong brjod kyang —/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mtha' yod ma yin ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi dam chos 'dzin pa yi/ /bsod nams de yang tshad yod ma yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyis brgyan 1 pas bcom ldan 'das las dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i bsod nams bshad pa 'di thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yilarangs te rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te—/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang dag dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa la brtson par mi bgyid pa de dab ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dab dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan thams cad ninibadag la yungs 'bru tsam du gda'o/ /dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams ji lta ba bzhin du bdag 'du shes gnas par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar bdag ④ sems can thams cad la bde bar 'tshal ba'i slad du lus dang srog kyang bor te/bde ba thams cad mi 'tshal bar dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung da ba'i slad du go 57—843

——cha bgo bar bgyi'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod kyi bsod nams kyi tsornam par smin pa'i rgyu 'thun 1pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod dang blo mnyam pa'i byang chub semasapa(dpa' rnams kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir nam mkha'i dkyil nas me tos gi char mngon par rab tu phab po/ /bar snang las kyang sgra 'di skad ces byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyisamazu'adus pa chen po'i le'u 'di brgyan te yongs su sazung ba'i bar du sangs rgyas kyi 1bya ba byas so/ /byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral ba'i sems can bang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin par 'gyur ba — de dag kyang de bzhin du dam pa'i chos rgyan par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe sku las 'di lta bu'i 'od rab tu btang bas 'od des phyogs bcu'i — sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i thog ma dang / bar ma dngam —/ tha ma bshad pa na sems can dpab tu med grangs med pa ni byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /sems can 13dpag tu med grangs med pa dag ni bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /sems can la la dag ni sems rnam par grol lo/ /la la dag ni chos kyi mig rnam par dag go/ /la la dag ni 'dod chakas dang bral ba rnyed do/ /la la dag ni lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa yongs su bzung bar gyur te 1—/ sangs rgyas bzhan dag la yang lha43ba'i phyir rgyu bsags par yang gyur to//de dag thams cad la yang bcom ldan 'das rjes su thugs rang ngo bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 57—844

par /'phags pa byams pas thus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rngo nga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi tri kapa ri prets+tsha —rā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phasas pa byams pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdas gis thos pa dus bcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i bab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong gi 4dbe 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhubs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbe 'dun chen po dang yang thabs cib go—/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nasasgyu bcom ldan 'das la — 'di skad ces gsol to1 /bcom ldan 'das 'di la chos sbyin pa'i rnam par smin pa gang lakas6 / de skad ces zagasol pa 57nga 872

dang —/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byams pa sus 3 stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ba'ajig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbul ba phul sheb bas/ gang bis snying rje bas tshigs su bcad pa gcig bzhan gyi rgyud la bzhag na byams pa bsod nams kyi phung po 'di la bsod nams kyi phung po snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/stong gi cha dang / brgya stong gi cha dang / bye ba'i cha dang / bye ba khrab khrig brgya stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / cha padangaX/ bgrang ba dang / dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te/bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas/ ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' nga to/ /gang gis gang gā'i bye snyed 'jig rten khams/ /de dag rin chen byur bur bkang byas te/ /dga' rab sem kyis rgyal la phul ba bas//gang sgas tshibs bcad gcig cig sems can byin/ /rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya chen de/ /snying rje bskyed nas tshibs bcad sbyin pa la/ gang gā'i cha dang grangs su'ang mi phod na/ /lan gnyis lan gsum sems la smog la zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ngo byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang /dge slong de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te— / bcom ldan 'das kyis bsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa byams pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen 57—873

tshog /'phags pa sprun ras gzigs dbang phyug gis thus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sgyu ba /rgya gar skad du/ ātsā 3ba lo ki kate shwa ra pa ri thrats+tsha sasnya ④dhasmo ka tsā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyus gis zhus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyas 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung—3po'i ri la dargo slong stong nyis dzibargya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ngo rab tu mang po dang thabs cig tu zhugasapa3date/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang 2phyug stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa bcig tu bzar nas pus mo bayas pa'i lha nga pad ma'i lte ba la btsukas 3/te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba yider thal mo sbyar ba btud deshā / bcom ldan 'das la 'di 57nga 875

skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsabyang chub kyi sems bskyed dz+wam thag pa'i byang chub sems dpas chos du zhig la bslab par bgyi 1/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyub la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub tu 0sems bskyed ma thag 1pa'i byang chub sems dpas chos bdun la bsgab par bya ste/ bdun kang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par rtog pas kyang 'dod pa la sten par mi byed na dbang po gnyis kyis sbyor ba lta smos kyang ci dbos/ tha na rmi lam gyi nang du yang rtomi dge ba'i bshes banyen stenarwa da par mi byed pa dang / bya dang 'dra ba'i sems kyis yongs su 'dzin pa med par bya ba dang / thabs dang shes rab la mkhas pas nga rgyal dang / ngar 'dzin pa med par bya ba dang / dngos po dang dngos po med pa spangs nas stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa brtan po dang ldan par bya ba dang / yang dag par bden pa ma yin pa'i kun du rtos pa'i shes pas sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang 'dra bar 'khor ba las mngon par dba' bar bya ba ma yin pa dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu la skur pa gdab par mi bya ba ste/ risas kyi bu byang chub tu sems bskyed ma thag pa'i byang chub sems dpas 1chos bdun po de dag la bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces kabaka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyub dang / dge slong de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag yi rangs te shā bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sotsho// //57—876

chag /'phags pa sbobs pa'i blo gros kyis thus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sna ra /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pra ti bhā na ma ti ba ri dṛts+tsha che tsā ma ma hā yā na srupa tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdab yis thos pa'i khyodus gcis na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal margon med zas sbyin kagyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dke 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' khri dang thabs cigam tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor mang pos yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston to/ /de'i tshe tshong dpon sbobs pa'i blo gros zhes dzebya ba zhirga tshong dpon gyi bu lnga brgya tsam so so'i sayos 'khor ༅lnga brgya lnga brgyas yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar ba dang lhan cig tu mnyan du yod pa'i grong khyer nas byung ste/57—879

rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin tsa gyi kun dga' ra ba ga la ba dang /bcom ldan 'das sa la ba de logs su song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la maso bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas g.yoka 'khor dang bcas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros stan las langs te/ bla gos 1phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsusas 4te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces bsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bla ma'i mchog /khams gsum pa'i dam pa/ byang chub kyi bsod nams kyi lhag pa'i gzhi/ sems can thams cad nges par sgrol bar mdzad pa/ kun du khyab pa'i thabs la malas pa'i phyogs thug pa ma mchis pa nges par thob par mdzad pa labs na/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchis pa'i 3dus snyigs ma'i rnyos pa lnga dang ldan pa la dug gsum 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar la/ bcig la gcig gdung bar bgyid pa'i sems can rnams kyi nang na gang nyes par bsam pa sems pa'i dus na gtso bo ma mchis shing de gang gi yang 4ma lakas pa dang / rgyal po dang / blod po chen po rnams yul la sred pas zil gyis non ( te phan tshun mi 'thun 1 zhing bcika la gcig g.yul 'gyed4 pa dang / de dag gcib la gcis g.yul 'gyed pa na gzhan dag gi dmag gi dpung gi tshogs dang / de las kazhan pa yul gyi mi sa chab 'tshal ba rnams kyi ming yang mi gda' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi slob ma kang zag bzhi po mang po de dag kyang bstan pa 'di la 'jug cing rab tu byung ba'i tshul 'thob dza pa dang / de das kyang phyi rol gyi kos ngur smris tsam 57—880

dang —/ khong pa'i nang gi 'dun pa dang / zhe sdang dang / shin tu ma gus shing phan tshun mi 'thun (la gcig la kacis skur pa 'debs par bgyid pa dang /skyon sgrogs —par bgyid nga dang / yon tan nges par sped —par bgyid pa dang /nga rgyal dang / rgyabs pa dang / dregs pas non cing ngar 'dzin pa dang /nga yir 'dzin par bgyid pa dang / de dka shi 'phos na yang ngan song gsum du skye zhing yud tsam zhig rnyed pa'i dpal yang ma 'tshal ba dang / tshe rabs gzhan dag tu bskal pa mang por sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi bzad par/ tsub pa/ tsha ba—/ yid du mi mchi ba dka 'byung bar 'gyur ba yang mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i sbad du sems can 'di dag yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / ngan 'gro'i lam las rnam par bzlog nas bsod nams kyis zhegazhal med khang thob par bgyi ba'i chos rnams gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang — bcom ldan 'das kyis ‘tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spobs pa'i blo gros de ltar khyod seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas de bzhin gshesas pa la zhu zhing / de ltar sems can thams cad de bzhin sashegs pa la chos zhu bar spro ba skyed pa leyos so legs so/ /sbobs pa'i blo gros sems can rnams gangangathob nas legs par rab tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur zhing /nag po'i phyogs sgrub pa spangs nas dkar po'i phyogs la zhugs shing / don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba'i chos de dag khyod zhus shika zhus nas kyang the tshom ka med par nyon cig dang bshad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das las gang dag bis ni lha rnams kyi ris su skye bar 'gyur/ gang dag sis ni dumi rnams kyi ris su skye bar 57—881

'gyur— gang dag gis ni sems can dasprul ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ gang dag gis ni dud 'gro rnams su skye bar 'grur/ gang dag gis ni yi dasasashā rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ gang dag gis ni rigs mthon 1po rnams su skye bar 'gyur—/ gang dag gis ni bran dang bran mo rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das las gang dag gis ni mi rnams kyi nang du sems can skyes pa rnams skal ba bzang por 'gyur zhing khyim khol shādang ldan pa dang / kha dri bda' ba dang —/ kha dog dang ldan pa dang / mthong na dga' ba dang / gnod pa ma mchis pa dang / lus dang sems shin tu tha mal du gnas pa dang / skye bo mang pos bsngags pa rnams su 'gyur/ las gang dag gis ni sems can rnams mi'i dam pa thob nas rtag tu skur pa 'debs pa thob par 'gyur zhing / skye bo mang po mi dba' ba dang / mdog mi sduka pa dang / kha dri mi bda' ba dang ⑤/gnod pa mang ba dang / sems mi dga' ba dang / lus shin tu sbyangs pa ma lags pa dang / nyes byas kyi las thams cad bgyid par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das las gang das gis ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di la rab tu byung ba dge sbyong dang rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo nye bar zhi ba gtso bor 'dzin pa rnams kang dang ba )gang du skye ba'i ‘skye ba thams cad du ⑤rgyun du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong nas kyang de darga las ( chos thos nas yid dga' zhing ci bsams 8pa bzhin du don yang grub par 'gyur—/ bdag sgas zhu ba bcu po de dag zhus pa lags na 'byung po grangs ma mchis pa thams cad la sman pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das gsol ba ma btab 57—882

par dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ dbang dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la shālkob tu ma gyur pa'i spyan dang ldan pas rnam par phye ste rgyas par lan stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros khyod kyis ji lta bu mizhu ba zhus pa rnams rgyas par dam par bye ste bshad kyis4 nyon cigab /tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 1 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni lha nyid —thob par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ dang po byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnod pa med par sems can rnams yongs su skyong bar byed cing bzod pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ bzhan gyis kanor 'phroka par mi byed cing bkren pa'i sems dang ldan pa ma yin pas yongs su gtong bar byed pa yin/gzhan gyi chung ma la spyod pa rnams kyang yongs su dab pa ma — yin te/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams kyang srung bar byed pa yin/ gso sbyong la brtson zhing bden par smra ba yin rang bzhin du 'dug cing rang gi skyon tshad med pa sgong bar byed la myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ( ba spangs pa yin te/ las lnga popode dag dang ldan pa rnams lha'i lus thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshisas su bcad pa 'di das bka' stsal to/ /srog rtsechags gsod las ldog pa byas pas lha dang mi dang lha min rnams/ /'jig rten du ni mi thub lus can tshe ring nad med 'gyur ba yin/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa'i lus can shes7 ldan dri med rdzogs pa'i lus/ /lha nang rab mchog de yi longs spyod sna tshogs 57—883

dpal can rtag tu 'byung / /bor ma thas tu lha nang rtag tu lha yi⑪ dbang phyug rnams su 'gyur/ /bsam med bsal ba 'phro ba ka rnam log rin chen longs spyod rnams dang ldan1 /rtag tu dba' zhing rab tu yid dga' dpal ldan sazhal med lang gnas shing / /rtse zhing dga' ba'i dpag bsam 1shing gi yul na me tog gtor lus ldan/ /mkhas shing 'dod pa mi phan yongs spangs dri mchog dag pa'i lus dang ldan/ /tshe rabs kun du dpe med saser mchog lus dang ldan zhing rab tu mdzes/ /rtab tu lha yi nang du skal ba zubazang thob lus las 'od 'byung 'gyur—/ /lha mo sna tshogs tshogs kyis bskor cing 'dod pa'i dpal la spyod par byed—/ /sngon chad cho ga bzhin du ngag skyon bzhi spangs kha ni dri zhim ldan/ /gsal zhing thogs med mi 'jigs tshig mchog lha rnams 'dir ni nges par 'byung — /yang dag lan 'debs rnam bsgrasas 55snyan cing skye bos shin tu tshig gzung —'os/ /pi bang rngo rol mo 5 sgra 'byor sprin sgra skad snyan pho brang 'khor skad ldan—/ /ma rmongs sems kyis myos 'gyur ma legs rjod byed spangs pas lhar 'gyur zhing 1 /grangs med dge ba'i lha yis mchod pa lha yi gnas na ( gnas par 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan zhing lus brtan yid bzang bag yod kun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de darga rtag tu bde 'gyur dbang rnams de dag phan pa rjod ( par byed/ /gal te tshe zad lha yi yul nas lhung ba'i lha rnams de tshe smad/ /sdis med lo brgya nyi shu lon rngo na lha yi gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams lnga mngon gyur pas de ni dam pa dpal ldan lus 'od can/ /lha rnams lam sel byed cing lha rnams bye bas mchod de brtan par 'gro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros ba mas 57nga 884

can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na| dang po byas pa gzo bas sbyin pa dang / bkron pa dang / dbul po dang /sduka bsngal ba la kun bged pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam ma nyams par sten0pa dang / sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus kyis —sems can le lo can rnams dge ba'i chos la spro bar byed cing nges pa'i sems kyis gus pa dang bcas la 'thun 1 par 'dzin pa ste/spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag/ dang ldan pa rnams mi nyid 'thob par 'gyur zhing longs spyod kyang chen por 'gyur ba dang / tshe ring ba dang /mdzes pa dang / gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rje dpon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sbyin pa byin pas mi yi rgyal po dam par 'gyur/ /rtag tu longs spyod 'byor dang ldan par rab tu 'gyur/ /lus ngan po dang mtshungs par sbyin dang spyod par byed/ /rigs dang dam nga thob pas rtas tu dga' bar 'gyur 1 /tshul khrims ma nyams de ni dkon mchog mchod par byed/ /nyes byas yongs su spangs pas shin tu nges pa ste/ /tshe ring dam pa thob pas 'chi 'pho med pa yin/ /bde ba thob nga sa skyon med rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /des pa'i mi ni pha rol sems 'khrubs ma byas shing / /kazhan dab rnams kyis gnod byas phyir ni gnod mi byed/ /de bzhin tshig ngan brjod kyang gshe gebar mi byed pas/ /dge ba mchog gi tshul thob nas ni mdzes par 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus bzang la lhag pa'i bsam pas sems dkar zhing / /stobs dang gzi brjid chen po dge ba rnams dang ldan/ /dmag dpon nyid kyi dam pa thob par gyur pas na/ /57—885

longs spyod 'byor pa'i spyod yul ldan pas lha der 'gyur/ /mi 'phrog4sems ldan mkhas shing shin tu 'thun tsapa ste/ /byas pa gzo zhing las la 'dod par rab tu byed/ /dkon mchog gsum dang ma la sogs la mchod mdzangs — —pa/nam yang kun la the tsom —byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi gang khyad par 'phags pa dge ba lnga po rnams/ /byed pa de ni sa yi bdag por rab tu 'gyur/ /stobs la sogs dang gzugs dang longs spyod mi zad ldan/ /grags ldan shin tu gtso bo rnams kyis rim gro byas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes nas kyang de dag tu bskal pa bye ba mang por gnas par da'agyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog la dad par mi byed la kun du bsngags tshipa ma yin brjod pas skur pa 'debs par byed cing 'phags pa'i lam la brnyas pa dang / de bzhin gshesas pa'i mchod rten 'jig pa dang / bar gyi dus na yang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen bdang / dge bsnyen ma gang zas bzhi po mang por 1mi gus pa 'thun na par mi 'dzin pa/ 'jika rten gyi smra ba lhur len pa/ dkon mchog bsum gyi dkor 'phrob pa dang / gcig la bcig nyes rtsom gyis/ sacig la gcib sbur pa 'debs pa'i tshig gis rgyal po dang / rje dpon dang / blon po dang / pha dang / bu rnams kacig la bcig mi 'thun tshepas mi gus pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dge slong rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la zhugs te/de bzhin gshekas pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa 57—886

la brten nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ bdag nyid dge slong yin par khas 'che zhing 3 dke ba'i chos yang dag par sgrub pa la mi gnas la/mkhan po dang / slob dpon rnams mgu bar mi byed cing bka'am blo mi bde la 'thun tsapar mi 'dzin cing yang dag par rjes su bstan kyang rjes su bstan pa la sgrub par mi byed cing sangs rgyas kyi byang chub sbong bar byed la bdag la stod ④ par byed/ gzhan la smod par byed cing nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang /dregs pa'i shas che la bla ma rnams la brnyas par byed/ rnyed pa dang bkur snyi la lhag par zhen cing skur pa 'debs par byed pa ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni sems can dmyal ba rnams tshesu skye bar 'grur zhing / skyes dzinas kyang ji srid du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'jika pa ma byung 4ba de srid du gnas par 'gyur zhing | 'jig pa byung nas kyang 'jib rten gyi khams gzhan na sems can dmyal ba gang dag yod pa de dag tu 'phen par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe der yang 'jig pa byung bar gyur na/ de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi lams bzhan na sems can dmyal ba gang dag yod pa de dag tu 'phen par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/kun du 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dag na sems can dmyal ba gang dka yod pa de dag tu 'khyam zhing 2sdug bsngal nyams su myong la 'byung ba'i mtha' med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i 4 tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rmongs pas thoka ma med nas 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal bying gyur pa'i| /'jig rten sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho las len mi byed de/ /de ni kun rib ma yin rnal 'byor rgyal po ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid chud kyigazan skye 57—887

bo gzhan rnams layang slu bar byed1 /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'byor pa sdug pa'i mchos byas na/ /de ni dge ba chung 'gyur 'jig par byed pa'i char 'gyur zhes/ /mi dge 'di ni mngon sum dge ba mdun na yod bzhin du/ /'on kyang sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs kun tu spyod par byed/ /bar ma rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bzhi po bkres pas nyam thag pa/ /phan tshun 'khon 3du 'dzin pas dkrugs shing bla ma smod par byed/ /'khor du 'dus pa 'dul ba'i dga' ba 'di ni rnam bshig pas/ /mi bzad ro med log nga ra ltung ba'i sar ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po pha dang sring mo spun dang kazhon nu bu mo rnams/ /byams pa'i yid ni log grur longs spyod rnams la brkam chags te/ /byis pa bu ltar thams cad gcig la gcig ni bzhad gad byed1 /log ltung dam pa rnam par 'bying bar myur du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ma 'ongs dus 'dir bang das shin tu sdig can sems can rnams/ /'thun — pa ra mi 'dzin dge sbyong kha dog 'dzin pa sazugs mi sdug /ngan pa'i bdag nyid ldan pa sdig pa khraka khrig byed 'gyur ba/ /de dag shi 'phos nas ni sdig pa rtsod pa'i mchob bis kanon/ /mi yis bskal pa brgya phrag mang por sdig pa lnga po dgab /bsgrubs shing byas pa dka ni bshags ka par nus pa ma yin te/ /gang du sangs rgyas khras khrig bis kyang bskyab par mi spyod pa'i/ /me ri drab po mnar med pa yi mer ni sreg par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' nga pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni dud 'gro rnams su skye bar 'gyurate/lnga bang zhe na/ dang po 'chal pa'i tshul khrims dang / chom rkun dang / gzhan gyi bu lon blangs nas gnod sems su byed pa dang / sros gcod pa dang / ma 57—888

dad pas dam pa'i chos ma yin pa nyan par dga' zhing dam pa'i chos ma yin pa nyan pa la dga' bas log pas 'tsho ba thams cad la dga' ba ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dka dang ldan pa rnams ni dud 'gro rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa la dga' ba'i mi rnams ni//bu lon byin pa rnam par blangs nas mi bzhan sasod par byed/ /srog gcod pa la dba' ba'i ri dgas rngo'achi bdag rgyal po rnams/ /rgya la sogs pas bzung nas sems can rnams la bsod nga ra byed/ /dad pa la sogs dman pa'i blo gros dkar po'i 'du shes can/ /nag ngo dpag tu med pa bdag cag spyod par mi shes pa/ /zongs pa rnams ni dam chos dkon mchos gtam la dga' mi byed/ /'jib rten zhugs pa'i chos la 'dir ni rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar gangs ri las 'dir kha ba bab dang rab bab pa/ /chu ni chu yi shugs kyis 'phral du sa 'og 'gro ba bzhin/ /lha mi'i grong du sdib pa'i phung po mang du byas pas na/ /rmongs pa rnams ni de bzhin dud 'gro rjernams su myur du 'gro/ /rta dre'u rnga bong glang chen ba lang ma he seng —be dang / /wa dang sprul dang pharga dang khyi la 5༄sogs par gyur nas su/ /rtswa za ba dang sha dang bdud rtsi lo ma'i —zas za zhing / /de dab rtapo tu yozhan gyi khur khyer ‘byed cing dub par 'gyur/ /bkres pas zil 6gyis non pas bcig la gcig za lhur byed pa/ /bskal pa khras khrig rnams su'ang nam yang thar bar mi 'gyur zhing / /ji ltar rgya mtsho gcig na ru 1sbal mis ni gcig yod pas/ /gnya' shing bu gar mgrin pa btad ༅par nus pa ma yin pa/ /de bzhin lha dang mi dang dbang phyug che nyid bde blag tu/ /57—889

log par lhung sgyub brgya yis thob par nus pa ma yin te/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer dam pa'i tshogs can dpas tu med pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog 'od kyis de dag 'byin par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni yi dgas mikyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur te/ lnga bang zhe na/dang po bkron zhing chasas pa dang / mun pa mun nag chen po'i bshes gnyen dang —/ sogs —pa lhur byed pa'i phyir bdag nyid kyang longs spyod par mi byed pa dang / chos ma yin pa dang ldan pa'i phyir phrag dos dang / ser sna lhur byed pas spun dang / sring mo dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang /nye du dang / 'brel pa dang / sbyin gnas dang / dbe sbyong dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa thams cad la rab tu sbyin par mi byed cing pha ma dag la yang rab tu sbyin par mi byed pa dang / nges par bskyangamazubar 'os pa dag mi skyong la bsnyen bkur 1mi byed cing bla ma la mi gus la gces par mi byed pa ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni yi dgas dzirnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshibs su bcad pa 'di das bka' stsal to/ /bkren pa'i nyes pas bcom pa nor gtong mi phod pa/ /de dag gzhan dag las ni blang bar 'dod par byed/ /mdzod rnams kyi ni sgo 'phar dam du bsdams bapa rnams/ /'dir ni bskyang 'os rtsa lag mchob rnams gso mi byed/ /gzhan nor chud gzon pa yis rtag tu skrag pa rnams/ /bla ma la yang de dag rab rtsub byams can min/ /de dag bdag gi chung ma la 57nga 890

sogs g.yog tshogasal/ /dbyib sbyin mi byed shin tu snying brtse shes med cing / /dkar po dag las log pa de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /yun ring mchog tu lus 'bar sdug bsngal yi dgas 4'gyur/ /de dag lo brgya rnams su mi lam rmis par yang / /gos dang zas dang btung ba'ang 1nam yang mi mi 'gyur/ /khab 'dra'i kha dang ri 1chen lta bu'i lto can rnams/ /nyam thag shar dang nub kyi rgya mtshor rgyug par byed/ /kha nas me 'bar lus ngan phyob/sa dang lho phyogs rgazhan—/ /skams tsupar mthong nas rin chen me nang lhung bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i pho nya dpung mgo las grub rab stug nacing / /sra ldan rnams kyis mnan nas zangs zhun —bzod dka' rab/ /mi 'dra ro bro med pa 3de dag rnams la ldud—/ /rmongs rnams yan lag brgyad ldan chu bzhin 'thung bar byed/ /nang grol lus kyi khog pa bsregs pa bsal ba'i rlung gis su/ / skyes pa'irakabadag nyid rnams la stobs chen yang ldud byed/ /de nas shi 'phos mi yimarje7'jig rten 'dir skyes rnams/ /rigs dang longs spyod lus g.yog rnams kyis dman par 'gyur| /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' nga pa snye sgobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni ribs mthon po rnams su 7'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lha ste/ zang zing dang / chos kyi sbyin pa dag gis 'jig rten thams cad la gnod sems med par grur pa 'i dang 1 dkon mchog gsum dang / pha ma la gus pa dang / lhan cib skyes pa'i bzod papa dang / des pa dang / shin tu gya nom pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnam pa sna tshogs klog pa dang / kha ton bya ba la brtson pa ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni/ rirgas mthon 57—891

po rnams su 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i khya tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /bsam byas gang dpo bsod nams tshosas pa skal bzang sbyin pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /kun du sems can mang la kun bged de dag rtag 1 tu nad med 'gyur/ /tshe dang la dog stobs ldan lus can 'jig rten mchos/ tu 'gyur/ /mtshungs dang rgya chen khyad par can gyis mdzes mdzod rin chen ri dbang bzhin/ /'dul ba nyams dga'i dkon mchog mtshungs med pha ma rnams la bsnyen bkur bas/ /shin tu rgya chen gtso mchog khyim du skyes pa grangs med 1skye bos mchod4/ /shin tu nus kyang yid 'khrub rnam spangs kun du gzusas kyis 'phags pa rnams/ /'jika rten rnams kyi mig tu sduka pa skal bzang rigs ni mthon por 'gyur/ /gang zab brtan zhing kun bzod zi— 'in tu yid bzang dkar dang 'thun rnams dang / /mi rnams gang dag shes rab dag mchog sangs rgyas bsung la kha ton brtson/ /de dag 'byor pa thob nas ribasam — )mchog skyes pa kun du kun mchog mdzes/ /de das dge bas rgyas pas lus chen rgya mtsho chen ngo bzhin du spa/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang sbobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ sbobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni bran dang bran mo nyid 'thob ( para'agyur te/ lnga kang zhe na/ 'di lta ste—/ pha ma rnams la mi gus pa dang / gya nom pa'i sems ma yin pa dang /zlog pa med cing ci dasar sdig pa spyod pa dang / gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa dang /bu lon phrogs nas bdag sbed pa ste/ sgobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni bran dang bran mo nyid 'thob 1nyapar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshisas su bcad pa 'di dka bka' stsal to//57—8sdi)2

bsod nams rgya chen 'byor pa bangasam— 'od lta bu'i khyem du skye thob nas/ /blun po gang dag rgyags khengs dregs pas sgyudakrugs shing gus par mi byed la/ /pha 3da ma rnams la rmad chebyung sbyin gnas 'dra bar 'du shes mi byed pa/ /de dab nyes pas gzhan du 'jig rten dbang gyur dman zhing g.yon can 'grur/ /dkon mchog mtshungs med rnams la ma gus lhur byed ma rungs brlang tshig 'gyur/ /gang das byams dang de bzhin snying rje pam lus dge ba chud gzan pa/ /de dag grangs med skye bar 'dzin med gzhan 'joms ngo tsha mi shes shing / /mi yi yul du bran nyid spangs nas skad cis gisani dma' bar 'gyur/ /bzugs dang dbang phyug rirgas mchog blo bral dman la mos pa'i glen par 'gyur/ /dkon mchog rnams mapab mchod pas nga rgyal med cing zhan la mdangs ngan 'gyur/ /dpal kun med cing nying 'dzin bral ba las rnams kyis ni bsdigs par 'gyur/ /de dag 'jirga rten kun dga' dga' ston che sogs med cing tshesas kyis 'tsho/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni skal ba mobazang por 'gyur zhing —/ khyim khol dang / kha dri zhim pa dang / gnod pa med pa dang / lus dang —/ sems shin tu sbyangs pa dang / blta na sdug pa dang / skye bo mang pos bsngags pa rnams su 'gyur te/ lnga bang zhe na/ 'du shes ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag pa dang / ma tshang ba med pa dang / sgro btags pa med pa 'i tshig dang —/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / theg pa chen po dang / thes pa rnam pa yosum po thams cad kyi tshig gi rang bzhin la mi bzod pa med cing mi smod la/ mi spong zhing de thams cad gzung ba dang / bshad pa dang / bak+kag ka 57—893

nga sdu sa gshe nga /da ma gyu trī da/ ca dī / rnaX di dad / // /gaX rna wa bro bye 2 dz+wa ༷ ཿ chi / /sna ༷ /༷rngu / lnga zi rnge nga ṭ+wāṃ —rte dri kyi da ne da ri ji dzi hūṃ sdus myi / 5bye /༷/ sdo rngo // nga pa/ ༷ wa nya / rna traṃ di bye rdoX / ༷ ba/ / sa/ sdu bye ngaX

pa dang / kha ton la sogs pa byed pa dang / ngab gi skyon bzhi po tshad med pa rnam par spong zhing 'phags pa'i lam la skur pa mi 'debs pa dang / sems can log par skrub pa la sanas pa rnams la snying brtse zhing yongs su bskyang ba 1 dang / skyon de las bzlog cing dge ba la dbod pa dang / gzhan gyi skyon mthong ba'i brjod pa yal bar 'jog pa ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems pecan las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni mi rnams kyi nang du skyes nas/ skal ba mibazang por 'gyur zhing khyim khol dang ldan pa dang / kha dri zhim pa dang /yid bzhungs pa dang / 'thun zhepa dang / skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / zu ngan med pa dang / sems tha mal du gnas pa dang / khro ba med pa dang /gnod pa med pa dang / kha dog dang ldan pa dang / grabs pa dang ldan pa rnams su 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas sogs la shin tu shas —)cher gus 'bad pha ma rnams mchod pas/ /rtag tu ngab skyon kun bral 'jig rten dag tu rmad du byung dzibar 'gyur/ /tshib gi yon tan bzung 'os rnga sgrar bcas shing tshe rabs kun du phan/ /ud pal dri dang mdzes pa'i rlung ldan kha yis phyogs su snyan pa grakas / /kang dag bdag byams gzhan 1mtshungs mi phan skyon brjod (sdig pa ngan pa las/ /phral nas dge ba kun la sems can rnams ni sbyor du 'jug byed pa1 /de dag 'jig rten thob nas skal ba tshebazang po kun du thams cad dga'/ /shin tu yid 'ong rin chen yul can bde gnas sdika las log par 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung dang bstan brtson de sems byedad+ku cing des par 'gyur/ /'dir ka ni sems can kun la pha ma 'dra bar byams pa'i sems ldan 'grur/ /57—894

'das pa'i dus su lus can kun ni nged kyi rtsa lag tshogs gyur ces/ /de lta zla ba lta bu'i sems sbyangs de dag la ni phan par byed/ /'gran dregs khyad gsod la tsusogs rnam pa sna tshogs phan tshun sun 'byin pa'i/ /sdig pa yongs su spangs nas dag pa'i yid can skyon rnams kun sbas nas/ /sems can lhag pa'i bsam pa dbe bas snyan tshogs phan tshun rjod —dpar byed/ /myur du lha yi dbang phyug mtshungs med thob nas sangs rgyas dge bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni mi'i dam pa thob nas rtag tu skur pa 'debs pa thob par 'gyur zhing skye bo mang po mi dga' ba dang / kha dri mi zhim pa dang /sems mi dga' ba dang / gnod pa mang ba dang / lus shin tu sbyangs pa ma yin par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ brdzun du spru ba dang / brdzun du smra bas rtag tu gzhan slu ba'i sems lhur len pa dang / chos kyi 'bel guba'i gtam chen po la 'dus pa na chos kyi gtam de la rnam par smod pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams mthong na de dag la brnyas shing khyad du gsod pa dang /dma' ba'i sems su byed pa ste/ spobs pa'i blo gros sems can las lnga po de dag dang ldan pa rnams ni mi'i dam pa thob nas rtag tu skur pa 'debs pa thob par 'gyur zhing skye bo mang po mi dba' ba dang / mdoka mi sdug pa dang / kha dri mi zhim pa dang / sems mi dga' ba dang / gnod pa mang ba dang / lus shin tu sbyangs pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di darga bka' stsal to/ /sems yid rnams kyis gzhan sems drag tu 'khrub dang sdig pa rnams byas pas / /log pa'i ngag dang gzhan 57—895

la gnod par dga' ba tha ma rnams sems dang / /lus kyis tsapesdug bsngal kazhal med rdzogs pa bar med nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /lcags kyi lcags kyu chen po rnon po rnams kyis nyam thag lce 'byin 'grur/ /gshin rje'i dbang phyus gnas su'ang mi rnams thin tu zangs bskolam 3ldud par 'gyur/ /dmyal bar mi bden tshig can skyes pa de dag dga' bar yong mi 'gyur/ /bang tshe 'dir ni tshig bzang bral ba ro ltar la dri mi zhim zhing / /'jig rten mig tu yid 'ong blta na sdug pa ma yin rnams su 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du mi snyan skur 'debs rtsod pa'i skyon mang zhing / /de dag rtag tu skyon gnas mi ni sa ya mang pos gleng bar 'gyur/ /sems can brdzun —smra rnams kyis tha mal sems dang lus bde ma yin phyir/ /sngar bshad nyes 'gro de yi 'bras bu sdug bsngal mang po spyod par 'gyur/ /mi nyid sgangs nas dbang med mi rnams bde ba kun la slu byed pa'i/ /sems can dmyal ba'i 'jib rten 'gro 'gyur de nas shi 'phos gyur nas ni/ /'gro ba lnga po'i 'khor ba'i zu'akhor lo rtsub par dud 'gro rnams su skye//de ltar lus can 'khyam pa 8 rnams kyi sdug bsngal zad par 'gyur ba med/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang spobs pa'i blo grogro la bka' stsal pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros dge sbyong dang / rigs kyi bu dang / risas kyi bu mo nye bar zhi ba gtso bor 'dzin pa'i sems can chos lnga dang ldan pa rnams ni gang dang gang du skye ba'i skye ba de dang de thams cad du rtag par sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun dang phrad pa thob par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong nas kyang de dag las chos kyang thos nas yid dga' zhing ci bsams — pa bzhin du byang chub rnams thob par 'gyur la / ci 'dod pa 57—896

bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyang thob par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bdab nyid dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas 2gzhan dag kyang gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba sgrub pa la rnam par 'job par byed pa dang /rnam pa thams cad kun tu rdzogs shing rgyas la rgya chen po legs par byas pa'i de bzhin gshesas pa'i sku sazugs byed du 'jub pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon shes shing gus pa dang bcas pa dang / bka' 1 blo bde ba dang 'thunarwa da par 'dzin par sgrub pa dang / kun du thogs pa med pa'i 'od zer rnams pe kyis sems can thams cad bdag dang 'dra zhing bu gcis pa'i byis pa dang 'dra bar mthong ba dang / ji ltar brtsams pa'i mdo sgrub pa dang / bklag —pa dang —/ kha ton dang / lung mnod pa dang / bshad pa rnams yid la byed pa yangs shing rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag gis bar chad med par bsgom pa la mngon par zhen cing spub par byed pa ste/ sgobs pa'i blo gros dge sbyong dang /rigs kyi du dang / rigs kyi bu mo nye bar zhi ba gtso bor 'dzin pa'i sems can chos lnga po de dab dang ldan pa rnams ni gang dang bang du skyes pa'i —skye ba de dang de yothams cad du bar chad med par sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams dang mi 'bral —bar 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams zhe 3mthong das kyang / de dab las chos kyang thos nas/yid dga' zhing ci bsams sgyu pa bzhin du byang chub rnams thob par 'gyur la/ci 'dod pa bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di das bka' stsal to/ /gang dag sangs rgyas yon tan mchob gi chos la gnas/ /de dag nyid kyis 57—897
trīpa 'ag rde sdi hūṃ t+t+waṃ be | darnge ra /byerdo twe lnge — ga rna rā sdu di/ ci hūṃ /ga tho twe da/ /bye || — // sgro / rna ༷ ༷ ༷ rdo /da/ )rde /

sems can thams cad 'dul bar byed/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs gzugs lebs rnams ni byed par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams ni slob dpon tshig la mchod par byed/ /gang dag phyogs bcu rnams kyi 'jis rten ma lus la/ /bdag dang bu gcig byis pa rnams dang 'drar mthong ba/ /de dag srid (pa kun du mya ngan med nges 'grur/ /shin tu rnam dab thugs mnga' sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong —/ /sang dag shes rab rin chen chen po 'byor mdzad rnams1 /nyin dang mtshan du dge ba kun du spyod par byed1 /'dir ni rmad du byung 1ba'i 'od dang ldan pa rnams/ /'jika rten mun pa che la snang ba 1mchog byed 'gyur/ /kun du chos rnams thams cad rab tu rnam phye nas/ /sangs rgyas lam las mchog ni gzhan med par/ /nges par byas nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jika rten gyi / /mthar thus 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni shes par 'gyur/ /de nas tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros chos kyi rnam shegrangs 'di thos nas tshim zhing mgu ste/yi karangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dba' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu lnga brgya tsam po dang / so so'i g.yos 'khor lnga brgya tsam po de dag ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba thob bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'bye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa ji snyed 'dus par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyis ni ci bsams —pa bzhin gyi theg pa rnams la sems bskyed do/ /ci 'dod pa bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa yang thob cing / me tog dang / sbos dang rje/ phreng ba dang /57nga 898

gos dang / rgyan la sosas pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gtor to/ /de nas tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces sasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khams gsum pa'i bla mas chos lnga po 'di das legs par gsungs pa legs so legs so/ /chos lnga po de dag thos nas 'khor 'di yid bzhin du thams cad rdzogs par don grub par gyur lags so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyang 'di nyid thos nas 33nag po'i phyogs spangs te/dkar po'i phyogs la zhubs shing brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi —dge 'dun dang thabs cig ④ tu sang༄ —bdag gi sdum par spyan 'dren na bdag cag la thukas brtse ba'i slad du khyod kyis de ltar gnang bar mdzad du gso' / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong dpon —sbobs pa'i blo gros la thusas brtse ba'i slad du gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar rig nas tshim zhing mgu ste yi rangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dasa' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mabo bos phyag 'tshal rngote/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor 7ba byas nas g.yog 'khor dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de rang gi khyim du song nas pha ma gnyis kyi rkang pa la phyag byas te thal mo spus spug por sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum 'di ltar rga/nga 'jig rten na shin tu dkon mchog gshegs pa bla na med pa chos kyi rgyal po khams sasum pa thams cad las 'das pa brtsom ldan 'das dge slong gi marte 57—899

dge 'dun dang thabs cig 1tu sang bdag gis gdugs tshod la spyan drangs na/des kyang bdab cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du gnang lags kyis 3)mkhyen par mdzod cig /de nas sgobs pa'i blo gros kyi pha shu—ma dag yid dga' ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /ba legs so/ /khyod kyis lebs par byas so zhes mngon par ༄bstod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i las la spro bar gyur to3 / /de nas spobs pa'i blo gros kyis ༄ rang gi bachung ma pad ma g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la bsgo ba/ bzang mo khyod kyis 3bcom ldan 'das de bzhin sashegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i don du bza' ba dang btung ba ro brgya dang ldan pa mang ba dang bsod par sbyor cig /sbyar nas kyang khyim thams cad chag chas gdab pa dang / phyag dar bya ba dang /bla re shābre ba dang / dar gyi lda ldi gdags pa dang / me tog chalas( par dgram pa dang / bdug rtsespos dri zhim pos bdug par byed du bcug la/ de bzhin kashegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ṇapa'i gdan ci 'os su thing ma ste / mchod yon dang zhabs la dbul ba spyan sngar bzhag pas ⑫bcom ldan 'das dam pa de la sdod cici ces bsgo stem/ spobs pa'i blo gros mdza' bshes dang —/ blon po dang / nye du dang / rgan rabs ral sogs pa dang lhan cig 'grogs shing ji skad smras pa thams cad byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i tshamatshan mo 'das nas dge slong gi dbe 'dun dang thabs cib tu r+ṣargyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal skyed —— mos tshal chen po nas byung nas/ sems can rnams la thugs brtse bas de bzhin gshekas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi dpal rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag par bstan pa'i rol pas cho4 'phrul dang bcas pas mnyan du yod pa'i 57——900

grong khyer chen por gshegs so/ /gshegs nas kyang rim gyis sgobs pa'i blo gros kyi khyim ba la ba de logs su bzhud do/ /de nas spobs pa'i blo gros g.yog 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das bsu shānas mchod yon dang zhabs la 'bul 1 bas bcom ldan 'das kyipasnye zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das zhabs 'bringam —ba dang bcas par khyim gyi nang du gshesas te/ bcom ldan 'das ni ci 'os pa'i gdan mchog la bzhugs so/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun ni ci 'os pa la 'khod do/ /de nas spobs pa'i blo gros kyi pha ma dang /slas dang / mdza' bshes dang / blon po dang / nye du dang / rgan rabs rnams ni yid dga' zhing 'dud la/ bla ma la gus pa dang / gces parab byed pa chen ngo sa bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 1pa la 'drim 1 par rtsom mo/ /spobs pa'i blo gros ni me tog dang / spos chur bcas pas bkang ba'i ril ba thokas nas ston pa'i spyan sngar 'dug par gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe sdug bsngal ba'i grogs po gnyis shig spobs pa'i blo gros kyi khyim du phyin par gyur nas/ de gnyis las gcis ni dge 'dun gyi nang du zhugs so/ /de'i tshe dke slong thams cad la bza' ba dang / btung ba 'byor tshogs zhes ⑫ ma sprus la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rjes su thugs rang ba ma gsungs pas/de gang gis kyang ci yang ma byin nas/ de khros te phyir byung nas 'di snyam du kye ma sdug bsngal ba bdab la gang yis ci yang ma byin pa ni/ dge sbyong bdag nyid ngan pa rnams te/ sems nye bar zhi ba ma yin zhing / snying rje med la byams pa'i sems dang4 ldan pa ma yin pa das go/ /gang de dag la byin yang 'bras bu med pa de lta bu dag la sbyin par byed pa ni sbyin bdag blun po ste/ gal te 57—901

bdag rgyal por gyur na thams cad kyi mabo lcags kyi 'khor los gcad 3༄do snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de nas de'i 'og tu dge slong thams cad la bza' ba dang | bca' ba — dab 'byor tshogs zhes ṭabyas shing / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rjes su thugs rang bar mdzad pa dang / cig mishos 'ongs par gyur to/ /des ni bza' ba dang / btung ba mang ba dang / bsod pa thob nas de yi rngo rangs te/ phyir byung nas 'di snyam du kye ma sdug bsngal ba/ bdag la gang dag gis bza' ba dang / btung ba mang ba dang / bsod pa byin pa ni dge sbyong bdag nyid chen po rnams te/ snying brtse bar byed la sems nye bar zhi ba yin zhing / byams pa'i bdag nyid can dag go/ /'dis ni bdas zhag bdun du tshim par 'gyur bar byas so — / /gang 'di dag la byin na 'bras bu che ba sbyin gnas chen po 'di lta bu dag la sbyin par byed pa ni sbyin bdag chen po mkhas pa ste—/ legs so/ /gal te bdag rgyal por gyur na 4sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la pa zhag bdun du bsnyen bkur thams cad kyis rim gro byed par gyur cib snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdurgas tshod bsol nas/ bstsang sder sherngogyu ste phyaka bcabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo deng phyin chacha bza' ba dang /btung ba ma blangs pa nyid du rjes su yi rang ba rjod cigapa /de nas spobs pa'i blo gros bayog 'khor dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang dag par dga' ba dang / yang dag par kazengs 5 rtabastod pa dang / yang dag par 'dzin du gzhug pa sngon du mdzad pa'i chos kyi gtam sems can mang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs bskyed parawaṃ 57nga 902

mdzad de/ gdan las bzhengs nas bzhud de/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du gshegs nas de na bzhukas so/ /de nas sdug bsngal ba de gnyis 'khor 'khor 'khyam 'khyam stesgyu / yul bzhan zhig tu song nas pha zad tshu zad tsam gyi phyogs su nyal bar gyur to/ /der bsod nams kyi las can de la steng gi nam mkha' la grib ma'i don du sprin gyi bla re 1 glog dang rlung 'byung ba dang bcas pa rab tu gnas par gyur to/ /de'i tshe yul de na rgyal po gang yin pa de 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /de na gang rgyal srid la dbang bskur bar bya ba'i rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa yang gzhan med do/ /de na tshong dpon dang / grong mi dang / yul mi dang | blon po chen po dang / blon po dang / sgo ba dang / 'khor 1na 'khod pa rnams ni/ mtshan mkhan dang / ltas mkhan dang / skar ma dang /gza' spyod pa la mkhas pa la zargyal por 'gyur pab su yod ces brtson par gyurapa ba cing 'dri'o/ /des smras pa/ skyes bu dbul po mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yod do —/ /de ni rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rgyal po la 'os pa rin thang che ba'i khri stan bzang po kaser gyi rkang rten dang bcas pa dang / yu ba nor bu las byas pa'i gdugs dkar po dang / yu ba gser las byas shing nono bu dang ldan pa'i rnga ma'i bsil yab dang / spos chus bkang ba'i bum pa du ma dang / me tog dang / rgyan phreng dang / gos dang /dbu rgyan dang / thod dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i rgyan dang / sbos kyi phur rtse ma dang / slo tsam dag thogs te/ sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / glu dbyangs dang bcas pa dag dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor nas byung ste/ kun nas de kun tu btsal to/ /ltas mkhan des sprin gyi tshogs kyis bkab pa'i 2 57—903

phyogs de mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang de dag la smras pa/ 4 grogs po dag khyed cag gis sprin sngon —ka po'i dkyil 'khor gyis khebs pa dga' zhing gsal ba'i phyogs de mthong ngam/ de dag gis smras pa/ grogs po mthong ngo / /des sprus pa / de na rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de 'dug ste/ de'i bsod nams kyi las kyis grib ma'i don tu sprin de dag 'dus so/ /de nas de dag der dong nas/ sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs kyi sgras sbran te — btud nas de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dbang bskur ba bzhes la rgyal por grur cig /des smras pa—/ kho bo lta bu rgyal po'i 'os ga la yin/ de dag this smras pa/ bsod nams kyi las can khyod/ de skad ma 1zer bar gdon mi za zi bar rgyal po bya dgos so/ /smras pa/ de bzhin du gyur cig /de nas de dag gis mal gyi rkang rten la rkang pa bzhag 5)pa de stan bzang po la 'dug tu bcus 3nas/bkra shis thams cad kyis rgyas par byed cing dbang basbur te/ dbu rgyan dar thod can la sokas pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan nas/ shing rta'i masopa— logs su bdugs chen po bsgreng ste/ btsugs 1shing yu ba gser las byas pa/ nor bu can gyi rnga ma'i bsil yab dag gis g.yob cing / lha rgyal bar gyur cib /rgyal bar gyur cig ces kun nas mngon par bstod de/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor khrid do/ /de nas rgyal po'i shing rta de bsgyur baba'i 'khor los bkren pa cigam shos gnyid log pa'i mgo chad do/ /de nas bsod nams kyi las can de yang rgyal srid la gnas par gyur to/ /de'i rgyal srid de yang / yams kyi nad tshedang —/ gnod pa med pa dang / 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang —/ lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang bar gyur to/ /57—904

rgyal po'i ming gis yon tan thams cad 'byor cing ldan par gyur la/ dga' dgur 3 spyod pa de 'di shesnyam du 'di gang 1)gi mthu yin/ bdas gi rgyal srid skal ba 4bzang po dang ldan pa 'di 1gang gis byung bar gyur —snyam pa dang /de sangs rgyas kyi mthus sngon 4 gyi las mngon par 'du rngo byas pa de thams cad rjes su dran no/ /yang dag par dran nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sems can mang po gzhan rnams la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ tshur gshegs su gsol zhes pho nya zhib btang ngo / /pho nya btang ( nas kyang / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi bar dang / rang gi khyim gyi bar du bar der bcom ldan 'das kyi thams cad dang ldan pa'i lam chag chag btab cing | phyag dar byas te/ me tog chal par bkram nas/ gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rta babs btsugs shing pog phor dag gis bdugs banas mngon par brgyan te1 bcom ldan 'das kyang de la thugs brtse ba'i sgad du gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal po de grong khyer kyi mi dang / yul mi dang bcas shing / blon po chen po dang / blon po dang / sgo ba dang /'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pas bsu'o/ /des rtabacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la me tog dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / bye mas bsgos pa'i slo shem dpag tu med pas mchod de/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i zhabs la lus thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal che nas/ 'khor dang bcas te bcom ldan 'das la bla ma la gus pa dang / gces par byed pa chen po mchog gis r+ṣa bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi rdzudage 'dun dang thabs cig shātu rang gi khyim gyi nang rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skyed 8 mos tshal chen 57nga 906

pos yongs su bskor bar gshegs su kasol nas/ zhag bdun du bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gro byas so/ /de nas rgyal po des bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol nas/ bstsang misder gyum ste/ phyag bcabs par rig —nas/chos mnyan pa'i phyir bayog 'khor dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das kyi )spyan sngar 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces kyangapazhegasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dma' ba — dang / dbul ba lags na/ bdag gi rgyal srid phun sum tshogs pa 'di ga las mchis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nga pa/ rgyal po chen po mnyan du yod pa'i grong khyer chen po na tsu/ sbyin bdag chen po spobs pa'i blo gros zhes —bya ba zhib yod de/ des dus gzhan zhig na rang gi khyim du/sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdusas tshod gsol to/ /de nas der sdug bsngal ba gnyis shig lhasas zhes tsa)bya ba nas rgyas par snga ma bzhin te| gcig gi mgo khyed rngokyis shing rta'i 'khor los chod tshipa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o—/ /de yang shi 'phos nas/ sems can dazul bar skyes te/ der skyes pa de'i mgo skad cis skad cig la skyes so cob na/ lcags kyi 'khor lo 'bar bas bcad do/ /de yang de nas bskal pa bye bas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis ni rgyal po'i dpal thob ste/ bdag de lta bur gyur nas/ sangs rgyas lalosorgas pa dge slong gi dge 'dun zhag bdun du gdugs tshod gsol bar gyur cig ces khyod kyisakusmon lam btab ste khyod kyi bsam pa de yang rdzogs so/ /de phyin cad r+ṣa ni tshe rabs dpag tu med pa thams cad duwaṃphun sum tshogs pa ches khyad par du 'phags pa dag 'thob ྾par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshibs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' nga to/ /'jig rten nag po 'byung ba'i 57—906

phyir / /yid ni dug gi rtsa ba yin/ /nyes par smra rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ /kha ni sdig pa'i sgo nyid do/ /sems kyis sgyusna tshogs sems par byed/ /de nas tshig tu smra bar 'gyur/ /ngag yid dag gis sdig byas pa/ /lus skyes kasdug bsngal sbyin par byed/ /phan dang mi phan ma bsamasar1par/ / blo gros medaXpas ⑤sdig byed pa/ /des na sdub bsngal snod 'gyur te/ /nyon mongs pa dag de ltar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi mgo bo dag /yid kyis gcod par 'dod pa de/ /blo gros ngan pa mi shes pa'i/ /mgo ni 'khor los yang dag chodashā / /dpal ldan yid 'di kho nas nim/ /chos dkar bdud rtsi rten pa yi/ /sems can bsod nams byas dge rnams/ / lha yi — 'jig rten rnams su khrid/ /'dir ni snying gis kun bsams tshenas/ /tshig tu rjod—smopas lergas smras pa/ /de phyir de ni lus kyis su/ /bsod nams mdzod ni len par 'gyur/ /mi yis blo ni sngon btang ste/ /las dge mi dge rnams bye nas/ /gal te bsod nams che byed na/ /rtag tu rab tu lha der 'gyur/ /sems kyis mi dge ba yiwaṃlas/ /rtag tu yongs su spangs nas ni/ /rab tu dga' bas bsod nams nyid/ /mi yis bya ste sdig pa min/ /tshe rabs bye ba grangs med par/ /'khor los sgyurad+ku sobs go 'phang gi/ /lha bami'i nang durgyal po'i dpal/ /thams cad thob nas khyod bzhin no/ / mi yi mdabang phyug dus kun du/ /srid rnams snying po med shes nas/ /khyod kyis sangs rgyas chos rnams la/ /mngon par brtson pa mtha' yas bya⑫/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po des yang dag phul gyi chos bstan pa 'di thos nas/ mchog tu yid byung ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas rgyunakhedu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /gzhan stong phrag mang po zhig gis ni/57—907

bcom ldan 'das mthong ba dang / chos mnyan ༅pas lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa 1 sna tshogs thob par 'byur ba dang / thar pa'i cha dang 'thun snyepa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed chodo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis der gang sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa de thams cad rgyas par mdzad nas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du byon te/ gtsug lag khang gi skyabs 5shika tu/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi nang du/ sangs rgyas kyi gdan bshams bapa nyid la bzhugs nas/tshe dang ldan pa kun dasa' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zung shibarto /chongs shig /lhogs shis /gzhan dag la yang ku / rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am—/ rigs kyi bu mo/ /gang su dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin par byed pa/ de thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang das par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa las/ ji ltar smon — lam btab pa'i theg pa rnams la lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming—ci lags/ ci ( ltar gzung tshobar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni/ las rnam par 'byed pa bstasta pa zhes bya bar shāsnye zung shigami /tshong dpon sbobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigaka /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /dke slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' 8de dag dang / tshong midapon spobs pa'i blo gros g.yob 'khor dang bcas pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 57——908
